demos.name: Nomad Drive Demo
demos.short_description: Repair your rundown RV and hit the road solo or in 1–4 player co-op through a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world. Gather resources, customize your RV, and survive as long as you can.

highlights.trailer_name: Nomad Drive: Official Gameplay Overview Trailer

demos.name: Invokyr Demo
demos.short_description: A co-op survival horror game about a cursed board game. Play with up to 3 friends. Roll the dice, survive the horrors that are summoned, and beat the Gamemaster to win your freedom.

demos.name: Casualties: Unknown Demo
demos.short_description: Casualties: Unknown is an unforgiving cave-exploration survival simulator. Your captors have tasked you with retrieving lost cargo on a foreign planet, explore its 5 layers and do your best to survive diverse hostile environments. You are just one of the thousands of test subjects sent to die.

demos.name: Cozy Game Restoration Demo
demos.short_description: Cozy Game Restoration is a soothing simulator where you gently bring forgotten video game cartridges back to life. Tear wrapping paper, peel old stickers, lift away grime, and transform dusty relics into cherished collectibles. No pressure or failure, just the quiet joy of restoring memories.

demos.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword DEMO
Maid Cafe Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Your first shift starts here! Run a maid café with two kemonomimi maids, make drinks, serve customers, and handle troublemakers in this first-person management demo. Reach café level 10 and get to know your new team.

demos.name: Chained Beasts Demo
demos.short_description: Chained Beasts is a 1-4 player co-op gladiator roguelite. Fight chaotic battles in the Colosseum while chained to your friends. Brave physical and mental injuries that change how you play. Entertain the blood-thirsty crowd by unleashing your inner beast.

demos.name: Car Mechanic Simulator 2026 - Single Player Demo
demos.short_description: Car Mechanic Simulator 2026 Single Player Demo

demos.name: IRON NEST: Heavy Turret Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: IRON NEST is a brutal dieselpunk heavy-artillery game where you dominate the battlefield through a colossal war machine. Take map measurements based on the received coordinates, strain the hydraulics, and gunlay the cannons to unleash devastating blows ⟹ Will you obey High Command, Operator?

demos.name: No Such Place Demo
demos.short_description: Welcome to the Unknown Research Consortium (U.R.C.), where you’re tasked with conducting reconnaissance missions, terminating unknown threats, gathering crucial information, and reaching the evacuation point in this treacherous top-down extraction shooter.

demos.name: VHOLUME Demo
demos.short_description:
Try a first slice of Robert’s bureaucratic quest through the derelict capital of Afro-Eurasia.

The demo includes 4 levels, multiplayer, shortcuts, and a few surprises.

Run, jump, climb, slide, and exploit momentum as you search for the fastest route.

demos.name: Deep Dish Dungeon Demo
demos.short_description: A survival exploration game where you navigate through a puzzly hand-crafted dungeon, with metroidvania and crafting elements. Unravel the enigmas of the dungeon’s depths solo or online co-op multiplayer.

demos.name: Cat Mail Co. Demo
demos.short_description: Run a cozy cat post office. Sort and deliver parcels from the daily boat, organizing everything your way. At night, the moon reveals hidden truths about packages. Clear a strange backlog, help locals, and unlock new abilities and destinations.

demos.name: Dust Front RTS Demo
demos.short_description: Dust Front is a classic RTS with 4X/grand strategy elements. In this demo, you will try out the RTS side: lead a triumphant siege of an industrial city. Command strike groups and crush one of two enemy factions.

highlights.trailer_name: Dust Front RTS - Next Fest trailer

demos.name: Project: Doors Demo
demos.short_description: The Project: Doors Demo lets you play the opening chapters as your squad explores a shifting maze of anomalies, puzzles, and deadly creatures. Meet strange characters tied to the Labyrinth and uncover the mystery behind the Doors-and see if you can escape.

demos.name: Dupery: A Game of Solo Deduction Demo
demos.short_description: The demo for Dupery! A solo deduction roguelite with over 175 roles, set in a noir city run by a criminal syndicate. Investigate everyone, make arrests and protect your reputation. Take down the syndicate and don’t get duped like the rest. Everyone is a suspect, trust no one. No friends required.

demos.name: Demon Bluff Demo
demos.short_description: The cards lie! In this single-player social deduction game, demons have infiltrated your village and disguised themselves as allies. Every card you turn over is either a friend or a foe. Can you see through their bluff?

demos.name: Trees Hate You Demo
demos.short_description: Hike through the worst forest full of the most horrible trees. Do not trust them. The trees will trick you. They will bully you. They will hurt you. If only you could find an axe...

demos.name: Boba Cafe Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: You’re reborn—back at the beginning of your startup journey. In your last life, poor management led to your shop being crushed by competitors. This time, the sweet scent of condensed milk runs through your veins, and you’re set on one goal: turn “Bingbao” into the top name in the industry.

demos.name: Pizza House Simulator🍕 Demo
demos.short_description: Cook authentic pizzas, manage your kitchen, serve impatient customers, and experience the first taste of Pizza House Simulator. The full game will expand into automation, customization, disasters, economy systems, and restaurant empire building.

demos.name: WheelMates - Friend's Pass
demos.short_description: Grab a friend and race into a co-op driving adventure as two tiny RC cars. Explore the professor’s home laboratory, solve puzzles across oversized locations, find hidden paths, and uncover what really happened inside.

demos.name: Friendly Steps Demo
demos.short_description: A physics-based 1-4 player co-op disaster about getting home after a wild night out. It was a fun night! Now grab your buddies and walk home. IF YOU REMEMBER HOW.

demos.name: Eggstreme Farming Demo
demos.short_description: Build your dream egg farm by raising animals, collecting eggs, managing resources, and expanding your production in a relaxing first-person farming experience.

demos.name: Hot Meals Fast Wheels Demo
demos.short_description: A co-op cooking game where small mistakes quickly turn into chaos. Go shopping, cook in your food truck, and drive through the city to deliver orders on time.

demos.name: Barfender Demo
demos.short_description: Barfender is a chaotic co-op bar sim where you pour drinks, clean disasters, stop fights, and try to keep the bar alive while everything falls apart. Build the place, serve the crowd, survive the night.

demos.name: Mortal Shell II - Open Beta
demos.short_description: Step into the ravaged world of Mortal Shell II and begin the Harbinger’s journey. Play the opening three hours of the game in this limited Open Beta, with select progress carrying forward into the full release.

demos.name: Airport Control 27 Demo
demos.short_description: Airport Control is a next-generation 3D ATC simulation. Take the positions at airports worldwide—marshalling taxis, sequencing departures, and spacing arrivals. Remember: Safe, orderly, expeditious.

demos.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 Demo
demos.short_description: Obliterate heretics in the name of the Emperor in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2! Play as Ultramarine Malum Caedo or Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath in this sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun with MORE enemies, MORE weapons, and NEW ways to purge!

demos.name: Bills Must Be Paid Demo
demos.short_description: You're broke, smash piggy banks, bills must be paid. A short active incremental game. Get money, upgrade, and get debt free!

demos.name: Ore Factory Squad ⛏️ Demo
demos.short_description: Ore Factory Squad Demo is a co-op mining and factory-building game with procedural mining and fun at its core! Play alone or with friends, buy properties, dig deep for valuable resources, complete contracts, upgrade and automate production lines and grow your factory from zero to industry!

highlights.trailer_name: Ore Factory Squad - Release Date Trailer

demos.name: Sovereign Tower Demo
demos.short_description: Play as the Sovereign of a magical tower in this story-rich, Round Table management RPG. Recruit eccentric Knights, assign quests and balance egos whilst carving out your kingdom's destiny. If destiny doesn’t go your way, keep turning back time, uncover secrets and rewrite fate again and again.

demos.name: Don’t Pull Me! Demo
demos.short_description: Dont Pull Me is a physics-based co-op parkour game for 1 to 4 players. Tied together by a rope, you and your friends must climb, swing, carry objects, and survive chaotic ragdoll disasters without dragging the whole team down.

demos.name: Urbexophobia Demo
demos.short_description:
Urbexophobia is a survival horror game for 1 to 4 players.
Survive. Loot. Escape… AND BET IT ALL AT THE CASINO!

demos.name: Secret Glory Hole Demo
demos.short_description: In an abandoned bathroom waits a hungry female mouth; wet, eager, and downright sinister. Dare to feed it? — SHORT NAUGHTY SPOOKY VISUAL NOVEL · 26k words · 12 endings (in some you might even survive).

demos.name: Project P.I.T.T. Demo
demos.short_description: Feed rubber ducks to a corporate void. Build physics contraptions. Chain combos for profit as the Maw grows hungrier... and larger. Brutalist PSX satire meets first-person sandbox chaos.

demos.name: Legion Breaker Demo
demos.short_description: A short active incremental game about defending from undead hordes. Wield an arsenal of spells, raise a holy army, and fight across ever-expanding battlefields. Start from nothing and progress through a massive skill tree to become the ultimate battlemage.

demos.name: Click the Button Demo
demos.short_description: Click the Button is an incremental game about clicking a button to receive chests that deliver incredible rewards. Improve your skills to become the strongest.

demos.name: Leafy Corner Demo
demos.short_description: Run a cute little plant shop in this cozy and relaxing game. Grow, sell, and care for a variety of real-life plants, help customers find their dream plants, complete orders, and customize your cozy shop just the way you like!

demos.name: Scapewatch: Idle MMO Demo
demos.short_description: 30 skills. Three combat styles. Clans, raids, hiscores, pets, capes. Set up your queue, close the tab, come back richer. Scapewatch is the idle MMO for people who actually like the grind.

demos.name: Solo Cultivation 独修 Demo
demos.short_description: Xianxia inspired Cultivation game. Cultivate, farm materials, learn manuals, craft pills and equipments, hunt monsters and fight bosses!

demos.name: VOID DIVER: Escape from the Abyss Demo
demos.short_description: Manage 'BALUSHA' antique shop in an anomalous city. Command 'Divers' into the abyss to recover artifacts from city dungeons. Survive and escape alive in this high-quality pixel art extraction action RPG. Face bizarre threats alone or with friends.

demos.name: Shipping Store Simulator 2037 Demo
demos.short_description: Run the logistics center of the future! Hire robots, deliver packages, automate routines, and become the biggest package pickup place in sunny Cranelock.

highlights.trailer_name: Shipping Store Simulator 2037 - Release Date Announcement Trailer

other_trailers.trailer_name: Shipping Store Simulator 2037 - Official Cinematic Trailer

demos.name: Speak Demo
demos.short_description: Call in secret, strike deals, spread lies, and trust no one as you fight for control of the city. (Play with up to 6 players in the demo.)

demos.name: Wheel Make It Demo
demos.short_description: One wheelchair. Two players. Infinite chaos. Solo or co-op physics-based game about teamwork, clumsiness, and the unstoppable power of friendship.

demos.name: The Guild 1 Remake: Europa 1410 Demo
demos.short_description: Forge your path to power in medieval Europe. Choose your profession and master trade, politics, and intrigue to climb the social ladder and found a dynasty. Secure your legacy and dominate history in this immersive economic simulation.

demos.name: Gold Mining Simulator 2 Singleplayer Demo
demos.short_description: Take control of powerful heavy machinery in this realistic gold mining simulator. Excavate the Alaskan soil, build and maintain washplants, and pan for riches. Balance your resources, manage tailings, sell your extracted gold, and upgrade your gear to join the gold rush!

other_trailers.trailer_name: GMS2 Full Game Cinematic Trailer - ENG - VO

demos.name: Frutiger Home Demo
demos.short_description: Decorate your dream frutiger home in this cozy co-op frutiger aero house decorating game. Pick a home layout, add from a wide range of frutiger-themed decor and hang out with your friends!

demos.name: Hull Rupture Demo
demos.short_description:
If the ship stops, humanity ends.

Manage a spaceship, treat puny humans as resources, and repel relentless alien assaults in a base-management tower-defense roguelite where every choice seemed reasonable at the time.

demos.name: Woodo Demo
demos.short_description: Woodo feels like a 3D coloring book you can touch, a relaxing tale told through handcrafted wooden dioramas. No pressure, just a cozy world that remembers what it felt like to be a child.

demos.name: GrassChopper Demo
demos.short_description: Swing your scythe, earn coins, and spend them on a variety of upgrades to cut deeper into the overgrowth. An incremental action game about pushing further than anyone has gone before

demos.name: Dimenshot Demo
demos.short_description: Dimenshot is a melee-focused boomer shooter FPS set in distinct worlds, each representing one of the Seven Deadly Sins with its own unique theme. Melee combat is central, ranged weapons are supportive. Play fast and aggressive; combine parkour with combat.

demos.name: Endacopia Demo
demos.short_description: Endacopia is a Point-and-Click Puzzle Adventure that is visually reminiscent of early computer edutainment games... with underlying horrors.

demos.name: Pixel Gun 2 Demo
demos.short_description: Fast-paced multiplayer shooter with destructible arenas, wild builds, and matches that never play the same. Break the map, adapt on the fly, and outplay your opponents in short, chaotic PvP battles.

demos.name: Database Detective: Minor Crimes Division Demo
demos.short_description: Solve criminal cases through the power of SQL queries! Help out the city of Los Zorangeles by becoming a Database Detective in this new (unpaid) work from home opportunity.

demos.name: Echo Weaver Demo
demos.short_description: A time loop metroidbrainia where time is your best resource and secrets are your only upgrades. You're the last of the Weavers, a remnant of a ruined society trapped in a glitching time loop. Explore what remains. Uncover the mystery. Perfect the loop.

demos.name: Magical Girl Yusya-chan and the Labyrinth of Lust Demo
demos.short_description:
Everyone's favorite idol "Yusha-chan" stars in a new turn-based roguelike!
Conquer deep dungeons, grow stronger, and seize victory, or taste a brutal defeat! Guide Yusha-chan, brought to life with fluid Live2D animations, to her destiny. Streamers welcome!

demos.name: Moka Love Relive♪ Demo
demos.short_description: A Live2D simulation packed with H-scenes! We've achieved next-generation cross-section expressions with an unparalleled "raw" feeling of the vaginal folds and "orgasm faces" that look like they're straight out of a manga, all in Live2D!

demos.name: Zenith Expanse Demo
demos.short_description: Play the opening hour of a living space colony survival sim. Wake your crew, secure water and food, build your first fragile settlements, and survive 50 Sols on a compact 30-star map.

demos.name: 星渊勇者 StarAbyss Heroes Demo
demos.short_description: Torn by an ancient cataclysm, the world lies in ruins. In this ARPG, play a hero exploring relics, looting treasures, forging weapons, and mastering skills on a decaying yet fantastical journey.

demos.name: OFFBEAT Demo
demos.short_description: OFFBEAT is a music-tycoon game where you build the recording studio of your dreams. Collect and upgrade increasingly strange musical objects, complete jobs for cash, and record real, actual music.

demos.name: Pathogenic Demo
demos.short_description: You are a disease. Infect the human body as a lone pathogen in this cellular roguelike shooter. Collect organelles to evolve your parasite in a microscopic arms race against your host's immune system. Conquer a beautiful, procedurally generated world of tiny proportions.

demos.name: Echoes of Aincrad DEMO Version
demos.short_description: Step into Aincrad, a world of beauty and danger where every battle could be your last. This Demo version allows you to play the Beta Test chapter. Save data from the demo can be carried over to the full version.

demos.name: Shroom and Gloom Demo
demos.short_description: The Shroom and Gloom demo drops you into a weird and moody double-deckbuilding roguelike. Build two distinct decks, battle through 26 handcrafted tunnels, and face off against spore-swarming enemies and biome bosses.

demos.name: Cozy Builder Demo
demos.short_description: Build, design, and decorate your dream château in a cozy vineyard valley. Live among your creations, harvest grapes from sunlit vineyards, and craft artisanal wine blends in a relaxing sandbox builder where every home helps restore beauty and balance to the countryside.

demos.name: The Message from Deep Space Demo
demos.short_description: Mission: Translate an interstellar message, using the universal languages of math & science.

demos.name: Corsair Cove Demo
demos.short_description: Build a sprawling pirate haven, raise a fleet to explore the high seas, and take on the Crown to keep the Age of Piracy alive! From ale to flintlock pistols, and from scallywags to swashbucklers, you’ll need to manage complex production chains and govern a rowdy crew to reign supreme over the seas!

demos.name: Maldhalla Demo
demos.short_description: Just one more minute. Play Maldhalla free in this demo: hold out against endless enemies with 3 characters and 9 weapons and no time limit. Scores go on the same seasonal leaderboard as the full game, which has 21 characters and 32 weapons.

demos.name: Vampire Mistress Demo
demos.short_description: Obey your mistress… or betray her? A dark, erotic point-and-click fantasy. Manage a cursed castle, explore a cozy village, seduce forbidden women, and uncover vampire secrets.

demos.name: Welcome to Elderfield Demo
demos.short_description: Welcome to the Elderfield demo, a cozy horror RPG with hand-drawn art and dark lofi music. Manage your farm, befriend or romance the locals, investigate mysteries, decorate your home, fight terrifying creatures, fish, cook, seek the Old Gods, die in your sleep, and more...

demos.name: My Princess is The AV Idol Demo
demos.short_description: Can viral traffic defeat an empire? In this management sim, lead a fallen princess to build an adult media empire and fund the frontlines. Balance stamina, scout trends, and survive random events to save your home. Every choice counts—turn views into soldiers and reclaim your kingdom!

demos.name: Chess: Three Kingdom Demo
demos.short_description:
The Han Dynasty withers as warlords rise in fury.
Command your legions, deploy your formations amidst the clash of steel, and make your moves as the winds of war shift. Tear through enemy lines with iron and blood. Seize cities, break the stalemate, and claim the world!

demos.name: As One We Survive Demo
demos.short_description: This demo features an early-game slice of As One We Survive: Survival Mode. Survive, scavenge, fight, and claim your first homestead across four in-game days. Early Access will expand progression, homestead development, and community management systems.

demos.name: My Fire Is Bigger Than Yours Demo
demos.short_description: Grow a tiny fire until it's bigger than the Sun! A short incremental game about throwing things into a fire, experimenting with builds, and creating chaotic chain reactions.

demos.name: Loot List: Thief Simulator — DEMO
demos.short_description: Rise from pauper to master thief - grab the loot list and get to work, whether it’s a roadside diner or a federal vault: slip past security and make fools of everyone, or unleash chaos and blow the place apart. Fence the haul to upgrade the hideout, gear up, and build your criminal empire.

demos.name: Life, the Universe, and Restaurants Demo
demos.short_description: Run your own restaurant in a bizarre universe! Cook for the gods; deploy robot and build automated production lines. Experiment with different builds to win over divine appetites. Earn massive profits and create the #1 restaurant in the universe! Tip: Your chef's knife isn't just for cooking…

demos.name: Symphony of the Serpent Demo
demos.short_description: Symphony of the Serpent is the latest thrilling chapter in the NLT saga, where a mysterious sex virus sweeps across the globe, setting the stage for the war between Heaven and Hell to reignite. As the otherworldly forces rise, humanity's fate hangs in the balance.

demos.name: Poly Fighter Demo
demos.short_description: Poly Fighter is a single-player roguelike fighting game. Learn new moves from every opponent you defeat to build your fighter’s unique style. Battle through tense retro-arcade duels with beginner-friendly controls to master your moveset and claim your title! Meet 4 playable characters in this demo!

demos.name: Backyard Baseball Demo
demos.short_description: Step up to the plate with Backyard Derby, a demo from the new Backyard Baseball game. This fun new mode features fast and competitive gameplay for single player or two player head-to-head. Backyard Baseball launches July 9th - wishlist now!

demos.name: Moonlight Peaks Demo
demos.short_description: Experience life as a vampire in Moonlight Peaks! Master the art of potion-making and spell-casting, tend to your supernatural farm, and make your mark on the magical town. Befriend the local werewolves, witches and mermaids, and maybe even find eternal love along the way.

demos.name: DDoD Demo
demos.short_description: DDoD is a solo and co-op action-shooter RPG with gunplay that feels right and charming mutants you’ll love, or hate. Explore a massive open world above and underground. Don’t get charmed; get to work and cleanse the Purple Lands!

demos.name: Growing My Manhole Demo
demos.short_description: Consume the universe, grow from Manhole to Black Hole in this insatiable incremental game.

highlights.trailer_name: Growing My Manhole Demo Launch Trailer

demos.name: Legion Was Here Demo
demos.short_description: Steal a face. Study a life. Survive the conversation.

demos.name: Anomalous Cleaning Detail Demo
demos.short_description: A relaxing first-person cleaning simulator where you scrub, vacuum, and restore a troubled town plagued by supernatural disturbances. Complete contracts and use environmental clues to prepare for the exorcism, because when the mess is paranormal, a standard clean won't be enough.

demos.name: Desktop Explorer Demo
demos.short_description: Rummage through the abandoned profiles of an old PC to unravel an inherited mystery. What secrets hide in this eerie adventure of cryptic games and outdated software? Who was using this computer? And what happened to them? Can you complete this demo?

demos.name: The Sinking City 2 Demo
demos.short_description: Set in the Roaring '20s, The Sinking City 2 is a survival horror steeped in Lovecraftian dread. Defy an eldritch deity and explore the drowned alleys of Arkham, stalked by the dead, as you weigh one life against an entire city.

demos.name: Swarm Bunker: Lust Defense Demo
demos.short_description: Command firepower, shred the swarm! In this adult pixel TD, build and upgrade defenses to rain destruction. Your reward: hot "service" from three squadmates. Unlock dynamic H-scenes—let adrenaline and lust explode! This is a man's battle!

demos.name: MagiScapes Demo
demos.short_description: Magiscapes is a AI sandbox adventure game. Build your camp and an AI companion, forging a unique bond through interactions. (The demo offers Plains and Cave maps with four NPCs and the option to recruit an AI ally. It also features a beginner's guide and initial quests.)

demos.name: Big Dig Demo
demos.short_description: Big Dig is a short incremental narrative game about digging up artifacts to help Mayor Dog win the election! Recover artifacts, grow your museum, and upgrade your tools while building a highway spanning the entire Animal Republic!

demos.name: GemCraft - Legacy Collection Demo
demos.short_description: Try out the first few levels of the first three games of the best tower defense franchise of all time!

demos.name: Sublight Demo
demos.short_description: Sublight is a space bullet heaven roguelike, where you captain a powerful warship and carve through escalating waves of enemies. Upgrade your arsenal, unlock new ships, and experiment with countless builds to dominate the battlefield.

demos.name: About Fishing Demo
demos.short_description: Cast your line into calm waters and feel the quiet pull beneath the surface. Each cast brings rewards, but some things you reel in were never meant to be found.

demos.name: The Plant Shop Demo
demos.short_description: A cozy horror game where you craft plants for late-night customers while you manage a small plant shop. Expand your plant collection, upgrade your shop & grow your business.

demos.name: DarkBazaar Demo
demos.short_description: DarkBazaar is a caseopening roguelike where you trade illegal weapons on the dark web to pay off a debt... or die.

demos.name: Veterans: Napoleonic Wars Demo
demos.short_description: Command history and turn the tides of war in this real-time strategy experience. Quick decisions and keen tactical formations are the only things that stand between your troops and victory during the Napoleonic Wars. A regiment that survives today is your elite force tomorrow.

demos.name: False Hero Demo
demos.short_description: False Hero is a fast-paced soulslike adventure where you steal your enemies’ attacks and chain them into deadly combos. Explore the corrupted Land of the Gods and put your combat skills to the true test in challenging boss fights. Will you fight for the Gods or become an apostle of Death?

demos.name: Burn With Me Demo
demos.short_description: Burn With Me is a story-centric deckbuilder filled with cozy dread and occultic mysteries. In order to summon a Personal Demon you'll master inventive gameplay with position-based synergies, and permanently burn your cards and your soul.

demos.name: Sniper Dan Demo
demos.short_description: Get ready to play an outrageously funny, family-friendly 3D Hidden Object game with a big twist. In this demo, use a high-powered sniper rifle to solve low-stakes problems. No violence. Just wholesome chaos and good intentions!

highlights.trailer_name: Sniper Dan | Aiming to Please - Gameplay Explainer

demos.name: Washington Prime Demo
demos.short_description: Step into the shoes of former special agent turned real estate agent Blake Kincaid, dragged back into the game to save a friend. Fight your way through office buildings in downtown Washington D.C., October 1998, and uncover what happened over the course of one long night.

demos.name: Land of Glarefall Demo
demos.short_description: An action-adventure survival game where every night could be your last. Explore a vast, dangerous world where survival depends on smart resource management, tactical combat, and what you choose to do before night falls.

demos.name: 师姐别急，我抽卡就变强 Demo
demos.short_description: Don't worry, senior sister. I draw cards to make Dome stronger. It's a card game that allows players to possess themselves in card battles

demos.name: Above the Immortality Realm 九界之上 Demo
demos.short_description: Mo Sheng is an ordinary cultivator who was often bullied and could never surpass the favored genius, Xiao Tianyu. After obtaining an ancient artifact that steals fortune, he swears revenge—taking the women around Xiao Tianyu and seizing his destiny to rise as the supreme ruler. (DEMO)

demos.name: RetroSpace Demo
demos.short_description: Disco-punk space horror where you can be a sneaky chap or a mutant action hero as you try to survive on a space station swallowed by a black hole. A mind-bending ride with weird creatures, immersive features, time jumps, and '70s mustaches!

demos.name: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School Demo
demos.short_description: Class is (back) in session with Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School! Get a first look at next year's curriculum with this new playable demo. Escape from a death-defying introductory puzzle course, kick it with new and familiar faces on campus, and enjoy a sneak peek at our brand new quest system!

highlights.trailer_name: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School Demo Trailer

demos.name: Drop Command Demo
demos.short_description: Classic '90s Mech combat at a grand scale! Build a Mech empire and conquer the stars. Pilot Mechs, Tanks, Infantry and Aircraft in combined arms combat on many worlds. You are the battlefield commander leading from the cockpit.

demos.name: Bannerlings Demo
demos.short_description: Build an unstoppable army in this strategy roguelite auto-battler. Fuse your Bannerlings, create powerful emblem synergies, and overcome unpredictable encounters on the road to the final boss.

demos.name: Bloodspill Demo
demos.short_description: Bloodspill is a fast-paced, pvp retro fps with one hit combat, featuring classic gamemodes like deathmatch, capture the flag and conquest!

demos.name: FirstPlate Demo
demos.short_description: Run a restaurant under constant pressure in the FirstPlate Demo. Build and expand your kitchen infinitely, draft new menu cards in an endless survival challenge, and coordinate chaotic service solo or in co-op. Survive as long as you can to climb the global leaderboards!

demos.name: Sludgineers Demo
demos.short_description: Clean, mine and refine pollution in this active incremental game. Cruise through the countryside earning cash and resources, build a refinery, process materials, upgrade equipment, unlock new areas and complete quests.

demos.name: WOIM Demo
demos.short_description: If you were a woim, could you still solve puzzles? in this rock pushing, egg cracking, woim snipping, puzzle game, you'll use your long, wriggly body to solve brain teasing puzzles, and find your way through the underground world of dirt you call home.

demos.name: MayDay MayDie Demo
demos.short_description: A first-person social deduction game on a luxury plane, featuring real-time action and betrayal for up to 8 players. Passengers rush to complete tasks and survive violent turbulence to land the airliner, while hidden Hijackers sabotage it to force a crash. No voting, just pure paranoia.

demos.name: Alice Nation Demo
demos.short_description: "Alice Nation" is a cute, fairy-tale-inspired interactive narrative card game. Play as Alice, the protagonist trapped in the "Other Shore," and master diverse gameplay styles alongside your companions to find a way back to reality.

demos.name: Trust Your Gut Demo
demos.short_description: A rogue-lite roulette game. Born unlucky; your life is tied to this game. To survive, buy mementos you want, bend the odds, and return to each spin a little stronger.

demos.name: Killer Aces Volleyball Demo
demos.short_description: The ultimate 6v6 indoor volleyball game! Build a powerhouse from the ground up to challenge the greatest teams in the world!

demos.name: RuinsofDawnDemo
demos.short_description: A loot-driven action role-playing game (ARPG) crafted by a solo loot enthusiast. Switch classes anytime, with hundreds of random affix combinations for gear stats, a unique forging system, and tough bosses, rifts, ruins, and trials awaiting your challenge.

demos.name: Shadow Dungeon Demo
demos.short_description: Sinister dungeons. Collapsing rifts of a corrupted otherworld.Nightmarish creatures crawl from the dark, Demon Lords lurk beneath the abyss.Enter the Shadow Dungeon. Carve your way through this dark gothic world and write your own legendary saga.

demos.name: Death at Fleming Manor Demo
demos.short_description:
"Your job is to write the death certificate."
Investigate a mysterious death in a British manor in 1959. Explore eerie scenes, analyze evidence, and complete death certificates and emergency reports. A forensic mystery with art inspired by 1960s European detective comics.

demos.name: Carpet Cleaning Simulator Demo
demos.short_description:
Clean carpets, earn money, and grow stronger in this incremental cleaning game.
Scrub, rinse, and squeegee your way to profit—before time resets and you start again.

demos.name: Hariti Demo
demos.short_description: "Hariti" is a first-person psychological horror game. You will play as a mother searching for her missing daughter in a crisis-ridden hospital. Experience an atmosphere of extreme dread within the halls of this abandoned Chinese-style medical facility.

demos.name: Hawthorn Proof-of-Concept Demo
demos.short_description: Former developers from Bethesda, BioWare, and Naughty Dog bring you a sandbox RPG realm of anthropomorphic animals and fairy creatures.  Play co-op or solo as you build a village of memorable NPCs, farm, craft, explore, and celebrate the seasons in an ever-changing world bigger than you.

demos.name: The Second Reality Room: Unspoken Truths Demo
demos.short_description:
You can’t understand them—yet.
Decode the “Second Reality” through Talk, Mind Read, and Translate in an empathy-driven psychological mystery adventure.

highlights.trailer_name: Demo Release and Theme Song Reveal Trailer

demos.name: Deck of Potential Demo
demos.short_description: Deck of Potential combines roguelike deckbuilder with bullet heaven. Collect cards, fuse them, and slap on sticker upgrades to beat thousands of monsters. Take down dungeon bosses, unlock new characters, and discover fusion recipes to build the ultimate auto-firing deck.

demos.name: Super Shout Showdown Demo
demos.short_description: Write your own incantations and cast spells through your microphone! Battle in duels, team fights, or chaotic free-for-all matches with 25+ unique spells to learn, combo, and master.

demos.name: Nightwater Demo
demos.short_description: Forage, craft and automate to grow your factory, unlock new technologies and expand your island to discover new biomes. Progress through the ages from sticks and stones to the Bronze Age, the Industrial Era and into the future to uncover the secret of the Lighthouse and escape this reality.

demos.name: Moss: The Forgotten Relic DEMO
demos.short_description: Get a first look at Moss: The Forgotten Relic, an emotional and atmospheric puzzle-adventure set within a living storybook, where a tiny hero and a watchful spirit must work together to overcome challenges far greater than either alone.

demos.name: Nocturne Demo
demos.short_description: The afterlife is now digital. Discover that eternal life comes with sacrifice in a genre-defying RPG with unique rhythm combat.

demos.name: DEMO: My Beautiful Faraway, Please Don't Be Cruel To Me
demos.short_description: A dreamlike, half-remembered nowhere. Quietly wander through it, solve opaque puzzles, and meet strange figures as something beautiful unwinds.

demos.name: Forsworn Demo
demos.short_description: Step into a realm torn by divine conflict where every defeat is just another beginning in this rogue lite, turn-based tactics adventure where no hero fights alone. Build powerful synergies to overcome unforgiving battles and defy fate in a world controlled by the gods.

demos.name: Last Breath Demo
demos.short_description: Last Breath is a tense side-scrolling shooter in a fungal-ravaged world, where humanity has become “Spore Zombies.” As the older sister Guan Jin, fight through the ruins to find your lost sibling. Scavenge, adapt, survive. But what awaits: redemption or a deeper nightmare?

demos.name: BRAZILIAN DRUG DEALER BEFORE 4: DEMONS FROM THE PORTAL TO HELL I OPENED ARE STILL IN THE FAVELA AND NOW I HAVE TO SAVE MAMADAS FROM RONALDO Demo
demos.short_description: THE STANDALONE SEQUEL OF THE BRAZILIAN BOOMER SHOOTER GAME MADE USING THE ID TECH 2 ENGINE! SHOOT, JUMP, DOUBLE JUMP AND DASH! EMBARK ON A JOURNEY THROUGHOUT THE STATE OF RIO DE JANEIRO, SÃO PAULO, SALVADOR, HELL AND EVEN HEAVEN! SAVE BRAZIL!

demos.name: To the Wives Who Were Heroes Demo
demos.short_description: All datable characters are hot wives! Explore the dungeon with these sexy, mature women, cultivate bonds through naughty rituals, and stop the Demon Queen from resurrecting!

demos.name: The Too-Cute Girl Who Moved in Next Door Demo
demos.short_description: A 3D romance simulation game with point-and-click exploration and interaction with the heroine.

demos.name: SiN Reloaded Demo
demos.short_description: SiN: Reloaded is a completely remastered experience of the 1998 shooter. This diamond-in-the-rough, story-driven FPS features memorable characters, horrific enemies, and a devastating arsenal that pushed the Quake II Engine to its limits. Now with remastered graphics and overhauled control schemes.

demos.name: Func Key Demo
demos.short_description: Func Key is a spelling roguelike deck builder where your keyboard is the deck! Customize your keyboard to be the ultimate spelling machine, or leave words behind with rule breaking mods. Spell, build, and relax, all to the soothing thock of the keyboard.

demos.name: Parking in Tight Spaces Demo
demos.short_description: A game with a budget of two beers and a sandwich. Test your skills in this relaxing parking game! Park cars, trailers, and buses in tight spaces. Each level pushes your precision and control - can you master every tricky spot?

demos.name: Crown Siege Demo
demos.short_description: A short incremental tower defense game centered around growing and strengthening armies, to defend your kingdom and stop endless waves of enemies.

demos.name: Backrooms Protocol Demo
demos.short_description: Backrooms Protocol Demo is a walk simulator designed to showcase the atmosphere and environments of the full game. It contains three different levels to explore, each featuring its own unique atmosphere.

demos.name: 放置斩魔录 Demo
demos.short_description: 这是一款融合放置挂机、回合制战斗与流派构筑的武侠养成游戏。培养角色、组合技能流派、搭配随机装备与独立装备，在领地经营、副本挑战与肉鸽冲塔玩法中打造属于你的最强阵容。

demos.name: Massage With Benefits Demo
demos.short_description: Step into the role of an exclusive private massage therapist operating right from your own home. When a stunning "Young Wife" arrives seeking relief from her daily aches, it’s your job to provide a touch she’ll never forget. Transition from soothing her muscles to make her yours!

demos.name: CAAAHR Demo
demos.short_description: Your voice is the engine. Literally. One player screams to make the car go faster, the other somehow tries to steer it through chaos. A coop friendship test about communication, panic, and losing your voice at 2 AM.

demos.name: Arcane Eats Demo
demos.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder with a delicious twist. Think like a master chef, balancing resources as you strategically combo ingredients to subdue hungry hordes. Recruit a legendary kitchen crew, and rise through the heroic cooking guilds—before The Hunger consumes us all!

demos.name: Brave New Wonders Demo
demos.short_description: Automate, optimize, and build vast factories in a post-apocalyptic world with no conveyor belts. Command intelligent robots that obey plain-text commands in any language, explore the ruins of a lost civilization, and rebuild humanity one machine at a time.

demos.name: Protect the Pit Demo
demos.short_description: A short incremental clicker game that blends the strategy of tower defense with the depth of sprawling upgrade trees. Build your own winding mazes to repel the oncoming hordes!

demos.name: POLYARIS Demo
demos.short_description: Explore the frozen Arctic in the POLYARIS demo featuring survival gameplay, skiing, boating, scavenging, dynamic weather, hostile encounters, and open-ended exploration. Stay warm, manage your needs, and survive the lonely north.

demos.name: Flyra: FPV Drone Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Flyra is a high-speed FPV drone simulator with Racing, Freestyle, and Survival challenges. Test your reflexes, explore unique environments, and fly a range of drones with realistic physics. Discover the thrill of flying free.

demos.name: Black Cat Book Club Demo
demos.short_description: A magical library you can place on your desktop. Help the black cat study ancient tomes and learn spells in this cozy idle game.

demos.name: Cemetery Simulator (Demo)
demos.short_description: A DEMO coffin means the cheapest pine one! Grow your own forest cemetery alone or with friends. First, tidy up the place, then grab a shovel, dig your first grave, and organize a funeral. See who among you is the best at shoveling and tombstone care!

demos.name: Time To Wake Up Demo
demos.short_description: You're stuck in a dream. Blink and change your surroundings to escape the shadows of your past.

highlights.trailer_name: Time To Wake Up - Gameplay Trailer

demos.name: Lord of Undead Demo
demos.short_description: Destroy the castle on the hill in this grim RPG where you play as the Dark Lord. Collect souls, summon an undead army, master dark abilities, craft powerful gear, build your base, and desecrate the lands of a vast open world.

demos.name: 烘焙糕手 Demo
demos.short_description: Welcome to Baking Master! This is a co-op roguelike management simulation game with a warm and comforting art style. Become an adorable animal chef and run a busy bakery with friends locally or online.

demos.name: Cozy Marbles Demo
demos.short_description: Play the free demo of Cozy Marbles and engineer the marble run of your dreams. No need to get it perfect – just release your marbles and let the good times roll.

demos.name: HYPERFIGHT 2 Demo
demos.short_description: Your meter is your life. Use it wisely or risk it all in this brand-new take on 2D fighting. Demo includes online multiplayer with rollback to fight your friends!

demos.name: Dinerz Demo
demos.short_description: Run your own diner! Cook juicy burgers, crispy fries, and pour refreshing sodas to satisfy your guests. Manage orders, serve hungry customers, and get paid. Keep the kitchen spotless by clearing tables and washing dishes, all while unlocking fresh ingredients to expand your menu!

demos.name: Penguin Colony Demo
demos.short_description: Cosmic horror, through the eyes of a penguin. Rival human factions have come to your home in the Antarctic, seeking an ancient and inconceivable being. Observe their descent into insanity in this faithful re-imagining of H.P. Lovecraft’s At the Mountains of Madness, and other stories.

demos.name: Fallosophy Demo
demos.short_description:
Use just two buttons to climb a colossal pinball table spanning the history of western philosophy. 
Fallosophy is a minimalist game that turns pinball into a quiet struggle against gravity. No score. No tilts. No savers. Falling down means climbing back up again.

Why climb? What does it all mean?

demos.name: Radiotext Demo
demos.short_description: Rise against the corporate overlords and become a cyber activist hacker. Join the uprising in a cyberpunk world using radio waves.

demos.name: lily's world XD Demo
demos.short_description: Lily was an ordinary teenager in 2004, and you just found her laptop. Read her diary, message her friends, and piece together what happened to her before it’s too late. But you're not the only one with access to her computer… Play the first chapter of Lily’s story in this demo.

demos.name: Aquapark Tycoon Demo
demos.short_description: Build the ultimate waterpark paradise in this classic tycoon simulation game! Design & customize water slides, pools, and saunas to fulfill your guests' needs. Combine creativity, strategy, and management to make a splash in the world of water parks and become the ultimate Aquapark Tycoon!

demos.name: Master Healer Kale with useless party Demo
Compound Interest Demo
demos.short_description: The networks are dead. The city has fallen. Manage your crew and send them into danger to earn money and respect. Claim turf, control trade, and make allies or enemies as you reshape the fully simulated city of New Sterling.

demos.name: Edenwound Demo
demos.short_description: A brutally difficult dungeon crawler rpg with roguelike elements. Face the horrors of Eden and discover the secrets buried deep within the abyss...

demos.name: Rift Wizard 3 Demo
demos.short_description: Rift Wizard is a hardcore combat strategy roguelike and wizard simulator featuring an extremely deep build system. Customize your Wizard with more than 500 spells and magical artifacts. Blast, summon, or enchant your way through 20 levels of pure turn based chaos.

demos.name: Flamecraft Demo
demos.short_description: Flamecraft is a 1-5 player cozy strategy game filled with magic. Become a Flamekeeper and help adorable dragon artisans find the perfect home. Enchant the town’s stores and fill them with dragon cards as you watch the whimsical shopping district come to life.

demos.name: Taxi Simulator (Demo)
demos.short_description: Jump into the Taxi Simulator Demo! Drive a classic yellow cab through a vibrant city district. Complete your first missions, refuel, clean up your ride, and avoid traffic tickets. Experience the shady, wild life of a streetwise cabby. Your shift starts now!

demos.name: Allogloom Demo
demos.short_description:
Demo: Join Nora in this mysterious and macabre point and click adventure game.
Find and collect items to solve puzzles. Talk to peculiar people and monsters alike. Explore Gruesome Grove and beyond to uncover forgotten truths and save the people of her town!

demos.name: Shion Can't Fight! Level Up Failed... Lewdness Maxed Demo
demos.short_description: "Shion" is an adventurer who can neither fight nor cast magic. While fulfilling her quests, she slowly becomes entangled in a web of carnal temptation and peril.

demos.name: Civica: Italian Renaissance Demo
demos.short_description: Build your Italian empire in this realistic medieval RTS that combines truly organic city building and immersive roleplaying. City-states compete for influence, families such as the Medici try to divide power among themselves and artists create masterpieces that define an entire era.

demos.name: HuntinBuddies Demo
demos.short_description:
DEMO : You get to play THREE NIGHTS in the forest !

1-4 player online HORROR COMEDY HUNTING game. Hunt wildlife to fulfill objectives, drag massive carcasses with your friends, and evade the creatures that begin hunting you back.

demos.name: Dragon Dinner Demo
demos.short_description: An explosive cocktail of intense strategic action and deceivingly cute dragons! Manage chaotic clients and strategically design your restaurants layouts to handle the rush and serve endless waves of hungry dragons.

demos.name: My Lovable Demon Demo
demos.short_description:
You summoned a hot demon. Build your relationship, go on dates, pat her head, battle evil and f**k a lot!
(Visual novel with point-and-click elements. Multiple endings.)

demos.name: Milki Delivery Demo
demos.short_description: Rebuild a community one bottle at a time in this tiny delivery adventure with your pet cow Milki. Gather resources and upgrade your barn, then bike along dirt paths, breezy meadows, and seaside cliffs to bring fresh milk back to the sleepy countryside.

demos.name: Lost Lures Demo
demos.short_description: Demo of the fishing adventure set in the northern wilderness. Learn fish behavior, read the waters and master your lures. Progress through a skill-based journey of quiet patience. Play solo or join friends online to complete shared missions and fish at your own pace.

demos.name: SPRAWL zero Demo
demos.short_description: SPRAWL zero is a fast-paced shooter inspired by the Golden Age of 2000s FPS. Survive a brutal cyberpunk city collapsing under military rule and cult fanaticism. Use your Gravity-Gloves, augments, and an arsenal of over 40 weapons to crush those who stand in your way.

demos.name: Total Victory: World Conflict 1939-1945 Demo
demos.short_description: The ultimate turn-based World War 2 grand strategy game wargamers have been yearning for decades. The best ideas born from players and from wargames so huge they overtook your dining room table, and your wife’s patience. From the developer of the WarPlan series.

demos.name: Aleef: Desktop Pet Collector Demo
demos.short_description: Work, browse, or play other games while hatching eggs in the background! Collect 300+ pets, unlock powerful upgrades, and build your battle team. Or Sell/Buy from the Steam Community Market.

demos.name: Atomcraft Demo
demos.short_description: A sandbox adventure where every pixel is physically and chemically simulated! Build intricate, fully functional machines from the pixels around you. Harvest, react, and manipulate all 118 elements to craft everything from simple tools to complex systems.

demos.name: Loop One: Demo
demos.short_description: Record loops with drones and robots by hand, to build up an efficient automated factory in this physics-based VR game.

demos.name: Realindustry Demo
demos.short_description: Experience the first 5 tech tiers of a hyper-realistic industrial simulation. Master 102 real materials and 152 accurate recipes using actual chemistry. Your factory grows. Your efficiency improves. Someone notices. Welcome to the Realindustry Demo, Director.

demos.name: Entropy Demo
demos.short_description: Entropy is a tactical turn-based RPG inspired by classic JRPGs. Assemble your party of mercenaries and forge your own path towards an expedition into hell to stop the demonic incursion. Choices you make along the way will determine the fate of your world.

highlights.trailer_name: Demo Out Now | Early Access Date Trailer

demos.name: Roll Together Demo
demos.short_description: Welcome to the ultimate friendship test! Control a massive, unpredictable Roller with a friend in this chaotic physics platformer. One moves the left wheel, the other rules the right. Trust is a lie, communication is chaos, and falling down is half the fun. Can you roll your way up to the top?

demos.name: Parasite Inside Demo
demos.short_description: A NSFW sci-fi survival horror where you explore an infested colonization ship, solve puzzles, and survive the unknown.

demos.name: Airport Contraband Demo
demos.short_description: Take over the duties of a customs officer in this roguelike-simulation demo of Airport Contraband. Inspect passengers and their luggage, perform body searches and handle the passenger queues of incoming and outgoing flights.

demos.name: Replay Value: Second Hand Games Demo
SpiritVale Demo
demos.short_description: A class-based action MMO inspired by classic RPGs. Explore a fractured world of monsters and ruins, build your own playstyle, and fight alongside friends in real-time, cooperative combat.

demos.name: Brigador Killers Demo
demos.short_description: Isometric insurgent simulator. Fight on foot and in vehicles, build and steal a private arsenal and bring the war home to the businessmen who started it all in this continuation of the Brigador saga.

demos.name: Green Mist over Portland Demo
demos.short_description: A detective noir puzzle deduction game. Explore a non-linear timeline during the cold war on a globe-trotting adventure following a trail of spies from a quiet English harbour town to a frozen Finnish fishing village and the corridors of an intelligence service rotten at its core.

demos.name: How To Destroy A City Demo
demos.short_description: How to Destroy a City is a casual incremental game where you pilot a giant robot to destroy the city. Upgrade your robot, fight the army, and unlock special abilities and new robots. It's time to turn the city to ashes!

demos.name: The Devil's Due Demo
demos.short_description: You lost your soul in a poker game against the Devil. Now, trapped in the infernal depths, your only hope is to fight your way back to freedom. You’ll face a diverse gallery of monstrous foes in nearly impossible poker battles - but luckily, you’re a cheater.

demos.name: Loot Frog Demo
demos.short_description: Loot Frog is an incremental action bullet hell about breaking pots, collecting gems, and fighting an evil cult. Upgrade your gear, unlock new abilities, explore diverse biomes, and push deeper into increasingly chaotic battles.

demos.name: Delta Demo
demos.short_description: Delta is a first-person movement-heavy platformer game focused on physics-based traversal, speedrunning, and mechanical mastery. And somewhere ahead, the one you lost is still waiting.

demos.name: BioEden Demo
demos.short_description: This is the demo version of BioEden. Step into a cozy management journey as a Keeper and bring life back to a world quietly waiting to be healed. Craft the perfect biome for dozens of wonderful animal species and use your ingenuity to restore your planet, one ecosystem at a time.

demos.name: PlinkIdle Demo
demos.short_description: Falling balls, rare buffs, and steady upgrades unlock colorful, cozy stages and immersive environments.

demos.name: Trine 6: Together in Time Demo
demos.short_description: The demo offers a small sample of the full game, giving you a first look at Trine 6’s platforming, puzzles, combat, and co-op-focused adventure.

demos.name: ALYSSA - Demo
demos.short_description: From the creator of Don't Be Afraid. You are a little girl trapped inside a nightmarish mansion, where twisted residents and dark secrets hide behind every closed door. Explore and uncover the beginning of Alyssa's story in this demo.

demos.name: Powerplay Demo
demos.short_description: Powerplay is an RTS with a focus on resources and industry. Create supply chains, transport, and explore in this thrilling base builder. Grow into a powerful industrial nation, but don't spread too thin! Resources are finite and "the others" can reclaim what is theirs at any time.

demos.name: Cat Me If You Can Demo
demos.short_description: Cat Me If You Can is a charming and cozy game where you explore beautifully handcrafted black-and-white worlds, searching for hidden cats to photograph and bring their colours back into the world.

demos.name: Next Reign: Kingdom Demo
demos.short_description: Transform a tiny settlement into a thriving medieval kingdom in this incremental strategy game. Build your economy, command your army, and keep discovering new ways to grow with every milestone.

demos.name: Witch the Showdown Demo
demos.short_description:
Witch the Showdown is a high-difficulty parry-action game where every battle is a boss fight.
Build mana through precise parries, then unleash attacks in real time using your cards—this unique combat system defines the experience.

demos.name: Spiritstead Demo
demos.short_description: A city builder set in a world of magic. Build a village and care for the people who live there, with the help of hidden spirits you discover along the way. Watch your town grow and flourish as you expand, create, and decorate.

demos.name: Takeover 2 Demo
demos.short_description: Take to the streets solo or with a partner in this fast paced, high-impact arcade beat ’em up. Takeover returns with refined gameplay, upgraded visuals and a pulse-pounding new soundtrack.

demos.name: Kaido Genkai: An Anime Racing RPG Demo
demos.short_description: Kaido Genkai is an open-world racing exploration game that blends the excitement of high-speed races with the charm of anime-style graphics and RPG elements, set in a nostalgic 90's fictional Japanese countryside. Come explore the open world and see who you meet along the way!

highlights.trailer_name: Kaido Genkai: Anime Racing RPG Demo Release

demos.name: Resurface Demo
demos.short_description: Escape the ocean depths in this casual incremental mining game. Mine, upgrade, and explore as your strength grows to crazy proportions, but don’t run out of oxygen!

demos.name: Raid of Lust: Match & Magic Demo
Roguecraft DX Demo
demos.short_description: Roguecraft DX is a casual yet challenging turn-based roguelike, crafted for fans of classic dungeon crawlers and inspired by Lovecraftian horror. Explore procedurally generated dungeons with mysterious potions, scary chickens, and secret rooms waiting to be discovered!

demos.name: Divine Frequency Demo
demos.short_description: A bewildering tale of a trashcan hobo's rise to becoming the universe's most effective security software.

demos.name: TANUKI: Pon's Summer Demo
demos.short_description: The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends. Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!

demos.name: Fantasy World Manager Demo
demos.short_description: Create a vast, living fantasy world: heroes, creatures, quests and events; cultures, religions and factions; overworlds, interiors and dungeons-filled with stories, wars and choices.

demos.name: The Alley Demo
demos.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game. Explore a maze-like alleyway, using your camera to distinguish between supernatural "Demon Traces" and deceptive "Demon Feints" while escaping the relentless pursuit of a vengeful ghost.

demos.name: Dreadline Express Demo
demos.short_description: Dreadline Express is a 1st-person, psychological horror metroidbrainia set aboard the last human train. Unravel mysteries of the enigmatic train, face strange passengers, and shape your path using a unique card-based mechanic that gives you full narrative control. This is no longer our world.

demos.name: Landscaper Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Lawns are wild. Parks are buried in weeds. Streets are littered. The world needs a hero, and that’s where you come in. As the Landscaper, it’s your job to turn disorder into beauty. With your weed whacker, pressure washer, and trash vacuum, you’ll trim, scrub, and restore every space to perfection.

demos.name: Silent Shark Demo
demos.short_description: A tactical WWII submarine sim demo focused on chart-based attacks: track ships by hydrophone and periscope, plot an intercept, estimate range, set up the Torpedo Data Computer, fire torpedoes, and evade escorts through tutorials, standalone encounters, and a limited scenario generator.

demos.name: Colorbound Demo
demos.short_description: In Colorbound, color is more than just hue. As Anku, an Aymara boy with a unique gift, you’ll harness the power of color to shape the environment itself, uncovering hidden paths to navigate challenging and complex puzzles.

demos.name: Farm Factory Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Grow crops, automate production, and manage your own store. Turn fresh harvests into valuable products, optimize your workflow, and build the ultimate farm-to-market business.

demos.name: Dead Reckoning: The Long Drift Demo
Ringash Demo
demos.short_description:
Ringash is a boss-focused ARPG featuring fast-paced combat, stylish combos and meaningful exploration. As a warrior with mystical powers, you’ll try to save a world that’s being destroyed.
Seek and challenge the bosses to grow your strength. Explore and uncover the truth to shape your story.

demos.name: Lunar Chrysalis Demo
demos.short_description: A box garden escape game. Su Li wakes up to find herself in an unfamiliar room, with monsters lurking around and strange symbols...she explores and solves puzzles in this eerie space, confronting the ever-approaching monsters... all to seize a glimmer of hope and escape this place!

demos.name: Farming Camp Demo
demos.short_description: Every summer, Evertree Farming Camp searches for the next best Evertree Farmer, someone ready to raise the bar in agriculture. In hopes of a better future, young Alessandra enters the contest to claim the title, but she will have to face her peers and discover what it means to be an Evertree Farmer.

demos.name: Bunderkin: The Ocular Eclipse Demo
demos.short_description: Trapped in a 3‑day time loop, you must master each moment and live the perfect day or watch the town that despises you fall into darkness.

demos.name: snaze Demo
demos.short_description: Snaze is a snake game. Eat the green dots and go to next level.

demos.name: Object Impermanence Demo
demos.short_description: A first person puzzle game where your vision defines reality, and only the things you can see exist. Learn and master the strange behaviours of objects outside your vision. Traverse the ancient structures of a world forgotten by the universe.

demos.name: 请神 Demo
demos.short_description: 《请神》是一款中式民俗克苏鲁游戏，多故事/多职业/多结局。

demos.name: Too Hot to Be True Demo
demos.short_description:
“Finding a wife in a week? Are you for real?!"

Your parents are visiting next week, and they expect you to show up with a bride. With only days left, your only hope may be the five gorgeous women staying at your seaside guesthouse. As feelings shift fast, who will you choose?

demos.name: CS Manager Demo
demos.short_description: CS Manager is a deep and tactical eSports manager game. Make key decisions on rosters, strategies, and practice, and take on your opponents in real time matches. Rise to the top of the circuit in a simulation where every decision has impact

demos.name: 33 Days till Extraction Demo
demos.short_description: 33 Days till Extraction is a top-down sci-fi action RPG shooter with roguelike progression. Harness brutal firepower and necromantic skills to survive.

demos.name: 她的掌门世代 Demo
demos.short_description: 《她的掌门世代》，一款集门派经营、恋爱养成与世代传承于一体的高自由度武侠游戏。作为临危受命的掌门，你不仅要处理内务、抵御外敌，更要面对真实的江湖爱恨。是成为一代宗师，还是那个掌控所有人命运的幕后黑手？一切，由你定义。

demos.name: Botlings Demo
demos.short_description: Control a swarm of mindless robots to build and automate a factory. Turn these workers into buildings, use them to carry resources, manufacture products and research new technologies. Manage your systems so your machines don't start to think on their own and escape your factory.

demos.name: Design and Conjure Demo
demos.short_description: Join Dalia, the Nature Witch, on a heartwarming journey to restore her hometown. Tidy spaces, design magical rooms, solve gentle puzzles, and soothe magical creatures affected by mysterious corruption bringing warmth and peace back to the town. 🌸

demos.name: Capy Castaway Demo
demos.short_description: Welcome to Swallow Town, where the resident birds are reluctantly hosting their first annual Soup Competition for a menacing, giant three-headed goose. Will you become the Soup Champ, or will you leisurely gather a bouquet for a family of cows? Choose your own adventure on Castaway Island!

demos.name: My Child New Beginnings Demo
demos.short_description: My Child New Beginnings is a parenting simulator where you go through everyday life of growth. After a series of traumatic events that you and your child went through, you now get to rebuild life together in a new region of Norway.

highlights.trailer_name: My Child New Beginnings - Main Demo Trailer

demos.name: Screenbound Demo
demos.short_description: Screenbound lets you discover a dual reality through the Qboy! Navigate challenging puzzles and battle through multiple levels in a blend of 2D and 3D platforming that creates the world’s first '5D' platformer.

demos.name: Blood Dungeon Demo
demos.short_description: From the creators of Nidhogg, murder hordes of monsters in this 2D platforming autoshooter with a killer soundtrack. Collect Blood, gold, and bones to increase your powers. Can you survive the Blood Dungeon?

demos.name: Salvation Denied Demo
demos.short_description: Salvation Denied is a chaotic co-op building sim for 1-4 players. Team up and use heavy machinery and ridiculous tools to build wild constructions. Physics rules everything. Every block has weight, every mistake shifts the balance, and disasters will push your creation to its absolute limit.

demos.name: Cinema Manager Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: 🎬 Manage and expand your own cinema. Upgrade equipment, schedule movies, set ticket prices, hire staff, and handle repairs to create the ultimate movie-watching experience! 🍿

demos.name: We Need More Humans! Demo
demos.short_description: A short incremental game about abducting everyone on Earth with your UFO! Travel around the world, unlock upgrades, abduct humans until no one is left.

demos.name: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival Demo
demos.short_description: Fight walkers as Rick Grimes, Daryl Dixon and Michonne in a brutal arcade brawler set in the world of AMC’s The Walking Dead. Face ruthless enemies like the Saviors and overwhelming walker swarms as you unleash relentless combos, signature weapon attacks, and crushing finishers.

demos.name: Office Manager Demo
demos.short_description: Build and manage your own office empire. Design buildings, find tenants, negotiate contracts, and keep them happy. Research new technologies, expand your business, and handle unexpected events in a living office world.

demos.name: Billion Egg Farm Demo
demos.short_description: Billion Egg Farm is a first-person automation game where you put chickens to work laying eggs and build production lines for eggs, meat, and processed goods.

demos.name: There is no next stop Demo
demos.short_description: After the announcement "There is no next stop," you are trapped in an endless subway. But you’re not alone—the "GUESTS" are hunting you. Trust the "GUIDES" to survive. Or don't.

demos.name: Tattoo Shop Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Run your dream tattoo shop! Provide tattoo and piercing services, customize your shop, and manage staff. Unlock new skills and roam the living city freely on your motorcycle. Buy real estate, fight off thugs, and grow from a small shop into the city's biggest brand!

demos.name: Empires of a Tiny Universe Demo
demos.short_description: Empires of a Tiny Universe is a relaxed single-player RTS where you build and expand your empire across space. Manage planetary infrastructure, develop new technologies for your fleet, and conquer the galaxy - all from a clear, minimalist perspective.

highlights.trailer_name: Empires of a Tiny Universe - Trailer

demos.name: PHASE ZERO Demo
demos.short_description: A grotesque illness binds the town of Flint Peak. Several survivors try to escape with their lives as mysterious creatures roam the streets. Face horrific monsters, solve puzzles and uncover the truth in this classic survival horror. Can you escape the nightmare?

demos.name: 拂晓之诗Dawn's Poem Demo
demos.short_description: A sci-fi otome AVG game where players will take on the role of the "Spark" of a new world, encounter 6 male protagonists, and unlock different endings through puzzles and choices. Uncover the mystery behind your parents' death and discover the truth of the world.

demos.name: They Are Here Demo
demos.short_description: “They Are Here” - is a first-person horror story about a journalist who witnessed an alien abduction at the Grayswood farm. Explore the area armed with a flashlight. Take photos of evidence of aliens presence and get to the bottom of the horrifying truth.

demos.name: Cup and Counter: Coffee Shop Simulator Demo
Kick Demo
demos.short_description: Kick is a nostalgic tale of making your way to school, all the while honing your soccer skills throughout challenging levels packed with unique challenges. Do you have what it takes to Kick it?

demos.name: 难道你是GAL高手 Demo
demos.short_description: An introverted girl who is bad at games, an artist who struggles with drawing human anatomy, a wealthy young lady who wants to play visual novels for the rest of her life, and a younger sister trying her best to understand what anime is—you will play their protagonist and start a romantic comedy!

demos.name: PetrolHeads Demo
demos.short_description: Build your dream garage from scratch! Customize everything from lifts to engines with deep tuning options. Design unique wide-body beasts, dominate drift duels or track days, and showcase your style in global meets. Your garage, your rules, your racing legacy starts now!

demos.name: Slayblade Demo
demos.short_description:
Build your battle-top and become King of the Streets! Collect 60+ parts, Merge their Powers, and Dominate opponents in this Chill Roguelite! 
Skate around a vibrant Y2K city, winning Cash and Upgrades on your way to the top. 
And if you Die in the game, you Die in real life.

demos.name: Lucky Shot Demo
demos.short_description: A shooting dopamine machine! Lucky Shot is a roguelike mag-builder FPS where you master different weapons, build wild combos, and break the game to reach massive high scores.

demos.name: Monk Took Book Demo
demos.short_description: A game about organizing, stacking and remembering where you put hundreds of books in a cozy-creepy medieval library. Play solo or with up to three fellow monks. Spend six nights at the abbey in this short demo.

demos.name: Space Scum Demo: Second Life
demos.short_description: Lead a band of mercenaries through battle after battle in this Sci-Fi, turn-based RPG. Fight your way across different planets, earning loot and equipment to outfit your team – and remember, no option is off the table when survival is on the line.

demos.name: Golf 5 MAX Demo
demos.short_description: Try Golf 5 MAX free! Retro arcade golf meets real physics. Build your golfer, master your swing and take on Birdie or Bust. The full game launches November 2 on Steam with 25% off for two weeks. Wishlist it now!

demos.name: Quack Quack Up Demo
demos.short_description: Shout your ducks through the finish line in this voice-controlled party game where you win by screaming at the top of your lungs! Use your voice to herd a flock of ducks, but be careful: ducks can be a bit dumb, and a sneeze at the wrong moment can get them lost or, worse, falling off a cliff!

demos.name: Chunky JUMP! – NIGHT 1 DEMO
demos.short_description: Chunky JUMP! is a short horror platformer where you must survive through the night on your BIRD BOY. But beware... the Ghabbit is hunting, and you must restore the gas station's power before it's too late!

demos.name: Dearbnb Demo
demos.short_description: Buy, Decorate, Rent, Relax. Start with a tiny apartment, decorate cozy spaces, manage rentals and businesses, and rise from a poor neighborhood to the city’s most prestigious zones. A calming yet deep management experience where every room tells a story.

demos.name: Complete Horror
demos.short_description: This is a horror survival game.Join the female protagonist to explore an abandoned subway station full of mysteries, seeking escape in oppressive darkness. Balance exploration, puzzles, and combat—one mistake may plunge you into endless abyss. Arm yourself constantly to face terrors from the depths.

demos.name: BrokenLore: ASCEND Demo
demos.short_description: The demo of BrokenLore: ASCEND is a first-person psychological horror experience featuring climbing and stealth mechanics. Follow two rooftop climbers as they confront a cursed tower and the terrifying Rokurokubi. The higher they climb, the closer they come to madness.

demos.name: Don't Kill Them All Demo
demos.short_description: Orcs don’t die: THEY RAGE! Embody their Warchief and lead them out of misery in this brutish strategy game with base-building, where one Orc outburst can turn victory into disaster.  Forge bonds between units, shape their personalities, and unleash their true potential both in and out of battle.

highlights.trailer_name: Don't Kill Them All - Early Demo Trailer

demos.name: Something to Drink? Demo
demos.short_description: I'm Tom and I just got a job as a bartender. Now I have to wipe down the same sticky counters where I used to leave my own marks. In this dive, even the rats look like they're hungover. Alright, the boozers won't pour their own drinks - time to get back to work.

demos.name: 中等生 Demo
demos.short_description: 这是一部中式校园（高三）为背景的百合向视觉小说。 只要考上大学，一切都会好起来吗？手牵着手，心跳扑通扑通，我们只是朋友吗？大家说只是开个玩笑，感到不舒服是正常的吗？想要挣脱母亲的期待，这是不孝吗？您将跟随主角周语桐，探索青春期的疑惑，帮她作出选择。

demos.name: Golden Swirl Demo
demos.short_description: Golden Swirl is a dark fantasy, semi-real-time action deckbuilder. Master tactical movement to dodge fierce attacks while managing your hand. Fully voiced with custom heroes, fine-tune your deck, relics, and runes to repel the Swirl. Can you survive the madness?

demos.name: Incrempire Demo
demos.short_description: Defend. Upgrade. Dominate. An incremental base-defense game, packed with powerful skills and a deep skill tree.

demos.name: MLF: Pro Catch (Demo)
demos.short_description: Cast, catch, and compete in the most immersive fishing sim ever made. Explore legendary waters, battle over 40 unique fish species, customize real gear, and climb the leaderboards in online tournaments with real-world prizes.

demos.name: D-Extinction Demo
demos.short_description: D-Extinction is a first-person investigative horror game. A secret experiment went too far. Now the pre-historic predators are loose. Explore, investigate, and survive in a immersive horror experience where one mistake can kill.

demos.name: Survivors Guild Demo
demos.short_description: A survivors-like bullet heaven with 1-4 player ONLINE CO-OP. Battle across the realm and take on hordes of monsters! Strategically choose your weapons and items to craft powerful builds, challenge bosses, and complete quests. Unlock new characters and unleash their unique weapons and abilities.

demos.name: Wilderings: The Lost Spring Demo
demos.short_description: Master the wilds. Restore a broken world. In this creature-collecting roguelite, dynamic action meets open-world style exploration. Befriend mystical Hântu to heal a corrupted land!

highlights.trailer_name: Wilderings: The Lost Spring Gameplay Trailer
Wilderings: The Lost Spring Cinematic Trailer

demos.name: Deep Space Remnant
demos.short_description: This space survival sim lets you build a space station, construct ships to gather resources for expansion, and upgrade tech for stronger shields to withstand cosmic radiation, all while surviving in a radioactive environment.

demos.name: [Act1] Staffer Retro : A Supernatural Mystery Quest
demos.short_description: Staffer Retro is a mystery adventure game where you uncover past incidents related to ‘Mana’, the source of supernatural powers. Gather information through dialogue and exploration, and piece together clues found in documents to guide the choices of Verita Retro, the protagonist.

demos.name: Knee Deep!: In Love Demo
demos.short_description: You might’ve accidentally found out that your scary roommate, your childhood best friend, and your project partner are obsessed with you and are willing to kill for you.

demos.name: Living with the Absolute Bustiest College Girl! Demo
demos.short_description: A sudden job transfer leads you to start living with Shizuku, a quiet and busty college girl. As you spend time gaming and bonding together, your relationship deepens, unlocking juicier interactions as her affection grows.

demos.name: Flowers and Deities Demo
demos.short_description:
In Flowers and Deities, you play as an ambitious Lizardkin rising through savage arena battles for the gods. Lead your blood-drenched army, combine units and blessings, harness spilled blood to cast spells—and fight to survive.
How far will you go?

demos.name: Meaningless Random Numbers Demo
demos.short_description: Meaningless Random Numbers is an Incremental Horror Game about earning money through Random Number Generators but be cautious, God is Watching...

demos.name: Silky Rails Demo
demos.short_description: Build your train from unique carts, fight waves of enemies, collect loot, and upgrade your setup to get stronger.

demos.name: Pawsome Resort Demo
demos.short_description: Pawsome Resort is a cozy life sim where you run an animal hotel in a charming pixel-art village. Design your resort, care for cute animals, grow crops, craft things, complete quests, and bond with villagers. With farming and RPG elements, it's a perfect cozy escape.

demos.name: Spooky Market Demo
demos.short_description: Spooky Market is a co-op shop simulator for 1–4 players set in a world of eternal Halloween. Open your own business, sell a variety of goods, serve vampires, skeletons, and other creatures, hire unusual employees, and gradually grow and expand your store.

demos.name: Futa on Top Demo
demos.short_description: 💕Futa on Top is a dystopian futa-dom visual novel ✨—a galaxy ruled by futa 👑 where males are reshaped through feminization. 🧬💄

demos.name: IDLE_DIRECTIVE Demo
demos.short_description: Idly gather and manage resources to repair what's left of a decaying world. Scavenge forgotten ruins, meet scattered survivors, and push back against the inevitable collapse. IDLE_DIRECTIVE is a grid-based inventory and resource management idle game.

demos.name: Fright Train Demo
demos.short_description: Fight through a train overtaken by monsters and survive Antarctica’s cold as paranormal special agent Doug Barker in this chilling single-player third-person survival horror roguelike.

demos.name: How Asian Parents went to School Demo
demos.short_description: An online 1-4 player co-op adventure where you experience the legendary struggle of getting to school as an Asian parent. Fight Tom, a psychopathic bear, defy physics, and survive the emotional damage from Tablo Escobar: an NPC who roasts you every time you fail.

highlights.trailer_name: How Asian Parents went to School, Demo Teaser!
How Asian Parents went to School Demo Trailer

demos.name: Doomed Otaku Demo
demos.short_description:
"Real friends exist in the online world!"

The Doomed Otaku is a multi-ending adventure that follows a wandering 20-something otaku as they navigate both the real and cyber worlds, experiencing various events along the way.

demos.name: Cyber Paranoia Demo
demos.short_description: Hospitalized for a mental contagion, you undergo therapy with an android. Experience love, pain, and control as your choices shape his fate – and decide your own reality.

demos.name: Pixel Washer Demo
demos.short_description: Grab your power washer and scrub pixelated worlds squeaky clean! Play as an adorable piggy, blast away grime, upgrade your gear, and restore a grubby town to its former glory in this cozy, almost zen-like game.

highlights.trailer_name: Pixel Washer | Early Access Release Date Trailer

demos.name: Chonky Cat Demo
demos.short_description: Become the fluffiest menace in Chonky Cat, play as a massively overfed cat on a never ending binge. Chase, crush, and devour waves of creatures to grow even fatter and more unstoppable. Eat everything, unlock upgrades, multipliers and customizations and see just how chonky you can get!

demos.name: Warding Witches Demo
demos.short_description: The Warding Witches Demo offers a classic, unapologetic bullet hell shoot ‘em up challenge while also putting defense into players’ hands. Experience an adrenaline-filled flow alternating between attacking, defending and dodging.

demos.name: Price for Freedom: Gold and Sand Demo
