demos.short_description: Gold and Sand is an erotic-CRPG with turn-based combat. Beautiful hand drawn art elevates this character driven game where you will explore the unique world and guide characters as they discover each other and themselves in fully animated erotic scenes.

demos.name: The Hambagu Shop Demo
demos.short_description: The Hambagu Shop is a cozy horror simulator where you work in a Japanese Hamburg Steak Shop. Cook Hamburg, serve customers, and upgrade your shop for more menu items.

demos.name: Rent a Boyfriend Demo
demos.short_description: Start your adventure in the "Rent a Boyfriend" demo!

demos.name: Beencremental Demo
demos.short_description:
Beencremental is an incremental Game about Bees.
Grow an unstoppable swarm and conquer the four seasons, devouring every flower in your path!
Drive your queen with your mouse, Gather Pollen, Gamble it into a Plinko machine and grow your hive trough a Tech Tree!

demos.name: Vision Quench Demo
demos.short_description: An online co-op dark fantasy adventure game set in the underbelly of a consumer goods conglomerate mega dungeon. Within its halls you will fight ancient foes and modern horrors. Can you survive long enough to make it to the top?

demos.name: Resort Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Run and manage a seaside resort! Take care of guests and handle daily operations. Grow your resort step by step, create the perfect vacation atmosphere, and enjoy a calming simulation experience.

demos.name: Monster Alchemy Demo
demos.short_description: Create unique creatures, use them to gather rare resources, and fuse them into even more powerful beings! This RPG combines classic exploration with a deep crafting system where your monsters are your ultimate tool for looting, combat, and discovery.

demos.name: Pepper the Giant Purple Dog Demo
demos.short_description: In this twist on a harmless pet simulator, take care of Pepper, who happens to be a giant purple dog. But when things go awry, you will have to decide: how many lives is one good boy worth?

demos.name: Crypto Trading Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Trade volatile crypto markets in real time, build automation bots, and upgrade your home-office into a capable trading setup. With bills rising and pressure mounting, every decision can push you toward profit or wipe you out.

demos.name: Few Shall Return Demo
demos.short_description: Few Shall Return is a PvPvE multiplayer dungeon extraction adventure. You have to work together to survive, but you're on your own at the end of the day. Each round only takes 7.5 minutes

demos.name: WILD Tactics Demo
demos.short_description: A character-driven turn-based tactical strategy game where planning and positioning decide every fight. Lead a squad of wild agents with shady pasts through high-pressure missions, manage their relationships, and make hard calls that shape every operation in the crime-ridden city of Clawville.

demos.name: Calame Demo
demos.short_description: In this turn-based tactical RPG, renown can change the course of a war. Lead Kenmare and the Panthers against the King of Light, shape the Chronicle through your choices, and wield the Legend to turn battles around.

demos.name: Cattlieb Demo
demos.short_description: A pachinko-style roguelike battle game where every shot can change the course of battle. Launch orbs, place helpful items, collect relics, and build your own synergies as you adapt to unpredictable boards and challenging battles.

demos.name: Aegis Force: The Scorian War Demo
Eldritch Escape Demo
demos.short_description: In this Lovecraftian Extraction Bullet Heaven, Earth has been consumed by an eldritch god. Build a customizable squad, battle endless horrors, extract resources, and search for a way out of the void

demos.name: Mr. Sparkle's Nightmare Demo
demos.short_description: Mr. Sparkle’s Nightmare is a precision-driven Bullet Hell Roguelite set in a twisted storybook nightmare. Craft powerful spell combinations, evade overwhelming bullet patterns, and survive brutal encounters that reward perfect execution.

demos.name: ShadowLess Light Demo
demos.short_description: A visual novel with RPG elements set in a Cyberpunk dystopia where you play a detective tasked with solving a smorgasbord of cases.

demos.name: Money Trails Demo
demos.short_description: Venture out in the back of your limousine and decide what to buy or build to grow your endless procedurally generated island. Add up your money, increase your passive income and receive random alerts on your Personal Digital Assistant while you travel.

demos.name: Imperial Ambitions - Tutorial/Demo
demos.short_description: This demo is composed of three tutorial levels.

demos.name: Item Collector Ball Demo
demos.short_description: You're a ball that collects items! Explore this carefully crafted time trial platformer with a plethora of unique physics based obstacles.  Unique music and retro aesthetic define this game and provide a relaxing and satisfying experience.  Easy to pick up but challenging to master.

demos.name: Space Scavenger 2 Demo
demos.short_description: A fast-paced, top-down action roguelite about building outlandish modular spaceships and discovering broken synergies. Scavenge resources, craft absurd builds, and hone your abilities in a paradoxical time loop.

demos.name: Medieval Darkness Demo
demos.short_description:
From 80's Rocker to Medieval Fantasy Hero, not bad dude!
You are a rock and roller sent on a holy mission to save a dying Medieval Fantasy world! Rock on dudes!

demos.name: BloodSworn Demo
demos.short_description: BloodSworn is an intense, FPS Roguelite where players navigate through various levels with an arsenal of diverse weapons and magic in a blood-soaked, and terrifying adventure.

demos.name: Night Blood W : Cutthroat Wolf Demo
demos.short_description: "Nightblood W: Cutthroat Wolf" is a cyberpunk action role-playing game. You will play the role of an ambitious gang cadre. Your goal is to challenge and eliminate the rebellious Frey Gang alone, prove your strength, and eventually reach the top of the gang to control the entire city.

demos.name: Deadline Savior Demo
demos.short_description:
This idle RPG adventure is based on the "Pomodoro Technique." Complete focused work sessions to advance your character's exploration.
To reclaim the Goddess's Hourglass and restore peace, the hero must defeat the evil dragon "Procrastination" and its minions.
The world’s fate is in your hands!

demos.name: Ventreville: A Cure for Sorrow Demo
demos.short_description: Interrogate your own player characters in this six-chapter murder mystery! Make your choices carefully, as your decisions determine how many clues you uncover before the detective, the final player character, questions you. Will your protagonists know enough to catch the murderer?

demos.name: Sexorcism Demo
demos.short_description: Sexorcism is an adult game combining roulette and spell-build crafting. As Ely runs out of Mana in battle, you become her exclusive “Provider.” Fight monsters by her side with Spells, Artifacts, and a “special” way to replenish Mana and turn fate around.

demos.name: Space Show edition 17 Demo
demos.short_description: Nervous, dynamic space shooter. Pass all the tests and become THE BEST.

demos.name: Flow Of War Demo
demos.short_description: A classic RTS with Auto-Micro. Workers perform their tasks and your Army fighting automatically. Free up your hands to focus on building a strategic defense base and crafting army combos with mighty heroes to destroy enemies on endless procedurally generated maps.

demos.name: Reports from Vera Cruz Demo
demos.short_description: Investigate the country of Vera Cruz in this journalistic first-person adventure! Solve puzzles, take photos of clues and report news exposing the horrific truths behind General Galba and his bizarre government!

highlights.trailer_name: Reports from Vera Cruz - Announcement Trailer

demos.name: Cultivation Realm: Card Survival Demo
demos.short_description: Cultivation Realm: Card Survival Demo is a cultivation survival game built around card-based interactions. Trapped in a mysterious realm that drains your lifespan but brims with spirit power, you must cultivate, survive, fight, and find a way to escape.

demos.name: Botfestation Demo
demos.short_description: Incremental tower defense for 1-4 players. Deploy towers, take your exoskeleton bot into battle, harvest resources, unlock a massive skill tree, and survive relentless techno-insect swarms.

demos.name: 天临混元 Demo
demos.short_description: "Tianlin Hunyuan" is a Chinese-style Xianxia SRPG with chess strategy and Roguelike elements, set in an open world. Players uncover lies and pursue freedom in a complex world of deep emotions and power struggles, embarking on an epic strategic and emotional adventure.

demos.name: 我所向往的美好结局 Demo
demos.short_description:
这个游戏DEMO版本是《我所向往的美好结局》的序章。
这里是充满快乐与希望的小镇，没有痛苦、没有悲伤、没有那些毫无意义的争斗。
在这里，你可以与小白人们玩耍，可以见到珍视的朋友们，可以看到你所爱的家人们，
只不过…这一切似乎……过于美好了……

demos.name: One Fenix Down Demo
demos.short_description:
A retro-inspired, classic turn-based RPG for those with nostalgia for the '90s golden era. 
Explore a vast world with 14 playable characters, fight hundreds of unique enemies, and delve into an epic story of war, betrayal, and redemption.

demos.name: The Life and Suffering of Prince Jerian Demo
demos.short_description: This is a narrative role-playing game telling the story of a crown prince of the Blessed Arknian Empire. You possess great power, but are also burdened by duty. Can you change the world and stay true to yourself? Every decision comes with a cost.

demos.name: Hollow Home Demo
demos.short_description: Hollow Home is a narrative survival RPG set in a city under siege. Learn to adapt, choose who to trust and make decisions that carry real weight. No weapons, no battles and no easy answers.

highlights.trailer_name: Hollow Home - Steam Next Fest Trailer

demos.name: Fairtravel Battle CCG Demo
demos.short_description: Let your magic run wild in this fast-paced fantasy card game, with a unique resource system, back-and-forth battles, moddable cards and multiple unique game modes. Play alone or with up to four players online, without needing to pay for new cards.

demos.name: The Three Kingdoms of Shadows DEMO
demos.short_description: The Three Kingdoms of Shadows blends eerie folklore with Three Kingdoms epic in a strategy game of faction politics and resource management. Play as Liu Bei in Xuzhou — enact decrees, win hearts, suppress rivals where history and occult intertwine. Rise to become an overlord.

demos.name: City Of Corals Demo
demos.short_description: Save the coral reef city in this cute tiny adventure game! Meet the colourful residents of this underwater city, explore the streets, befriend different species of fish and help them restore the corals to their former glory! This demo features the first level of the game.

demos.name: Surface Demo
demos.short_description: A Linear first person adventure. The game is about exploring creepy liminal environments without monsters or puzzles, you simply walk and look around.

demos.name: Sixth Force Demo
demos.short_description: Harness the Sixth Force: a bond that keeps you close and powers your energy whips. Levitate, swing, freeze obstacles, fight ridiculous enemies, and solve puzzles on the run through sweet chaos in a comedy co-op adventure for two where something stranger waits just beneath the sugar coating.

demos.name: Dunebound Tactics Demo
demos.short_description: Lead your band of survivors on a perilous trek across unforgiving sands in search of a new home. Battle ruthless factions, scavenge dwindling resources, reshape the terrain to your advantage and make life-or-death choices in Dunebound Tactics, a Roguelite Turn-Based Tactical RPG.

demos.name: Peacemaker: Bloody Emperor Demo
developers: MaouCat Studio / 魔王貓工作室
demos.short_description: A JRPG about a princess knight's psychological downfall. An honorable princess knight must fight the Bloody Emperor, a ruthless usurper. But through a forced marriage to a vassal and the looming threat of a female dark lord, her ideals gradually begin to crumble...

demos.name: CUBOID Demo
demos.short_description: CUBOID is a challenging spatial puzzle game with minimalist design, where you progress through a labyrinth of levels using a unique mechanic of merging with world blocks.

demos.name: Go North Demo
demos.short_description: Wander a world filled with cleverly-crafted mazes. Whoever can solve them all gets their wish granted by the Maze God. Explore beautiful mazes, discover unique items and help other maze explorers complete unusual side quests in this cozy and immersive maze adventure!

demos.name: Office Aberrations Demo
demos.short_description: Office Aberrations is a first-person, spot-the-difference game, where you are stuck in an endlessly looping hallway. Determine if anything is out of place by carefully examining your surroundings. No detail is too small. Knowing if and where there are aberrations is your only way through.

demos.name: HYPERWIRED Demo
demos.short_description: Pilot a ship with a charger hanging. Explore an ever-changing space an plug to recharge your energy while surviving the enemy breach in this cable-like space shooter with roguelike elements and plugged resource management.

demos.name: KYRO Demo
demos.short_description: In this 30-45 minute demo, play as Aiden. Explore the Forest of Ka'a, solve puzzles to uncover ancient ruins, and use your slingshot and the KYRO system to conquer early bosses in this top-down, pixel art action-adventure prologue.

demos.name: Don't Fret Demo
demos.short_description: A sentient guitar trapped inside a nightmare music school. Hide, distract, and survive horrifying creatures as you tune your way through musical puzzles and fractured memories to uncover the truth.

demos.name: Signy & Mino: Against All Gods Demo
demos.short_description: Signy & Mino is a Tag-Team Battle RPG where every move combos together! Try the 40 min playtime Demo now and discover your hidden powers as you find yourself hurtled into a conflict among the gods!

demos.name: Fool's Guild Demo
demos.short_description: A cozy idle economy game that quietly runs beneath your desktop while your fantasy guild slowly grows throughout the day.

demos.name: Poolcore: Submersion Demo
demos.short_description: Immerse yourself in poolcore-inspired vibes as you explore a vast complex of mind-bending liminal architecture straight out of your dreams. Navigate through a facility filled with obstacles and puzzles, venturing into depths that descend far below the rippling, chlorinated waters.

demos.name: Till the End Demo
demos.short_description: Earth has fallen. Recruit survivors in the ruins, activate their unique Power Suits, and fight back against endless alien hordes in this solo-developed sci-fi roguelite wave shooter. Master Bushido blades, Centurion tanks, or Magi blasts — become unstoppable.

demos.name: THANKS, LIGHT. - DEMO
demos.short_description: A first-person puzzler where light reshapes physics and geometry — a glitch-laced mystery for the people who still keep a portal gun, a camera, and a perspective shift in their library.

demos.name: Project: Break//Down - Beta Demo
demos.short_description: Project: Break//Down is a single-player, experimental,  3D, action-adventure brawler with a unique limb-based combat system. In this game demo, you explore the EZON complex's Storage Department, a mass production and distribution facility secretly gone rogue in the shoes of 2 fools.

demos.name: Land of Oblivion Demo
demos.short_description:
Explore a forgotten world through jumping, combat, and discovery.
Land of Oblivion is a light-paced 2D action platformer with Metroidvania elements.

demos.name: Kicking Brass Demo
demos.short_description: There's a tuba stuck on your head and it won't come off! Fight your way through this third-person bullet hell roguelike with instruments in order to become the champion of King Brasshoven's arena!

demos.name: Asbak Demo
demos.short_description: Asbak is action hack n' slash platformer. Exorcise the demons lurking in urban Indonesia. BE FEARLESS!

demos.name: Battle of Arachnidia Demo
demos.short_description: Battle of Arachnidia  is a fast-paced top-down shooter in which you fight back against hordes of arachnid robots. Protect your base by destroying all enemies by coming up with different tactics, improving your robot and using different help bonuses.

demos.name: Sojourn Past Demo
demos.short_description: Sojourn Past is an exploration game, a journey of finding hope in the face of adversary. Set in a handcrafted world, discover it’s mysteries, overcome its tough bullet-hell inspired challenges and embrace hope in this action-adventure.

demos.name: BraveYard 勇者之墓 Demo
demos.short_description: This is a demo based on the development version of “Braveyard”. It includes the basic systems of the game, limited skills, and the content of the first level.

demos.name: Beats Of Un'sonia Demo
demos.short_description:
Dive into a rhythmic combat game where every move counts!
Adapt your playstyle, explore diverse biomes, face epic bosses, and push your score higher. Face the beat... and conquer it!

demos.name: Outclaw Demo
demos.short_description: Collect and command a horde of mischievous minions as you explore this starry world. Turn chaos into connection in this surreal puzzle action-adventure about carving out your own strange little family.

demos.name: Dumbriel: Magnificent Adventure in Hell Demo
demos.short_description: Dumbriel is a 2D metroidvania action-adventure set in Hell. Play as a clumsy fallen angel in a twisted underworld. Slash, craft, and dodge through deadly arenas, weird monsters, and hellish traps. Die, upgrade, and dive back in.

highlights.trailer_name: Dumbriel Gameplay Trailer - Kickstarter + NextFest Announcement

demos.name: Aikyam Demo
demos.short_description: Dazzle the hearts of disgruntled villagers with extravagant turn-based battles and rally them against demons in this Bollywood-inspired fantasy RPG!

demos.name: Forsaken Lands Demo
demos.short_description: Lead a team of brave heroes in a card battle to save the world! You will face dangers at every turn, countless enemies, mysterious relics, and unexpected allies. Overcome challenges using both brute strength and the power of persuasion!

demos.name: RoboGAL: Gaga Delta Lady - Demo
demos.short_description: Experience a taste of Rei-Bo's adventures in two stages full of obstacles and traps and face each of the GALs at the end.

highlights.trailer_name: RoboGAL: Gaga Delta Lady - NEW DEMO RELEASE

demos.name: Daimyo Reign Demo
demos.short_description: Unify Medieval Japan in this real-time tactical grand strategy game. Build your domain, recruit armies, plan your attack, and fracture your enemies with rebellions to win!

demos.name: Ashes of the Damned: The Forgotten Ward Demo
The Last Good Boy - Demo
demos.short_description: The best Idle RPG inspired by a dog named Ramon in the World! Okay, seriously now: you play as a brown shih tzu on a journey to find his missing friends. Gather resources, unlock the map, fight monsters, and grab their loot, proving that you are the best dog in the world!

highlights.trailer_name: The Last Good Boy | Demo Trailer 2026

demos.name: Cars 'n Guns Demo
demos.short_description:
Burn rubber and pull the trigger! Drift, race, and blast your way through artistic tracks in gorgeous customizable cars.
Challenge friends in split-screen or LAN/online multiplayer.
Replay recorded races from cinematic angles and playback speeds to create unforgettable videos.

demos.name: Bulbo's Belief System Demo
demos.short_description: Bulbo's Belief System is a puzzle-platformer where knowledge is both a tool and an obstacle. Bulbo believes everything he's told, letting him see, move, and interact, but he can forget! Erase walls from existence, ignore gravity and manage conflicting beliefs to solve cute mind-bending challenges.

highlights.trailer_name: LAGS - Summer Game Fest 2026 Extended Trailer

demos.name: Garuda Emblem Demo
demos.short_description: Campus turned warzone. Thugs took over, and Farid & Rani are fighting back. No rules, no textbooks—just fists and whatever isn't bolted down. Grab a weapon and tear it up in this hardcore hand-drawn brawler!

demos.name: Keru and the Guardians of the Universe Demo
franchises: Keru and the Guardians of the Universe

demos.name: ATTENTION DEFICIT - A story about ADHD Demo
demos.short_description: An abstract visual novel about a girl dealing with the challenges of having ADHD while trying to complete a school assignment before the deadline.

demos.name: HOMEPAGE Demo
demos.short_description: A horror anomaly finder where you are contracted to observe websites and report errors and changes. But there is more to your clients than meets the eye.

demos.name: Trailer Park Zombies Demo
demos.short_description:
Trailer Park Zombies is a survival roguelite shooter with random procedural levels. Shoot endless waves of zombies. Select your favorite hillbilly character, find the best level ups and weapons. 

How long are you able to survive in the trailer park?

demos.name: Capy Stream: Rise to Fame (Demo)
demos.short_description: Try to become an internet star in the Capy Stream: Rise to Fame demo by playing as a cute and fluffy streamer! Relax in a hot tub, eat sweet fruits, and have fun to gain fame!

demos.name: Montabi: Monster Taming Roguelike Deckbuilder Demo
demos.short_description: Tame, collect, fight! Assemble an unstoppable team of unique Montabi in this Creature-Collector Roguelike Deckbuilder. Master their awesome abilities, synergize their strategic strengths and save the city in tactical turn-based combat!

demos.name: Shaky Hand Demo
demos.short_description: Shaky Hand is an arcade game where you deliver food to tables and avoid dropping it on the floor. Dodge obstacles and work quickly before your customers get upset!

demos.name: Nion Forge Demo
demos.short_description: Your ship is your build. Put it together in the hangar with 50+ modules, fly out, survive the swarms and take down the district boss – then come back with scrap for your next attempt. The demo gives you the full loop: 4 districts, 100+ upgrades, 30+ cores.

demos.name: Shape Sender Deluxe Demo
demos.short_description: Hi, it's Sendy. Try my 16 handcrafted physics puzzles, share your best solutions as GIFs, and try not to leave me alone for too long. Roughly 15-20 min of your time. A reasonable ask, I think.

demos.name: Wanderers' Outpost Demo
demos.short_description: A Colony-Sim in a dungeonpunk-fantasy world where you build outpost near ancient ruins, support adventurers, and tax their loot. Expand your outpost, survive waves of dungeon-born monsters, and ultimately conquer the depths before they consume the outpost.

demos.name: Stella Magical Idol Demo
demos.short_description: In Stella Magical Idol you need to help the incredible Idol & Magical shojo Stella find the time for her "special" hobby by solving funny and horny puzzles.

demos.name: Dungeon Raid Demo
demos.short_description: Dungeon Raid is an adventure card roguelike. Dive deeper and deeper into the dungeon. Use everything you find to defeat enemies and kill the final boss. Good luck! And try not to die... from hunger.

demos.name: 舰魂重构 Demo
demos.short_description:
Plot - The Earth has been destroyed, and you are transformed into a space fighter by a mysterious force to take revenge on the aliens.
Gameplay - You can get some props after each level. Different placement positions of the props will bring different benefits to your battleship and weapons.

demos.name: CastleOn Demo
demos.short_description: Build a castle! Grow economy, recruit troops from Europe and the Holy Land, man the walls and towers! Place traps and defeat attackers with arrows, wood and stone, fire, disease and cold steel! Survive the Third Crusade and conquer enemy lands in this turn-based strategy!

demos.name: Ship Shape Slam!!! Demo
demos.short_description: Out-dodge, out-dash, and outlast your friends in chaotic 1–4 player bullet hell arenas. Side effects may include shouting, betrayal, and broken couches.

demos.name: Car Wash Simulator (Demo)
demos.short_description: FOAM! RINSE! SHINE! Jump into the car washing business and take a high-pressure look at this official demo! Blast road grime with rich active foam, master core cleaning mechanics from windows to tires on 3 unique cars, and test-drive vehicles in the parking lot!

demos.name: UNGALAND! Demo
demos.short_description: "Dive into a prehistoric world of adventure where the power of primal seeds changes everything. Unlock abilities, attach them to your weapons, and face challenges in a vibrant land full of action, and surprises."

demos.name: Blackjack Roulette Demo
demos.short_description: Blackjack rogue-like with a Roulette "spin". Collect Boules with Chaotic Effects and Purchase Insurance Policies with unique abilities  that give you the edge while taking on a larger Roulette wheels with even larger Buy-In Costs.

highlights.trailer_name: Blackjack Roulette Next Fest Demo Trailer

demos.name: Battle Among Stars - Alien Wars Demo
demos.short_description: Free Demo. No commitment. Just command. Play the first chapter of the Campaign with 5 complete missions and 2 maps from the Quick Battle Rogue Skirmish. The War has only just begun. Download for free and dive into the beginning of this journey.

highlights.trailer_name: Battle Among Stars - Alien War Demo

demos.name: The Hollow Complex Demo
demos.short_description: The Hollow Complex Demo is an action-filled survival thriller inspired by the Backrooms. Dive into one area of a dark and twisted rendition of internet folklore that actually allows you to fight back. Explore, scavenge, complete quests, and find a way out.

demos.name: Upbaka! Demo
demos.short_description: A chaotic roguelite where every floor is a mess, the enemies don’t know what they’re doing, and neither do you. Fight, loot, and climb the tower... or die trying.

demos.name: Orbital Demo
demos.short_description: Can you survive? Orbital is an infinite survival space game where you must out run a massive black hole that threatens the entire galaxy. Navigate wormholes, blow up asteroids, and use futuristic technology to stay alive against the dangers of space and earn your spot at the top of the leaderboard.

demos.name: 小Q-LITTLE Q- Demo
demos.short_description: This is an RPG game similar to the Metroid series. Players will play as a little scientist and create a robot named Little Q to destroy the mechanical city of Crazy Scientists

demos.name: Made in Lucifer City Demo
demos.short_description: Build and design your demon castle with unique room combinations, fend off invading heroes and adventurers, harvest resources from their failed assaults, and recruit them into your ever-growing army. Hear their stories — each hailing from a different world—and listen to their voices.

demos.name: MineGeon: Renegades Demo
demos.short_description: Descend into the dangerous depths of PAIMO in this co-op sci-fi roguelite bullet-hell focused on resource gathering. Play solo or with friends as you fight, gather resources, and upgrade together. The deeper you go, the greater the risks, rewards, and secrets waiting beneath the surface.

demos.name: 虚轴实刃-Virtual Axis Real Blade Demo
Machinefall Demo
demos.short_description: Machinefall is a post-apocalyptic real time strategy game set on a fully playable global map. Lead humanity’s last survivors as they build bases, gather resources, and wage massive battles against an overwhelming machine swarm. Progress through technological eras from Stone Age to Space Age.

demos.name: Bloodmoon Survivors Demo
demos.short_description: You are a Lunar Knight of the Blood Moon, and tonight is your night.  It's time for violence.   Take the fight to the twisted horrors conjured by the Blood Moon.  Gain experience, grow stronger, and synergize your weapons to crush the enemy forces and survive the night.

demos.name: Tidal Rush: Demo
demos.short_description: Jump on your Hydrospeeder and hit the waves in Tidal Rush – a high-speed arcade racer where fun always comes first! Master water physics and engage in friendly competition in both singleplayer and multiplayer races! Face the odds to become the ultimate racer!

demos.name: Port of Jumanah Demo
demos.short_description: Port of Jumanah is a 2.5D Action Game with Rogue-lite elements, Charming Visual, and Snappy Combat. Players take on the role of Mansour, a young man who finds himself in a series of unfortunate events that bring him on a world-saving Journey.

demos.name: Club Soko Demo
demos.short_description: Navigate your way deep into an underground nightclub and discover secrets hidden in its depths.

demos.name: Cosmic Fear Demo
demos.short_description: You’ve discovered evidence of a cosmic presence influencing humanity since its origins. Now something born in the depths of the cosmos is calling again. Investigate, uncover forbidden knowledge and survive a disturbing first person Lovecraftian horror adventure.

demos.name: Glory On Pluto Demo
demos.short_description: Build the perfect, chaotic rocket engine in this numbers-go-up space roguelite. Load your ship with wacky fuel items, chase the right synergies and pray that it’s enough to get you to Pluto. Push it as far as you can before it all falls apart. Chaotic. Glorious. Human.

highlights.trailer_name: Glory On Pluto - Release Date Trailer

demos.name: Death In Your Dice Demo
demos.short_description: Roll the dice… or cities die. Learn lethal rules, twist outcomes, accept the cost. One bad throw calls the bombs. Win to delay death. Lose to become a murderer. Every choice reshapes your ending. Fate is loaded. Your turn is encoded?

demos.name: Rope Grabber Demo
demos.short_description: PET SHOOT CHIPTUNE.

demos.name: The Glory Dungeon Raider Demo
demos.short_description: Enter the depths of a treacherous dungeon in The Glory Dungeon Raider, a fast-paced 2D roguelike where every run is a new challenge! Arm yourself with various weapons, and face off against deadly creatures. Do you have what it takes to survive?

highlights.trailer_name: The Glory Dungeon Raider Eng Trailer

demos.name: Sweep The Underworld Demo
demos.short_description: Break into the dangerous underworld and keep moving forward bravely.  Prepare the weapon combination in advance, summon and put away the weapon group at any time in the battle to deal with all crises.  Feel a real-time combat experience full of strategy!

demos.name: Remnant Blade: The Scarlet Edge Demo
Ravengrave: Iron Bonds Demo
demos.short_description:
You are the blacksmith of a Viking village. You forge what you're asked, fulfill your orders and pay your debts. Something in this village doesn't add up, and you're part of it without knowing it.
Your father has disappeared, debts don't wait, and neither does the fire.

demos.name: Fairysite Demo
demos.short_description:
This is a demo for Fairysite. 

You play a colony of fairies. On one side, you depends on the humans for resources. On the other side, they can expand fast and overrun your structures. You must maintain the balance between restricting the humans and letting them expand unchecked.

demos.name: The Button Effect – Demo
demos.short_description: Every button has a purpose. In this short, minimalist first-person puzzler you explore a dense, interwoven architecture – a museum, full of hidden connections and spatial insights.

demos.name: Blade of Mercy: Bloody Countess Demo
Tiny Bomber Demo
demos.short_description: Tiny Bomber is a 2D vertical scrolling action game blending roguelike elements with bullet-hell dodging. Players control a tiny bomber, navigating procedurally generated levels, avoiding bullets, and bombing enemies. With a countdown system and random upgrades, each run is a thrilling challenge.

demos.name: Grimdelve Demo
demos.short_description: Play the first hour of Grimdelve. Guide two souls through a dying world beneath a medieval Slovenia and decide who they become. Sneak past strangers, try to understand them, or tear them apart. Become charming manipulators or complete disasters.

demos.name: Children's Garden Demo
demos.short_description: Welcome to the Reincarnation Ethics Program "Children's Garden." This is a puzzle game where you seek eternal rest.

demos.name: CORPSE CARNIVAL DEMO
demos.short_description: "CORPSE CARNIVAL" is a top-down action-adventure game where you will play as Li Xiaomeng, a first-year student at the "Linge" Military Academy, and escape from a city filled with zombies and monsters alongside "Asami Yuki."

demos.name: A Lighthouse Tale Demo
demos.short_description:
Return to the island of your childhood and relive fragments of your lost memories.
Discover what your grandfather wanted you to remember.

demos.name: 混元灵印 Demo
demos.short_description: 2D automation factory game, set in an chinese ancient fantasy world,play as a sigil Master,puzzle-solving, programming, optimize production to meet time, financial, or spatial constraints.

demos.name: MEATHOOK Demo
demos.short_description: Survival horror FPS with a physics-driven weapon system. You are bound to a sinister conveyor mechanism. Reach for weapons and items, navigate labyrinthine tunnels, and blast your path to worthiness!

demos.name: ExoDomia Demo
demos.short_description: Exodomia is a narrative-driven, action-adventure game set on the robotic world of Salakar V! In this fast-paced combat experience, you will encounter many dangerous creatures and enemies as you navigate a story of struggle and survival.

demos.name: Vault of Fallen Demo
demos.short_description: Vault of Fallen is a brutal first-person action game set on a cursed island. Blast enemies with a powerful shotgun or slash through undead hordes with sword and shield in a fast-paced, dark fantasy world where science and sorcery collide. This demo does not include the final abilities of the player.

demos.name: King's Guard Demo
demos.short_description: In this turn-based strategy roguelike your job is to keep an ungrateful king alive. As the royal guard's manager you unlock upgrades, assign badges for special skills and try to keep morale and supplies from collapsing faster than the monarchy.

demos.name: 构想彼方 ImagineFuture Demo
demos.short_description:
"Imagine Future" is a Visual Novel with a campus theme. You will follow the perspective of the protagonist Ji Wang, experience the life of a high school student.
The final examination seemed so far away. one day, it was close at hand.
Standing at the crossroads of life, what choice will you make?

demos.name: Astro Combat Demo
demos.short_description: This is an "Arcade-style Beat 'em Up" with "Real-time Tactics" and "Action RPG" elements. Choose to engage in a rampage or opt for stealth. After the main story, explore regions, collect items, battle foes, and develop your team.

demos.name: HellDrop Demo
demos.short_description: HELL DROP is a roguelite action shooter with modular ship-building. Drop into a hostile insect planet, assemble upgrades on the descent, breach the crust, and detonate the core.

demos.name: Leaforia Demo
demos.short_description: Build and manage your cozy farm while gathering resources and crafting potions. Meet and befriend three key NPCs, explore the village, and engage in combat as you uncover a story leading to an attack on a lumberjack camp.

demos.name: O.U.T.T. Demo
demos.short_description: O.U.T.T. is a Turn-Based Puzzle Adventure set in São Paulo, 22nd century. In a Soul Punk story, as Flavia, an ingenious psy-scientist, you must use your wits to unveil the source of those evil doings on this deep narrative, puzzle game.

demos.name: Nested Demo
demos.short_description: Nested is a cute grid-based puzzle game made around the concept of russian nesting dolls.   Come twist your brain as you stack, push and interact with the various objects you'll find in each levels. Let's see if you can reach the right combination of nesting dolls to solve every one of them!

demos.name: Island Keeper (Demo)
demos.short_description: Embark on a heartwarming eco-adventure as you breathe new life into polluted islands, gather trash, craft equipment, build your sanctuary, and witness nature flourish in a vibrant, ever-changing world. Welcome to Island Keeper DEMO.

demos.name: Gloopalaxy (Demo)
demos.short_description: Collect and study strange aquatic creatures in Gloopalaxy! Discover new life forms, create the perfect ecosystem for their well-being, and complete all kinds of objectives to earn your diploma.

demos.name: Nowhere to Run Demo
demos.short_description: Get a unique introduction to the world of our interactive film, "Nowhere to Run"! This demo allows you to lead the investigation of a girl's disappearance. Will you be able to find out the truth?

demos.name: PengPong Demo
demos.short_description: PengPong is a single-player survivor-like shooter where you play as a penguin with a hockey stick who bounces everything in sight. Inspired by 1940s–60s American amusement culture, it features chaotic pinball-style combat and vintage cartoon monsters in a unique survival showdown.

demos.name: Grim Trials Demo
demos.short_description: Reap the whirlwind. In this demo for Grim Trials—a roguelite dungeon crawler—hone your scythe skills and refine your equipment with every run until nothing can stop your rise as a Grim Reaper!

demos.name: Cube Party Demo
demos.short_description: Cube Party is a 2-8 player co-op puzzle and adventure game! Team up with friends, stack your box characters into walls, solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and find the key to clear 40+ unique levels!

demos.name: FENDERSHOT Demo
demos.short_description: Intense street racing with some outrageous Race Tech™. Inspired by Blur, Midnight Club and NFS:U. Split-Screen local multiplayer. Blazing fast on PC and Steam Deck. Coming soon on Mac.

demos.name: War Tactics Demo
demos.short_description: 《War Tactics》is a turn-based tactical game inspired by "Advance Wars". Command military units on square grids in modern warfare scenarios. Features deep tactics, intuitive controls, rich unit variety, complex terrain interactions, and single-player campaigns. Plan and conquer with your intellect.

demos.name: Junko's Part Time Job !! Demo
demos.short_description: "Your choices have always mattered, please don't forget that." - A creepy-cute otome visual novel where you follow a loyal group of friends' descent into anomalies, magical girls and more! ♡

demos.name: World Inverted Demo
demos.short_description: The sky lies beneath our feet.Above stretches a vast plane. From it hang forests of inverted buildings, linked by narrow corridors and pipes. They stand in silence, like upside-down obelisks pointing toward the eye of the sun.This game reveals an upside-down world through words and unique visuals.

demos.name: The Comeback King Demo
demos.short_description: The Comeback King is a light-hearted retro boxing management game set in the UK in the 1980s.

demos.name: MIHASHIRA Demo
demos.short_description: A top-down 2D action shooter. Pixel art reminiscent of the Super Nintendo. Characters with scrolling rights can scroll freely. Easy to use with the Directional pad, 2-shot button, and bomb button. Collect items, unleash your hyper limit, and mow down enemies.

demos.name: Panzer Fantasy 16 Bits Demo
demos.short_description: "A Novel Published in 16 Bits! Spanish indie isekai, adapted by the author to Mega Drive. Linear visual novel blending satire on RPGs and the isekai genre, where two Spanish soldiers are transported—along with a Leopard 2 tank—into what appears to be a medieval fantasy role-playing game session."

demos.name: Echoes From Ciudadela Demo
demos.short_description: Wield your Balearic sling in a first-person puzzle narrative adventure through ancient ruins. This demo offers a hands-on preview of Ciudadela’s early puzzles and mysteries. Letting you discover the first secrets of the forgotten civilization and getting familiar with the core mechanics.

demos.name: Mushroom Madness Demo
demos.short_description:
Mushroom Madness is a fast chaotic multiplayer brawler where you play as a little mushroom trying to knock friends off a crumbling arena. Dash, dodge, shoot, and grab powerups as the floor falls away beneath you. 

Can you survive the longest?

demos.name: DinoSwarm Demo
demos.short_description: DinoSwarm is a roguelite where you can hybridize Dinosaurs, fuse Powers and Elements, and more! The Swarm Queen is ready to invade the dimensions and gather as much DNA as she can. She will grant you incredible powers and enhancements. Invade Dimensions to collect DNA, Powers and Elements.

demos.name: Spirited Line Demo
demos.short_description: Spirited Line is a boss rush hack ‘n’ slash action game where every hit you take is fatal. Master precise, skill-based combat against unique spirits in a surreal, minimalist subway world. Fast-paced duels demand focus, timing, and patience to survive.

demos.name: 痴情妹妹纱雪的兄控日记  Demo
demos.short_description: TamaMako首部原创游戏，以闷骚妹妹VS妹控哥哥为主题。夏日的心动同居物语从此开始！本游戏内含五篇ASMR音声，让你的体验不再单调！夏日的每一天，我们的妹妹要如何表达自己的爱意呢？

demos.name: Elemental Witches Demo
demos.short_description: In Elemental Witches world, you command Fire, Wind, and Thunder to craft unique spells from three elemental orbs. Merge identical elements to summon powerful pets. After each battle, upgrade elements, unlock items, and shape your own playstyle as you face new adventures.

demos.name: Marble Mirage Demo
demos.short_description: A homoerotic thriller visual novel set in a luxurious men’s spa. Investigate a murder, pursue romance, solve puzzles, and uncover dangerous secrets.

demos.name: Build a Mecha Demo
demos.short_description: You must upgrade your mech as you battle your way through an army of robots to destroy their central generator.

demos.name: Puppeteer: No Strings Attached Demo
demos.short_description: In a world controlled by strings, YOU are not attached. Fight your way through champions of ancient fairy tales in this action packed boss-rush game, escape the grip of The Puppeteer, and write your own ending.

highlights.trailer_name: Puppeteer: No Strings Attached Demo Trailer

demos.name: Dice Rogues Demo
demos.short_description: Dice Rogues is a tactical roguelite with infinite possibilities where you upgrade your dice and harness unpredictable rogue faces (X2, baguette, croissant, etc.) to bend fate, outplay the House, and survive a new roll each run.

demos.name: Whatta Frogs? Demo
demos.short_description: Trick up to 5 amphibian friends into choosing the wrong box and trump over them in this social deduction multiplayer game!

demos.name: Your Forever Friend Demo

demos.name: Down Under Destruction - Demo

Experiment with runes, accessories, and pets. Discover the island’s mysteries and rebuild your sanctuary to uncover what the island truly wants.

demos.name: It's Chopping Time! Demo
demos.short_description: It's Chopping Time! Demo is a short incremental game about chopping down trees on a secluded island by using your mouse and the lightning strikes!

puzzletwist-demo
demos.short_description: Extreme Difficulty Warning: Except for the first few easy levels, all other stages will crush even streamers and leave them in tears.

demos.name: Empire at Risk Demo
demos.short_description: Expand, conquer and dominate your rivals on dynamic hex maps. Capture regions, secure supply and adapt to every seed. Battle friends or AI in solo and multiplayer matches with up to 4 players and climb the leaderboard.

demos.name: Cryptoria Demo – Enter the Depths
demos.short_description: A dark top-down dungeon experience focused on survival, skill-based combat, and atmosphere. Explore a mysterious dungeon, face dangerous enemies, and master core mechanics in this early demo of Cryptoria.

demos.name: Rondo's Romp Demo
demos.short_description: Join Rondo, a cheerful Akita pup, as he explores 8 whimsical worlds, digging up coins, items, and throwable objects to solve puzzles, battle enemies, and uncover secrets... all with the charm and challenge of a classic 2D platformer!

demos.name: Furry Adventure Club and the Temple of Pawsion 🐱 Demo
demos.short_description: 🐱 Join Indica and her furry friends on their return to adventure! The Temple of Pawsion is filled with secrets, puzzles, and chances for love in the most unexpected places. It’s time to join the Furry Adventure Club!

highlights.trailer_name: Furry Adventure Club and the Temple of Pawsion 🐱 Trailer
Furry Adventure Club and the Temple of Pawsion Gameplay

demos.name: Hollow Alchemist Demo
demos.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where alchemy fuels your cards, dice shape your fate, and sins whisper in your ear. Build your deck, forge your path, and decide what kind of soul you’ll become. All buffs react to one another as proper alchemy should do!

demos.name: Bedtime Nightmare Demo
demos.short_description: Complete nightly tasks and keep the lights alive. Survive what lurks in the dark.

demos.name: Spinning Scarecrow Demo
demos.short_description: A dark arcade puzzle game where a Spinning Scarecrow faces deadly traps, grotesque minigames, and precision challenges in a fully hand-drawn world.

demos.name: Spaceborn Awakening Demo
demos.short_description: Spaceborn: Awakening is a narrative-driven roguelite bullet-heaven where you step into the role of a legendary space crew, answering a mysterious distress signal. Eliminate hordes of the Voss Praetor’s corrupted army, awaken your true potential, become a Spaceborn - decide the fate of the universe.

demos.name: Retro Arcade Shop Simulator (Demo)
demos.short_description: Try the Demo and transform a dusty room into a profitable Retro Arcade Shop! Place Car Simulators, Basketball hoops, and Arcade Machines. Set up a Bowling Area to increase your hourly income. Customize your walls, manage the cafeteria, and build your 80s venue!

demos.name: The Aquarium (Demo)
demos.short_description: Plunge beneath the surface and discover the enchantment of The Aquarium (Demo). Set sail, scoop up fish by hand, and transform your catch into breathtaking custom aquariums. Unwind, nurture your aquatic companions, and craft a tranquil sanctuary in this gentle, immersive journey.

demos.name: The Wake (Demo): A Lovecraftian Fishing Tale
demos.short_description: Set sail on the dark waters of a forgotten archipelago. Catch mutated monsters with customizable gear, master eldritch magic, and fight for survival. Take up arms to fend off sea beasts in an unforgiving Lovecraftian world.

demos.name: Kitty Burger Demo
demos.short_description: Ready for a peaceful day at Kitty Burger? This demo lets you serve warm burgers to purring customers and enjoy a few levels. Full game unlocks more content and continues beyond the demo’s end.

demos.name: Streetlight Syndicate Demo
demos.short_description: A casual, story-driven incremental game set in 1920s New York. Build your criminal empire from speakeasies to protection rackets, fight rival hitmen, meet colorful characters, and become the city's most powerful crime lord.

demos.name: Crow's Requiem - Prologue Demo
demos.short_description: The world is sick — and you are the body collector in this Pandemicpunk cRPG. Take the role of Fisher, a veteran Crow, and take your first steps into the City. Collect the dead; or risk joining them in the first two days of your Crow's Requiem dark work.

demos.name: The Lost Land Of Bahía Blanca Demo
demos.short_description: In this visual novel with light RPG elements, you’ll come out of exile to walk into the bloody belly of a vampiric regime once more in search of a past that still haunts you. Embark on a journey inspired by the horrors of the last Argentine civil-military dictatorship.

demos.name: Flecto Demo
demos.short_description: Flecto is a puzzle game where you place blocks in order to deflect bullets and shatter targets. Strategically use your tiles to split bullets, bounce them around each level, and destroy every target.

demos.name: Phantom Floor Demo
demos.short_description: You are trapped on the Phantom Floor. You must find a way to escape, but keep quiet, it's always listening.

demos.name: Backrooms Fishing Demo
demos.short_description: Idle and catch mysterious creatures lurking in the Poolrooms. Upgrade your fishing equipment, research bizarre specimens, and build your collection as you uncover the secrets of the Backrooms. Every catch will bring you closer to understanding this strange realm.

demos.name: Supermarket Guard Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Work as a security guard at a shady supermarket. Check customers, stop thieves, upgrade store security using various devices. Hire staff and do whatever it takes to protect the store. Become friends with your boss.

demos.name: Ribbit Jump Demo
demos.short_description: A precision platformer where every move counts. Try the initial Ribbit Jump experience. Adjust the power of each jump to progress through an increasingly demanding level design. Master the jump in this trial version that includes the first challenges of the game.

demos.name: BSG: Big Space Guns Demo
demos.short_description: BSG: Big Space Guns is a coop bullet hell roguelike where you step on giant buttons to activate cannons while you dodge bullets.

demos.name: 2 Hours to Refund Demo
demos.short_description: A 5×5 card strategy game where poker hands become combat skills. A single card affects multiple lines—maximize combos through strategic placement. Battle through 40+ stages to claim your refund.

demos.name: NEODRIVE Demo
demos.short_description: Tear through a solo time-attack campaign in a 1600HP stick-shift muscle car. Manage nitro and perfect your drift lines to get the author medal on every single one.

demos.name: Crystals Bureau
demos.short_description: Command your Escort Cart and navigate freely across the map! Plot your own defense routes, build towers, hunt for powerful artifacts, and defeat Umbra monsters to bring the Crystal Core home.

demos.name: Galaxy Critter Co. Demo
demos.short_description: Galaxy Critter Co. is a cute chaotic roguelike where tower defense meets top-down shooting: build turret lines, fight alongside fluffy operatives, and craft broken synergies to survive the massive Swarm.

demos.name: 她于深渊 Demo
demos.short_description: You accidentally intercept a distress signal from space—a girl codenamed C804 is venturing alone into a forbidden zone. Game time runs in perfect real-time sync with reality; every response, every silence, shapes her actions and decisions.

demos.name: Returnless Demo
demos.short_description: Eyeball Gun is your weapon. Use it to fight shadow enemies, manipulate time, and escape a city consumed by black fog - no pause, no checkpoints. Progress is saved at the end of a run in the full game.

demos.name: 卡包修仙 Demo
demos.short_description: "Cardpack Cultivation" is a roguelite cultivation sim where you play as a cultivator, and every run tells a new story.

demos.name: KharkivVision 2035 Demo
demos.short_description: This is an atmospheric demo version of the narrative indie game KharkivVision 2035 with open-world elements, dedicated to relocation, change, and a look into the future.

demos.name: Operation Obliteration 2 Demo
demos.short_description: Fight through a bloody WWII meat grinder. Cut scenes are cut. No handholding. No safe spaces. Every level is designed to be played hard and fast, with constant pressure and zero cinematic nonsense. If you survive, you will know what the obliteration universe is all about.

demos.name: Meow with Pipeline Demo
demos.short_description: Meow with Pipeline: a precision pixel platformer with lots of cute cats and challenges. Guide a cat through dangerous pipe networks—run, jump, dodge traps and master tough platforming. Tight controls and skill-based progression make every victory satisfyingly earned.

demos.name: Star Dice Demo
demos.short_description: A turn-based roguelike strategy game about crafting powerful builds through dice customization and relic synergies. Optimize your 3×3 dice grid, trigger massive combo chains, and reach unbelievable scores.

demos.name: After the Wane Demo
demos.short_description: Retracing the footsteps of a mother she never knew, Lena's trying to make it as a dancer in the city. Caught in a quarrel between dance companies, dealing with love and heartbreak and the challenges of young adulthood, she must also cope with the voice in her head commenting on everything she does.

demos.name: Heaven's Glaive Demo
demos.short_description: A classic-styled RPG, with deep lore and many different ways to experience it. On the island of Principium, secrets are hidden deep within the past, but most are not brave enough to seek them out. You are not like the rest. Find what lives within, Vanguard.

demos.name: When will I get Home? Demo
Space Imperia 4X Demo
demos.short_description: A faithful digital adaptation of the acclaimed board game by GMT Games, beloved by wargamers for almost two decades. Command the rise of your civilization and the fall of others, all in one to two hours.

demos.name: Atana Demo
demos.short_description: Atana is a female-led romance visual novel set in late 20th-century America, where you grow alongside your creator, Atana, as an AI.

demos.name: Author Sim Demo
demos.short_description: Have you ever dreamed of becoming a world-renowned author? Now's your chance! Study masterpieces from other authors, craft breathtaking stories, and maintain a public profile in pursuit of your dream.

demos.name: Restoration Demo
demos.short_description: Mother Nature fights back once more, a pixel-art journey to restore life to a world built on ruin.

demos.name: Soulblade: Dawnbreaker Demo
demos.short_description: 《Soulblade: Dawnbreaker》- Sidescrolling action-adventure with satisfying melee, roguelike runs, and gear collection! Explore late Ming's chaos, face court incompetence + treacherous martial arts—every journey brings new challenges. Ready to unsheathe your blade and rise as Dawnbreaker?

demos.name: Chainsaw Demo
demos.short_description: Become a GOD in this real-time turn-based combat RPG with non-stop brawling.

highlights.trailer_name: ティーザートレーラー01

demos.name: 叨叨巫师Chant Wizard Demo
demos.short_description: Chant Wizard is a real-time PvP spell card game. No turns, no waiting—just a live battle of wits over time and resources. Build your deck across five schools of magic—every spell must be chanted aloud in your own voice. Because a wizard awakens not with a click of a mouse, but the moment they speak.

demos.name: Kisen: Seeker of Aenjan City - Demo
Corpse Burger Demo
demos.short_description: Grind humans into “tofu” burgers, keep your customers hooked, and fight or avoid twisted mutants. Manage your secret meat supply, don't get caught, and deliver the most addictive meals in town.

demos.name: VILLAIN – Path of the Necromancer Demo
demos.short_description: A dark narrative strategy adventure where you play a villain, blending resource management, unit creation, exploration, and freeform wave defense. Build defenses, make meaningful decisions, and adapt your strategy in a hostile world.

demos.name: GameJam 水群模拟器 Demo
demos.short_description: A simulation game that immerses you in the real group chat dynamics of indie developers during a 21-day game jam.

demos.name: Miney Golf Demo
demos.short_description: Miney Golf is a casual miniature golf strategy game where players can pick up and place land mines all over a destructible course to either help them traverse obstacles or mess with their opponents. Play through the first course of the full game with your friends online through Steam!

demos.name: ZenWash Demo
demos.short_description: Wash away the dirt in a calm and relaxing way, surrounded by soothing nature sounds and the gentle flow of a nearby river. Unlock new upgrades and take on larger houses to clean.

demos.name: Sunny Side Up Demo
demos.short_description: Sunny Side Up Demo is a cozy 3D parkour adventure game where you guide a brave little egg across a charming farm to reunite w/ your family. Master jumps, uncover hidden paths, & explore 2 handcrafted levels on a heartfelt journey full of charm, one careful hop at a time. Can you find your way home?

highlights.trailer_name: The Sunny Side Up Demo Trailer

demos.name: Planetary Field Team Demo
demos.short_description: Play as the team's operator in this Roguelike Auto-Battler RPG. Build your team to effectively fight against hostiles on an alien planet.

demos.name: Die Deep Demo
demos.short_description:
Die Deep is an action game focused purely on the confrontation with your enemies.
No exploration, no puzzles, The only core is Combat.
One reckless move or greedy strike, and it’s all over. 
Answer the silent call of the abyss. Descend into the depths to find your forgotten desires.

demos.name: Fortune Fragments Demo
demos.short_description: In Fortune Fragments, you run your own shop as a ‘Foreteller' and guide your customers' fates by reading their souls! Sink in the unique blend of Visual Novel roleplaying and hex-tile based rune building set in the bustling modern-fantasy city of Clearcastle.

demos.name: Fading Echo Demo
demos.short_description: Fading Echo is a fast-paced elemental action-adventure RPG where creativity fuels combat. Manipulate water, trigger chain reactions, and shift through surreal worlds as One, a young Legend on a mission to save a dying desertscape from the grip of the Paradox corruption.

demos.name: Labytrip Spirit Demo
demos.short_description: LabyTrip Spirit is an adventure puzzle-action game about a soul lost in the labyrinths of the afterlife. Work with friends to guide the spirit to ascension, or vie with other players toward the abyss. Be watchful, shrewd, and swift as you make your way through the changing labyrinths of limbo.

demos.name: Mechaconda Demo
demos.short_description: Survive hordes of monsters and bosses while collecting cards that add unique ability upgrades to the body of a small snake Mechaconda.

demos.name: Ding! Pocket It!: Rogue Simulator Demo
ChimpUP! Demo
demos.short_description: ChimpUP! is a chaotic climbing game where you race with your friends to gather mysterious bananas. Armed with two independent grapple hooks for arms, compete to the top in a fast-paced fashion. Master the movement, sabotage your friends, race to the top, create cosmetics and maps. Satisfy your urge!

demos.name: Bara Blood - The Crimson Heir Demo
demos.short_description: You play as Lucien, Dracula's son, and your goal is to free people from the magical good manners the angel Angelo has casted to people. Reveal the pleasures of life to humans and monsters through the way of 1 level with 4 NSFW animations. Unlock 1 CG in your gallery.

demos.name: Under His Eyes Demo
demos.short_description: Under His Eyes is a gritty, story-driven strategy game where you play a crime boss. Make game-changing decisions, manage your crew and income, send operatives on missions, seize districts, and eliminate rivals. Will you rise through subtlety, rule with fear, or fall to a small-time gang?

highlights.trailer_name: Under His Eyes - Updated Demo Trailer

demos.name: Micro Solar Punk Demo
demos.short_description: Micro Solar Punk is a hybrid tactical strategy game that blends RTS and TBS gameplay. Reposition yourself, attack, and survive as you build the foundations of a new, miniature human civilization. But your ambitions will face the retaliation of the true owners of the land: the insects.

demos.name: Aenoic Abyss demo
demos.short_description: Swap between two heroines (Paladin/Mage/Assassin/Centaur Archer) instantly in this 2D pixel-art roguelite platformer, forge permanent Diablo-inspired builds with 200+ affix combinations to conquer cycle-reborn abyssal labyrinths and rend the holy veil of the Purification Ritual.

demos.name: Dream Walker Demo
demos.short_description: "Dream Walker" is an RPG game that combines survival, scavenging for extraction, and turn-based combat. Every time you explore within the dream, you might acquire valuable treasures, but you could also lose everything.

demos.name: Banana Life Sim Demo
demos.short_description: Banana Life Sim is a game in which you can become a banana.

demos.name: Goldfish Gunner Demo
demos.short_description: Become the most wanted outlaw by taking on the role of Goldfish, a gunner robbing every bank in the Wild West. Escape across challenging, obstacle-filled landscapes where your only way to move is by firing your weapon and riding the recoil.

demos.name: Dungeons and Treasure 2 Demo
demos.short_description: Dungeons and Treasure II is a voxel action roguelike for 1-4 players. Brave endless, scaling floors with 100+ items, buffs, and permanent unlocks. Explore procedural zones with unique bosses, secrets, and traps. Features full controller support and mid-run saves for desktop play.

demos.name: Feed the Cat: Gravity Puzzle Demo
demos.short_description: Move platforms, manipulate gravity, and solve relaxing physics puzzles to guide the food safely into the hungry cat's bowl. A cute, logic-based casual game where your main goal is simple: make sure the feline gets its treat!

demos.name: Spheromania Demo
demos.short_description: Bounce, blast, and outlast in Spheromania. A fast-paced arena shooter where drones duel with blasters, mines, and mid-air hops. Manage your energy, dodge the shrinking arena, and be the last sphere hovering. Solo mode or online multiplayer.

demos.name: Cozy Pages: Find & Color Demo
demos.short_description: A cozy hidden object game inspired by coloring books and “Where’s Wally?” Find adorable objects from simple clues, and watch each discovery bring the page to life with color.

demos.name: Travelling Home: Ever After Demo
demos.short_description: This is an excellent study companion game, because it's not fun.

demos.name: Pact Warden Demo
demos.short_description: As a Marchwarden, you travel the southern roads to protect pilgrims and travelers. You will fight multi-phased bosses, shape the storylines of characters, and explore an interconnected world.

demos.name: The Pharm Sim Demo
demos.short_description: Manage your own pharmacy in this first-person simulation game. Serve customers, stock shelves, process prescriptions, handle daily operations, and build a successful healthcare business.

demos.name: Best Streamer Demo
demos.short_description: A ruthless streamer simulation where you'll do anything to reach the top. Grow legally with content or eliminate rivals with weapons. Manage survival needs, use illegal tactics to crush the competition, evade the police, and become the world's number one streamer

demos.name: Grandpa Nightmare Demo
demos.short_description: A tense escape game set inside a strange house ruled by a quirky but dangerous grandfather. Solve clever puzzles, avoid being caught, and face thrilling chase moments. Multiple endings await based on your choices. Can you outsmart the grandfather and escape the house?

demos.name: Whale Cleaner Demo
demos.short_description: Take charge of a deep-sea wash station for filthy marine giants! Upgrade bizarre bio-industrial tools to scrub whales, dolphins, sharks and other mysterious beasts. Get them spotless before Mr. Claw docks your pay in this relaxing, atmospheric, and satisfying cleaning simulator. Find hidden secrets!

demos.name: Thirsty Snail Demo
demos.short_description: Unhinged snails have taken over your desktop. A growing collection of weirdos — they bicker, they roast you, they judge your life choices. Your typing keeps them alive. They are not grateful.

demos.name: Hey Tom! Demo
demos.short_description: Stranded on an abandoned island hunted by the terrifying creature Tom, you must fight, scavenge, and manipulate your environment to survive

demos.name: Dread Disc Demo
demos.short_description: A strange game disc appears at your door. Every difference you spot changes your apartment while something unknown tries to find a way inside.

demos.name: Twilight Requiem Demo
demos.short_description: Experience the opening chapter of Twilight Requiem, a dark fantasy action RPG inspired by classic fast-paced combat systems. Battle through a cursed realm, unlock powerful abilities, and face your first major boss in this playable demo.

demos.name: BPM Bitcrushed Demo
demos.short_description: BPM Bitcrushed: A retro roguelite rhythm shooter where every shot, dodge, and jump must sync to the beat. Battle through dungeons where enemies attack in time with the music. Find epic loot and even import your own songs to create a custom, rhythm-fuelled soundtrack for your destruction!

demos.name: Blood Moon Serenade: Complete Edition Demo
demos.short_description: Enter the secret world of vampire aristocracy in this otome visual novel. Read, choose, and shape your heroine’s fate in the Complete Edition, including all three Blood Moon Serenade titles.

demos.name: Hide and Sink Demo
demos.short_description:
The Hide and Sink series is a horror anthology chronicling short stories of uncanny childhood events.
This Demo, is the first episode of the series. A paralyzed boy witnesses his parents becoming increasingly terrifying. Alone in a dark bedroom, how will he find a way out of this nightmare?

demos.name: Mongolian Wind Script 1: Chongzheng Academy Demo
demos.short_description: A historical visual novel set in early-20th-century Inner Mongolia. Make choices for Saran, a girl placed in the real Chongzheng Academy, and branch her story toward five true endings. Featuring native vertical Mongolian script rendering and reimagined period music.

demos.name: TankFall Arena Demo
demos.short_description: TankFall Arena is a fast-paced top-down tank combat game where precision, ricochets, and weapon mastery decide every battle. Fight solo or with a friend, adapt to changing arenas, and outmaneuver opponents using unique weapons and environmental strategy.

demos.name: Eternal Hatred Demo
demos.short_description: Eternal Hatred is a fast-paced indie shooter blending the aesthetics of ULTRAKILL and Quake. At its core lies a dark story about the nature of human cruelty and an attempt to drown out inner pain within the abyss of one's own consciousness.

demos.name: The Prime Minister's Crest: Path to Power Demo
demos.short_description: A political simulation visual novel set in a severe post-bubble economic crisis. As newly elected governor Kazuma Oriki, allocate tight budgets to resolve economic, security, and welfare issues. Navigate complex factional politics and ultimately forge your path to the Prime Minister's seat.

demos.name: Lugal: Bronze Age Survival Game Demo
Supermarket Simulator: Idle Tycoon Clicker Demo
rook Demo
demos.short_description: rook is a chess deckbuilding roguelike. cover your board in stickers and stack spare tiles to supercharge the cascading chaos and watch your scores go exponential, maybe then you might just survive the gauntlet.

demos.name: Lady Death Demonicron Demo
demos.short_description: Experience the first three levels of Lady Death Demonicron in single player story mode.

demos.name: Wadi Karma - وادي كرمة Alpha Demo
demos.short_description:
Wadi Karma is a 2D Survival Sandbox game inspired by Arabian folklore with farming, exploration, crafting and combat in a forgotten desert world.
وادي كرمة هي لعبة بقاء وصندوق رملي ثنائية الأبعاد مستوحاة من الفولكلور العربي، تجمع بين الزراعة والاستكشاف والصناعة والقتال في عالم صحراوي منسي.

highlights.trailer_name: Official Intro trailer شارة البداية الرسمية

demos.name: The Murder Of Yesterday Demo
demos.short_description:
A psychological horror crime experience featuring Story mode and Anomaly mode.
Where time is your only weapon.. travel back through fractured moments to stop a brutal crime before it happens uncover the truth, alter the outcome, and face the consequences of changing fate in a haunting reality.

demos.name: Frutz Demo
demos.short_description:
Free demo: a level from each of the five worlds, capped by a first encounter
with Lord Zorkannan — dodge, dash, graze, and see how far you get before he
puts you down. The full game is the rematch.

demos.name: SPACERO: ORIGINS Demo
demos.short_description: Pilot a customizable ship through a hostile open galaxy in this top-down space action RPG demo. Mine resources, trade at stations, upgrade your weapons, survive faction attacks, and face a massive boss encounter.

demos.name: Coffee Masters! - Multiplayer Cafe Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Welcome to the place where the smell of coffee meets chaos! Play solo or co-op with up to 4 players. Run your own cafe and work together with your friends to grow your business. Take orders, prepare coffees, serve customers, and increase your earnings.

demos.name: BUDGE Demo
demos.short_description: A co-op movement game. Lift heavy objects together with 2-6 players, or simply ride along on top and wave the ceremonial staff as your friends do all the lifting.

demos.name: After End Demo
demos.short_description: ---- Support the Kickstarter! ----

demos.name: AENIGMA Demo
demos.short_description: Set in the year 4XXX, humanity lives disconnected inside underground megastructures to escape the threat of the ever-expanding silicon-based lifeforms.

demos.name: Eatime Demo
demos.short_description: Eatime is a Chinese-cuisine strategy puzzle about planning every minute. Arrange cooking steps on a timeline, manage chefs and cookware, combine tasks, and adapt your schedule so every dish is served at just the right moment.

demos.name: 2DOM! Demo
demos.short_description: This is the DEMO for 2DOM! A Chill 2D sidescroller physics-based chain reaction puzzle game featuring dominoes!

demos.name: The Quiet After Demo
demos.short_description: Step into Greyholt as Ava, a would-be adventurer taking a chance to register with her father's guild. Will this bring the independence she craves, or something more dangerous? A psychological, choice-driven visual novel where every decision shapes the road ahead and the journey beneath her own skin.

demos.name: Lost Exit Demo
demos.short_description: A first-person psychological horror experience set in a forgotten shopping mall. Explore, investigate, and survive as reality twists into something far more sinister.

demos.name: Avelins Journey Demo
demos.short_description:
Stranded on a mysterious alien world, you must climb ever higher through a surreal parkour of floating ruins, ancient structures, and magical forces.
Every fall costs time. Every move requires skill.
How fast can you reach the top?

demos.name: Yacht Sea: Island Casino Demo
demos.short_description: A non-idle clicker dice game about getting rich the honest way: brazen cheating and lucky rolls. Bribe the dealer, rig the table, chase bigger payouts, and cool it down before the casino catches on.

demos.name: Sea Warden Demo
demos.short_description: Sea Warden is a survival adventure set on the back of Ao, a giant sea turtle journeying across a shattered world. Build, craft, explore, and defend your living base as you travel between forgotten islands in search of lost knowledge and stranded souls.

demos.name: Neon Dreams Demo
demos.short_description: Live the life of an aspiring arms dealer in a Cyberpunk city. Complete thrilling bullet-hell combat simulations with your trusty battle mech, while managing your high-stakes business. Drink coffee, buy weapons, collect stickers, and overcome difficult battle modifiers.

demos.name: Hacker Cats Demo
demos.short_description: Who needs human hackers when you have cats? Lead a crew of fluffy cybercriminals, hack servers, steal valuable data, research new technologies, and conquer the Internet one paw at a time.

demos.name: Dreamscape Demo
demos.short_description: An absurd, dreamy puzzle game about navigating anxieties for the future.

demos.name: Code:Stella Demo
demos.short_description: Control a squad of unique heroes, switch between them instantly, and tackle dynamic objectives that make every run different.

demos.name: Bojan Demo
demos.short_description: You think YOU have it bad? Try getting thrown into a quest with nothing to protect yourself, except your wits! In this trial and error adventure game, patience is key. Explore the castle including 6* bosses and 18 levels complete with their own layouts, enemy paths, buttons, doors and coins!

demos.name: Cavernreach Demo
demos.short_description: A first-person, story driven, cave exploration experience where a routine expedition turns into something far more complex as you descend into the unknown.

highlights.trailer_name: Not all is what it seems...

demos.name: Sign: 碎冠篇 Demo
demos.short_description: Sign is a visual novel series that blends fantasy, urban life, and adventure. The story follows Tian Qin, a high school girl who encounters Cygnus, a witch from another world. Together, they embark on a journey to reclaim the witch’s lost powers.

demos.name: Bittersweet Blossoms Demo
demos.short_description: A lesbian romance set in England shortly after WWI. The story centres around Dot, a young maid who begins to work in the crumbling stately home of Bly, and her young mistress: the devious, devilish Patience.

demos.name: Misty Valley: A Cozy Fishing Tale Demo
demos.short_description: Welcome to Misty Valley, cast your line, sail to hidden islands, and uncover secrets of the sea. Befriend charming villagers, tend your farm, and explore a world full of wonder, mystery, and gentle adventure. Your story begins where the mist meets the tide.

demos.name: Stop The F Demo
demos.short_description:
Stop The F is a first-person puzzle game made in the style of old games.
Use a camera capable of capturing objects from reality into subspace and bringing them back.

demos.name: Eden's Inferno Demo
demos.short_description: Descend through Heaven and Hell as a Guardian Angel in search of her human. A movement focused Boomer Shooter inspired by retro 3D Platformers and Collectathons. Takes place in a large interconnected world set in the afterlife.

highlights.trailer_name: The Demo is Now Out and Playable. Right now.

demos.name: Adrenaline Overdrive Demo
demos.short_description: In this retro-styled FPS, tear through an alternate 1980s Brooklyn as a vengeful detective enhanced by experimental drugs. Master supernatural movement abilities, and uncover the truth behind your brother's murder - before the power that drives you becomes your doom.

highlights.trailer_name: Adrenaline Overdrive Next Fest Demo Trailer

demos.name: Thumps and Blows Demo
demos.short_description: A fighting game were a weird cast of stickmen fight each other in chaotic 1vs1 battles, using very extravagant techniques.

demos.name: MassEve Demo
demos.short_description: Mass-Eve is a fast-paced roguelike twin-stick shooter diving deep into the mysteries of modern physics. The quantum world is on the edge of revolution, and only neutrinos can shift its fate. The future of the universe depends on your choices, are you ready to reshape it?

demos.name: Evolvania Demo
demos.short_description: Explore a colossal creature by blending in with the environment and enemies. Evolve and gain new powers in this hand-drawn metroidvania where you can experience a unique adventure or create your own with a special level editor.

demos.name: Panzer Planet Demo
demos.short_description: The ultimate fast-paced twin-stick shooter roguelite where you command tanks on spherical mini-planets battling hordes of aliens, zombies, and monstrous insects! Strap in, gear up, and prepare for chaotic arena survival action packed with explosive upgrades, weapons, and non-stop bullet-hell mayhem.

demos.name: Ten Years of Rain Demo
demos.short_description: Ten Years of Rain is a fantasy adventure with a unique Central Asian inspired setting. Pick up your blade, call your hawk, and prepare to travel the cursed lands of the steppe. Battle the forces of the Great Khan, explore the secret places of the world, and discover the cause of the long rain...

demos.name: F.E.A.S.T Demo
demos.short_description: Congratulations! You've been hired by an elite organization that cooks for gods. Farm, automate, and cook gourmet meals to appease divine beings.

demos.name: Proxima B The Demo
demos.short_description: A short Sci-fi adventure game made for the Game Boy Color in GB Studio! Solve puzzles, collect energy for your weapons, and fight the alien Ackloids to claim the planet Proxima B for the humans!

demos.name: FantasyJourneyDemo
demos.short_description:
The core combat gameplay is similar to Sekiro, emphasizing precise parrying, counterattacks, and dodging—players can even trigger powerful counters with regular attacks.
The game features richly detailed environments and a vast, expansive world map.

demos.name: EGO Demo
demos.short_description: A Smoke based 3D Beat’em all. Fight thousands of robots at a time through open-ended levels in this Arcade style Smoking Wizard game ! Dash, Jump, Climb, ignite your smoke and obliterate every bots in your way!

demos.name: Talespinner Demo
demos.short_description: Enter a captivating realm woven with the tapestry of Japanese mythology in Talespinner, a deck-building roguelike adventure. As the storyteller, you will guide your chosen hero through an ever-changing narrative shaped by your decisions and deck construction.

demos.name: AstroScaper Demo
demos.short_description: Colonize barren asteroids and transform them into thriving space colonies. Discover powerful building synergies, solve satisfying placement puzzles, and journey from one procedurally generated world to the next.

highlights.trailer_name: What is AstroScaper? Gameplay Overview Trailer

demos.name: Soft(A)ware Demo
demos.short_description: A surreal puzzle-platformer where you bend gravity, rewind time, and disrupt a virtual prison built to contain you.

demos.name: Turning Manor Demo
demos.short_description: All you have to do is count the differences and choose an exit. Easy right? Yet strange things start happening as soon as you sign the job contract… It's up to you to uncover what is happening at Turning Manor.

demos.name: KAMI 2 Demo
demos.short_description: Kami 2 is a relaxing puzzle game where you fold colorful paper to fill each board with a single color in as few moves as possible. Solve hundreds of handcrafted levels or create and share your own with the puzzle builder. Designed with real sheets of folded paper.

demos.name: The Goddess's Will Demo
demos.short_description: Dive into a 2.5D isometric action RPG adventure inspired by late-90s and early-00s classics. Face cunning enemy factions, explore a layered world filled with vivid characters, mythic stories, and handcrafted environments. Immerse yourself in a dangerous and unforgiving golden age of power fantasy.

demos.name: 白线 Demo
demos.short_description: "White Line" is a campus and racing-themed romance visual novel developed by PlanC. Told from the perspective of the protagonist, Jiang Yao, the story chronicles his journey of mutual growth alongside the heroines as they join hands to make their youth shine with a unique brilliance.

demos.name: No Way Back: Dark Horizon Demo
Risko - Shepherd's Leap Demo
demos.short_description: Free demo of Risko – The Shepherd’s Leap. Includes four game modes with score limits and some basic skins. The full version will add unlimited modes, a campaign, and additional content.

demos.name: CREATION OF THE GODS: Rebellion at Five Passes Demo
