demos.short_description: Enter the mythic 'Creation of the Gods' saga, "封神演义" in Chinese. Experience its legend via vibrant pixel art and animated storytelling. Master deep turn-based RPG combat, blending tradition with tactical depth. A world where divine fate clashes with human will — only one prevails.

highlights.trailer_name: Promotional Video New with sub EN

demos.name: Ariokan™ - create your cards, break the Meta Demo
demos.short_description:
Ariokan© is a player-friendly, highly interactive, competitive card game with a twist: you can create new official cards to build deep combos around Gods and Legends of mechanically-predictable Factions. 
Unlock and strategize around cards created by others! Offline and roguelike modes available.

demos.name: BOILED Demo
demos.short_description:
America, 1925. A simple errand for an old friend pulls ex-gang leader Dan into a violent smuggler war on the border. 
A narrative-driven, adrenaline-pumping top-down shooter inspired by Hotline Miami, set in the 1920s Old West.

demos.name: 黄莓C HuangmeiC Demo
demos.short_description: 《HuangmeiC》: a cute, laid-back modern daily visual novel. Play as a new grad, enjoying funny daily life in another world—a light, silly romance! Stress-free job, little to do, great coworkers. No dark stuff or bad endings; just love, growth! Worldview not real—don’t use 3D logic!

demos.name: Spooky Fun Park Demo
demos.short_description: Welcome to Shouxian Funfair, frozen in time since the millennium. You're just a new employee here: check tickets by day, patrol by night. Simple job, great pay. But you'll soon find the rules here are far more complex and dangerous than they seem.

demos.name: DigSite: Archeology in Egypt Demo
demos.short_description: DigSite is open-world archeology sandbox game located in Egypt where you dig, clean and document artifacts you find. Donate rare artifacts to a museum and build your legacy as a legendary archeologist.

demos.name: Where The Flock!? (Demo)
demos.short_description: Save a herd of lost sheep from a treacherous mountain using a variety of helpful (but sometimes risky!) tools in this quirky 2D puzzle-platformer adventure. Devise unique strategies to solve dozens of levels across multiple chapters, and get the flock back to the farm, safe and sound.

demos.name: Void Pachinko Demo
demos.short_description: Build your own pachinko! Upgrade pins and balls, unleash powerful synergies, and help a shattered village rise again in this incremental adventure.

demos.name: Pattaya Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Pattaya Simulator is a life simulation game set in the city of Pattaya. Players take on the role of a masseur who travels to Pattaya to earn money, pay off family debts, and bring happiness back to the city through massage.

demos.name: Don Pepe y sus globos Demo
Astrolite Demo
demos.short_description: Astrolite is an arcade-styled bullet heaven in a race against time. Conquer each planet before the forces of the galaxy overpower you. The Galaxy stands united. The World Guardians prepare a final stand against their greatest enemy... that enemy... is you.

demos.name: Purgatory Demo
demos.short_description:
An indie RPG set in the afterlife, through a partly-dystopian, partly-vibrant, and always-dangerous lens. Explore a range of different environments, battle a wide range of enemies, learn an unnecessary amount of lore if you want, and most importantly...
Be the bad guy who saves everyone.

demos.name: Melted Time Demo
demos.short_description: Candle, your path is full of puzzles. Can you handle it? Hurry, your time is already melting away.

demos.name: Anomaly Operation Demo
demos.short_description: Anomaly Operation is a sci-fi horror observation game. Trapped in the security room, you must monitor a derelict ship via CCTV. Report anomalies and avoid lethal threats. Survive until 03:00 AM.

demos.name: Beerhouse Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Brew beer your own way! First-person homebrewing simulator where every batch can go brilliantly wrong or surprisingly right — and clients might just notice the difference, or not. Brew, experiment or cause total beery mayhem.

demos.name: Is The Vat Utopia or Dystopia? 拆迁地球及爱情事故 Demo
demos.short_description:
"We regret to inform you that the Earth has been demolished."
Coming next—a "Human Observation Documentary" starring "Landmine Girl"(fake) and "Nerd" (so-called).

demos.name: Forge the Fates Demo
demos.short_description: Take deckbuilding to the next level. Transform your hand of cards into a tactical grid of runes. Plan, shift, and strike to unleash powerful combos and chain match-3 bonuses. Choose your hero, master their deck, and fight through deadly dungeons to face a mysterious dark overlord.

demos.name: IN SILICO Demo
demos.short_description: In a distant future humanity is enslaved in a simulation. Now that you are awake, can you escape from reality too?

demos.name: Dungeon Inspection Guild Demo
demos.short_description: Dungeon Inspection Guild is a top-down dungeon editor inspired by classic Action-Adventure games. Bring broken dungeons up to code while catering to the whims of the dungeon owners. Create and customize your own dungeons; share them with others; or explore other dungeons from the community!

demos.name: Synergy Strike Demo
demos.short_description: Combine synergy attacks, shatter geometric hordes, and climb the leaderboards! Synergy Strike is a bullet heaven roguelike with hypnotic audio-reactive visuals that pulse to the beat.

highlights.trailer_name: voice over Trailer Synergy Strike Demo

demos.name: 그날의 신문 Demo
demos.short_description: In 1920s Gyeongseong, you are the editor of a newspaper under colonial rule. Choose which stories to print, which words to censor, and what truths to leave unsaid in this historical choice-driven visual novel.

demos.name: BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy Demo
demos.short_description: Listen up, comrade! Tired of feeling like a terrible chess player? Ditch the flashy modern tools. My routine is simple: I teach you a sharp concept, you apply it in a puzzle, then I unveil the secret twist. Survive my training, and become a true Chess Master!

highlights.trailer_name: BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy - Announcement Trailer

demos.name: 100 Cats Lost in Japan 2 Find & Color Demo
demos.short_description: 🎯 100 mischievous 🐱 cats are hiding! 🔍 Search every corner 🏠, find them 😻, and bring each scene 🎨 to life with your colors 🌈. Play online 🤝, relax with lo-fi music 🎵, and compete 🏆 for the top!

demos.name: 美丽旧世界：纸牌塔 Demo
demos.short_description: A text-based RPG adventure. Uncover an epic story of decay and rebirth in a new world, 200 years after humanity's arrival. Guide multiple protagonists through an immersive narrative, diverse gameplay, and a dynamic art style. An unforgettable experience awaits!

demos.name: Beta 3000 Demo
demos.short_description: You've woken up in your cheap hotel room, low on funds and equipment. The town where you currently reside is under attack by a dragon from a different game world. You and your teammates embark to slay the dragon for easy money.

demos.name: The Last Worlds : Crossed Souls Demo
Keepers: Fractured Realities Demo
demos.short_description:
When it's mice, you call an exterminator. 
When it's criminals, you call the police. 
When it's a gaping fracture in reality, you don't call anyone; the Keepers are already there, and you've seen too much.

demos.name: Pirate Pillage and Plunder Demo
demos.short_description: PIRATE PILLAGE & PLUNDER is the unique blend of card game and auto battler, wrapped together in a neat roguelike package. Choose your faction, amass an army from thousands of "willing" participants, and lead them to greatness! (or agonizing defeat)

demos.name: RUNT Demo
demos.short_description: RUNT is a rural gothic visual novel mystery where you play as Runt, the youngest of five brothers, surviving a monstrous post-apocalypse.

demos.name: Soccerboy vs Aliens Demo
demos.short_description: Try playing as Soccerboy, a plucky little soccer fanatic in this 2D action, puzzle platformer. Honing your ball skills, you must take on an alien invasion to save the galaxy and your soccer idol Bro-naldo, in this fun take on the platforming genre.

demos.name: Square Shootout Demo
demos.short_description: Co-op only game play up to 4 players. Old school no saves. Silly game play, friendly controllers.

demos.name: XeGrader plus Demo
demos.short_description: A retro action game where shooting and puzzle-solving intersect. This demo includes 6 stages (LV01-LV06) and a boss battle. Players defeat enemies while unraveling mysteries in each stage. Experience the fusion of 1980s classic game visuals with modern design.

demos.name: Bullet Spell Demo
demos.short_description: Dodge, weave, and coordinate your way through bullets and enemies in this magical spy-thriller! Stress-test your ability to multitask by controlling the twin sisters Aurora and Solana simultaneously, or share control with a second player to coordinate the twins' survival.

demos.name: Prime Prism Demo
demos.short_description:
Numbers are light; logic is the lens.
"Prime Prism" is a pure logic puzzle game themed around prime numbers and factorization. Construct circuits of light using optical tools like "Prisms" and "Lenses" to decompose and synthesize numbers. Over 140 stages across 11 worlds await your challenge.

demos.name: Scrapfall Demo
demos.short_description: Classic falling-block gameplay pushed to the edge in a fast-paced action roguelite of escalating gravity, unstable physics, and cascading systems.

demos.name: SUSHI Claw Machine Demo
demos.short_description: Aim, grab, and blast off! Command a chaotic physics-based crane arm to send sushi flying. Capture wacky dishes like grooving salmon and runaway ginger to complete your guide. Face giant cranes and sushi swarms in this hilarious physics comedy. How will you react to the madness?

demos.name: Jeremy, No! Demo
demos.short_description: Jeremy, No! Is a spot the difference horror game where you are babysitting a poltergeist named Jeremy. Jeremy isn’t allowed to move stuff around or invite any “friends”, so carefully look at the rooms and call him out if anything has changed. Don’t let Jeremy get away with too many shenanigans...

demos.name: Horny Jail Demo
demos.short_description: An adult comedy visual novel about waking up in a prison that shouldn't exist. Make choices, shape relationships, and steer your sentence toward Reform, Riot, and multiple adult endings.

demos.name: Void Salvage Demo
demos.short_description: Void Salvage is a spaceship simulation with node-based upgrades and choice-driven encounters. Combine weapon augments, modules, drones, and sockets to build a powerful ship. Unlock strategic control-panel actions for auto-combat, then prestige to pursue different paths through the story.

demos.name: Space Pirates Demo
demos.short_description: Experience Arcade space combat in this early demo of Space Pirates.

demos.name: Tidy Tidy Demo
demos.short_description: A casual healing organizing game. No complex controls—just click and drag to logically sort and arrange items across scenes, turning clutter into order. With no time limits, savor the relaxation and healing of tidying up.

demos.name: 高考移民：常安转校生 Demo
demos.short_description: A Transfer Student from Chang'an is a Chinese-style school-themed visual novel. A student with excellent grades who transferred from a provincial key middle school suddenly becomes your deskmate. What is the reason she always avoids discussing about her transfer reason? Let's go and seek the answer

highlights.trailer_name: 高考移民：常安转校生 实机演示
高考移民：常安转校生 PV1

demos.name: Brawl Party Demo
demos.short_description:
Brawl Party Demo is a 2–8 player multiplayer party game where fast-paced mini-games and night battles turn friends into rivals.
Play a curated selection of mini-games and experience Brawl Party’s competitive core before the full release.

demos.name: PhotoLoop Demo
demos.short_description: Boot up the world's oldest PC to take photo editing commissions from a colourful cast of virtual strangers. In PhotoLoop, the only thing stopping you is your imagination... and probably your entire editing interface.

demos.name: Survivor:Unknown Village Demo
demos.short_description:
You can play through Stages 1 to 3 in this demo! The full version is planned to feature up to 10 stages. 
Please download it and give it a try!

demos.name: Shitlings Demo
demos.short_description: Gather resources, build a camp and protect it by constructing defenses. Assign jobs to your Shitlings, take care of their needs, develop new skills and unlock new constructions. Move the camp between locations on a path to the total victory of Shitlingness over the World!

demos.name: 大荒消劫录 Demo
demos.short_description: 在国风画卷中展开智斗！《大荒消劫录》是一款将三消与策略对战深度融合的游戏，通过精巧消除来组合技能、搭配英雄阵容，在实时对战中决胜千里。玩家通过精妙的消除进行战斗，每一局都是对策略的直接考验。收集拥有独特技能和属性的英雄，自由搭配您的战斗小队。理解每位英雄的特性，组合出能产生奇妙协同效应的阵容，是克敌制胜的关键。融合“六十四卦”系统，为战局带来无穷变数。将卦象之力与英雄技能相结合，催化出独一无二的战斗风格与战术。

demos.name: Laser Boy Demo
demos.short_description: A short but sweet first person laser-based puzzle game that includes a completely superfluous day/night system, lots of questionable humor and amazing finnish-swedish voice acting. Adjust lasers, solve puzzles, test your patience. A very confusing and memorable experience. DEMO VERSION.

demos.name: Traveler Stories: Journeys of Real People Demo
demos.short_description: "Is this really the life you want?" A visual novel with simple life-sim elements, based on 80% true stories from world travelers. Step behind the bar in Tokyo, encounter extraordinary lives, and challenge your values. A simulation to rediscover yourself and open the door to a "new you."

demos.name: Wreck Below Demo
demos.short_description: Wreck Below is an underwater horror game where you dismantle wrecks and avoid the unseen threat of The Arbiter.

demos.name: Market Simulation: Rush Hour Demo
demos.short_description: Build, expand, and manage your own supermarket through the chaos of rush hour! Level up in this fast-paced first-person supermarket simulation, unlock new shelves and products, use multiple payment methods, catch thieves, deliver orders, and meet your adorable cat!

demos.name: BeyondHelix Demo
demos.short_description:
Another day, another data retrieval job. Or is it?
Using a linux-like terminal, explore BeyondHelix's systems and uncover what led to the company's demise.

demos.name: Minibles World Adventure Time Demo
demos.short_description: Explore a vibrant 3D world in Minibles World, an isometric puzzle-adventure game. Rescue kidnapped Minibles from mischievous Boblins, solve challenging puzzles, and navigate through handcrafted environments. Solve, fight, and save your friends in this quest.

demos.name: Send In The Vampires Demo
demos.short_description:
Maniacs have taken over the asylum. Restore order with your fists in the ultimate gothic arcade beat em up.

Supports up to 4 players in couch coop/remote play.

demos.name: Covenant of Fate Demo
demos.short_description:
《Covenant of Fate》 is a Chinese horror mystery RPG.
Play as a Contractor, a being neither alive nor dead, who gains immortality by laying restless spirits to rest. Investigate haunted cases, uncover hidden truths, and confront a bloodstained mystery from your own past.

demos.name: Rocket Man X Demo
demos.short_description: In this third-person platformer shooter, fight your way through enemies and platform your way through levels. Unlock new armor by finding the hidden boxes, and earn new weapons by beating the bosses.

highlights.trailer_name: Rocket Man X Trailer No Intro

demos.name: The Beekeeper Demo
demos.short_description: A fast systemic strategy puzzle about ecological scarcity and timing. Place limited hives in a degraded biome, protect fragile species, and optimize under pressure knowing some losses may be inevitable.

demos.name: Critical Descent Demo
demos.short_description: Master the hardcore, Starship-style catch maneuver in the Critical Descent demo. Pilot massive boosters and agile upper stages across many levels on Earth. Featuring multiple difficulties, and a realistic physics system for the ultimate landing experience.

demos.name: Monetaria Demo
demos.short_description:
The world begins a slow, creeping erosion.
Those who sensed the anomaly were guided by "E" to gather.
To stop the ambition of Nous, a being intent on erasing the very concepts of existence, you must investigate global disturbances and eliminate his subordinates, the Apostles.

demos.name: Ambitious Road Demo
demos.short_description: Join the ambitious protagonist Michel as he rises through a war-torn world in this traditional turn-based war tale simulation RPG.

demos.name: The Borderless Demo
demos.short_description: A cozy floating island management sim where you build and expand your own island world from a small platform in the middle of the ocean. Welcome visitors, meet their needs, plan activities, hire staff, earn money, and grow your ocean paradise day by day.

demos.name: Card Homestead Demo
demos.short_description: Card Homestead is a roguelike deckbuilder where card placement decides everything. Each day, draft one of three delivered cards and stack them onto your plot, engineering powerful chain reactions. Produce gold with efficient synergies and layouts to survive the ever-rising taxes.

highlights.trailer_name: Card Homestead Official Demo Launch Trailer

demos.name: Some Type of Trip Demo
demos.short_description: A simple typing narrative game exploring the depths of the mind. Sometimes cozy and warm, sometimes intense and challenging, always interesting.

demos.name: Nine to Never Demo
demos.short_description: Routine is safe. Predictable. Comfortable. But what if that comfort hides something… dangerous? In this game, your job isn’t just to work. Will you stay where it’s safe, or risk everything to uncover what’s beyond?

highlights.trailer_name: Nine To Never | Wishlist Now on Steam

demos.name: Warp to Sector One Demo
demos.short_description: Trade, fight, and explore a procedurally generated galaxy in this deep space trading game inspired by 80's sci-fi computer screens and early text based space games. Command fleets, negotiate with alien factions, colonize planets, and forge your legacy across five unique career paths.

demos.name: Rain of Awakening Demo
demos.short_description: Dash and slash your way out of Lovecraftian horrors. Master momentum-based movement to reach seemingly impossible locations. Collect upgrades and shape your own fighting style. Can you save what is left of this doomed world or is it too late?

demos.name: Crimson Wanderer - One Credit Demo
demos.short_description: Blast your way through a thrilling adventure that brings back the spirit of 90s arcade classics… with a modern twist.

demos.name: MYCO Demo
demos.short_description: Escape the City and begin your journey.

demos.name: 3 Sheep Puzzle Demo
demos.short_description: 3 Sheep Puzzle is a 2D Sokoban-style logic game with remote movement. Guide the sheepdog through the barn to complete each level. A minimalist, relaxing challenge, perfect for quick minds looking to test their ingenuity.

demos.name: Milord Idle Defense Demo
demos.short_description: Defend your tower against enemies and survive as long as you can.

demos.name: SURI: The Seventh Note Demo
demos.short_description: A rhythm-action platformer where every move syncs to the music. Dash, jump, and escape through a mystical world shaped by rhythm to save your mother’s life. Rhythm was the life of the island of Suri, who will step up when its harmony is broken?

highlights.trailer_name: SURI: The Seventh Note : Demo Trailer

demos.name: Protocol Solari: Escape Room Demo
demos.short_description: Awaken alone aboard a drifting colony ship under autonomous lockdown. Restore critical systems, solve interconnected puzzles, and uncover the truth behind the Solari Protocol before you and the colonists depending on you are lost to the void.

demos.name: WitchOver Demo
demos.short_description: Watch the witches.Don't miss the anomalies.Despairing witches slowly lose themselves and become monsters.12:00 AM – 6:00 AM.Your job is to manage the “witches.”As the caretaker of a facility, monitor the witches who possess dangerous powers and resolve any anomalies that occur within the facility.

demos.name: Angler's Journey Demo
demos.short_description: This idle clicker demands you battle for every catch, from small fry to mighty bosses. Arm yourself with diverse weapons; unlock powerful skills and constant upgrades to complete your massive fish collection.

demos.name: Incremental Fishing Demo
demos.short_description: A short incremental game about fishing across diverse ocean biomes and upgrading your ship.

demos.name: Infinite Ruins Demo
demos.short_description: An incremental mining game where you manage golems, destroy blocks, unlock upgrades, and descend infinitely in search of ever more valuable resources.

demos.name: Brainrotting Demo
demos.short_description: Brainrotting is a "scroller" desktop simulator about doomscrolling or solving minigames, getting upgrades and eventually automating your dopamine generation.

demos.name: Ghostslayers Demo
demos.short_description: Ghostslayers is a wave-based top-down coop shooter where you slay the ghosts with magic and couple thousands of bullets... Or punches, or slashes, or explosions. Use the varied weaponry, spell cards and abilities, combine them together and obliterate absolutely everything.

demos.name: PredaDeck Demo
demos.short_description: PredaDeck is a trading card game that transforms the brutal yet exquisite real-world food chain into a competitive strategic duel. Here, knowledge is your sharpest claw, and strategy is your only law of survival.

demos.name: FileTowerDefence Demo
demos.short_description: Defend your desktop from invading viruses! An OS-themed strategic tower defense game where you combine various file extensions to build powerful defense towers.

demos.name: Gambit's Escape Demo
demos.short_description: Gambit's Escape is a strategic puzzle adventure that expands on the classic Minesweeper formula, where every move matters. Use logic to uncover the board, manage risks, and guide a king on the run as he rescues villagers and fights for his escape.

demos.name: Operation HOPE - Tower Defense Demo
demos.short_description: A fast-paced Tower Defense set in a colorful retro-futuristic 1980s world. Face massive enemy swarms, build powerful defenses, and adapt to relentless assaults. Survive the final stand in Story Mode or test your limits in Roguelike Mode.

demos.name: The Bed Above My Head Demo
Liminal:Childhood Memories Demo
demos.short_description: Exhausted by the gray reality of adulthood, a 21 year old awakens in his forgotten past. Childhood Memories is a puzzle-free, melancholic exploration experience driven by the nostalgic atmosphere of 'Liminal Space' and 'Kenopsia'. No monsters, only memories.

demos.name: Monster Girl Gym Demo
demos.short_description:
Manage a gym full of adorable monster girls! Create a safe space where they can work out without creeps or judgment. Help the girls train, build relationships, lose weight, or learn to embrace their curves.

Win their hearts, one workout at a time.

demos.name: Clickstead Demo
demos.short_description: A short incremental game about harvesting trees using elements like Fire and Lightning to your advantage. Build your skill tree and rise from Seed to legend.

demos.name: Cat Hits the Deck Demo
demos.short_description: Deckbuilder roguelike about a cat that fears being hurt but has only cards that hurt her before enemies! Min-max your resources, get OverPowered cards in your paw, and build an unlosable Deck that prolly gonna kill you 9 times^^

demos.name: EchoLink: Recursion Demo
demos.short_description: EchoLink: Recursion is an active incremental hacking simulation spanning 1990s dial-up to 2150s megacities. Hack through time by infiltrating networks, building proxy chains, and automating routines. Every reset reboots you with exponential upgrades. Grow a skill tree and rewrite history.

demos.name: DEBRISVERSE Demo
demos.short_description: Smash your way out of a $100M debt. DEBRISVERSE is a satisfying sci-fi debris-smashing incremental simulation. Destroy debris, collect resources, and upgrade tools in an addictive loop. No game overs—just pure immersion as you chip away at your debt.

demos.name: Rogues of Titan Demo
demos.short_description: Descend into the hellish underworld of a moon ruled by a psychic order, where transcendent horrors have broken free. Play as two outcasts as you invoke psionic powers, harness otherworldly technology, and uncover the prophesized death of a goddess.

demos.name: Harold Rabbit 3: The House of Mysteries Demo
PIERCING Demo
demos.short_description: PIERCING is a violent rhythm action game where you shatter panels in one continuous stroke to the beat. Destroy the Devil statue at the goal to clear the stage. If you fail, the Contract compels you to pierce Asha’s ears.

demos.name: Flocked and Loaded Demo
demos.short_description: Raise your herd. Arm them for war. Survive the wild! Guide your flock through dangerous environments, battling escalating waves of predators. Extract your surviving animals to your ranch to unlock powerful guardians, expand your roster, and prepare for even deadlier runs.

demos.name: Touhou: Beyond Gensokyo Demo
demos.short_description: Discover the mysteries of Gensokyo through the lens of Shin, a photographer from the outside world. In this immersive visual novel, join forces with the shrine maiden Reimu Hakurei to unravel the truth behind this incident and stop the enigmatic Kurohana.

demos.name: Blox Pressure Wash Demo
demos.short_description: A relaxing first-person cleaning simulation where you use a pressure hose to wash dirt from houses, vehicles, and structures. Switch between different spray modes, move around the environment, and fully clean every object to progress through increasingly challenging levels.

demos.name: The Eternal Woods Demo
demos.short_description: The Eternal Woods is a short, fast paced incremental about an adventurer trapped in a never ending Woods. Sharpen your axe, upgrade your skills and conquer the different Forests to escape the Woods!

demos.name: Textures Not Found Demo
demos.short_description: Explore a mysterious facility where colors have vanished. Restore the world piece by piece, uncover hidden secrets, and navigate unique environments guided by a sarcastic AI companion in this atmospheric narrative experience.

demos.name: Formula: RPG Demo
demos.short_description: Experience the story of a struggling team facing bankruptcy in this RPG-themed Racing Sim. Upgrade and tune your car, level up your driver and challenge the competitive world of open-wheel racing. Balance race setup strategies and character progression to find the fastest way around the track.

demos.name: BEATSHIFT ARENA Demo
demos.short_description: Fight to be the last color standing in a beat-synced arena shooter where every song reshapes the battlefield, fallen players become physical cover, and taking damage turns you into a massive moving target.

demos.name: The Long Wake: What Remains Observed Demo
demos.short_description:
The town is empty. The nightmare isn’t.

A third-person 3D survival horror game with roguelike elements and knowledge-based mechanics.
Explore a deserted town trapped in a relentless loop, where each attempt reveals new paths, tools, and truths, escape before time runs out.

demos.name: Trader's Life: Medieval Shop Demo
demos.short_description: Step behind the counter in an immersive medieval trading simulation. Buy low, haggle hard, and sell high! Upgrade gear at the blacksmith, infuse your goods with elemental magic, and research new skills to transform your humble stall into the realm's most famous marketplace.

demos.name: Surface Doctrine: Crater Demo
demos.short_description: Immerse yourself in the life of Crater — a unique world whose origins remain an unfathomable mystery to its inhabitants. Explore the fates of entire communities and delve into the minds of individuals as you seek the truth amidst the turmoil and unrest of a fading world.

demos.name: Pogopa Demo
demos.short_description: In this funny & unconventional physics-based platformer, you help Grandpa conquer a treacherous mountain to rescue his granddaughter. Master the Pogo3000 and Grandma’s Balloon Helmet to reach the summit!

demos.name: Tessera Demo
demos.short_description: You've been handed a Tessera — a ticket into an underground tactical combat league. Build your roster, manage the     money, call the strategy, and fight for the championship from behind your broker's desk.

demos.name: Dual Core Sync Demo
demos.short_description: Your brain has two sides, and one of them has to break: a high-difficulty, brain-splitting game that forces single players to handle "two-player co-op" solo.

demos.name: Mega Marbles Demo
demos.short_description: Mega Marbles is a team-based party game for up to eight players. Powered by rollback netcode for online play, compete for marble mastery around the world!

demos.name: Invisible Ascent Demo
demos.short_description: A rage-inducing memory platformer where the path disappears before you jump. Study the platforms, trust your memory, and climb upward one painful mistake at a time.

demos.name: Sunderborn Demo
demos.short_description: This is a multiplayer asynchronous sandbox with elements of puzzles, logic games, world exploration, and strategy. Take on the role of the Creator, shaping your own reality out of the surrounding Chaos. Manage your created world and compete with other Gods!

demos.name: 这张不算 This One Doesn't Count Demo
demos.short_description: This One Doesn't Count — Forty years buying lottery tickets every day. Never won once. On your deathbed, God leans in: "The winners? They all cheated." Now you're reborn. By any means necessary, scrape together your daughter's tuition before her college entrance exam. Scratch-off × Roguelite.

demos.name: Koko's Cafe Demo
demos.short_description: Serve coffee and befriend customers as you learn their story in this coming-of-age visual novel.

demos.name: Word Search Cafe Demo
demos.short_description: Cozy up and unwind with Word Search Café —a chill, no-pressure word hunt where you can play at your own pace (timers optional). Find words, relax, and enjoy the vibe.

highlights.trailer_name: Word Search Cafe Demo Teaser Trailer

demos.name: Bit Demo
demos.short_description:
In Bit, you play as Bit. A little pixel alone in the void.

Bit has the urge to climb. Why does he want to climb? Find out with him across 10 unique worlds and help him find his purpose.

demos.name: Tiny Farmie Demo
demos.short_description: An ultra-tiny idle farming simulation you can place anywhere on your desktop. Start your cozy farming life anytime.

demos.name: Mortar and Malady Demo
demos.short_description: A medieval apothecary simulator where you brew, grind, and sell remedies to earn your place in a wary new town. Solve intricate recipe riddles, manage your resources, and grow your mastery of herbalism to heal the sick and maintain your reputation as the local healer.

demos.name: Woke Up In a Dark Nightmare Demo
Banquet of Nausea~纳希亚盛宴 测试版
demos.short_description: Banquet of Nausea is a dark fantasy RPG made in RPGMaker. You will play as Liya — a girl on an epic quest to find her lost kin. Explore sacred ruins, purge festering abominations, and forge bonds with survivors whose fates lie in your hands.

demos.name: Fyrardien - Demo
demos.short_description: After a fateful discovery, our hero and their new companions embark on a challenging journey through unknown lands. Are they the last hope for their world? And could these new companions become more than just friends? The choice is yours, young Guardian...

demos.name: Almost A Ghost Demo
demos.short_description:
Almost a Ghost is a grid-based, Sokoban-inspired puzzle game about a spirit caught between worlds.
Push boxes, master evolving mechanics, and work your way toward becoming real.

demos.name: Monst Demo
demos.short_description: Players take on the role of an alien monster, devouring humans on Earth with various transformations, fighting against human armed forces, and annihilating the world.

demos.name: Komo: A Sunlit Journey - Demo
demos.short_description: A cozy metaverse chat app where you can relax in a gentle, soothing world. Stroll through beautiful nature or gather around a campfire to chat. Set up chairs and tables or pull out food and drinks at your favorite spot. Spend time alone or with others — enjoy your place at your own pace.

demos.name: Zwamman Demo
demos.short_description: Zwamman is a zero pressure single screen puzzle game in which you have to use your light to help Zwamman find crystals in dark forests and swamps. Use the crystals to light a path to Zwamman's home and reveal the true nature of the scary monsters!

demos.name: Midnight Moments Demo
demos.short_description: A small, cyberpunk diorama-building game where you create cozy rain-soaked backstreets, glowing apartment blocks, or quiet neighbourhood corners. Decorate your designs with props and place citizens, crafting stories that bring your city to life. At your own pace. No goals. Just vibes.

demos.name: Stealth Operative Syn: Virtual Training Demo
demos.short_description: Synthia “Syn” is training to become a Stealth Operative. In order to do so, she trains in the Virtual Simulation Room. Use different tactics and techniques to sneak past the guards and obstacles. Finish every level to complete your virtual training!

highlights.trailer_name: Stealth Operative Syn: Virtual Training Demo

demos.name: Courier Beware Demo
demos.short_description: Deliver to haunted places, solve paranormal mysteries, and struggle through the daily grind in this horror life sim adventure.

demos.name: Maelor The Robot: Going Rogue Demo
demos.short_description: Flip gravity on the fly, master a multi-stage jetpack, slingshot across massive gaps, and use weapon recoil to launch yourself through chaotic levels. Evolve your arsenal through use, fight aggressive enemies, and turn the environment itself into a weapon in this high-mobility sci-fi adventure.

highlights.trailer_name: Maelor The Robot: Going Rogue Trailer

demos.name: CELESTIAL: FIRE & FORGE Demo
demos.short_description: An incremental clicker game where you HEROICALLY… click a button to light a fire. That’s it... The fire makes ash, you assign recipes to arcane forges, materials appear, upgrades unlock, numbers go up, and somehow.... you’re still optimizing it all. Repeat forever.

demos.name: Retail Rivals Demo
demos.short_description: Build your retail empire inside a shopping mall. Open multiple stores, sabotage rivals, and play solo or with up to 8 players. Choose different match objectives or play endless mode and compete for retail domination.

demos.name: Platon³ Demo
demos.short_description: Create your deck with cubes to place them on a grid. The objective is simple : make the highest score possible. Platon³ is a roguelike and incremental game. The further you go, the higher the scores will be. But, if you lose, you have to restart and try new strategies.

demos.name: One Song, One Life Demo
demos.short_description: 【DEMO Ver.】“One Song, One Life” is a rhythm adventure game where the music and story change based on the notes you hit. Take control of Sumire Kirishima, a girl striving to become the ultimate net artist and perform alongside her idol. Your performance will shape her destiny—one song, one life.

demos.name: Dawn Bell Demo
demos.short_description:
When she opens her eyes, she finds herself in an unfamiliar old castle—.
Dawn Bell Demo is a trial version of the 2D side-scrolling horror adventure Dawn Bell, in which a girl who lost her memory explores a mysterious castle, solving puzzles while uncovering fragments of lost memories.

demos.name: Time To Waste Demo
demos.short_description: Drive your little trash compacting robot across a ruined world, collect mountains of trash, and upgrade everything — until your one small bot becomes an unstoppable cleaning fleet. An active incremental about quiet, endless purpose.

demos.name: Factomancer Demo
demos.short_description: The Order sends you on a mission. Armed with technology powered by magic, build production chains, plan, transform, optimize, and prepare for the unexpected. In this automation roguelite, the Eye of the Order watches your moves: failure is only a step toward perfection.

demos.name: Seal Shark Diary Demo
developers: 鲨乘豹工作室 Atelier Seal&Shark
publishers: 鲨乘豹工作室 Atelier Seal&Shark
demos.short_description: Run a cozy island diner as a cute seal chef in this hand-drawn simulation game. Cook a variety of dishes, grow ingredients, upgrade your restaurant, and complete light challenges while uncovering heartwarming stories. Expand your menu and shape your own relaxing island life.

demos.name: Rising Moonshade Demo
demos.short_description: Rising Moonshade Demo is a turn-based strategy game set in a medieval fantasy world. Under the dual pressure of survival and combat, you must ultimately withstand the Demon King's invasion.

demos.name: Fusion Core: Black Hole Demo
demos.short_description: A simple idle, clicker game where you create atoms and feed them to a black hole. Unlock new elements, upgrade your stats, resources, and watch the numbers go crazy

demos.name: Heroic Musical Chairs Demo
demos.short_description: Face off against your friends and family in this epic take on musical chairs! Play locally or online as tiny wizard athletes ready to do anything to win. Special powers, dirty tricks, and dozens of crazy arenas: when the music stops, chaos begins!

demos.name: The Disappearance of Emily Crowe Demo
demos.short_description: A first-person psychological horror built on stealth and dread. Raise your real phone to reveal what your screen can't — hidden threats, impossible paths, and the truth about a sister who vanished 15 years ago. What took Emily never left, and it remembers you.

highlights.trailer_name: The Disappearance of Emily Crowe - Demo

demos.name: Spear of the Sky Demo
demos.short_description: Grab your magical returning spear in this cozy first-person hunting game! Take your time hunting unique creatures across dynamic skies, upgrade your arsenal, and use baits to discover rare beasts. Relax, enjoy the hunt, and prepare for occasional epic boss fights.

demos.name: Nymera Demo
demos.short_description: Locked in a Case, the player meets the Key. Wanting to find a way out, he immerses himself in What’s In Me, where his decisions change what is happening, bringing him closer to or further from the search for the mysterious Source.

demos.name: Over Engineered Demo
demos.short_description: Design elaborate contraptions, where the longer a ball takes, the better. Inspired by Rube Goldberg machines, you’ll soon craft sprawling machines where complexity is your goal. Get ready to overtake your screen with over-engineered chaos.

demos.name: Guardians Hand Demo
demos.short_description: Harness the elemental powers of fire, wind, ice, and lightning to enhance your defensive turrets and hold back relentless waves of enemies. Strategically build your deck and adapt your tactics to survive increasingly challenging encounters.

highlights.trailer_name: Guardians Hand Next Fest Demo Trailer

demos.name: MeloDancer Demo
demos.short_description: A turn-based roguelike with rhythm-infused elements. The melody and pulse rising from the depths grant you strength, empower your choices. With every step, the darkness grows heavier and more enemies emerge from the shadows. Gather power, seek relics

demos.name: SFTP - Super Football Tactics Pro Demo
demos.short_description: Super Football Tactics Pro drops you into the high-energy chaos of a wild football league where classic checkers meets hard-hitting strategy. Plan your moves, outsmart your opponent, and unleash game-changing special powers that can flip the match in an instant.

highlights.trailer_name: SFTP - Super Football Tactics Pro - Gameplay

demos.name: Just Pool Demo
demos.short_description: Just Pool is a simple multiplayer & singleplayer 8-ball pool game. Score all your balls before the other player to win the match. Play with friends, or solo.

demos.name: Plobania 47/B Demo
demos.short_description: Immortality is not a blessing, it is a burden. As Milton Clarke, you work at the 47/B Mandatory Sleep Hospital, review documents, surf the internet, and decide who will no longer exist. You don’t kill anyone. You only “put them to sleep.” The rules are clear. Every decision has consequences.

demos.name: Zombobox: Bredo Story Demo
demos.short_description: It seems like a zombie apocalypse has begun in the world, but it's somehow quiet... Maybe ask an elderly drunked person what happened? He says that he stopped everything, but how?

demos.name: たろうくんはいってきました Demo
demos.store_url: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4682720/たろうくんはいってきました_Demo

demos.name: Adventure Honor Demo
demos.short_description: Adventure Honor is a rogue-like RPG. On your journey, you’ll collect skills and items to build your character. With the right buffs and upgrades, you can grow into a powerful warrior as you explore.

demos.name: Estancia Protocol Zero Demo
demos.short_description: A first-person survival horror set in Neuquén, Argentine Patagonia. Venture into a remote estate in Cerro Ocaso to search for your missing partner. Face hordes of the undead, manage your resources, and solve classic puzzles to survive the nightmare.

demos.name: Antarctic Grave Demo
demos.short_description: A first-person survival horror set in an Antarctic research station. Explore the frozen complex, search for tools and weapons, keep the generator fueled, and outsmart mutants to survive the harsh conditions.

demos.name: Spy Carnival Demo
demos.short_description: Spy Carnival is a 2-10 player social deception game set in a vibrant, chaotic funfair. Spies hide among the crowd, sabotaging rides and eliminating visitors while blending in with NPCs. Officers must stay sharp, read the crowd and take down the spies before the carnival turns into complete chaos.

demos.name: Fill The Void Demo
demos.short_description: Experience the power of BEING a black hole. Consume everything. Grow. Morph between a void that swallows the world and a rolling sphere that bounces, dashes, and wall-jumps across themed diorama levels. Inspired by Katamari Damacy.

demos.name: 趋光本能 Pygmalion Demo
demos.short_description: This is a love story. You will explore a mysterious apartment, talk to girls with distinct personalities, gather clues, and build connections. Your choices will lead either to an unreal happy ending or to a truth that comes at a cost.

demos.name: Banneret Demo
demos.short_description: Roguelike deckbuilding meets tactical auto-battling in this party building strategy game! Recruit and upgrade fighters, customize your deck, explore treacherous lands and battle fierce enemies.

demos.name: InTheLake
demos.short_description: This is a moderate-paced hardcore 3D action dungeon crawler. Free of redundant storytelling, it focuses purely on combat. Featuring balanced roguelite elements, you can combine random abilities and character talents to craft your own unique combat playstyle!

demos.name: 国王的游戏（King'sGame） Demo
demos.short_description: King's Game is a strategy roguelike: use resources to recruit soldiers or heroes, deploy tactically, defeat enemies, and climb the tower to unveil the hidden truth.

demos.name: Custom Corner Demo
demos.short_description: Experience the cozy atmosphere of Custom Corner in this demo version. Design your own isometric room with over 70 basic items and enjoy lo-fi music. Boost your productivity while working or relaxing with basic assistant tools like a focus timer and a to-do list.

demos.name: MITOS VERSA Demo
demos.short_description: Try Mitos Versa, a lightweight voice and text chat app for friends. Talk in voice channels, share your screen, listen to music together, use a soundboard, and play a small social card game — all in 10 languages. Free demo for up to 4 friends.

demos.name: Idle Crush Factory Demo
demos.short_description: Idle Crush Factory Demo is a physics-based incremental idle game where you crush shapes and build an automated factory that can run at bottom of your screen while you work. Earn cash, unlock upgrades, optimize your gears, and scale your factory in a satisfying progression loop. Wishlist now.

demos.name: Hyper Bun Buster: Rocket Hammer Action Demo
２つの言語　-リンと澪とメトロポリタン美術館- Demo
demos.store_url: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4648290/２つの言語_リンと澪とメトロポリタン美術館_Demo

demos.name: AfterMove Demo
demos.short_description: Move one piece. Everything else moves with you. AfterMove is a minimalist puzzle game where every piece on the board follows its own rule — find the sequence that wins. 180+ hand-crafted levels. Quietly merciless, deeply satisfying.

demos.name: Standard Human Pizza Demo
demos.short_description: Make deadly pizzas to kill monsters. Standard Human Pizza is a horror-cooking sim where you serve monsters, survive anomalies, and use lethal ingredients to exterminate your clientele.

demos.name: The Wicked Isles Demo
demos.short_description: A Puzzle Roguelike of Risk and Deduction. Combine powers of artifacts, unlock new characters and on your way out of the cursed archipelago. This demo consists of Miniaturised teaser stages.

demos.name: DeskFarm: Idle Garden Demo
demos.short_description: A desktop-optimized idle farm that stays by your side. Use built-in pin and hide features to grow your pixel garden without interrupting your workflow. Strategically secure rare seeds from the rotating shop and upgrade your way to discover increasingly valuable crop tiers.

demos.name: Cleaning Simulator: Ultimate Mess Demo
demos.short_description: Clean, organize, and restore different environments in this level-based cleaning simulator. Every level introduces new mechanics, tools, and satisfying ways to turn mess into perfection.

demos.name: Astral Hunter: Homebound Demo
demos.short_description: This is a top-down action RogueLite game where you fight hordes of alien creatures with your chosen weapons. Build a unique combat style using various upgrades and items. Capture creatures to use their abilities or harvest materials. Recruit more characters and conquer the planet!

demos.name: Vquarium Demo
demos.short_description: Vquarium is a relaxing incremental-idle game where you grow your own underwater world on your screen overlay with a virtual assistant. Collect rare fish, discover sparkling variants, and decorate your tank while taking care of an adorable assistant!

demos.name: Murder Castle Demo
demos.short_description: You are trapped inside a masterpiece of madness. Unravel the chilling mystery of H.H. Holmes Murder Castle. In this atmospheric true crime escape simulator, every room is a puzzle and every document a shocking discovery. Can you escape the architect of death?

demos.name: Greedy Spin: Reel Roguelike Demo
demos.short_description: Greedy Spin is a roguelite slot game built around a rotating prize wheel. Freely modify the machine’s symbols and multipliers, combine 150+ items to uncover wild chain effects, and rake in absurd amounts of chips — and cash!

demos.name: Summer Vacation Demo
demos.short_description: Summer Vacation is an adult visual novel about self-discovery, first love, and the chaos... of figuring out who you really are. Live this summer with Mat, and his first year at university. Every choice shapes the bonds you build, and the person you'll become.

demos.name: Rituals of Demons Demo
demos.short_description: A demon-hunting game where you investigate haunted locations, gather evidence to identify the entity, and perform the correct ritual to banish it—before it hunts you.

demos.name: OVER SAND Demo
demos.short_description: Take to the steampunk skies! Defend your flying ship over endless sands from mechanical hordes. Master turret firepower, switch weapons, and craft synergistic perk builds mid-wave. No movement — pure skill!

demos.name: Prologue: Gossip & Potions
demos.short_description: Gossip & Potions is a potion-brewing and gossip-listening simulator about a witch named Owi, the small town she just moved to, and the very specific potions its very specific inhabitants need. Help them. Or don't. Watch what happens.

demos.name: The Perils of Magic Demo
demos.short_description: The Perils of Magic is a fantasy, hack-and-slash adventure. Battle monsters on tiny planets and overcome challenges.

demos.name: Reflection Arena Demo
demos.short_description: Master the basic controls in the Training Ground, which also serves as a tutorial.

demos.name: 幽囚の魔法使い Demo
demos.short_description:
“The Imprisoned Magician” is a fantasy BL visual novel that explores the bond between master and apprentice.
Aim to become a fully-fledged magician under the tutelage of a master with a troubled past.

demos.name: YOU BECOME FROG 🐸 DEMO
demos.short_description: A short incremental bullet heaven game about becoming animals. Laser eye frog, unicorn cow, bomb slug. Each have their own abilities and weapons. Build weird builds and combos. Explore and find new animals. BECOME.

demos.name: 键盘侠：键入即毁灭 Demo
demos.short_description: Type fast to destroy falling letters under a stunning starry sky with meteors. Master active skills and marking systems to trigger explosive combos, ice slows, bonus scores and spectacular effects across dozens of unique stages!

demos.name: Chiasmus Demo
demos.short_description: Viktor finds himself in a mysterious apartment with no way out. He discovers an amazing ability to move between two parallel worlds. This discovery helps him piece together the scattered fragments of what is happening and find the key to solving the mystery.

demos.name: Bring It Demo
demos.short_description: A stylized retro arcade game about a motor courier hustling through the city to deliver meals, coffee and groceries with skill and style. Chain boosts, drifts, air dashes and double jumps, then spend your earnings on home upgrades,new licenses and bikes with unique abilities for the next day’s rush.

demos.name: Forbidden Scrolls : Midnight Whispers Demo
demos.short_description: Forbidden Scrolls: Midnight Whispers is a single-player/indie game that blends Chinese-style eerie cultivation with card battle. The atmosphere is dark and gloomy, filled with ancient Chinese mystery. Players will take on the role of a wandering cultivator who has stumbled upon forbidden scrolls

demos.name: Dark Watching Chapter 2 Demo
demos.short_description: After leaving the bunker, you've arrived at the shopping mall, but your sister is still missing. Solve simple puzzles and survive the dangers lurking in the dark...

demos.name: Phantasma Hotel Demo
demos.short_description: A dark and ruthless horror RPG with roguelike elements. Turn-based combat challenges existing challenges; each respawn changes the environment and your decision-making. Set in the 1980s, Pilgrim City, an abandoned hotel that remembers every death and every mistake you make.

demos.name: How To Grow a Black Hole Demo
Dread Admiral Demo
demos.short_description: A turn-based naval roguelite where every ship you lose is gone forever. The Black Fleet hunts you. Your Flagship must survive.

demos.name: Spiriki: Tiny Island Demo
demos.short_description: Listening to the gentle sound of the waves, take care of three small quirky nature spirits! With their help and some patience, create your own tiny cozy diorama and bring back life to your overgrown island!

demos.name: The Last Shot: Underworld Demo
demos.short_description: The Last Shot: Underworld casts players in the role of an aging scientist who, by a sinister twist of fate, finds himself deep in the dungeons of Metropolis—a place inhabited by victims of monstrous experiments, rogue robots, and other unfortunate souls cast down to the depths.

demos.name: GoHome Demo
demos.short_description: Take control of an old local regular who’s had a few too many in this little atmospheric pixel-art adventure. After being kicked out of the tavern into a biting winter blizzard, you must navigate the freezing, snow-covered streets to find your way home.

demos.name: Be kinder and, like, be a Rewinder, dude! Demo
Lured In Demo
demos.short_description: Run your own cozy aquarium! Travel to different places to catch all types of fish. Bring them back for idle profits, or sell them for instant cash. Unlock research for new upgrades, and ascend for powerful bonuses. Customize your character and tanks, and make your aquarium your own!

demos.name: Pipfiend: The Demonic Domino Deckbuilder Demo
Chess Master Quest - Idle Demo
demos.short_description: Learn Chess. Real Progression. Idle Mode.

demos.name: Fairy Springs Demo
demos.short_description: You are a magical Fairy tasked with your first assignment: aid the critters of the glen through the seasons of a year. Take your time getting to know the valley's inhabitants in this cozy little adventure. Every day has a new task to complete with each animal neighbor having something fresh to say.

highlights.trailer_name: Fairy Springs Gameplay Trailer - Next Fest

demos.name: Mythmon: Mythic Monsters Demo
demos.short_description: Build the ultimate monster party and defeat the Demon King in this hack-and-slash strategy game! Combine quirky Mythmon, equipment, and formations to craft the perfect strategy and lead your forces to victory!

demos.name: MouseWorks Demo
demos.short_description: Switch between themed mice, click to trigger unique interactions and random rewards, collect coins and items, and unlock an ever-growing collection of fun new mouse themes.

demos.name: F.L.E.E.C.E Demo
demos.short_description: F.L.E.E.C.E. is an indie game that skillfully blends platforming with puzzle-solving. Everything you see here is a challenge, and the world itself is the ultimate puzzle. you need to combine your own abilities with those of a companion into the key that will move you forward to uncover the truth.

highlights.trailer_name: ⚠️观看此视频即视为同意参与《F.L.E.E.C.E》

demos.name: Thoughtless Demo
demos.short_description: A dark sci-fi psychological Visual Novel where your choices shape who you are. The world has ended and it's been dominated by mysterious aliens who roam the city. Despite that, you only think of what you've lost. Will you be able to rebuild your relationships? Or even... the world itself?

demos.name: DEMON'S REIGN Demo
demos.short_description:
Venture into a dark world ruled by demons, overcome the challenges and defeat the archfiends to gain their power. 

Explore at your desired order and freely build your character to face impossible battles.

demos.name: But in briefs Demo
demos.short_description: Reach the exit… until it runs away, everything collapses, and your pants catch fire. Six zones of chaos in a clean minimalist platformer.

demos.name: NEKO MAKER：貓娘育成物語 Demo
Alchemist's Arcana Demo
demos.short_description: A narrative puzzle game where you return to your hometown as an Alchemists' Guild clerk and unexpectedly become the acting alchemist. Relearn forgotten alchemy, help the townsfolk, and survive with your companions in a world slowly falling apart.

demos.name: Battle Nap Demo
demos.short_description: Battle Nap is a roguelite top-down shooter where your picnic nap becomes an explosive journey into dreamland domination. Build your arsenal, stack your perks, and blast through your subconscious to ensure you don’t wake up until the job is done. Don't wake up - the fight is just getting good!

demos.name: Streamchat: Horror Live Demo
demos.short_description: A first-person livestream horror game where you explore abandoned locations, survive terrifying encounters, and experience dynamic audience interactions through realtime chat and donation systems.

demos.name: Cult Clicker Demo
demos.short_description: You are a newborn God. Harvest souls, unlock deadly powers and grow your faithful followers by smiting non-believers. Whether by a T-Rex with laser eyes, a blazing inferno or simply a violent sneeze, souls must be sacrificed. Let the harvest begin!

demos.name: Internet Cafe Tycoon Demo
demos.short_description: Run a 2000s-era LAN cafe. Hire a literal ghost apprentice, dodge municipal inspections, keep rival groups from fighting on your bench, and ride the chaos through a 30-day campaign. Pixel-art tycoon with three difficulty modes and a Steam Next Fest demo waiting for you.

demos.name: Idle Aqua Driller Demo
demos.short_description: Dive into the depths of the first four platforms of an offshore drilling rig and develop underwater resource extraction! Manage drilling rigs, hire divers, and send submarines to new levels. Unlock increasingly valuable layers, upgrade decks, and improve extraction speed and team efficiency.

demos.name: The Hero's Adventure Log Demo
demos.short_description: In the Kingdom of Verde, the tale of the hero has been passed down for many millennia. It's said that the summoned hero will one day walk the land and aid the citizenry in their time of need.

demos.name: Farming Pixels Demo
demos.short_description: A unique resource gathering game with quests, gambling, tools and a lot of loot. Play the first chapter of the main story and try to reach the highest possible rank - to eventually become the king of the pixels!

demos.name: Sweet Land Survival Demo
demos.short_description: Sweet Land Survival is a colorful survival game in a world made of sweets! But don't let the cute visuals fool you. The island is treacherous: to survive another day, you'll have to gather resources and fight monsters. Gather a team of loyal companions to make survival more fun!

demos.name: Canyon Raid Demo
demos.short_description: Canyon Raid is a classic reimagined in 3D. Pilot unique aircraft through procedurally generated canyons, destroy enemies, collect XP, and unlock powerful upgrades in this roguelike aerial shooter. Classic gameplay, modern twist.

demos.name: Void Fragment Demo
demos.short_description: The Void needs to grow. An idle incremental game where you feed a Void with mana and essences. Collect fragments to empower spirits' power and continue feeding the Void.

demos.name: Click & Mine Demo
demos.short_description: Click & Mine is a relaxing incremental mining game. Mine various resources and use them to buy upgrades, allowing you to descend deeper and deeper while unlocking new biomes, ores and skills.

demos.name: Pigeon: A Love Story Demo
demos.short_description: Find one pigeon among millions in this needle-in-a-haystack sim that's about nothing and everything.

demos.name: Silver requiem Demo
demos.short_description:
Dance on the Edge of Death. A single counter turns the battlefield into your stage.
High-Mobility Counter × Build-Oriented 3D Soulslike Action
:Dance on the edge of death, Silver Undertaker.:

demos.name: Normal Dev Guy - Inside Kenney World Demo
demos.short_description: Norman is an everyday game dev who entered his own game to test it — and now must fix bugs in the most unusual way possible: playing crazy minigames inside the code!

demos.name: Cold Decree Demo
demos.short_description: Cold Decree is an atmospheric detective game that puts you in charge of a forensic laboratory. Scrutinize unsolved case files, analyze objects, and manually query the technical data within massive databases. Stop guessing; identify the perpetrator using only concrete evidence.

demos.name: Eternal Sword Tomb Demo
demos.short_description: A hardcore cultivation Roguelike where a mortal soul founds a sect, forges a divine sword, and dies into a Sword Soul. Master the Five Elements, fight beside spirit beasts, and turn each death into a step toward immortality.

demos.name: 雀神 -infinity- Demo
demos.short_description: Mahjong meets roguelite loot-building: score big with skills and gear to defeat the gods. Pure damage won’t save you—choose hands that restore HP/MP and master deep mahjong decisions. Equip consumable ofuda and permanent omamori & special tiles; chase rare drops run after run.

demos.name: The Moon my Destination Demo
demos.short_description: Demo version for the runner game The Moon my Destination, with reduced functionality and limited time gameplay.

demos.name: Weirdshine Demo
demos.short_description: Weirdshine is a 2D precision platformer full of gimmicks that would probably have been considered a rage game in the late 2000s.

demos.name: Sente Demo
demos.short_description: Jump into a sneak peek demo and experience the strategic depth of Sente, a simultaneous turn-based board game where every decision unleashes a cascade of electrifying reactions. Built for 1-6 players, this  is the final battleground of humanity against AI supremacy.

demos.name: With A Heavy Heart Demo
demos.short_description: Control a fragile balloon lifting a weary soul through the beautiful, surreal maze of his dying memories. A cozy but deeply emotional 2D platformer about holding on.

highlights.trailer_name: With A Heavy Heart Brief Demo

demos.name: Waifuro : Roguelike Waifubuilder Demo
demos.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilding card game where you battle enemies using powerful waifu cards, unlock new waifus, and build the ultimate squad.

demos.name: Unseasonable Flowering Demo
demos.short_description: "Unseasonable Flowering" is a first-person horror game set in Japan. After moving to a new home, the young protagonist, Mashiro, is met with eerie residents and inexplicable phenomena. Something "sprouting" everywhere quietly erodes her daily life.

demos.name: Broken Divide Demo
demos.short_description: Build your guild, gear your party, and send them into battle. Broken Divide is a tactical autobattler RPG with deep skill trees, real-time ATB combat, and a growing roster of heroes to master.

demos.name: Piroot Demo
demos.short_description: Journey to the center of the planet in Piroot, an open world adventure! Explore and survive as a shipwreck's lonely survivor. What secrets lie at the planet's core, and can you trust the voice leading you there?

demos.name: IDLE: Intergalactic Defense League Exterminators Demo
demos.short_description: An incremental game about blasting bugs, collecting guts, upgrading a base, and blasting more bugs!

demos.name: Open The Gate Just A Little Demo
demos.short_description: Command armies of Crusaders, Orcs, Undead, and Dynasty warriors in a PvE tower defense where strategy, positioning, and timing decide survival against relentless enemies and mighty dragons.

demos.name: WINGMINE Demo
demos.short_description:
WINGMINE is a narrative puzzle game inspired by Minesweeper, entirely based on logic.
Your special unit has been scattered behind enemy lines: analyze the terrain, defuse the mines, and save your team.

demos.name: Dark Age Gladiator Demo
demos.short_description:
An age of chaos where empires and monsters coexist.
As a mere gladiator, step into the arena and carve your name in glory through blood and battle.
A dark fantasy action RPG where sword and sorcery collide.

demos.name: Gridbound Tactics Demo
demos.short_description: Gridbound Tactics is an async PvP tactics auto-battler where TFT-style drafting meets Backpack Battles-style spatial buildcraft. Draft units, multiply local trait power with placement, and find the strongest shape for the pieces you hit.

demos.name: 盲心：伪装的幻想 Demo
demos.short_description:
Blind Heart: Disguised Fantasy is an AVG game——At some point, my ordinary life stopped being ordinary…
The doppelgängers I’d only read about in online horror stories had appeared in the real world.
Before I could even process this, my lover, Lin Shiyu, knocked on my door.

demos.name: Playback '94 - Post Office Demo
demos.short_description: Alex Reed, a private detective, followed the cold trail of missing journalist James Carter to Willow Creek Valley. What he found had been untouched for a century — and whatever waited there had never stopped watching.

highlights.trailer_name: Playback '94 - Post Office Demo Official Trailer

demos.name: Goobies 2 Demo
demos.short_description: Splatter blobs with your friends, unlock never-before-seen Goobies with unique abilities, discover powerful genetic goobie mutations and combine omens for the second blobbath experience in Goobies 2!

demos.name: Soul Injector Commando Demo
demos.short_description: An over the top, cacophonic smash stuff FPS challenge that serves as a very short supplement to the main game.

demos.name: Flock of the Seraphim Demo
demos.short_description: Exorcise hordes of demons using gun-wielding nuns and angels in this survivors-like bullet heaven! Collect and keep angels with unique weapons, stats, and abilities to create god-like builds as you fend off waves of enemies! Do you have enough faith to survive?

demos.name: Album3D Demo
demos.short_description: Not a flat photo viewer—Album3D is a game-like 3D photo experience that turns your photos into 3D albums you can manually explore. Import large photo libraries, switch 3D views/layouts, and enjoy manual mode, slideshow, or flythrough—fast and fun.

highlights.trailer_name: One of Album3D Demo Grid Views

demos.name: Oort Protocol: Perihelion Demo
demos.short_description: 2476. Mercury orbit. Four soldiers. One extraction. A solar system about to burn. Hardcore tactical roguelike with permanent death. No tutorials. No mercy. Read the lore or lose your squad.

demos.name: The Last Errant Demo
demos.short_description: The Last Errant is a challenging turn-based tactical deckbuilder. Build your deck, master unique classes and variants, manage your sanity, evolve and mutate your cards, and outsmart your enemies in deeply tactical grid-based battles.

demos.name: Luvu: Your Desktop Pet Demo
demos.short_description: An interactive digital pet that lives on your desktop. It watches, reacts, and keeps you company. No scores, no pressure. A calm, playful experience that turns your screen into a more alive and personal space.

demos.name: Heavy Duty Inc. Demo
demos.short_description: Lead three space mechanics through tense turn‑based tactical battles to save a collapsing space station. Work the shifts solo or bring backup for co‑op mayhem, picking new gear between missions to keep your crew patched up and pushing on!

demos.name: Kitty Krush Demo
demos.short_description: Kitty Krush is a cozy, cat-themed roguelike deck-builder about cats. Upgrade your deck after each run with powerful cards and discover what happened to the humans. Based on a true story.

demos.name: Whatever it takes Demo
demos.short_description: Whatever It Takes is a hardcore first-person Action RPG in a dark fantasy setting. As a fallen god, master elemental magic, absorb enemy powers, and engage in tactical duels. Use a harpoon for traversal and shape the Omnisphere’s fate. Reclaim your throne. Whatever It Takes.

demos.name: Goblins for Good Demo
demos.short_description: A short incremental game about growing a goblin army, merging them into massive units, and unleashing comedic, wholesome chaos — all while supporting real-world good. 90% of profits are donated to charity, and players vote in-game for which charity they want their money to support.

demos.name: Battlements Demo
demos.short_description: Pirate ships, fortresses, and cannons! Battlements is an arcade reimagining of the "Rampart" classic. Defend the peaceful nation of Marinia from the dreaded Crimson Waves Empire - build walls, set up cannons, bombard the enemy! Control the fight with upgrades and special cards!

demos.name: Bubble & Squeak Demo
demos.short_description: Bubble & Squeak is a tower defence-lite, ambient strategy game where you wander, summon moss creatures, cast hexes, and build up a small camp and cauldron at your own pace.

demos.name: Project: Station Demo
demos.short_description: Co-op horror where the Station watches you. Complete missions, scavenge loot, and upgrade your gear across deadly runs. The Station Director learns your squad's habits, your fears, your greed, your routines, and adapts every run to break them

demos.name: Lassen's Loop Demo
demos.short_description: More than an app. More than a game. Try Lassen's Loop free! Build songs from 8-second cards made by real musicians in this cozy throwback studio. No music theory or DAW knowledge required. Y2K visualizers, starter deck, progress carries to the full game. Made in tribute to Justin Lassen.

demos.name: Last Alive Demo
demos.short_description:
You receive a message from an unknown sender.
Following their instructions, you must navigate a world overrun by zombies and survive the night.

demos.name: Where the Echo Sleeps Demo
demos.short_description: <Where the Echo Sleeps> is a story-driven hospital receptionist simulator with multiple endings. Become a hospital receptionist in a pandemic apocalypse and manage the order in which patients receive treatment.

demos.name: Iron Inc. Demo
demos.short_description: Iron Inc is an interplanetary factory automation game where you colonize, build, and fight on planets across the galaxy while developing inter-planetary logistics systems. Create massive bases and engage in combat on the ground and in space.

demos.name: MEGAPAIN Demo
demos.short_description: A dynamic retro shooter with intense arena battles and co-op mode! Gear up with pistols, assault rifles, and rocket launchers to annihilate hordes of mutants solo or with friends. Every arena is a new challenge, every firefight is pure action! Inspired by the FPS shooter legends of the '90s-'00s.

demos.name: 光与影之恋 Chiaroscuro Lovers Demo
publishers: 北京黎羽科技有限公司
demos.short_description: A domineering CEO-like older sister who’s gentle only to her sister, a childhood friend who became her doctor, and a cheerful girl only she can see… Who was Chu Hebai before losing her memories, and how did she become entangled with them? A melancholic yuri AVG about regret and unspoken love.

demos.name: Buried Below Demo
demos.short_description: An old tape replays your worst memory. Tonight, you take control as it plays out. A camping trip. A storm. Your girlfriend, gone near an abandoned mine. Scour the forest for tools to breach the entrance, but something awaits you below.  Can you survive and find her in the depths?

demos.name: Bus Terminal Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Experience an immersive terminal management simulator. Manage passengers, organize schedules, inspect luggage, catch smugglers, and prevent illegal activities. Not every passenger is innocent  some will try to trick you or smuggle illegal items. Stay alert and run your terminal efficiently.

highlights.trailer_name: Bus Terminal Simulator Demo Play Now

demos.name: Huntervania Demo
demos.short_description: Huntervania is a fast-paced roguelike where you battle endless hordes, craft powerful builds, and fight to survive. Inspired by Vampire Survivors, every second matters. How long can you last?

demos.name: Still in the Fog Demo
demos.short_description: A first-person horror adventure that combines environmental exploration, combat, strategic puzzles, and intense encounters in a fog-covered town that refuses to let you escape. Can you find a way out?

demos.name: Station Nexus Demo
demos.short_description:
A survey vessel bound for a destination 84,000 km away.
While investigating a destroyed spacecraft, you encounter an unexplained spatial anomaly.
Manage power and resources to continue your journey, and uncover the truth behind a phenomenon that is slowly consuming reality itself.

demos.name: Guinea Pig Gunner Demo
demos.short_description: Play as a combat cyborg guinea pig in this run-and-gun 2D action platformer. Use your teleporter gun, and a massive arsenal of weapons to fend off a reptilian invasion.

demos.name: TideBroker Demo
demos.short_description: A story-rich role-playing game, TideBroker will take you to a fantasy world of secrets and machinations of three opposing factions. You will play the part of an envoy and determine the outcome of a peace conference through dialogue, letters and books.

demos.name: VANADEN Demo
demos.short_description: Vanaden is a first-person survival horror game set in a cursed, fortress-like labyrinth. Hide from monsters, solve puzzles, and navigate shifting corridors where stealth and every decision determine your survival.

demos.name: Once Upon a Time… After the End Demo
Sevenfall Demo
demos.short_description: A turn-based strategy RPG with deck-building, fortress construction, and intense battles against legendary factions. Explore dangerous domains, conquer ancient keys, and face Ulthar, the Dark Trinity, in a journey where every choice shapes your destiny.

demos.name: BUG SQUASH Demo
demos.short_description: Defend your Command Centers against relentless waves of mutated insects! Customize powerful tanks with an arsenal of weapons and tactical modules in this action-packed tower defense game. Go solo or team up with friends in online co-op.

demos.name: The Crimson Contract Demo
demos.short_description: Every contract pays. Some cost what’s left of your humanity.

demos.name: ケンナゲェル -SWORD FLINGER- Demo
demos.short_description: Throw swords to fight in this roguelite chain-action game. Weapons bounce off walls and enemies, chaining hits from one foe to another. Build damage bonuses with every chain and dive deeper into ever-changing dungeons while collecting swords, spears, axes, staves, shields, and more.

demos.name: Tom Lander: The Exiled King Demo
demos.short_description: Pilot wacky aerial vehicles with silly key-based controls through an epic action packed campaign. Struggle to stay airborne while performing deliveries, rescues, firefighting missions, bombing runs, and chaotic dogfights. This game will remind you that flying is hard, but landing is harder.

demos.name: Tileburg Demo
demos.short_description: Tileburg is a game where each tile played has direct effects as well as powerful combos that trigger as soon as the conditions are met. Transform the landscape and develop your city while scoring points. Each turn, the city expands on a random tile!

demos.name: VELATO Demo
demos.short_description: VELATO is a Poker-Bluff Roguelike Deckbuilder where players build a Joker-driven economy engine, manipulate AI opponents through bluffing, and survive escalating table pressure across each run.

demos.name: Secret Stream ASMR with Saya: Just the Two of Us Demo
Pizza Man Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Burned the pizza? Just drown it in ketchup! In your restaurant, microwaving a frozen Hawaiian is literally an everyday thing. Serve picky customers, upgrade your pizzeria and improvise in the kitchen. The most important rules? Nobody gets food poisoning… and the cash actually adds up.

demos.name: Custom Image Survivors Demo
demos.short_description: Your Images, Your Survival. Survive the swarm using your skills and your favorite images! Custom Image Survivors is a fully customizable Survivors-like game where you can replace those familiar-looking assets with any image you prefer.

demos.name: (TwwwT) The Witches Who Weave Timelines Demo
demos.short_description: A 2D action-focused roguelite demo where you control “Joan of Arc” & "Lilith" battling endless enemies and dense bullet-hell barrages to correct fractured timelines.

demos.name: UNHUMAN Demo
demos.short_description: UNHUMAN is a 2D idle extraction shooter set in a cyberpunk dystopia. Raid hostile zones, loot valuable gear, fight enemies before extraction, and craft powerful weapons. Progress through a deep skill tree, install augments, and transcend humanity. Start as a scavenger. Become UNHUMAN.

demos.name: Rampallians Demo
demos.short_description: Rampallians blends the resource gathering of strategy games with core card game mechanics from Trading Card Game classics. With an auto battler for combat, in a fantasy setting. Nearly 400 cards available, and future expansions to be free updates. So no pay to win, ever.

demos.name: Project Beat Stands Demo
demos.short_description: "Project Beat Stands" is a 3D retro-styled Rhythm Hack'n'Slash adventure set in the fictional VR-MMORPG Shenanghia.

demos.name: Road To Majesty Demo
demos.short_description: A journey of redemption through a dying world. Break through mazes filled with traps and the Horsemen of the Apocalypse, solve tactical puzzles, and evolve unique abilities. Forge your own Road to Majesty — or create a new trial for others.

demos.name: CATS BLOCKS: HOT SPRINGS Demo
demos.short_description: A cozy cat puzzle game where you arrange fluffy block-shaped kitties into a relaxing hot spring resort. Rotate and place them in 90 handcrafted levels to unlock their happy reactions.

demos.name: Portrait Painter Demo
demos.short_description: Paint portraits to help a struggling art museum in this relaxing painting game.

demos.name: Milkraid Demo
demos.short_description: Defend the milk at all costs! Place towers, build your base, recruit minions, and battle endless swarms of enemies. Unlock new towers, characters and base upgrades, and upgrade them to create ridiculous builds. Every run is unique.

demos.name: Bean Wizard Eviscerates the Gonklins Demo
demos.short_description:
🫘 The world's first twin-stick anthill shooter! 🫘

Reign terror down on the Gonklins using every bean in your arsenal. Be careful, warrior Gonklins will strike back with their blasters! Upgrade your legume weaponry and defeat King Donklin the Gonklin!

demos.name: HAE Stack Demo
demos.short_description: In the far future year of 2025, society is dominated by a handful of global megacorporations that surveil everyone, everywhere, at all times. They know where you go, who you know, what you like, and sell that information to anyone willing to pay. But you need a job, and one of them is hiring.

demos.name: S-Ranker Demo
demos.short_description: Fight through short dungeon runs, shape your build through your choices, and rise on the path from F-Rank to S-Rank.

demos.name: Night Duty Log A Shōwa School Record Demo
demos.short_description:
A psychological horror demo set in a Showa-era Japanese school. Explore a quiet school at night, investigate strange occurrences, and uncover the beginning of a mysterious story.
The full version is scheduled for release on June 24, 2026.

demos.name: Souls Inferno Demo
demos.short_description: A minimalist soulslike with turn-based combat. Enter a cursed realm, defeat demonic knights, collect souls, and shape your build as you uncover a deeply interconnected world.

demos.name: Hex Judge Demo
demos.short_description: Interrogate villagers, uncover hidden truths, and decide who will be judged before sunset. This is a demo version.

demos.name: Project Echo: Downfall Demo
demos.short_description: Project Echo is an open-world FPS survival game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Explore the anomalies of the Downfall Zone, scavenge for resources, craft gear, rebuild your shelter, and uncover a story-rich narrative.

demos.name: Rogue Mate Demo
demos.short_description: This is a free demo for Rogue Mate. Play the first two campaign stages and Endless Mode. Full game coming soon!

demos.name: Birds Eat Bugs Demo
demos.short_description: One tree, two birds. One bird climbs up, one bird climbs down. Draw lines, circle bugs, feed them. If you don't care about scores, just draw and relax; if you aim at full combo, there are endless random challenge-mode levels. No matter what, enjoy the cute birds!

demos.name: VCTR Demo
demos.short_description:
