Shoot. Dash. Collect. Upgrade. VCTR is a kinetic arcade shooter where two simple actions create countless strategies.
Read the field. Choose when to act. And turn the chaotic battlefield into a dance of high-risk, high-reward play.

demos.name: Construcubes Demo
demos.short_description: Grab, move, rotate and connect bricks to build many cute objects ! Follow instructions to build things such as a flower, a robot or a little wood shack ! Available for PC, and for VR with Oculus Quest 2 and 3.

demos.name: The Bright Future Village Demo
demos.short_description: An atmospheric first-person horror where you take on the role of a watchman in a small post-Soviet village. Patrol the grounds, interact with eccentric villagers, and uncover the unsettling truth lurking behind the facade of Bright Future.

demos.name: Forge the Moon Demo
demos.short_description: A handcrafted incremental game about a monk forging the Moon. A harvest cursor pulses collecting energy. Crystalize collected energy into living items - bells, flutes, kites, paper planes. Many items can be fused to make something stronger. When you collect enough energy - Craft the Moon.

demos.name: Project Looking Glass Demo
demos.short_description: 1963. A classified CIA experiment. A grieving mother. A signal that won't stop transmitting. Step through the Looking Glass — a first-person psychological horror told through the static of a Cold War-era apparatus that peers into places mankind was never meant to reach.

demos.name: Necromancer's Army Demo
demos.short_description: Raise the dead in a dark narrative idle game. Collect souls, send minions to gather offerings, and trace rituals for lasting improvements. Play Act 1 in the free demo while your army keeps producing at your pace.

demos.name: RanaRangam: Where Chess Pieces Bleed Demo
demos.short_description: RanaRangam reimagines chess as a tactical battle of health, attacks, and step-by-step commands. Instead of instant captures, pieces can be commanded to any valid tile and then advance one step per turn, turning movement, combat, and board control into a deeper tactical battle.

demos.name: Climber and The Ice Tower Demo
Bonehold Demo
demos.short_description: Dungeon Crawler with elements of rogue-like and ARPG games. Kill hordes of enemies, duel mighty bosses, and acquire legendary loot!

demos.name: Sovereign's End Demo
demos.short_description: Feel invincible. Until you're not. A dark 3D space survivor-like with deep build-crafting and auto-firing abilities.  Outlast the swarm and face the Sovereign. If you can reach it.

demos.name: Idle DeepMiner Demo
demos.short_description:
You control a living pickaxe capable of tearing through the world on its way to the core.
Launch it downward, upgrade and modify it, and watch as a simple descent turns into a chaotic spectacle of explosions, lightning, and combos.

demos.name: Find Eat Hide Till Dawn Demo
Home Defense Zombie War Demo
demos.short_description: Defend your home against zombies! Place your heroes, build your defenses, and survive as long as possible in Survival Mode in this demo version.

demos.name: Octal: Of Course They Are Linked Demo
demos.short_description: A strategy game about correlations and bending reality for profit. You’re hired to increase a company’s sales—by any means necessary. Link variables together and transform changes in the world into revenue. More penguins? Somehow, that means higher sales. Don’t question it. Optimize it.

demos.name: Yaoguai Compendium Demo
demos.short_description: Yaoguai Compendium is a strategic roguelike idle game featuring equipment synthesis, build crafting, and tower climbing. It delivers a light-paced, casual experience while offering solid strategic.A strange Yaoguai aura suddenly sweeps across Shenzhou. Cultivation sects march out to roam the world.

demos.name: Gap World Events Demo
demos.short_description: This is an original orthodox detective mystery game. The player suddenly takes possession of Roran, who hopes to report to the academy. You must investigate and deduce the truth behind a series of bizarre incidents that obstruct his journey, helping him successfully reach the academy.

demos.name: Brix Demo
demos.short_description: Think it, build it, and watch it break. Brix is a physics-based engineering sandbox where you tackle impossible challenges with your own custom creations. From battlebots to earthquake-proof towers..

demos.name: SAIGAI Demo
demos.short_description: Play through the first segment of the game. You wake from cryosleep aboard a drifting deep-space freighter. The crew is gone. The ship is dark. Something is moving through the corridors with you. Uncover what happened to the crew and what secrets lurk about on this forsaken vessel.

demos.name: You had a bad dream Demo
demos.short_description: A minimalist horror game where you move through procedurally generated narrow corridors and avoid lurking monsters.

demos.name: Cannon Clicker Demo
demos.short_description: Build your army from nothing to military supremacy! Cannon Clicker blends addictive idle clicker action with real strategy in a WWII setting. Expand your skill tree, juggle three currencies, and command infantry, tanks and aircraft. Crush the enemy base and dominate every battlefield!

demos.name: VVV Demo
demos.short_description:
Raise your Voltage in a Virtual world and seize Victory!!!  
Chain combos, master powerful Arts, and race against time.  
Roguelite × 3D Action  
Every cleared stage brings new upgrades, while the relentless countdown pushes your Voltage even higher.

demos.name: WinHack 95 Demo
demos.short_description: Build a malware empire from a 90s PC. Code viruses, automate systems, take darknet contracts and also deploy them. Generate endless income to fund a shadow organization’s classified research in this hacker idle-clicker.

demos.name: NumberMaxxing Demo
demos.short_description: A match-3 where you don’t swap pieces. Add and subtract to rewrite the board, trigger massive combo chains, and break the game with overpowered builds.

demos.name: Low Effort Romance Demo
demos.short_description:
Low Effort Romance is an otome visual novel about two tired adults who accidentally fall for each other between quarterly reports.
Can you juggle deadlines, nosy coworkers, group projects, and a romance that keeps almost happening on company property?

highlights.trailer_name: Low Effort Romance Demo Debut trailer

demos.name: Hulljackers Demo
demos.short_description: Run a galactic pirate syndicate from a single screen. Raid ships, loot cargo, capture crew, and grow a fleet that raids in parallel while you watch. An incremental space-pirate idle game with tactical raids, a reputation-based black market, and a legendary endgame.

demos.name: Friendship VS The World Demo
demos.short_description:
A wholesomely chaotic base defender for 1-4 players! Frantically craft units with unique abilities and send them out to BATTLE!

Unlock new heroes, discover deep tactics, and hone your co-op skills to defeat the CEO of Evil TOGETHER!

highlights.trailer_name: Friendship vs The World - Demo Trailer!

demos.name: Crow's Foot Demo
demos.short_description: A turn-based hex strategy you can finish over lunch. Outsmart AI rivals, each with their own grudges, ambitions, and breaking points. Conquer provinces, command knights, scouts, assassins, and more. Unlock rule-bending scrolls. Go bankrupt and your own army defects.

demos.name: Gooblings Demo
demos.short_description: Fish a cozy pond with friends. Reel in creatures with randomized species, colors, patterns, and rare mutations — some wear tiny hats, some glow, some sprout wings. Breed new combos, display them in aquariums, and chase fish nobody has ever seen.

demos.name: FerryMan Demo
demos.short_description: Revolt against death itself. Every outcome by the roll of your dice. Sacrifice boons given to you from your crow companion and tip the odds in your favor.  Die, grow stronger, unlock more boons, and fight toward the Reaper who bound you to this endless cycle.

demos.name: Vivid Intrusion Demo
demos.short_description: A fast paced FPS roguelike with an emphasis on movement. Imbue your weapon with unique effects that make each run different. Survive a variety of arenas, enemies, and boss fights. Are you able to stay ahead of the curve and complete all your trials?

demos.name: Giga Lich Demo
demos.short_description: This is a single-player PvE extraction dungeon crawler where combat is king, and resources are limited. Explore the dungeon to utilize powerful equipment and souls-like combat to overcome the dungeon's guardians.

demos.name: Rong Demo
demos.short_description: Battle your way through a dystopian internet in this Rogue-Like Ping-Pong adventure. Battle a variety of enemies in virtual ping pong matches that twist the concept to its extremes.

demos.name: G Squad Demo
demos.short_description: Run the gauntlet with G Squad in this hand-crafted autobattler with roguelite and RPG elements, designed to scratch the strategy itch without the spreadsheets. 9 unique heroes, in-run rewards, permanent progression, and boss challenge modifiers to test yourself against.

demos.name: Friend and foe Demo
demos.short_description: A sci-fi deckbuilding roguelike with a twist: play solo or with bots through four floors of rogue AI and war machines, or team up online — cooperate to survive, or sabotage your friend to stay on top.

demos.name: Twerk Star Goddess Demo
demos.short_description: Twerk Star Goddess Demo is a high-energy rhythm game where you control the left and right butt cheeks of a dancing goddess. Match the beat and help her twerk her way through the competition. Jump into a selection of tracks, test your rhythm skills, and experience the fun, fast-paced gameplay.

demos.name: Framework Zero: Terminal Panic Demo
demos.short_description: You are hurtling through space aboard an industrial freighter. The crew already had their hands full with failing systems. But now there is a new threat on board. Something is hunting you. TERMINAL PANIC is a survival-horror "interactive fiction" text adventure RPG with '80s terminal aesthetics.

demos.name: Knuckle Jet Demo
demos.short_description: What's this? An off-the-wall, riveting jetpunk nose-breaking ricochet action platformer, lovingly crafted by the oddballs behind the Teslagrad series!

demos.name: Hovertron Demo
demos.short_description: Hoverboard your way through a physics-based platformer. Easy to learn but hard to master; Flow and flip through a series of levels to chase perfect runs.  Compete on a global scoreboard, or hunt down the secrets hidden throughout the game.

demos.name: Mexican Train Demo
demos.short_description: Mexican Train brings the classic game of Mexican Train Dominoes to 3D, supporting up to 7 players per online multiplayer session, or play solo and compete against up to 6 CPU players.

demos.name: Darklords: Siegefront Demo
demos.short_description: Pick Human or Demon in a real-time strategy game with twelve units and faction skills per race, custom six-unit armies, and a multi-difficulty campaign. Finish the campaign to unlock Challenge Mode and top your records.

demos.name: Bet On It - The Demo!
demos.short_description: Step up to the table for a high-stakes game of intense survival where every pull of the trigger could be your last. Wager your life for chips against friends or AI, and unlock rare loot. Will you walk away wealthy, or lose it all?

demos.name: Shepherd Demo
developers: 黑眼圈工厂 Dark Circle Studio
publishers: 黑眼圈工厂 Dark Circle Studio
demos.short_description: A post‑apocalyptic visual novel centering on humanity, violence and faith. In the wasteland where human civilization has collapsed and all order crumbled, what conflicts and connections will arise from the encounter of a handful of survivors? Is death the end? And how shall a new world dawn?

demos.name: Increbouncer Demo
demos.short_description: Increbouncer is a short incremental ball game where you launch balls, earn two different currencies from wall bounces and ball collisions, unlock new balls, and level up a skill tree to maximize your income.

demos.name: Hungry For Loot Demo
demos.short_description: A human made, story driven, turn-based RPG. You play as a party of 4 slimes who eat loot to power up their abilities. Distribute your loot among the slimes for maximum effect. Balance combat needs with sending loot back to complete quests.

demos.name: Legacy of Sail Demo
demos.short_description: As a 17th Century Admiral, send your squadrons out to capture enemy towns and sink their ships. Force boarding actions to capture their prized Ships of the Line all while balancing the need for supplies, repairs and upgrading your crew in this throwback real time tactics naval combat game

demos.name: 嘿，牛马！ Demo
demos.short_description:
这是一款反乌托邦黑色幽默节奏游戏。
你扮演小马，一名初入牧原集团的“牛马”员工。脖子上戴着“幸福项圈”，头顶是电子牧长永恒的微笑，面前是灰绿色的营养糊。
你没有选择。你只能——跟着节拍，活下去。

demos.name: Choo Choo Defenders Demo
demos.short_description: Build your track, assemble your train and deliver cargo and carnage in equal amounts in this on-the-rails take on tower defense! This demo lets you play the first world as much as you'd like!

demos.name: Beat Vector Demo
demos.short_description: A 360° Rhythm Game where smashing beats makes the world explode with effects. Transform every track into a massive light show!

demos.name: Almarti: Trade in the Woods Demo
Flame Hunter: Zhong Kui Demo
demos.short_description:
Become Zhong Kui, the legendary demon hunter! 

Hack and slash through hordes of monsters. Morph into your foes and turn their own powers against them. Journey across a supernatural world of ancient magic to uncover the secrets of the Underworld in this myth inspired ARPG.

demos.name: UnderMire Demo
demos.short_description: Explore, fight, and SMUSH in this hand-drawn roguelite first person adventure! Descend a magical bunker filled with wild biomes, master magical tools, manage your fear gauge, overcome hazards, combat spooky enemies, and cause co-op chaos.

demos.name: Typomagical Demo
demos.short_description:
Combine words to cast spells!
Typomagical is a spell-casting roguelike with a twist: create and cast spells by typing incantations!
Spells and the elements are at your fingertips, literally -- creative synergies are the key to victory!

demos.name: EON Survivor Demo
demos.short_description: Battle relentless alien swarms, complete dynamic missions, gather valuable resources, and forge devastating builds in this fast-paced space survivor.

demos.name: Moony Mayhem: Cheeks Unleashed Demo
demos.short_description: You are randomly assigned “Civic Disturbance Duty” and must complete tasks using the power of your butt. Demo includes the first area consisting of 8 tasks to be completed and 3 Golden Cheeks to be collected.

demos.name: Pit Wizard Demo
demos.short_description: Pit Wizard is a short top-down shooter with incremental progression where you play as a wizard custodian. Jump into magical pits, clean up hordes of dangerous enemies, and mine rare resources while developing two massive skill trees.

demos.name: Foxy The First Steps Demo
demos.short_description: Foxy is a precision platformer focused on timing and control. Master pressure-based jumps, clear 20 demo levels, and chain crystal combos. Prove your skills, uncover a mysterious story, and reach the portal. This is a DEMO version.

demos.name: Fossilfuel 3 Demo
demos.short_description: Jump straight into the horror as you fight through a secret Soviet underground base overrun with flesh-eating dinosaurs!

demos.name: Blacksmith Idle Demo
demos.short_description: Blacksmith Idle Demo is a chill idle game where you manage your own workshop, unlock new items, watch your inventory and buy upgrades. Chase the BIG numbers.

demos.name: The Machine Stops Demo
demos.short_description: Make everyone obsolete with AI by managing resources on a Matrix-style interface. You have one year to strategize resource allocation, unlock new layers of growth, and keep an accelerating company from collapsing under its own scale.

demos.name: Lapistasia Demo
demos.short_description:
3-min learn, 100-hour addiction!
Lapistasia is an 8x8 grid, deck-building roguelike inspired by Balatro.
The rule is simple: clear blocks. But with unique block traits and 150+ relics blending into broken synergies, strategy is limitless!
Build your deck and unleash hyper-inflation damage!

demos.name: Aircraft Dispatcher: Ground Operations Demo
demos.short_description: Take control of airline operations from the ground up. Flights depend on your judgment — from managing aircraft, equipment, and maintenance schedules to overseeing ground crews, tugs, and marshals. Coordinate taxiway movements and ensure every aircraft reaches its gate or runway safely and on time.

demos.name: The Trials - Chapter Two Demo
demos.short_description: The Demo for The Trials - Chapter Two is its own self-contained story which is a prequel to Chapter Two, containing the same features found in the main game.

demos.name: Contract Cooks Demo
demos.short_description: We're a staffing agency. We send cooks to kitchens. The cooks are you. Today, a coffee shop on the high street. Tomorrow, a suburban one in a heatwave where everyone suddenly wants ice. Contract Cooks is a co-op cooking roguelite where you go where the agency sends you and try not to get fired.

demos.name: HOLER! Demo
demos.short_description:
Dig, dig, and DIG!
Plunge into an endless underground world in this relentless mining action game!
Break your "Best Record" in an eternal challenge against your past self!

*Screenshots feature the Full Version. 4-player local multiplayer is exclusive to the Full Version

demos.name: Incremental Retro Racing Demo
demos.short_description: Earn more and more stars by driving faster and faster in Incremental Retro Racing. Accumulate and unlock 70+ vehicles, upgrades, track generation options, and more. Includes unlimited tracks and customizable CRT filter for that old school retro feel.

demos.name: Jarred Defense Demo
demos.short_description: A difficult maze-building tower defense. Protect the kitty from evil robots and endure its unhelpful comments. Force enemies the long way around, push them through lava, and adapt as levels change beneath you. No spells, no card modifiers. A love letter to Warcraft III custom maps and Flash games.

demos.name: Subsomnia Demo
demos.short_description: Explore an ever-changing dream universe in this 2.5D action roguelite. Wield your slingshot, solve physics-based ricochet puzzles, and traverse procedural worlds. Every magical object is a gateway to a new dream: will you reach the source?

demos.name: Surviving Day! Demo
demos.short_description: Jump into an endless voxel world adventure. Mine for ores and cut down trees, marvel at your own creations that can be wired with computers and more! Enjoy the wild life and fend off bears that turn aggravated near by! Dragons and the rare velociraptor are also known to lurk in the world.

demos.name: FlockSol Demo
demos.short_description: FlockSol is an incremental top-down survival game. Light up the dark and defeat the monsters hiding inside. Spend their essences to unlock and upgrade your skills. Summon your past souls to fight alongside you. Reach your full potential, survive the night and cleanse the world of darkness.

demos.name: The Gas Station : Graveyard Shift Demo
Bubble Balance Bonanza Demo
demos.short_description:
Roll, bump, jump, and crash your way through this fast-paced, marble style, physics-driven platformer. With fun environments, cute characters and crazy obstacles to overcome, you'll need to keep your balance to complete the journey!

 Are YOU ready for the bonanza?

demos.name: Rush Hour Relay Demo
demos.short_description:
Run your grandfather’s delivery company. His old partner, Sterling, wants it back.

Build routes, manage drivers and fuel, keep stock fresh, and climb from Rank 50 to Rank 1 in a city dominated by corporate chains.

demos.name: Drained Creatures Demo
demos.short_description: Drained Creatures is a multiplayer 3D arena brawler for up to 8 players locally, playable using gamepads only.

demos.name: CyberSushi Demo
demos.short_description: Play a focused slice of CyberSushi: a fast arcade roguelite where tiny sushi heroes race through collapsing dimensions, chain streaks, fill Sushi Surge, choose run-bending Sushi Hacks, and chase one more impossible run.

demos.name: One More Core Demo
demos.short_description: One More Core is a 3D incremental game where you carve through planets layer by layer with your flagship, gather resources, upgrade your fleet, and keep advancing until you capture the planet's core. Don't forget to refuel… there's one more core to go!

demos.name: Hug Factory Demo
demos.short_description: Hug people to generate electricity to sell for money to upgrade your hugging skills to hug people to generate electricity to sell for money to upgrade your hugging skills to hug people to generate electricity to sell for money to upgrade your hugging skills to hug people to generate...

demos.name: Market Chain 98 Demo
demos.short_description: Build your Market Chain in this retro incremental game set inside a nostalgic 90s operating system. Start with a small shop, manage bank loans, expand your logistics hubs, and unlock global upgrades through your Portfolio. Fill your desktop with windows and dominate the market!

demos.name: Galactic Bounty Demo
demos.short_description: Take on contract missions in this free first-person sci-fi bounty-hunting demo. Blast rogue droids and pirates, upgrade your gear and get a taste of Galactic Bounty’s intense action.

demos.name: Dark Fantasia Demo
demos.short_description:
Crush the armies of darkness and rise to divine power.
Your goal is the fortress where the Great Demon awaits.
But remember - you are not immortal. Dodge enemy attacks, find new weapons and perks - only then will you survive.

demos.name: Booty Demo
demos.short_description: Booty's a swashbuckling, arcade-y 2D platformer game with Rocket Jumping at its core! Aim, charge, jump, shoot and fly across many islands! Loot treasure, blast enemies and climb to the top! Destroy blocks, speedrun through stages, increase your bounty and unlock gameplay-altering curses! Demo Ver!

demos.name: Grandma's Golden Boy: Sheep Shear Madness Demo
demos.short_description: Get a sneak peek at the beginning of your future adventure! Try shearing different types of sheep, unlock upgrades, and build a cool spinning wheel in this free demo.

demos.name: RogueBlocks Demo
demos.short_description: Stack rows, unleash powerful combos, and survive Chaos that rewrites the rules—solo or with friends—in this comic-inspired roguelite puzzle adventure.

demos.name: The Belt Demo
demos.short_description: A hardcore precision platformer built around a relentless moving conveyor belt. Master unlockable movement stances, adapt to escalating traps, and survive a brutal mechanical gauntlet where every mistake matters.

demos.name: MechShell Demo
demos.short_description: Pilot S.H.E.L.L., a weaponized snail mechsuit, and defend the Overgrown Realms. Customize your shell, and squad up in 4-player co-op side-scrolling combat. Activate Battlefield Clarity to shift into first-person warfare.

demos.name: Tokamak Hand Demo
demos.short_description: Tokamak Hand is a turn-based monster-taming RPG. Confine wild Thermons within fields, forge bonds of resonance, master diverse builds and battle across a continent teetering on the edge of imbalance. Every capture tips the scales—will you restore order, or unleash chaos?

demos.name: GAP OR DIE Demo
demos.short_description:
There’s only one rule: make the jump.
Push your speed, commit to the gap, and survive as long as you can in this high-risk endless racing game.
Upgrade your ride, and see how far you can go before everything goes horribly wrong.

demos.name: South of the March Demo
demos.short_description: South of the March is an RPG that combines visual novel exploration with turn-based combat in a hand-drawn dark fantasy world. Meet the locals and unravel a mystery, equip your party for the dangers ahead, and set out into the unforgiving wilderness.

demos.name: Picky Numbers Demo
demos.short_description: Picky Numbers is a calm incremental/idle game based on lottery mechanics. Buy tickets, choose numbers, and watch as the drum draws results one by one. The more numbers you hit, the bigger the payout. Each ticket is a different strategy, with higher risk and higher reward, or a JACKPOT.

demos.name: Farming & Supermarket: Clicker Demo
demos.short_description: Click, harvest, and sell! In this cozy pixel-art clicker game, tap to grow 7 unique crops on the left and manage your custom shop layout on the right. Upgrade your Click Power and hand size to build your ultimate chill farming market empire!

demos.name: Pipplop's Tiny Adventure Demo
demos.short_description: A compact precision-puzzle platformer where you enter circles to launch Pipplop and solve miniature stages involving movement puzzles.

demos.name: Spaceman's Luck Demo
demos.short_description: A space 4X game. Colonize planets and annihilate enemy races in an intergalactic war for living space. Designed to be fun, fast, and easy to play.

demos.name: Rail Estate Demo
demos.short_description: Outbid your rivals in auctions for key railway routes, build and upgrade your tracks to dominate the rail economy. Compete to create the most profitable network, balancing speed, capacity, and maintenance in a dynamic simulation

demos.name: Just A Gun Demo
demos.short_description: Just A Gun is an incremental point-and-click shooter where you evolve a single weapon through a massive upgrade tree.

demos.name: Runerock Arena Demo
demos.short_description: Forge a lasting dynasty across a Gladiator League of Runerock in this turn-based strategy game with RPG aspects. Hire your team, outfit them with equipment and spells, then lead them into tactical combat. Guide careers from raw recruits to seasoned legends, training new successors for arena glory.

demos.name: Barbarian Lands Demo
demos.short_description: Barbarian Lands is a challenge hardcore, single-player ARPG set in a barbarian open world. The game features fast-paced combat with a lot of different weapons, exploration to find anything, horizontal and vertical, an unique risk/reward progression system, epic loots and dungeons a dangerous world.

demos.name: Directors cut: Train Demo
demos.short_description: Demo version of Directors Cut: Train

demos.name: Decline Demo
demos.short_description: Welcome to your new night shift inside an abandoned underground drainage facility, you should handle the power problems nobody else wants to deal with. Your main task is simple: monitor the security cameras, manage your limited electricity, and survive until dawn. But don't HIDE, they see you.

demos.name: Shepherd Demo
demos.short_description: Shepherd is a survival horror game where you must identify invisible entities using audio and visual cues. Protect your passengers, keep your ears open, and if all else fails...trust your gut.

demos.name: Spin Tactics Demo
demos.short_description: The full loop of Spin Tactics in one run: three encounters, then a boss. Everything on the board is yours to change, and what you build with what drops is the whole game.

demos.name: Beyond Yardwork Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Head out on your first job and transform a neglected garden. Start up the mower, grab the blower to clear leaves from the paths, and blast the dirty driveway with a pressure washer. Tackle wild weeds, sort the remaining trash, and feel the ultimate satisfaction of perfect order.

demos.name: Lofi Cozy Room Demo
demos.short_description: A transparent mini-room in a corner of your desktop and gentle Lo-Fi music to make your work time cozier. Try every feature of Lofi Cozy Room ahead of launch with the demo.

demos.name: Heroes of Lust and Magic Demo
demos.short_description: A fantasy idle RPG where desire powers the world. Recruit dangerous companions, cross fractured realms, outmaneuver rival factions, and uncover the truth behind the vanished goddess Amura.

demos.name: Tidy Up Demo
demos.short_description: A peaceful cleaning and organizing game where you explore different locations, collect trash, clean stains, and arrange items to turn mess into perfection.

demos.name: Orb Breaker Demo
demos.short_description: A minimalist Bullet Hell. Shoot bouncing orbs at enemies, buy upgrades, and embrace the chaos!

demos.name: ANONYMIZED Demo
demos.short_description: Play as a digital rat and hack your way into the retro-futuristic grid-based movement puzzle world of Anonymized, where you shift hues and dive layers deep in search of the one true Source Cheese.

demos.name: Idle Isekai Mining Demo
demos.short_description: An Idle mining game where your workers keep mining even when you're away! Hire workers, collect manager waifus to automate your mines and boost production. Dig deeper, build and upgrade your mine shafts to earn more gold. Pump those numbers up!

demos.name: Watamari Part2 - A Fake Marriage? Demo
demos.short_description: This is a yuri game where you as an angel of love must help guide the heroines. Do your best, little angel (you) and take care of your mistress's wellbeing!

demos.name: Spud Keeper Demo
demos.short_description: Pick up and smash bugs, upgrade your tools to protect your potato patch from escalating waves of pests!

demos.name: The Looking Glass Wars: House of Cards Demo
Rabbit Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Rabbit Simulator is an Action Adventure game with a strong emphasis on gun violence.

demos.name: Grapixo Arte em Guerra Demo
demos.short_description: Scratch in a 2.5D world that blends hip hop aesthetics with action/platforming, where urban art has come to life. Explore dynamic environments, face cleaning robots, and uncover secrets of this vibrant world as you reclaim your identity in this intense and colorful adventure.

demos.name: XiaoLuo's English War Demo
demos.short_description: The town is collapsing! A demonic legion is closing in, and its survival is in your hands. Words are your bullets, and typing speed is your life. Type accurately to unleash lethal skills against waves of enemies. Grab your keyboard and fight to master English and survive!

demos.name: Rune Tavern Demo
demos.short_description: This is an asynchronous PVP auto chess game. Arrange your runes and components, use energy transfer to activate as many rune skills as possible, and build a powerful lineup! In the face of randomly matched opponents, be the first to smash the enemy's elemental blocks and win more!

demos.name: Meow Time: cozy cat room Demo
50 Years Classic Demo
demos.short_description: 50 Years Classic is a minimalist turn-based strategy game where you can choose from a variety of nations, each with its own unique feature. The game offers fast, engaging gameplay with high replayability. This is a demo version.

demos.name: Outta Space Demo
demos.short_description: Where is your cat flying right now? Outta Space is an idle game where a tiny cat explores the universe from your desktop corner. Every keystroke, every click fuels the spaceship. From the Moon, past the solar system, to distant stars. Come back and see how far your lovely cat has gone.

demos.name: Just Keep Defending And Mining Demo
demos.short_description: Just Keep Defending And Mining is a unique incremental game that combines combat and resource gathering. Balance mining and survival, invest into upgrades, grow stronger every round, unlock new regions, and Just Keep Defending and Mining.

highlights.trailer_name: Just Keep Defending And Mining Demo Trailer

demos.name: Gamble Inc. Demo
demos.short_description: Tired of making money for your corporate overlords while you get paid peanuts? Hack into your work computer and syphon cash straight from the slots and into your bank. In this corporate dystopia jobs have been reduced to betting all you've got and letting the house (your boss) win.

demos.name: Aisle Survive Demo
demos.short_description: Aisle Survive is a 2D roguelite retail horror. Manage your stress, maintain your hydration and don't miss your bathroom breaks. Survive your notice period while fulfilling all the tasks required of you. Keep customers at bay with your breadstick.

demos.name: 天机•大唐重构 Demo
demos.short_description: “STIANJI: TANG RECONSTRUCTION” is a 2D side-view deckbuilding rogue-like set in an alternate late Tang Dynasty. Play as a modern science student, build Physics and Chemistry decks, break enemy armor, read hidden intents, and reshape the fate of Tang.

demos.name: Can I Take Your Order Demo
Flakeparty Demo
demos.short_description: Scoop, position and score cereals to gain enough points in this relaxing, rogue-like deck-builder. Collect quirky cereals with unique effects, use them to play the rule-twisting minigames to gain special toys,buy upgrades to increase your chances and reach the final extra difficult boss round!

demos.name: Hoverise Rebellion Demo
demos.short_description: Pilot a fast and agile HoverTank in a sci-fi vehicular arena shooter focused on high-speed movement, explosive combat, abilities, and classic multiplayer modes.

demos.name: The Heart of Gold Demo
demos.short_description: The Heart of Gold: Demo is an Hybrid Bullet Heaven-JRPG game, where each character is unique thanks to their own abilities, progression, and combat style. Upgrade your equipment, evolve your weapons, collect cards, and survive hordes of enemies in a colorful world full of secrets and challenges.

highlights.trailer_name: The Heart Of Gold Demo: 1.1.1 Update.

demos.name: Blosharper: Battle of Blossoms Demo
demos.short_description: Blosharper is a card-shark noir roguelike deckbuilder: forge Korean Hwatu card combos to smash each round's target score. Don't rely on luck—use illicit "cheat" skills to rig the deck and survive a deadly underground gambling den. Pay off your debt, defeat the bosses, become the ultimate sharp!

demos.name: Elemental Master: Heroes Assemble Demo
demos.short_description: A deep idle strategy game with extensive progression: heroes, promotions, arcane arts, gear, spirit beasts, talents, and runes. Create thousands of unique builds to form powerful teams! Experience adventure, team battles, and Demon Tide defense, and win easily with smart strategies!

demos.name: Sisyphus Conviction Demo
demos.short_description: Sisyphus Conviction is a Clicker Game about walking up Mountain, dragging a Rock from the Underworld. Based on the Greek Myth of the King Sisyphus who tried to defy Death. Now doomed for Eternity, join Sisyphus on this adventure with a Click, Upgrade, Repeat system.

highlights.trailer_name: Sisyphus Conviction Demo Trailer and First Look

demos.name: Slots & Sword & Magic Demo
demos.short_description: Slots & Sword & Magic is a turn-based roguelike slot machine game where every spin can break your build and trigger insane combo chains.

demos.name: Monkey Wave Demo
demos.short_description: Monkey Wave is a fast-paced action clicker where you defend your banana stash against waves of hostile apes. Click rapidly to defeat primates and epic bosses in solo, co-op, and PvP modes. Deploy strategic abilities and survive the chaos of the jungle.

demos.name: Kotoha’s Sealed Sword: Hiragana Deckbuilding Demo
demos.short_description: Learn and master Japanese with Kotoha! Join her as she goes on a mission to find her grandfather's sealed sword. Discover new creatures. Unlock and craft new words, add them to your hand to aid you in battle.

demos.name: The Sleepless Nights Origins Demo
demos.short_description:
A first-person psychological horror walking simulator. The same rain-soaked corporate street, looping. 
Notice what's wrong before it notices you back.

demos.name: I Need to Fix My Dream Car (But I Work at a Junkyard) Demo
The Server Demo
demos.short_description: A FULLY ENGLISH-VOICED otome mystery visual novel set in a fog-shrouded coastal town. Work as a waitress at an exclusive supper club, romance four men hiding dangerous secrets, and uncover the truth buried beneath. Every choice you make shapes your path and where it ends.

demos.name: fox girl next door demo
demos.short_description: Nika's life takes a sharp turn when an unusual girl named Rumi moves into the neighboring apartment. Is she the salvation Nika desperately needs, or the most dangerous encounter of her life?

demos.name: Bibidi Bibidi! Demo
demos.short_description: Bibidi Bibidi! is a wizardcore roguelike deckbuilder where you combine cards in your spellbook to cast unique and powerful spells. Crawl through twisting tunnels and fight maddening monsters to find the perfect build for your wizard. Every turn is a puzzle!

demos.name: Seekers Alliance: Hero's Journey Demo
demos.short_description: Seekers Alliance: Hero’s Journey is a roguelite deckbuilder where every run expands your strategic options. Recruit Heroes from 3 rival Factions, unlock Talents, upgrade Skill Cards, forge Artifacts, and master each Hero’s unique abilities to create powerful synergies as you uncover their stories.

highlights.trailer_name: Seekers Alliance: Hero's Journey Official Gameplay Trailer

other_trailers.trailer_name: Defying Fate | Seekers Alliance: Hero’s Journey Cinematic Trailer

demos.name: Astrobarian™ Demo
demos.short_description: Astrobarian™ is a 3D action RPG game where you and Cordina travel to different worlds — some cultivated, others filled with deadly hazards. Along the way, you may encounter others with different motives and unresolved mysteries.

demos.name: Frog It Up Demo
demos.short_description: Frogs, ponds, clicks, you now the vibe

demos.name: Spiritus Sancti Demo
demos.short_description: Spiritus Sancti is a first-person psychological horror where your voice is your weapon. Speak sacred rites through your microphone to repel, stun, and exorcise the forces of darkness. Every encounter is real-time, every word a test of faith. An experience like no other.

demos.name: Rick Henderson: Eternal Arena Demo
demos.short_description: Rick Henderson is back! Join the endless arena battle, upgrade your ship, upgrade your guns, upgrade your drones. Fight, upgrade, die, repeat.

demos.name: No Death In Wild West Demo
demos.short_description: Play as time travelers wiping out cowboys with high-tech weapons. Overcome brutal terrain against an unforgiving timer. Master unique heroes with different movement styles to conquer the Wild West.

demos.name: Draco and the Seven Scales Demo
demos.short_description: Set sail on a voyage full of pirates, dark magic, and the thrill of discovery! Draco and the Seven Scales is a retro-inspired adventure that harkens back to an age of top down dungeon crawlers and lovable, crunchy pixel art.

demos.name: Don't Get Fired! Demo
demos.short_description: The company is going under and corporate has made YOU the office manager. Turn things around quick or everyone's doomed. Run the office, keep employees productive, and avoid disasters. Muscle through the workday or automate the grind. Play solo or with friends — just Don't Get Fired!

demos.name: Grinding Guilds Demo
demos.short_description: Grinding Guilds mixes the loot hunt and character building from ARPGs, with the strategy elements of Auto Battlers. Pick your hero, level up, get loot and upgrade abilities. Hire allies for your guild, equip Pacts, position your units and find the best strategy to beat all bosses.

demos.name: Short Short Fictions Demo
demos.short_description: A short short mix tape of one story that connects three shorter stories. On the NewWave, a magical game console that is retro but new, enjoy DON'T SAY YES, TO:NORTH, and a secret tale nobody yet knows. Welcome to a slightly fantastical and nostalgic world of painful, toilful, and beautiful stories!

demos.name: Astra Bestiary Demo
demos.short_description: Raise Beasts from eggs into powerful Champions in this 2D monster-raising/taming RPG. Feed, train and evolve your partners to explore a perilous, non-linear world. Master fast-paced, tactical battles, uncover the secrets of a fading world and pass on the Beasts' legacy across generations.

demos.name: Drunk or Baby Demo
demos.short_description: A chaotic party game where 1-8 players guess whether bizarre real-life scenarios were caused by a drunk adult or a baby, using deduction, voting, and laughter to win.

demos.name: SwitchTrack Demo
demos.short_description: SwitchTrack is a coordination puzzle game! Time your inputs to control the tracks, and help direct the minecarts safely through each level.

demos.name: Omen Demo
demos.short_description: Infiltrate the remnants of a fallen empire, extract valuable loot, establish defenses against hostile fanatics, and unlock the gateway to a dimension of cosmic dread that defies comprehension.

demos.name: Press a Button Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Welcome to Press a Button Simulator: a new and exciting twist on modern video games. Gone is the time of tryhards and sweats, and in is the new age of only pressing a button! Will you find all the secrets? Of course not! There is only one: You get to press a button!

demos.name: MONSTOPIA Demo
demos.short_description: This is a casual detective game featuring interview simulation and "find the differences" gameplay. You will play as an ambitious young demon, determined to transform the dilapidated park into the most thrilling horror-themed attraction.

demos.name: 7 Days To Think About It DEMO
Escape the Beach: Chapter Zero
demos.short_description: A surreal first-person narrative experience. Walk along an endless tropical beach, encounter out-of-place artifacts and look for a way to escape while being guided by a soothing yet sarcastic voice who makes you ponder the meaning of your existence.

demos.name: Kill Through Demo
demos.short_description: Blast through endless zombie hordes in KillThrough, a 2D isometric pixel shooter! Manage limited ammo, use diverse weapons, and master strategic movement to survive. Experience fast-paced, retro combat filled with satisfying pixel gore. Your only goal: Kill Through!

demos.name: Stray Service Demo
demos.short_description: What's cheaper than cheap labor? Cats! Play as Tub and Bub - two very committed felines on the clock to bus tables, wash dishes, and mop up every mess before the restaurant goes under. Solo or with a friend, it's chaotic, it's frantic, and someone's definitely knocking over a stack of plates.

demos.name: Runeveil Demo
demos.short_description: Sequencer Roguelike. Enter the Arena as an elemental wizard, craft powerful rune chains, and break the game with wild artifact synergies. Beat all trials, defeat the Sin Kings, and ascend to godhood. Magic is chaos, order is power!

demos.name: Sumo Fumble: Physics Party Demo
demos.short_description: Sumo Fumble is a silly physics-based couch party game with procedurally self-balancing characters. Grab, heave, and throw your rivals into wild hazards, or pull their pants off for a laugh. Fumble, flail, and fall your way to victory in ever-changing arenas!

demos.name: Anti-Anti-Cheat: a musical action game Demo
demos.short_description: This is a demo version of musical action game where you need to dodge many enemy bullets appearing to the rhythm of music. Can you defeat Anti-Cheat?

demos.name: Hex Harmony Demo
demos.short_description: Restore the balance between Nature and Human using futuristic technologies. Each island is a true puzzle. Build thoughtfully, observe interactions, and shape a durable world in a calm and accessible experience.

demos.name: Origins Of Teco Demo
demos.short_description: Play as Teco, a charismatic one-eyed orange guy with laser beam powers! In this 2D platformer adventure, face hordes of purple creatures, gain experience, unlock new abilities, and uncover an engaging story as you fight to save the world.

demos.name: Reverse Survivors Demo
demos.short_description: A reversed survivors-like where you are sending waves of monster to stop the survivors.

demos.name: Star Scrap Demo
demos.short_description:
Fight endless waves in Star Scrap's free survival demo. Build wild card loadouts, battle a boss every 10 rounds, and rack up credits that carry into the full game.
~5 minute runs. Replayable forever. 🚀

demos.name: Sime Returns Demo
demos.short_description: Sime Returns Demo is a introduction to quirky, darkly comedic action-adventure about a fisherman, his cats, and the island that decided it no longer likes him. Rescue your cats from furious villagers, and unravel the mysteries lurking beneath the sunny shores of the Adriatic.

demos.name: Ouroboros Solitaire Demo
demos.short_description: Face scaling foes in this endless deck-builder! Its elegant rules let you play for free with a real deck. Steam automates shuffling and modulo 13 math. Now featuring poker-style "Hand Bonuses" for instant kills , enemy "Bribes" , and powerful "Special Cards"  for deeper strategy!

demos.name: Bifröst: Prelude to the Storm Demo
demos.short_description: This is the demo for Bifröst: Prelude to the Storm. Experience the first 4 chapters of an upcoming dystopian fantasy BL visual novel.

demos.name: Earthia Mining Demo
demos.short_description: Welcome to Earthia Mining Demo! The Wizard Intelligence hath usurped thy craft and stolen away thy livelihood! To the mines, wayfarer! In this demo you will begin your magical mining journey.

demos.name: Link Lab Demo
demos.short_description: Connections are all you need to succeed. Link objects together to share and mix traits to create the tools you need to solve each level. Be careful which resource you spend where though, as each one is single use and you might need that piece later!

demos.name: Cosmic Crusher Demo
demos.short_description: Incremental game about protecting solar system. Destroy asteroids with a huge arsenal of weapons, upgrade your skills through a massive skill tree, and defend the solar system from hostile alien fleets. How far can you go?

demos.name: Marbs: Deluxe Demo
demos.short_description: Marbs: Deluxe is a casual puzzle game where you link colourful Marbs to rack up huge combos, equip game-changing modifiers and score big! Give the demo a go with "Classic" mode and a limited "Deluxe" mode with 22 Marbifiers to play around with!

demos.name: Chat, Is This Real? Demo
demos.short_description: Chat is this Real? is a first-person psychological horror game. Play as a streamer in an abandoned hospital during a livestream. Uncover the hospital's dark past, follow the clues in the chat, and survive a nightmare that should have remained buried.

demos.name: Evergarden Demo
demos.short_description: Evergarden is a relaxing idle incremental about turning a tiny barren patch into a lush, living island. Restore tiles with your shovel, let workers gather resources, meet pets, and watch the ecosystem quietly spread on its own.

demos.name: Softboiled Demo
demos.short_description:
A challenging physics-based precision platformer about a fragile egg. 
Crafted for hardboiled players.

demos.name: MOLOKAUST Demo
demos.short_description: Venture into a cursed town in this ruthless first-person survival horror game. With a hyper-realistic atmosphere and extreme survival mechanics, you'll need to ration your inventory and confront your worst nightmares to save your wife and daughter.

demos.name: Tsuki Journey Demo
demos.short_description: A relaxing slice of life adventure game where Tsuki travels between beautiful cities, meets new friends, uncovers stories, and fills out collection logs at his own pace, combining cozy idle activities with short, meaningful bursts of progression.

demos.name: The Macro-Mines Demo
demos.short_description: This is the demo for The Macro-Mines, a rogue-lite platformer where the world is reigned by the rules of the iconic Minesweeper. In this demo, you can complete the tutorial and perhaps even the full game, if you are skillful enough.

demos.name: Factory Time Demo
demos.short_description: A factory automation incremental game at the end of the universe. Start crafting by hand, automate production, and build the Chronoforge to escape.

demos.name: Min5 Min - Party Edition Demo
demos.short_description: "Fast, competitive, and sugar-coated! Min5 Min is designed for those looking for intense action in a short amount of time. Equipped with a variety of characters and powerful weapons, you have a minimum of 5 minutes to survive in this stylized world!"

demos.name: The Blinking Room Demo
demos.short_description:
One night, young Lily wakes from a nightmare — unaware that her real nightmares are only just beginning.
Uncover the secrets hidden behind closed eyes.

demos.name: Pumpkin & Patch Demo
demos.short_description: The Pumpkin & Patch demo offers an introduction to the characters and basics of combat and movement. Master the Leeching Bark ability, deflecting projectiles, parrying enemies, and restoring health. See if you can defeat the first mini-boss, and first main boss of the game!

demos.name: Turn Back Now Demo
demos.short_description: You are Ross Chole, a young detective who responds to a routine call in a quarantined city on the brink of collapse. What begins as a simple investigation quickly spirals into a fight for survival as an unknown outbreak turns ordinary people into something monstrous.

demos.name: Nah, I'd Shotgun Demo
demos.short_description: Nah, I'd Shotgun is a tight hand drawn boss rush game where you fight demons in their special arenas , blast them away of existence , unlock more shotguns, and get good because otherwise you'll be humbled.

highlights.trailer_name: The Official Gameplay Trailer For Nah, I'd Shotgun Demo

demos.name: Ask Mom: Находи предметы, учи слова Demo
LEVATE Demo
demos.short_description:
A short atmospheric visual novel about a teenager who tries to hide from his thoughts and problems. 
But the longer he avoids reality, the more it distorts around him.

demos.name: Ground Floor Demo
demos.short_description: Len Chandler is trapped in an elevator, navigating strange floors filled with the fragmented conversations and unresolved problems of his colleagues, friends, and family. Can he piece together the storylines, mend relationships, and finally reach the Ground Floor?

demos.name: Astral Trial Demo
demos.short_description: This is a deck-building game (DBG) that emphasizes symmetrical strategy. Your enemies, like you, possess decks, energy, and relics. Optimize your strategy, build your deck, challenge powerful female bosses, and save the world from collapse.

demos.name: Abyss Horde Demo
demos.short_description: Darkness tears reality apart. Hordes of beasts, monsters, and abyssal demons surge from the depths—mindless, driven only by destruction. Adventurer, the line needs you! In 《Abyss Horde》, defend against ever-stronger waves. Every run builds a new defense; every upgrade shifts the tide.

demos.name: DwarfHold: Tokens & Towers Demo
demos.short_description:
Build and defend your dwarven settlement. 
Stack tokens to gather resources, create tools and build towers. Keep your dwarves fed with ginger beer, discover new crafting recipes, and fend off the animals attacking at night!

demos.name: Weapon Gambit Demo
demos.short_description: Roll your weapons, plan your every move! A bite-sized tactical puzzle blending dice and chess. Strategize your positioning with the rolled weapons to dismantle enemy defenses. Strike directly at the Monster Crystal before your turns run out!

demos.name: Ghost Buster:Village Demo
demos.short_description: An extreme blogger arrives in a village abandoned in a single day. He planned to spend the night, but soon realizes — this place is not empty. Rituals, entities from Slavic mythology, and the feeling of being watched… This demo is only a short glimpse.

demos.name: Fiefs & Trade Demo
demos.short_description:
Fiefs & Trade is a medieval sandbox game which focuses on trade, party and inventory management, combat and diplomacy. Hire companions to fight for you, herd animals to carry your goods and create trade routes to become the richest merchant the world has seen.
Or simply overpower everyone in battle.

demos.name: Taru's Infernal Pledge Demo
demos.short_description: A devilishly kinky story, in an epic dark medieval fantasy world. Please your demonic master's sexual appetites as his concubine and become his assassin. Explore consensual BDSM with an anointed cultist, embrace the God of Mercy's teachings, and find a way to save your soul from the abyss...

demos.name: Defenders of Ten Roads Crossing Tower Demo
demos.short_description: No lanes. No safe paths. Build fast or fall. Fight and adapt in real time as enemies attack from every direction. Control your hero, place towers on the fly, and shape the battlefield in this intense 1–4 player tower defense.

demos.name: Shape Survivors Demo
demos.short_description: Take on swarms of angry shapes in this free bullet-heaven demo. Combine 10 weapons and 10 items into powerful builds, battle the forest’s giant boss, and see how long you can survive.

demos.name: Stellar Fantasy World Demo
demos.short_description: When alien threats descend upon the planet, you embark on a grand adventure. Born from a massive stone, you know nothing of this world. During your open-world exploration, every corner of the land hides mysteries and pleasant surprises.

demos.name: United2030 Demo
demos.short_description: United2030 is a third-person 3D action game that takes you on a journey through the near-future world of 2030. A female character explores various maps. The game's appeal lies in being able to explore realistic forests, near-future fortresses, and futuristic cities.

demos.name: G.H.O.S.T. Ghost Hunt Ops Special Team Demo
demos.short_description: G.H.O.S.T. — a tactical co-op for 1-4 players. Your main objective: track the Ghost via anomalies and capture it before it collects 7 runes to open the portal. Use Devastators, secure torsional artifacts, and remember—you are there to stop the invasion, not to become its victim.

demos.name: Garden and a Goat Demo
demos.short_description: Garden and a Goat is a single-player animal collecting and ecosystem recovery game! You play as a friendly robot, eager to help a series of ecosystems in need. Clean up the environment, revive plants, and entice the local wildlife to return, unlocking ever more animals and decorations along the way!

demos.name: Spell Knight: Abyss Cleaver Demo
demos.short_description:
Descend into the dark abyss and wipe out endless hordes of monsters.
Wield powerful weapons as a magic knight and enjoy the thrill of rapid growth.

demos.name: Pathotaxia: PANDORA Demo
demos.short_description: Pathotaxia: PANDORA is an RPG Maker horror puzzle game where you explore Pathotaxia's setting, interact with strange characters, and view visual novel-like cgs as you progress through the game. Help Pandora as she seals demons back into her dolls and unravels the mystery behind her mother's death.

demos.name: 最后的营地：曙光 Demo
developers: Hangzhou Digital Source Polar Technology Co., Ltd.
demos.short_description: ‘The Last Camp’ is a post-apocalyptic world-themed game. Utilizing high-quality graphics, a rich weapon and item system, and a vast world map, it delivers a cross-generational twin-stick shooter experience, offering a feast for hardcore shooter enthusiasts.

demos.name: 分裂细胞 (Cells of Division) Demo
OverRead Demo
demos.short_description: Consume text at the speed of thought. OverRead is an experimental R.S.V.P. reading utility that eliminates eye fatigue by flashing words directly into your focal center. Import your own TXT and PDF files, customize your optical link, and reach a literal reading flow state.

demos.name: When the Stars Threw Down Their Spears Demo
demos.short_description: When the Stars Threw Down Their Spears is a story-driven, retro space shooter inspired by DOS-era space games like Star Control, Solar Winds, and Lightspeed. Blast your way through fast-paced arcade combat; build out modular, upgradable ships; and explore a galaxy torn by war.

demos.name: FEED THE AI Demo
demos.short_description:
Feed the AI. Collect data. Unlock upgrades. Watch the algorithm grow beyond your control.
An active incremental where you feed an evolving AI with data and shape what it becomes.
Will it save the world… or take it over?

demos.name: Kamikaze Survivors Demo
demos.short_description: Survive waves of kamikaze attackers as battleships from the World Wars of last century to the present in this turret-based Roguelite. Gain equipment from underway replenishment and pick up admirals from history to increase the power of your ship.

demos.name: Gravity Whipped Demo
demos.short_description: Use the incredible power of the Gravity Whip to alter the direction of gravity and whip your way through the mysterious Maze of Dreams in this exciting 2.5D Puzzle Platformer. Jump over spike pits and collect coins and gems to upgrade your character and unlock secret levels. How far will you go?

demos.name: 邪祟Evil thing Demo
demos.short_description: Deep in the mountains stands a dying fox shrine. As a new shaman with a spiritual bond to immortals, you're now its guardian. But this temple is no sanctuary—corruption spreads, dark forces watch. Can you survive each night in this cursed land?

demos.name: S.A.N.D.Y. - Beach Cleaner Demo
demos.short_description:
This is a cozy, narrative and dark game in which you clean oil off the beach, sort out trash and rescue animals.
Relaxing cleanup in a post-apocalyptic world.

demos.name: Unknown Operations : The Habitus Demo
demos.short_description: Experience a story-driven WWII FPS. As Eduard Pěnkava, explore the Habitus base and travel to Europen to destroy German tanks. The demo includes one mission, two levels, and the core gameplay features of the full game.

demos.name: Kioskeria: Summer Breeze! Demo
demos.short_description: Run and manage your own cooking kiosk business. Serve customers, earn money, buy new equipment, and expand your menu. Customize your kiosk, design your own menu, and choose your location, whether on the beach, in the city, or in a park. NOTE: No AI used anywhere in this game.

demos.name: Starfish ROOM: DEFEND THE ROOMS Demo
demos.short_description: In a world colonized by aliens, Kibo Wave has been chosen to fight various aliens, kill monsters, collect cards, and speedrun in seconds in an eternal loop in a 2D musou roguelite sci-fi queer game.

highlights.trailer_name: Starfish ROOM DEFEND THE ROOMS - OFFICIAL TRAILER

demos.name: Car Factory Tycoon Demo
demos.short_description: Build cars step-by-step in a factory sim. Design vehicles, build your garage layout, hire and train workers, manage parking inventory, and sell cars through customer orders or walk-in buyers as you expand your operation.

demos.name: Kvga Demo
demos.short_description: Fast-paced card battler with fighting game DNA. Build decks, chain Kombos, and dominate the tournament!

demos.name: 逐末之地：60s Exploring the Endless Land：60s Demo
Make'Em Mayhem Demo
demos.short_description:
Make’Em Mayhem blends autobattler and roguelike elements where every run is a deadly spectacle. Thrown into the King’s Royal Cup, you must summon heroes across the multiverse.
Gamble, wager in the black market, hunt prisoners, and survive brutal trials. 
Win the Cup to find the truth to the mayhem.

demos.name: InfinityMine Demo
demos.short_description: No enemies—debt and a volatile ore market are your true foes. Mine a dungeon that changes every day. Drop to 0 HP and you lose the day’s mined ore. Upgrade tools, manage carry limits, time sales, and descend to the deepest layer.

demos.name: 持镣铐者#735 Demo
demos.short_description: 《The Shackles Holder #735》 is a female-oriented text-based game set in a steampunk world. On November 30, 1875, Police Chief Temis, known for his 100% case clearance rate, was transferred to the crime-ridden city of Nineveh.

demos.name: Junkyard Stories: Rebirth Demo
demos.short_description: A dystopian sci-fi adventure where you're a broken robot carrying the consciousness of a legendary hacker. Cross landscapes shaped by war, scavenge supplies, hack systems and solve puzzles as your battery drains. Infiltrate Block-07 to find the person who can save your mind before it’s lost forever.

demos.name: till death ROLLS us apart Demo
demos.short_description: "till death ROLLS us apart" is a roguelike dice battler where you collect new dice, stack powerful modifiers, and unleash huge combos in stylish, fast-paced duels.

demos.name: DIMENSIONAL PROJECT Demo
demos.short_description: Travel to multiple completely unique dimensions, gather their unique natural resources, build new structures and buildings, craft high-level materials, and automate everything. In doing so, you will be able to complete your ultimate goal: constructing the "Dimensional Engine".

demos.name: Arc Salvo Demo
demos.short_description: Arc Salvo is a fast-paced online turn-based artillery game featuring explosive team battles, a growing arsenal, and deep character customization.

demos.name: Backpack Dungeon Demo
demos.short_description: A unique pixel-art backpack management roguelike. Your backpack isn't just storage—it's your combat core. Item placement, adjacency, and trigger mechanics determine your survival in the dungeon. A mental challenge of spatial planning and strategy.

demos.name: Gambition Demo
demos.short_description: A chess-inspired tactical roguelike where every battle becomes a puzzle of sacrifice and manipulation. Evolve chess pieces, build powerful armies, and turn clever sacrifices into devastating synergies.

demos.name: PathoBLASTA RK Demo
demos.short_description: Immerse yourself in this Shoot 'Em Up 80s Style Arcade game with unique Graphics & Sound. Shoot waves of virus, protect the Containment Wall, don't let the virus through. Demo is a slice of Level 1 with dual shot power up, enemy Viruses of different types, a Mini Boss and animated Game Over Screen.

highlights.trailer_name: PathoBLASTA RK Demo Trailer Game Play

demos.name: Model Kit Shop Simulator: Demo
demos.short_description: Run your own hobby shop in this first-person store management demo. Order stock, fill shelves, set prices, match kits with paints through the Hobby Basket System, and let customers assemble their projects at Build Tables.

demos.name: Stuck with my Ex's Family and ZOMBIES!? Demo
Net Gains Demo
demos.short_description: A fishing roguelite about drafting your gear and paying off your debt before the Loan Shark eats you.

demos.name: Stinky Cat Demo
demos.short_description: Kidnapped in Cyber Space with a High-tech toilet plunger on his head, Stinky Cat needs your help! In this cozy puzzle game combining Sokoban with Bomberman, you must plan your moves to push crates, set off explosives to clear paths. Outsmart the evil Fox, and blast your way back to reality!

highlights.trailer_name: Intro-how Stinky Cat starts his journey.

demos.name: Colorful Slots Demo
demos.short_description: Colorful Slots is a short incremental game where you play slot machines to achieve increasingly higher scores.

demos.name: 不吃鱼 DonEatFish Demo
demos.short_description: A cozy cat on your desktop while you goof off. Idle fish, crack chests, dress up—turn your desk corner into a wholesome little nook. Come adopt an adorable kitty.

demos.name: SUITE:The Automated Card Engine Demo
demos.short_description: SUITE: Automated Card Engine is a poker roguelike game. Run countless workshops, wield broken cards and bizarre Jokers, create dozens of unique poker hands, and earn chips on your way to becoming unbelievably rich.

demos.name: SunWars Demo
demos.short_description:
Over 500,000 players on mobile!
Sun Wars is a real-time strategy game set in a galactic war between suns. Build and boost your solar system, attack enemy suns, avoid deadly black holes, and manage energy wisely. Only smart tactics and strategy will let you survive and win the war.

demos.name: Minesweep Together Demo
demos.short_description: Did you know you can play multiplayer minesweeper with a mouse for each player? With "Minesweep Together", attach up to 4 mice and play with family and friends! Enjoy Co-Op and 2 Player versus modes in this demo.

demos.name: The Mansion Of Whispering Desires Demo
demos.short_description: Perform a forbidden ritual of ecstasy to resurrect your lost love in this supernatural mystery visual novel.

demos.name: 交叠之夏 Demo
demos.short_description: This demo is a trial version of the visual novel game "Overlapping Summer" developed by Link Interactive Studio. It includes the prologue and the first chapter. The player will play the role of a high school student, where summer overlaps, telling a beautiful story of redemption and love.

demos.name: Reborn Demo
demos.short_description: A psychological horror and adventure story demo featuring fragmented memories, gameplay choices, and test scenarios. Experience the tone, themes, and decision-driven structure of Reborn without revealing the full story.

demos.name: Chromascape Demo
demos.short_description: Step into a gentle, hand-drawn world in Chromascape. As Luna the hedgehog, you hold the power to absorb and share colors in a land fading into gray. Use warm hues to light fires, cool tones to freeze paths, and restore vibrancy to this heartwarming 2D adventure.

demos.name: Ancient Adventure Demo
demos.short_description: Venture forth!  Evil has taken over the world.  Equip your Weapon of Choice and venture forth.  Journey out into the world to avenge your predecessors. Survive the hordes of monsters, seek out to extinguish the source of all Evil, so that one day, your people may finally live in peace.

demos.name: Empyrean Defense Demo
demos.short_description: A fast paced modern warfare tower defense game where you build, upgrade, and customize defenses to repel a relentless enemy invasion. Unlock powerful skills and abilities, craft advanced ammunition, and gather resources directly on the battlefield to outmaneuver and outlast the enemy.

demos.name: Tidal Break Demo
demos.short_description: A discovery puzzle roguelite demo. Combine elemental fish to unlock new elements and uncover the first secrets of an abandoned island before the tide resets everything.

demos.name: Gods & Gore Demo
demos.short_description: Play as a god defending your city in this roguelike tower defense game. Choose the best cards, expand your city, defend with godly powers, and collect mythological creatures to aid you.

demos.name: Barely Alive Demo
demos.short_description: A co-op survival party game. Hunt your friends or survive until sunrise.

demos.name: Dark Cards of Candlewood Demo
demos.short_description: A solo collectible card game with the soul of a classic JRPG. Embark on replayable dungeon runs with deceptively deep, two-choice card combat. Draft items for your backpack, master chain attacks, and even crack a few card packs...then save the world from eternal darkness!

demos.name: The 9th Seraph Demo
demos.short_description: An upcoming story-driven dark fantasy RPG. Journey across the Jophinian Isles and battle wild elemental beasts in your search for humanity's last hope -- the individual known as the Seraph.

demos.name: Giant Enemy Robot Crabs Demo
demos.short_description: Crush the countless crabs while blasting your way through the cancer zone!

demos.name: Where We Used to Play Demo
demos.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game with a retro aesthetic focused on observation. Explore a familiar house, detect subtle anomalies, and decide whether to move forward or turn back to survive a haunting time loop.

demos.name: Hamayumishi ～Night Parade of a Hundred Yokai～Demo
Extinction Zone Demo
demos.short_description: EXTINCTION ZONE is a zombie themed combat action survival game with 2D pixel art environments, puzzles to solve and a conspiracy to unravel.

demos.name: Star Fire Demo
demos.short_description: STAR FIRE is a fast-paced，hand-drawn 2D boss rush bullet hell. Play as Eira, a stray catgirl driven by a long-lost promise, deep into the Astral Disc. Dash, jump, and weave through dense bullet patterns in stylish duels to defeat Guardians and soothe their unresolved regrets.

demos.name: In Full Bloom Demo
demos.short_description: Feed and raise your little baby. Watch it grow and feed on every and anything. In Full Bloom is a Tamagotchi inspired Katamari-like about a creature with never-ending hunger for anything around it. There is only one way.

demos.name: God Shot Demo
demos.short_description: God Shot is a collection of violent party games, one lethal rule that failure is fatal. Get your friends together and risk it all to show your life is the only one that matters. Don't expect to survive.

demos.name: Carol and the Bells: A Cozy Strategy Game Demo
Terrafarmer Demo
demos.short_description: A roguelite farming strategy game where every tile matters. Choose from randomly offered polyomino crop tiles, arrange them for powerful synergies, and terraform a dead planet before your debt catches up.

demos.name: Shroomveil Demo
demos.short_description: Shroomveil is a real-time combat, Action RPG, with character progression, skills, and gear upgrades. Set in a magical, mushroom-filled world full of danger and discovery, you'll explore a beautiful fantasy land, find and defend villages, equip warriors, clear dungeons, defeat bosses, and bring peace

demos.name: Shipyard of Theseus Demo
demos.short_description: A game about thinking about ships

demos.name: The Chosen Jinx Demo
demos.short_description: Lance, an extremely unlucky office worker, is pushed to his limits—until a truck hits him while crossing the street. He should have died or woken in a hospital, but instead awakens aboard a cruise ship. Explore, survive tense chases, collect clues, and uncover the truth of why he is here.

demos.name: Heatspire Demo
demos.short_description: Chain-building roguelike where you deal damage by lining up magic chips in a row. Fight drunk ogres and loud knights, stack run-defining charms, drink powerful brews, and push your luck for devastating combos.

demos.name: Fenestra Demo
demos.short_description: A fusion of semi-turn-based battles and roguelike mechanics. Build a party of heroes, explore randomly generated dungeons, discover powerful builds, and encounter strange creatures as you fight your way through the dungeon. Plan ahead and adapt to your surroundings, or meet your inevitable end.

demos.name: SnekromancY Demo
demos.short_description: Slither through a maze-like dungeon, devouring enemies and gobbling up treasure to summon an unstoppable horde in this twist on a classic.

demos.name: Last State Demo
demos.short_description:
Last State is a hardcore text-based wilderness survival sim where bad planning kills your run. Hunt, craft, build shelter and manage hunger, thirst, warmth, fatigue and disease in a procedural post-collapse world. Play the 60-minute demo 
and extend your run with smart survival decisions.

demos.name: Tiny Farm Big Money Together Demo
demos.short_description: Up to 2-player co-op, physics-based resource management and production game.

demos.name: Type Strike Demo
demos.short_description: Aim for simultaneous strikes, chain massive combos, and compete for top scores and high ranks in this fast-paced, reflex-driven strategy challenge. Juggle multiple agents, make split-second decisions, and master timing to stay ahead—every move counts in this thrilling test of skill and strategy.

demos.name: The Postman Cometh Demo
demos.short_description: Deliver mail in a strange little town in the middle of nowhere. Meet a colorful cast of villagers as you try to figure out what happened to the previous postman.

other_trailers.trailer_name: The Postman Cometh – Official Announcement Trailer

demos.name: Runic Winds Demo
demos.short_description: Runic Winds is a top-down action RPG about mastering rune magic through deliberate combat, exploration, and atmospheric dungeon crawling.

demos.name: Sophia's Path Demo
demos.short_description: Set out on an enchanting, turn-based puzzle adventure as Sophia, a brave young girl guided by a mysterious glowing pendant. Follow her as she journeys through worlds inspired by ancient Greek mythology in search of her lost father and her own inner courage.

demos.name: GalactiWar - Empire Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Watch empires rise and fall, or intervene with godly powers, in GalactiWar, a space empire simulation sandbox game.

demos.name: BeeTD Demo
demos.short_description: BeeTD is a tower defence game all about protecting yourself from summer's greatest menace. The wasp. Do not let the cute visuals fool you, for the wasps have no mercy.

demos.name: Bump Guardian  Demo
demos.short_description: Bump Guardian is a deck-building defense game about protecting a growing life. Build your deck, repel incoming threats, and progress through the stages of pregnancy.

demos.name: Wukong Survivors Demo
demos.short_description: Pixel-art bullet-heaven roguelite where Wukong, a Warrior, and an Immortal carve through escalating hordes. Grab guns, blades, and staves, stack wild upgrades, evolve builds, and survive to the final boss.

highlights.trailer_name: 悟空幸存者 试玩演示

demos.name: Ash of the Covenant Demo
demos.short_description: A fast-paced action roguelike where brutal melee combat meets dangerous divine power. Accept blessings from forgotten gods, build powerful synergies, and face the hidden cost behind every gift.

demos.name: Antichrist Demo
demos.short_description: As a journalist, you made headlines back in 2006 with a groundbreaking story. Years later, an anonymous call tied to that very event leads you to an horror house. But this house may belong to the Antichrist believed to appear at the end of days. You’re chasing a story… but it might be your last.

demos.name: 虚空斗盘 Demo
demos.short_description: A high-contrast grid-based real-time combat Roguelike. Build unique tactics with attachments that affect all five inventory slots, adapt to timed events, calculate every stamina point, and survive randomized themed stages.

demos.name: 命运挽歌：词汇英灵录 序章
demos.short_description: You are a new student at Lunrant Magic Academy, the top magic school on the continent of Yusiaid. Here, you’ll learn to control Spirit Cards and summon mighty Spirits. By mastering magic spells (English words), you’ll guide your Spirits in battle and grow into a powerful Spirit Summoner.

demos.name: Fast Food Wars Demo
demos.short_description: Fast Food Wars is a bullet-hell shoot'em up rogue-lite game in a procedural generated restaurant with random power ups, weapons. You play as a burger fighting to claim back all the invaded burger restaurant from other fast foods

demos.name: Point In Time Demo
demos.short_description:
Use time travel to cooperate with your past self and conquer seemingly impossible puzzles.
Can you craft the perfect timeline without altering history?
Design your own escape.

demos.name: Paddle Legends Demo
demos.short_description: A chaotic roguelite twist on retro arcade action. Every run will test your reflexes and decision-making as you unlock new paddles with unique projectiles and conquer levels with a variety of modifiers and challenging foes.

demos.name: TriviaSpire Demo
demos.short_description: Test your trivia knowledge against other people on a global scale! Don't let the water rise above your spire as you do not know how to swim

demos.name: Fleshborn Demo
demos.short_description: A short incremental game where you are tasked to clean a research facility from fleshy growths using your flamethrower. Collect resources and spend them in a vast upgrade tree to unlock new abilities.

demos.name: Kaboomania Demo
demos.short_description: A fast‑paced retro maze bomber packed with explosive action, colorful pixel art, and a fresh twist on a timeless gameplay formula. For all retro and pixel art lovers!

demos.name: MyDear.exe Demo
demos.short_description: Celebrate love with Ellie and Lucien in MyDear.exe. A short and cute game that takes place in the folders of an old DIY PC. In the shoes of Ellie, play the game offered by Lucien after a long life together. Humor, memories and love are on the menu of this short ~2 hours experience.

demos.name: Kingdom Craft Demo
demos.short_description: Kingdom Craft is a survival game in a world of floating islands with unique gravity. Craft items by combining different materials, explore, build, and progress to reach the ancient portal and return home.

demos.name: Stamperor! The Jester's Decree - Demo
demos.short_description: A city builder where you play as an alien jester who becomes a temporary emperor and must make unusual decisions by stamping decrees, trying at all costs to keep everything from collapsing.

demos.name: We Believe in No Gods (Demo)
demos.short_description: Awaken as a forgotten deity in a post-apocalyptic wasteland ruled by staunch materialists. Listen to desperate prayers—bestow miracles or watch with cold indifference. Extract faith to survive, manipulate mortal minds, and shape the ultimate fate of a world where We Believe In No Gods.

demos.name: BROKEN SOUL : Boss Rush Demo
demos.short_description: Try this free 2D Souls-like boss rush demo on a 5×2 grid. Dodge, parry, and learn the patterns of 12 enemy types. Play through Chapter 2-5 and unlock Jiny alongside Nyra.

demos.name: Imperial Wager: The Shattered Crown of Augustus Demo
demos.short_description: Rule a fractured realm in this minimalist political sim where statecraft is an abstract game of chance. Wager your treasury to awaken dormant relics, mold a Ruling Will to set the house in motion, and steer shifting borders. Set the stakes, delegate power, and gamble to reforge the name of Augustus.

demos.name: No Trust Demo
demos.short_description: NO TRUST is a brutal pixel platformer where nothing behaves as expected. Navigate deceptive levels filled with hidden traps, master precise movement, and survive unforgiving challenges that constantly test your reflexes and instincts in a dark cyberpunk world.

demos.name: Worlds Upon The Wind Demo
demos.short_description: Resettle the shards of a shattered world in this peaceful roguelite deckbuilder, covering centuries of classical Japanese art. Nurture communities, befriend animal spirits, and shape a new civilization through choices that echo across generations.

demos.name: Verto Demo
demos.short_description: Drop blocks, match colors, rotate everything. This puzzle game adds mind-bending board rotation to classic gameplay. Choose from timed challenges or endless modes, and compete for high scores. Easy to learn, impossible to master.

demos.name: Cozy Mozy Demo
demos.short_description: A relaxing cozy home renovation game where you clean, paint, repair, and decorate spaces at your own pace. Enjoy satisfying interactions, calming visuals, and create warm, lived-in rooms with no timers or pressure.

demos.name: Finding Polka Demo
demos.short_description: Go on a little adventure to find Polka. Along the way, make friends by helping people in need. Your friends will surely help you!

demos.name: Minesweeper: Next-Gen Demo
demos.short_description: This isn’t the Minesweeper you’re used to! In Minesweeper: Next-Gen, you’ll explore boards built from a variety of geometric tessellations. Boundaries can wrap around, tiles can split, and parts of the map can even contain the map itself. Rely on pure logic to gradually uncover all safe areas.

demos.name: H.A.R.V.E.S.T.E.R Demo
