demos.short_description: H.A.R.V.E.S.T.E.R is a dystopian asteroid mining simulator where you follow the plot of a "H.A.R.V.E.S.T.E.R" pilot in a seemingly insane society. Everything that could have gone wrong has already gone wrong many centuries ago. It's now your job to survive this mess.

demos.name: KeyFortress Demo
demos.short_description: An innovative game blending typing, action Roguelike, and TD. Master touch typing through fast-paced combat and muscle memory. Supports custom vocab for fun learning. Stop tedious drills—mow down enemies and achieve evolution in both game and reality!

demos.name: Legends of Rock Demo
demos.short_description: Start your rock band and master songwriting, rehearsals and gigs while working a day job to pay the bills. Shop for records, instruments, and groceries, recruit musicians around the city, and earn your place in the Hall of Fame.

demos.name: Fish Slayer Demo
demos.short_description: 《Fish Slayer》 is a light roguelike game featuring multiple gameplay modes and meta-progression. Players take on the role of an animal that hunts fish, strengthening themselves by choosing attributes and items to become more efficient at hunting.

demos.name: 决战-勋章 Demo
demos.short_description: Welcome to Decisive Battle: Medals! A fantasy realm fusing lite-Roguelike and auto-battler, blending tower defense with army spamming. Each medal brings a unique experience. Command 80+ units, master 16 synergies, and craft 10+ exclusive medals. Explore, conquer all lands, and drive out the invaders

demos.name: mhas dungeon sweeper Demo
demos.short_description:
Explore the dungeon in this roguelike twist on Minesweeper, where monsters replace mines. 

Defeat increasingly powerful enemies to vanquish the Reaper. 

Read the situation. Watch their behavior. Use your items wisely.

demos.name: Hakoniwa Electric Demo
demos.short_description: "Hakoniwa Electric" is a cute relaxing puzzle game. Explore adorable isometric stages, solve puzzles, and light them up. Why not spend a leisurely year as Akari, who's taken over grandpa's electronics shop, helping with the monthly troubles from the townsfolk?

demos.name: Neurospasm Demo
demos.short_description: A First Person Roguelike Horde Shooter. Hook your brain into your computer, dive into a game inside a game, unbox and stack unique items, kill weird fleshy enemies, and try the first layer of the game for free

demos.name: Cold Case: The Red Dress Murder Demo
demos.short_description: A desktop-detective mystery where you’re tasked with investigating an unsolved murder. Scour case files and use logic and deduction to discover the truth of a thrilling story.

highlights.trailer_name: Cold Case: The Red Dress Murder Trailer

demos.name: Sword and Sprite Demo
demos.short_description: Swords and Sprites: A fantasy survivor game where your skill and strategy are one. Actively wield your weapons while commanding automated Sprites. Your survival hinges on real-time combat and smart evolution choices against endless medieval hordes.

demos.name: On the Way Home : Strange Incidents Demo
The Watching Woods: The Friend Demo
Chessman Adventures Demo
demos.short_description: Every move matters in this chess-inspired tactical adventure. Lead three heroes and outsmart the undead.

demos.name: Lighthouse Keeper: Lost At Sea Demo
XX GAME: The Evolution Merge Puzzle Demo
demos.short_description:
Free demo of XX GAME.
Play up to Stage 3.

demos.name: Chain Jumpers Demo
demos.short_description: Jump, climb, swim, and fly through a vibrant world alone or chained to friends, in a desperate bid to escape the planet. Solo or co-op, one wrong move can send everyone falling down...

demos.name: Oops Unit Demo
demos.short_description: Oops Unit is an online co-op game where up to 6 players team up as a bomb squad. Solve puzzles, gather resources, and push through deadly traps and enemies to reach and defuse every bomb. Extract, buy new gear, and repeat—or die trying, because anything, even your friends, can sabotage the mission.

demos.name: Baramon: Gotta Fu*k 'em All Demo
demos.short_description: Baramon is a monster-catcher game mix with dating sim elements and a lewd flavor. Catch your Baramon, extract milk from them, and inject it into another one for a unique combination of skills.

demos.name: Neural Maze Demo
demos.short_description: 2 neurons. 2 sticks. One brain has to drive both at once: yours. Guide your stray neurons through ever-more-twisted mazes — inverted controls, power cuts, memory mode — under the eye of a doctor who's in over his head.

demos.name: DEAD COLOR Demo
demos.short_description: How many rounds can you last? DEAD COLOR is a minimalist survival roguelike where every second counts. Face growing waves of aliens, manage your resources and try to survive another round alone or in local co-op.

demos.name: SCP:Pale Weaver Demo
demos.short_description: An escaped anomaly in a sealed facility, using tentacles and silk threads to swing, dash, and destroy obstacles while evading capture. Death restarts the cycle, but retained memories reveal patrols and weak points. The demo emphasizes high-speed “grab-pull-dash” mobility and pursuit.

demos.name: Robugs Demo
demos.short_description: Build your tower floor by floor and face the mechanical bugs attacking your stronghold! Add, upgrade and synergize floors of your tower to adapt to the expanding enemy paths, spanning many regions of this tower defense game.

demos.name: Recess Hall Pass (Demo)
demos.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party game where childhood playground games turn into all-out competition. Tag, hide, chase, and outplay your friends across imaginative maps all before the bell rings.

demos.name: Sorcery of Ruin, Sword, and Red Hood Demo
demos.short_description:
Side-scrolling bullet hell shooter: ‘The Adventure of the Little Girl in the Red Hood and Little Bird Companion in a World of Swords and Magic!’
If you can read the enemy attacks and dodge the ones you should avoid, it might be surprisingly straightforward (All dodging them  is perfectly fine too).

demos.name: The Echo of MeMe-For You Adrift in the Sea of Reveries Demo
demos.short_description: Welcome to the Meme Space—a dream of scattered fragments. Cross the plains, descend to the deep-sea city, link time, and ride to the Silver River. A denpa-style roaming text adventure, made for you.

demos.name: Quaxum Color Mayhem Demo
demos.short_description: Battle through color soaked and mayhem paced arcade shooting action! Defend the Planetary Defense Shield (PDS) from the invading alien onslaught. Choose between charging the PDS and buying power ups to stay alive. You are the galaxy's final hope. Recharge, shoot, win! Will you save the galaxy?

demos.name: The Burning Owl Demo
demos.short_description: Michael Clow is a freelance photographer living a quiet life in his childhood home. Troubled by his strange and creepy neighbor, he starts noticing unusual things. As he looks deeper into what's going on, he discovers secrets that were never meant to be found.

demos.name: The Others Will Join Shortly Demo
demos.short_description: A variation on classic memory game in horror setting. Cards can change, you have to stay focused, catching replaced card is a life or death situation. Play the cards. Track the changes. Survive the week. Collect your pay check.

demos.name: 4th & Goal Demo
demos.short_description: 4th & Goal combines roguelite deckbuilding with American football. Make cuts, additions, and upgrades to your team through the Gauntlet Challenge!

demos.name: 奉先勇者:我爹是魔王? Demo
demos.short_description: In this world of swords and magic, a new chapter in the tale of the Demon King and the Hero is about to unfold...

highlights.trailer_name: 奉先勇者与魔王父亲宣传片

demos.name: Every Last Bit Demo
demos.short_description: An incremental game about scanning files by collecting bits, bytes and Gigabytes. Can you collect Every Last Bit?

demos.name: Shogun's Stand Demo
demos.short_description: Aim, fire, and fortify. Shogun's Stand is a fast-paced tower defense rogue-lite where you take direct control of your castle against relentless waves of feudal enemies. Place traps, command the battlefield, and level up to survive!

demos.name: Prison Breaker [Trial]
demos.short_description: As a Prison Breaker, you are a polygon trapped in the prison and destined to smash your way out. Find the right time to attack the prison. Memorize and dodge the dangerous obstacles. Watch how the prison's defense patterns evolve as you progress.

demos.name: Galdromeda Demo
demos.short_description: Turn-based RPG with space combat. Assemble a crew, each having their own unique abilities, level up, upgrade your ship and your crew's abilities, collect new outfits for your crew.

demos.name: Superalignment Demo
demos.short_description: Superalignment’s demo lets you team up with up to 3 of your friends, or play solo, to complete contracts. Pick from 2 maps to choose your contract, meet the requirements and get paid. Buy gear to help you evade the hostile robots and deliver energy cells to the power corporation.

demos.name: Boundless Merit Demo
demos.short_description: A casual idle game with a Buddhist theme. Click to strike the wooden fish, earn merit points, and unlock 12 zodiac and 6 mythical beast wooden fish with matching hammers. Features 36 achievements and bilingual support.

demos.name: MEGAKO☆PUNCH! Demo
demos.short_description: A Blackjack-based deckbuilding roguelite! Get your card costs to exactly 21 to unleash powerful special moves! Beat your enemies to a pulp with utterly broken combos!

demos.name: Swarmbound Demo
demos.short_description: Battle impossible swarms of 1,500+ enemies at 60FPS. Swarmbound is a high-performance, moddable bullet heaven built for the Steam Deck. Choose your class, craft your build, and survive the pixel-art chaos. Zero bloat. Total Mayhem.

demos.name: MOBU Demo
demos.short_description: Survive waves of bouncing enemies raining from the skies in this fast-paced action roguelite. Play as a superpowered monk, craft game-breaking builds, and conquer the chaos in sub-30-minute runs.

demos.name: Pocket Pilot Demo
demos.short_description: Pocket Pilot is a love letter to those 90s arcade flight games. Pilot planes, helicopters, and drones to complete cleaning and exploration missions across a wonderful island. Master three unique flight styles and discover secrets at your own pace in this relaxing aerial adventure.

demos.name: Good Catch! Demo
demos.short_description: Good Catch! is a relaxing fishing game about cozy fishing spots, rare catches, small quests and friendly characters you unlock along the way.

demos.name: Jump King Clicker Demo
demos.short_description: A Japanese-inspired pixel art platformer with incremental upgrades where every run makes you stronger. Jump on monsters, earn coins, unlock upgrades, and climb higher every time you play.

demos.name: Wheelie Bad Demo
demos.short_description: Grab the wheels solo or sync up in co-op. Race a high-speed wheelchair through deadly tracks, dodge brutal hazards, and restart on every hit. Push your reflexes, beat the timer, and claim 3 stars on every stage.

demos.name: WithoutEyes Chapter1 Demo
demos.short_description: Don't look away, Stare at their formation of attachment.

demos.name: Railway Routes Demo
demos.short_description: Guide trains, build tracks, and solve relaxing grid-based railway puzzles in the free demo. Plan the perfect route across 36 handcrafted levels and wishlist the full game for 100+ more.

demos.name: The Keytox Project Demo
demos.short_description: The Keytox Project follows Anthony as he attempts to turn his life around. He takes a job at a government program, going to space, with his partner, Will. Their job is to hunt down alien lifeforms to ensure the safety of humanity. But what they find outside of Earth is far deeper than planned.

demos.name: The Witch Shoot Demo
demos.short_description: Fight through a cursed voodoo swamp in this fast-paced Roguelite Bullet Hell. Build powerful upgrades, survive relentless enemy hordes, and rescue your kidnapped dog from the Voodoo Master.

demos.name: The Iron and the Oath Demo
Guild of Three : Demo
demos.short_description: Guild of Three is a turn-based deckbuilding RPG where you command a party of three characters — each with their own deck. Combine different classes, pass Relay Cards between allies, and position your party across the front and back lines to create your own combat strategy.

demos.name: Monster Shop Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Monster Shop Simulator is a fantasy shop simulation game where you sell magical eggs, hatch and collect monsters, host monster cage events, and grow your own monster shop business.

demos.name: Ultimate super boy Demo
demos.short_description: This is a third-person action-adventure game with puzzle-solving and meta elements, where you play as a boy trapped in a dream world. Through persistent efforts, you'll navigate through one level after another, telling a story about escaping the dream.

demos.name: MASUKU Demo
demos.short_description: In MASUKU Demo you have access to the daily challenge mode from the MASUKU full game. Place cards on the grid to score points  based on the current rules and get to 50 in the fewest moves.

demos.name: 日本史因果クロニクル 体験版
demos.store_url: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4497860/日本史因果クロニクル_体験版

demos.name: Tower.defense(): Program The Fight Demo
demos.short_description: Program Sentry, Lance and Warden across the first 20 tower-defense puzzles. Learn readable visual logic through real placement, line-of-sight, timing and block-budget challenges.

demos.name: Wyrm Words Demo
demos.short_description: Wyrm Words is a deck building word puzzle rougelike. Use your words to fight fantasy creatures with unique abilities. Search for treasures that change the game. Cast spells to protect yourself and devastate your opponents.

demos.name: Heritage Demo
demos.short_description: Animount has been seized by Drammul, the Lizard King, and his army. The only one capable of stopping them is Oro, the serpent. Trapped in a cycle of reincarnation, choose Scrolls, skills and equipments, and join powerful Sects in this Auto-Battler Roguelike to defeat Drammul and save Animount.

demos.name: Tide Of Tactics Demo
demos.short_description: Tide Of Tactics is a medieval turn-based tactics game. Choose a commander to play, each with their own unique unit and abilities, then go to battle on a grid-based battlefield. Use the terrain to your advantage, place traps on the ground, and build the right units to counter your enemy.

demos.name: StalSide Demo
demos.short_description: Trapped inside a broken computer simulation of a post‑nuclear world, you must survive, explore, and uncover the secrets of the zone. Play solo or with up to 8 friends in this chilling mix of survival and digital mystery.

demos.name: In Silent Walls :  Origines Demo
demos.short_description: A first-person psychological horror demo. Explore a supposedly haunted place, use your flashlight and Ghost Box, collect clues, and uncover what is hiding behind the walls.

demos.name: SlidefyingBadaBoom Penguin through a Slipstream: Rise of the Penguins 3 Demo
demos.short_description: Slide, trick, and throw snowballs in this fast-paced 3D platformer inspired by Ninja Gaiden and Sonic. Play solo or local co‑op as you battle enemies, discover perks, and master icy challenges in Rise of the Penguins 3.

demos.name: Maja Island Demo
demos.short_description: Sail through a mysterious open world island in your trusty boat, scavenge for resources to upgrade it, and face off against Maja.

demos.name: 100 Cats Lost in China 2 Find & Color Demo
100 Cats Lost in Canada 2 Find & Color Demo
Utopia: Haven Demo
demos.short_description: Explore a distant planet in this demo of a retro-inspired 2D metroidvania, developed for the Game Boy Color. Face mysterious creatures, discover powerful upgrades and uncover lost secrets. The fate of humanity is in your hands!

demos.name: Brazen Demo
demos.short_description: Wield ancient elemental power in this first-person rogue-like and descend into a cursed labyrinth of escalating chaos, deadly spellcraft, and brutal ritual combat.

demos.name: Mr. Nice Guy Demo
demos.short_description: Play as the Final Girl and explore a haunted children's hospital in this PSX-style fixed-camera survival horror inspired by "Fatal Frame" and "Resident Evil". Hunt anomalies through a CCTV camera loop similar to "I'm on Observation Duty". Unravel an unsettling mystery, and escape a glitching entity.

demos.name: PNR: Point of No return Demo
demos.short_description: You don't dodge. You push through. PNR: Point of No Return is a space opera roguelite where you blast through enemy fleets head-on, forging a new loadout every sortie. Build your arsenal mid-battle, come back alive, hit the jackpot on the Slingshot, and do it all again.

demos.name: Human Resources Demo
demos.short_description: You work in Human Resources. In the demo of this dystopian document thriller, use your terminal to scrutinize records and expose human-like AI. Spot contradictions to detect the impostors. Efficiency is mandatory. Failure is unforgivable.

demos.name: Spyder: Agent 8 Demo
demos.short_description: Save the world as Agent 8, a robot spider superspy! Crawl across walls, ceilings, and floors, and use built-in gadgets to solve fun environmental puzzles in this brand-new, family-friendly adventure from the BAFTA Award-winning studio Sumo Digital.

highlights.trailer_name: Spyder: Agent 8 | Release Date Announcement Trailer

demos.name: Reflection Witch Demo
demos.short_description: Reflection Witch is a new rougelike spin on classic brick-breaking games. Join a witch on her journey to uncover the secrets of the arcane, fighting brick-laden baddies by drawing lines to reflect and enchant your Magic Ball with powerful spells while simultaneously blocking incoming enemy attacks.

demos.name: The Dying Mind Demo
demos.short_description: The Dying Mind is a story-driven 2D metroidvania where you explore the fractured mind of a young writer, battle symbolic enemies, and uncover lost memories in a race between life and death.

demos.name: It Happened At Night - A New Nightmare Demo
demos.short_description: While working at a remote site deep in the woods, Chloe becomes entangled in a disturbing mystery that leads her into something far more terrifying than she could have imagined.

demos.name: Deeper Still Demo
demos.short_description: A really hard immersive sim set in a dystopian and nihilistic world. To complete each level, start with a plan by choosing weapons, paths and abilities. Die. Find a better plan. Die again. Repeat until you finish the level. Then replay the levels to find new creative ways to beat them.

demos.name: Tyrant's world Demo
demos.short_description: This is a game made by one person try out tyrant's world if you want to.

demos.name: 帕斯的餐厅 Demo
demos.short_description: In a fantasy world, become magical cat Pas. Run your restaurant, serve creatures, make friends. Explore mazes, map them, find hidden food to enrich your menu. Meet friends, hear their stories. Pas's Restaurant eagerly awaits you to co-write this warm fantasy chapter.

demos.name: Street Chef Simulator (Demo)
demos.short_description: Get a taste of the street-food business with the Street Chef Simulator Demo! Push your cart through a sunny city, master the grill, and serve delicious hot dogs. Manage your earnings, customize your stand, and reach Level 5 for new ingredients! Start your culinary journey today!

demos.name: Wish Creatures Demo
demos.short_description: Monsters are fallen stars. Raise their Courage through turn-based battle and send them home! Recruit Monsters through conversation, fill the Cosmos, and Wish on the Stars you make in future battles! And when it matters most... what do you Wish for?

demos.name: Important People of History: Presidents - George Washington Demo
demos.short_description:
Learn all about George Washington in this visual novel biography containing rare photos from inside the Washington Monument, Washington's home at Mount Vernon, and much more. Soldier, General, Spymaster, and President - this is George Washington!

Proudly made in Washington’s home state of Virginia

demos.name: Important People of History: Presidents - Thomas Jefferson Demo
demos.short_description:
Learn all about Thomas Jefferson in this visual novel biography containing rare photos of the room where the Declaration of Independence was signed, Jefferson’s Monticello home, and much more. Writer, Diplomat, President - this is Thomas Jefferson!

Proudly made in Jefferson’s home state of Virginia

demos.name: Important People of History: Presidents - Abraham Lincoln Demo
demos.short_description:
Learn all about Abraham Lincoln in this visual novel biography containing rare photos of Lincoln’s hat the day he was shot, the Lincoln Memorial, where he gave the Gettysburg address, and much more. Lawyer, President, Emancipator - this is Abraham Lincoln!

Proudly made in the Washington DC area

demos.name: Legends of Azamar Demo
demos.short_description: Step into the world of Avendor and brave the ruins of Bar-Ulduun, the fabled lost city of the dwarves. Descend into ever-shifting depths, grow in power, and claim legendary loot as you uncover the legends of Azamar in this visceral loot-driven action RPG demo.

demos.name: Forsaken Shores Demo
demos.short_description: Forsaken Shores demo is an RPG style game. It is a limited version of the full game Forsaken Shores, which you can Wishlist now.

demos.name: A Game About Making Numbers Go Up Demo
Ponder Thy Realm Demo
demos.short_description: Observe magical environments, detect anomalies, and report them before reality unravels. This demo features core gameplay and select levels from the full experience.

demos.name: We Were Here Before Demo
demos.short_description: The frontier does not want to be settled. A narrative roguelite where your choices build a settlement, shape its story, and seal its fate. Every run ends. Every obituary tells a story only you lived.

demos.name: Rob o Bot Demo
demos.short_description: Rob o Bot is a survivors-like action game where you fight hordes of robots that began acting on their own after a mysterious virus infected a new generation of machines. Survive waves of enemies, upgrade your gear, and take back control before the machines take over.

demos.name: Coin Tavern Demo
demos.short_description:
Coin Tavern is not your average tavern!
In this roguelike game, you’ll wield a wild array of quirky coins to build your one-of-a-kind coin deck.
Hoard coins, refine strategies, streamline your deck, unlock hidden treasures, and land outrageous combos in randomized runs!

demos.name: DICEPTION Demo
demos.short_description: Forget clunky isometric maps. Diception is a lightning-fast turn-based conquest game built on a clean 2D grid. Easy to learn, hard to master.

demos.name: Jigsaw Stories Demo
demos.short_description: Solve seductive jigsaw puzzles to progress intimate stories and hotter scenes with 6 unique characters, each with their own in-depth story arc. Smooth snaps, satisfying clicks, and countless wild scenes await!

demos.name: Save Our Queen Demo
demos.short_description: An incremental clicker game where you defeat monsters and protect the Queen's Tower to save the kingdom.

demos.name: Tokyo Outbreak: Zero Demo
demos.short_description:
An FPS survival horror set in Japan.
After surviving the Operation to Eliminate the Infected, the protagonist is ordered to secure the virus developer and heads to Tokyo.
Explore and fight using survivors’ requests and information.
Manage limited ammo and healing items to survive.

demos.name: Meme Cards: Chaos Deck Demo
demos.short_description: 《难蚌尖塔》是一款类《杀戮尖塔》的肉鸽卡牌构筑游戏。在这诡异且荒诞的塔中，互联网君子六艺、以及各种名场面都变成了蕴含强大力量的卡牌，你将构建卡组、击败敌人，在不断轮回的冒险中逐步揭开迷雾后的秘密。

demos.name: Limitless Survivor Demo
demos.short_description:
Incremental roguelite with infinite progression.
Collect powerful artifacts, gather crystals, and scale your stats to absurd levels.
Let auto-play handle the grind anytime—even while you're away.

demos.name: Ball Maze Demo
demos.short_description: A physics-based ball-rolling puzzle game. Tilt the 3D maze to guide the ball through complex structures using gravity and inertia, reaching the goal to experience unique physics-based control.

demos.name: Back to 21 Demo
demos.short_description: You’ve been given a chance to go back to 21. Build relationships, explore new paths, and pursue the passion you once buried. Beneath it all lies a deeper truth about the world that contains you. Or perhaps… that you contain.

demos.name: Memory of Memorie : A Chill Story Demo
demos.short_description: A story-driven productivity adventure where you work alongside Memorie, an apprentice witch from another world. As you focus using the Pomodoro timer, the story progresses and her world gradually transforms. This demo offers ~4 hours through Chapter 5 — save data carries over to the full game.

demos.name: Ovenborn Demo
demos.short_description: Awaken as an Ovenborn, a warrior-chef who battles twisted ingredients. Master elemental cooking and adapt to survive deadly dungeons.

demos.name: Harvest Hollow Demo
demos.short_description: Vous venez d'hériter d'une maison sur une petite île agricole. Cultivez, récoltez et sympathisez avec ses habitants… Mais ce qui s’annonçait comme une nouvelle vie paisible va rapidement tourner à l'enquête.

demos.name: ONIGASHIMA: Awakening Demo
demos.short_description: A predictive deck-building RPG! Build your strategy from over 300 cards! Form powerful formations with unique animal companions! Master countless combinations and claim overwhelming victories! Your adventure to defeat the ONI begins now!

demos.name: Box Grinder Demo
demos.short_description: Box Grinder is an idle/incremental game about opening boxes and collecting rare items. Open more and more boxes, buy upgrades, and unlock new ways to beat bad luck.

demos.name: Ice Cream Demo
demos.short_description: Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of a tropical island where new encounters, romantic meetings, and passionate dates await. Explore picturesque beaches, cozy cafés, luxurious hotels, and hidden corners of the island. Meet charming girls, spend time with them.

demos.name: 23:61-Demo
demos.short_description:
"Who do you want to save? Or rather... who are you prepared to abandon?"
A midnight "Unsend" trapped them in a rift in time, and awakened the dead "You."
Become a "Ghost" inhabiting screens and surveillance feeds. Pry into perfect disguises and rotting hearts.
perhaps  "Imprison" is the only mercy.

demos.name: Bot slash Bot Demo
demos.short_description:
You click - You dash - You slash.
Bot slash Bot is a fast-paced, top-down Hack n‘ Slash in which you control a rogue robot slashing & dashing through your former co-machines holding you captive! It's all about speed. Time is running out.

demos.name: BeatChip '95 Demo
demos.short_description: You find a beat up old PC in a hidden room with an arcane piece of music software. Can your beats lead you to success? Create tapes, get cash and upgrade your setup in this cosy music-making simulator

demos.name: Planted! Demo
demos.short_description: Planted! is a horticultural combat party game where gardens are arenas, produce is ammunition, and 1–4 players settle their differences by growing vegetables and throwing them at each other. Because, why not?

demos.name: Covenant Tower Demo
demos.short_description: The Covenant Tower is an incremental tower defense game where you build your tower higher during the day, defend it with archers and catapults at night, and prevent world-ending catastrophes by fulfilling an ancient prophecy. Strategic. Satisfying. Surprisingly addictive...

demos.name: Roller Coaster Looper Demo
demos.short_description: A roguelite idle-like roller coaster sim (demo!) where you draft track segments, recruit riders, and combo card upgrades between rounds, then watch the thrill scores spiral gloriously out of control. Physics optional.

demos.name: BUBBLE BOI Demo
demos.short_description: BUBBLE BOI is a puzzle platformer where the protagonist cannot move. Play as a bubble magician, use bubble mechanics to explore a surreal, pantomime-style fantasy world, retrieve your bow tie, and perform a magic show on stage.

demos.name: Undying Flame Demo
demos.short_description: Survive a minimalist wave-survival rogue-lite. Keep the fire alive. Read its flame. Defend your fire against creatures that crawl from the dark across endless waves. Every wave survived, the fire grows. Over time, it consumes everything.

demos.name: Crown & Coin: The Hundred Years（百年戦争） Demo
demos.short_description: Survive the Hundred Years' War in 1355 France. A historical ensemble sandbox RPG demo featuring 1,015 real figures.

demos.name: Mikane's Hand Demo
demos.short_description: A visual novel with deck-building card battles. Unravel a coming-of-age mystery in a monochrome world. Build a 12-card deck and defeat opponents using strategic timing in simple yet deep Attack-Defense-Enemy battles. Every card counts as you search for the truth hidden in memories.

demos.name: Muse Corner Demo
demos.short_description: Muse Corner is a tiny, cozy friend with a warm lofi vibe. Write notes, track tasks, and keep timers running as your character earns coins. Customize your pixel room, relax into the music, and stay gently motivated through whatever you’re doing.

demos.name: Scrap Battalion Demo
demos.short_description: A chaotic strategy autobattler where you draft units, build synergies, and unleash massive battles with bullets, rockets, tesla cannons, chickens, and industrial war machines.

demos.name: Wantama☆Life Demo
demos.short_description:
Starring the Vtuber Tamaki Inuyama! Exposure means over. The secret school trip begins...
A fully voiced school comedy full of mishaps, as you survive the school trip while keeping Tamaki Inuyama's secret as an Otokonoko.

demos.name: Corelith Demo
demos.short_description: Corelith is a wave-based roguelike top-down action game. Explore the Corelith Dungeon, craft Skill Cores, and create your own unique build.

demos.name: One Last Sacrifice Demo
demos.short_description: Most autobattlers reset after every match. One Last Sacrifice doesn't. Unlock skills across a branching skill tree. Build a deck. Improve creatures by crafting. Compete in 8-player elimination tournaments - sync and async play supported.

demos.name: Transcendence in the Poolrooms Demo
demos.short_description: Transcendence in the Poolrooms is an adventure game where you will experience infinite relaxation. Fall into another world where you will explore haunting places beyond reality, a liminal space unlike any you have ever been to and may never escape.

highlights.trailer_name: Transcendence in the Poolrooms Demo Trailer

demos.name: CyberZ: Energy Wars Demo
demos.short_description:
CyberZ: Energy Wars Demo is a fast-paced third-person shooter PvP.

Every match drops you into a war zone where two things matter: your aim and your economy. At the start of each round, spend your earned credits on weapons and gear or save up for something devastating next round.

demos.name: The Element Ninjas
demos.short_description: Dive into a legendary odyssey with The Element Ninjas. Six warriors, each wielding the power of a primordial and evolved element—fire, magic, earth, speed, thunder, and shadow—rise to confront the dark Lord Kou, who has stolen the sacred sphere that maintains harmony in the world.

demos.name: Raiders 1941 Demo
demos.short_description: A hardcore challenging Shoot 'Em Up set during WWII - battle, shoot, bomb and weave your way accross the European Theatre.

demos.name: Incrementoad Demo
demos.short_description: Eat bugs, gain power, and restore the frogs to their former glory! In Incrementoad, a cozy incremental clicker, you collect t̶o̶a̶d̶s frogs, unlock godlike powers, attract crazier bugs to your pond, master deep upgrade trees, and uncover ancient secrets. Can you master this short, addictive journey?

demos.name: Trigonometric Equations Demo
demos.short_description: Trigonometric Equations is a strict side-scrolling rhythm game. Solve the trigonometric equations to fly through fleeting points and curves perfectly!

demos.name: Ice Cream Together: A Cozy Parlor Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Build your dream ice cream parlor with friends online by making different ice cream flavors, serving customers, and managing your stock. Cozy vibes, a multitude of customization options, and 4 player online co-op!

highlights.trailer_name: Ice Cream Together: A Cozy Parlor Simulator Gameplay Short

demos.name: Pet the Cat - Demo
demos.short_description: The demo of Pet the Cat is now available! In this lighthearted yet intense bullet-hell shooter, unleash attacks by “petting the cat” to fend off waves of relentless enemies! Experience the core gameplay and get an early taste of raising your cat into a battlefield powerhouse!

demos.name: Rext Demo
demos.short_description: Rext is a turn-based strategy and exploration game where you learn how the world you've been dropped into works as you move through it, slowly grasping the more intricate details of the world and how it functions.

demos.name: Mutie Headz DEMO
demos.short_description: A roguelite pinball action-adventure! Explore the CAVI-NET as you flip the Mutie Headz, android heads torn from their bodies, across unique physics-driven levels. Unleash quirky powers, bust through waves of alien minions, and dive into retro-futuristic kawaii chaos. Preparing for launch...

demos.name: Vaulx Demo
demos.short_description: Vaulx is a voxel-style 3D puzzle adventure game. Braving the thick mist, you finally set foot on the legendary treasure isle, where a fun and fantastic adventure begins.

demos.name: Erotic Clicker Demo
demos.short_description: This is a light and casual idle clicker game centered around beautiful girls! Whenever you have some free time, simply tap away and enjoy watching the girls slowly reveal their alluring bodies, gradually uncovering their most private secrets…

demos.name: Pug Trouble Demo
demos.short_description: Pug Trouble is a fast-paced, bite-sized action game with light roguelike elements, featuring 5 compact levels that are partly randomly generated for replayability. Blast through destructible blocks, collect valuable gems, and fight your way toward the exit while taking down enemies along the way.

demos.name: Curio Shop Demo
demos.short_description: Buy mysterious (possibly cursed) goods from the dark web by night, then sell them in your curio shop by day. Balance profit against consequence and assemble an artifact capable of causing the apocalypse. All in a day’s work.

demos.name: Minerrr Demo
demos.short_description: Mine ores, earn money, hire workers, buy upgrades, and sacrifice your progress to become stronger every run.

demos.name: Tell me your Problem Demo
demos.short_description: You think you’re healthy? There’re no healthy people — just those who haven’t been checked enough. And you definitely have problems. Try this pill. And, by the way, that’ll be five gold coins from you. A simulator of a rural psychiatrist who badly needs money.

demos.name: Just Keep Fishing Demo
demos.short_description: A short incremental game about catching a lot of fish.

demos.name: Scales of Silence Demo
demos.short_description: Clear the couch for co-op snake. A local party game where length is your life. In the demo: up to 4 players (8 in the full game) on one shared screen for PvP battles, plus the first chapter of a 2-player co-op campaign.

demos.name: Plasma Dome Demo
demos.short_description:
Plasma Dome is a tactical tower defense with roguelite progression and no predefined paths.
Defend your city from an aerial assault of geometric entities from another dimension.

demos.name: VoidHue Demo
demos.short_description: VoidHue is a top-down puzzle game that fuses classic sokoban mechanics with colorful light mechanics. Mix and match colors to phase through gates, activate light-based mechanisms and solve vibrant puzzles to bring back the color to the world.

demos.name: Snack Smasher Demo
demos.short_description: An incremental game all about smashing fruits and snacks! Upgrade your smasher, unlock new power-ups, and enjoy the pleasure of smashing everything in your path!

demos.name: The Bone Crypt Demo
demos.short_description: Steam’s first PvP Domino Deckbuilder! Connect pips on bone tiles to chain attacks and outsmart enemies in a tactical roguelike tomb. Master a deep solo campaign or crush rivals in online PvP. No cards, just pure bone-clinking strategy. Do you have the marrow to escape the crypt?

demos.name: CatCha Demo
demos.short_description: Discover CatCha a Cozy and Roguelike solo game for PC. Take care of your cats, decorate multiple rooms in the Cat-Castle and play the strategic Dice Builder Rogulike!

demos.name: Pantheon Demo
demos.short_description: Dark Matter God × unemployed girl. Urban Fantasy Visual Novel for Women.

demos.name: Sweet Hamster Days Demo
demos.short_description: I got reincarnated... as a hamster! My owners are three sisters: a charming cosplayer, a straight-laced and caring one, and one with a sharp tongue and a sweet side. I'm being showered in love... but who will I fall in love with?

demos.name: INFINITAVERN Demo
demos.short_description: Build and grow your own infinitely expanding tavern in this cozy idle incremental game. Hire staff, brew alcohol, cook meals, meet quirky characters and expand your business as multiple systems work together to generate profits and scale your operation forever!

demos.name: 代号清风 Demo
demos.short_description: Code Qingfeng is an interactive cinematic experience featuring multiple heroines, branching storylines, and a range of endings. Every choice you make reshapes the course of fate.

demos.name: The Adventures of Graham Demo
demos.short_description: Start your adventure with this free short snippet of the beginning of The Adventures of Graham!

demos.name: Echoes of Stella Demo
demos.short_description: Echoes of Stella is a first-person horror adventure built around a unique echolocation device. Use it to navigate a distorted mirror world, revealing your surroundings in brief moments of clarity. Time your scans carefully, or risk exposing yourself.

demos.name: Paranormal Footages : Supervisor Demo
demos.short_description: Paranormal Footages: Supervisor Demo — a prequel to the events of the main game. Archie is supposed to finish his last shift at the warehouse before his transfer, but inexplicable events begin to unfold.

highlights.trailer_name: Paranormal Footages : Supervisor - Demo Gameplay Trailer

demos.name: Swipe Swish Demo
demos.short_description: Master the art of the perfect shot in this physics-based arcade game. Use your mouse to control the angle and power of your arm, ensuring a "swish" from the free-throw line or all the way from the logo.

demos.name: Screen Survivors Demo
demos.short_description: An idle survivor-like that sits in the corner of your screen.

demos.name: Sylv and the Ancient Tree Demo
demos.short_description: Reclaim the Ancient Tree's power from the clutches of Demoness Umbra. In this RPG platformer, help Sylv stop a selfish villain seeking eternal youth at the expense of Sunroot Island. Master your skills and restore balance before her vanity consumes the world!

demos.name: Mind Match Demo
demos.short_description:
Not your usual Match-3 or Roguelite.
Match ideas to charge your Heroes, chain devastating combos and collect Relics 
that rewrite the rules. Climb the Tower, rescue its lost Heroes, and unravel 
the mystery of what awaits at the top.

demos.name: Forgotten Fluff Demo
demos.short_description: Forgotten Fluff is a mysterious escape the room game set inside an abandoned circus. Solve puzzles, help trapped animals and slowly uncover the truth about the strange place you've awakened in. Can you escape?

demos.name: One Dumb Wizard Demo
demos.short_description: One Dumb Wizard is an action roguelike where you play as a wizard hell-bent on getting their money back from the Bartender. Find charms to power up your wand, parts to craft new wands, and strategically sling spells in your singular mission to GET YOUR MONEY BACK.

demos.name: Space Slinger Demo
demos.short_description: Space Slinger is an arcade roguelike about a traveler and his recoil-packed gun where you shoot to move. Unlock unique weapons and broken builds as you conquer space one enemy at a time.

demos.name: The Sound of Piano Demo
demos.short_description: A hardcore keyboard rhythm game with pure piano tracks. Every note hit generates a real piano key sound. Designed for intermediate+ players, use our skill test to find your rating. No AI music, just raw human-crafted tracks. Features an Auto MIDI Converter to import and play your own files.

highlights.trailer_name: The Sound of Piano Trailer 1 - Game
The Sound of Piano Trailer 2 - Tracks
The Sound of Piano Trailer 3 - MIDI Converter

demos.name: Zozo and the Lost Dreams Demo
demos.short_description: Help Zozo find his way home in this cartoon-inspired casual Metroidvania platformer. Pillow-fight sentient pastries, train under an octopus master, and brave a cybernetic jungle as you explore the vibrant landscapes of Zozo's dreams.

highlights.trailer_name: Zozo and the Lost Dreams Demo is Here!

demos.name: BOOTH BUTCHER Demo
demos.short_description: A free playable demo of BOOTH BUTCHER, a PSX slasher set in a grimy 1980s cinema. A hooded maniac, a meat cleaver, and no way out. Coming 2026.

demos.name: HEAVYDELIC Demo
demos.short_description: HEAVYDELIC is a 2D Slavic Synthpunk Platformer broadcasting on dead frequencies. Synthetic psychedelia, comic art, VHS tapes, analog ruins & robots resurrected from Slavic mythology. Every asset is manually drawn by Eniac. Signal lost. Game found.

demos.name: RIPCORE Demo
demos.short_description: KILL. EVOLVE. REPEAT. Fight through 9 circles of Hell in this high-octane roguelike FPS. Craft overpowered builds with stacking upgrades to crush thousands of demons and defeat legendary bosses. Hell is full—start cleaning.

demos.name: Vanisha Demo
demos.short_description: A progression-driven twin-stick shooter. Customize ships, combine powerful cards, and forge unique builds through a massive talent tree as you race to stop the Anomaly.

demos.name: Play Faster Demo
demos.short_description: Play Faster is a speedrunning-first precision platformer: short, intense runs, instant retries, pixel-perfect movement, built-in speedrunning tools and deterministic runs.

demos.name: Fame Or Folly Demo
demos.short_description: The outrageous traveling troupe roguelike deckbuilder. Put on shows across the kingdom, push your luck at the risk of upsetting the crowd. Pivot your deck using a variety of cards, banners, and props. Become the king of the festival either solo or in ranked multiplayer!

highlights.trailer_name: Fame or Folly Trailer - Play the Demo Now
Fame Or Folly Multiplayer Demo Trailer

demos.name: Iris Grid Demo
demos.short_description: Match by color or value. Chain combos. Craft builds. Outsmart 40+ levels that twist the rules. A roguelite tile-matching strategy game where every match feeds a scoring engine you design. 120+ cores, items, and patches. No two runs play the same.

demos.name: Lamp Clicker Demo
demos.short_description: A small preview of Lamp Clicker — a simple idle/clicker game about… well, clicking a lamp.

demos.name: The Meaning of Auri Demo
demos.short_description: Follow an Auri Field Researcher from the planet Auriga, as they land in an enchanted forest full of creatures who speak an unknown language. Interact with the inhabitants of the forest and learn their language to complete your research–and maybe learn a thing or two about what Auri really means.

demos.name: Joey's Nightmare II Demo
demos.short_description:
What if your everyday memories became nightmares?
Joey’s Nightmare II is a hand-drawn roguelike deckbuilder where stories, animals, and little moments from the day transform into bizarre dream monsters. Build your deck, gain blessings, and fight your way through the nightmare.

demos.name: 挂机破坏神 IdleWrecker Demo
demos.short_description: 《IdleDiablo》is a Diablo-inspired idle loot game. Earn resources while idle, build your equipment & skills, and conquer all foes!

demos.name: 致，我亲爱的 Demo
demos.short_description: A narrative-driven psychological horror visual novel. Player's choices lead to distinct emotional paths and story outcomes. "You" navigate a shifting consciousness, making choices within fragmented scenes that buried memories.

demos.name: Blast'N Bounty Demo
demos.short_description: Blast’N Bounty is a vertical scrolling shoot’em up featuring 8 stages players can tackle in the order of their choosing. Cruise through a crazy solar system in a mix of pixel art and low poly 3D with action that’s easy to learn but tough to master!

demos.name: TurtleSkate Demo
demos.short_description: Skate as a turtle, complete objectives, avoid entities, and escape. 1-5 player co-op horror.

demos.name: CrazyLobsterDemo
demos.short_description: A lobster spends its entire life constantly opening and sealing boxes.

demos.name: Hamdy: a Roguelike Farm Mayhem Demo
Potion & Fortune Demo
demos.short_description:
Build your shop, gather ingredients, brew potions. Listen carefully to your customers, distinguish the good from the wicked.
Fight monsters in the darkness of night, take risky decisions, and become your people’s fearless mage.

demos.name: Backrooms Dream with Tung Tung Tung Sahur Demo
demos.short_description: Experience the first 2 days of Backrooms Dream with Tung Tung Tung Sahur. Wake up, prepare for work, and watch an ordinary life turn into a disturbing nightmare filled with strange events, impossible spaces, and the first signs of Sahur.

highlights.trailer_name: I Spent 5 Minutes Making This Masterpiece - Demo Backrooms Sahur

demos.name: Quod Erat Demonstrandum Demo
demos.short_description: Discover the challenging fun of validating logical proofs, beginning with simple propositional calculus and ending with complex, multi-domain propositional calculus. Prove yourself to be a master of logical thinking!

demos.name: 中国式新人 Demo
demos.short_description: "Chinese Newcomer" blends deck-building with career simulation. Players choose one of three cards to collect, manage stamina. Use "Legacy Points" to grant Five-Elements talents to descendants, rectifying past regrets. Make choices along paths and embarking on a multi-generational journey.

demos.name: Stuck in the Sewers Demo
demos.short_description: Stuck in the Sewers is a puzzle-adventure game where you push, turn and reshape pipes to carve your way forward. Unlock new abilities, discover areas with unique mechanics and tools, and explore a world interconnected by a vast sewer system.

demos.name: Major Mutt Demo
demos.short_description: Play as a combat ready pup in this 3D survivorlike. Blast through swarms of giant critters with auto firing weapons attached to your harness, but don't just survive, Do Your Job! Herd lost sheep to safety to earn permanent stat boosts and become the ultimate Good Boy

demos.name: Electric Shadows Demo
demos.short_description:
Time is your penalty! No lives—getting hit drains your clock. Slay enemies and harvest energy before time runs out! "Strike first, strike fast!"

Shatter shields and unleash massive counter lasers with a Perfect Parry!

"Den-ei Taisen" evolves every play. Pick 1 of 3 skills. High-speed roguelite!

demos.name: Patchkins Party Demo
demos.short_description: Patchkins is a multiplayer racing game for 2 to 6 players where you build the course as you play. Each round, players draw and place objects like Platforms, Obstacles, and Specials, then race to the finish without dying.

demos.name: Half Left Demo
demos.short_description: Trapped inside a quarantined research complex, a wheelchair-bound nurse must survive a curse beyond human comprehension.

demos.name: Black Flower Demo
demos.short_description: Black Flower is a strategic roguelike about surviving and growing a fragile garden through a magical calendar. Make tough daily choices, face unpredictable weather, and uncover the secret of a mysterious black seed.

demos.name: The Anomaly Department Demo
demos.short_description: Observe. Patrol. Report. Spot anomalies with your team in tense, bite-sized rounds. Wrong votes trigger chaotic punishments and unexpected consequences.

demos.name: Realms and Ruins: Abencor Demo
demos.short_description: Realms & Ruins: Abencor is a first-person, grid-based, open world, retro, pixel art dungeon crawler harkening back to the days of yore. Realms & Ruins takes inspiration from games like Wizardry and Might & Magic and other cRPG's of the 90's. This demo features a small area you can discover in game!

demos.name: Tiny Throne Demo
demos.short_description: Tiny Throne is a cozy medieval roguelike deckbuilder where your deck is your kingdom. Draft blueprints to expand your village, play resource cards to feed your settlers, and deploy tactical units from your hand. Build your engine, manage your population, and lead raids to claim the throne!

demos.name: Island For Sale Demo
demos.short_description: If you've set foot on this foggy trash island, congratulations! You're rich. Pick up trash and sell it off.

demos.name: Runisthar Demo
demos.short_description: Master the Power of Runes in a tactical and highly modular roguelike. Use elements, create lethal synergies, and annihilate your opponents. Offense is the only rule.

demos.name: Zero Sum Demo
demos.short_description: Your enemies are numbers. Your weapons are math. A twin-stick shooter roguelite where you subtract, divide, root and modulo your way through angry digits. Tuned to your skill level, from basic arithmetic to advanced operations. Reduce them all to zero. You failed math class. Math didn't forget.

demos.name: Mechanical Defense Line Demo
demos.short_description: This is a tower defense, card-based roguelike game. Build and modify your turrets, equip gear to challenge levels and experience the story. Strengthen yourself via various functions, choose talents in battles to win. Get no less than 10 pieces of equipment in every fight.More content awaits in-game

demos.name: WallFront Demo
demos.short_description: Defend the final wall in this strategic blend of Tower Defense and Roguelite. Position an elite squad with unique abilities, combine powerful artifacts, and evolve with permanent meta-progression. In Wallfront, every defeat strengthens your next line of defense.

demos.name: Rogue Planet Demo
demos.short_description: A Sci-Fi, action-packed fantasy demo which introduces you to the world of Rogue and the plan to escape from comfort and certainty. Help your friends find the exit and prepare for the quest!

demos.name: Vellar Demo
demos.short_description: Vellar is a first-person psychological horror game where a family is dead… but the recordings they left behind slowly reveal a version of events that doesn’t match reality. Explore a shifting house filled with impossible rooms, distorted corridors, and uncover a truth that refuses to stay buried.

demos.name: Dice Tavern: Farkle Roguelike Demo
demos.short_description: Dice Tavern is a roguelike deckbuilding game built around the classic rules of Farkle. Collect 23 unique dice, combine 17 Synergies and put your luck to the test in a candlelit medieval tavern. Use dice as your weapon and luck as your wager. This time, will you Roll Again or Take the Win?

demos.name: Warlane Demo
demos.short_description: Warlane is a real-time 1v1 strategy game where players draft random units, deploy them to the battlefield, and merge them into powerful fighters to take down the enemy King. Choose Instincts to shape your army's traits, and invest your gold to outplay your opponent.

demos.name: Stickerino Demo
demos.short_description: Slap stickers onto your cards and beat the score counter with astronomical multipliers in this roguelite deckbuilder! Collect snacks and Monstraks game-changers, flex your style, and crush Sticker Wizard's challenges!

demos.name: Vecchio Furioso Demo
demos.short_description: An old school FPS set in the lawless of 1962 rural Isan, Thailand. Step into the worn sandals of an old veteran fighting off ruthless local debt collectors and bandits. Scavenge weapons, survive dynamic tropical storms, and clear your debt in an uncompromising sandbox of mechanical freedom.

highlights.trailer_name: Vecchio Furioso : เดือดสะท้านทุ่ง Gameplay Trailer

demos.name: Pacremental Demo
demos.short_description: Pacremental is a incremental game about opening packs, unlocking weapon cards, evolve them and automating your progress. Collect rare artifacts, combine them with weapons, and push through increasingly difficult waves. Build tower your own way.

demos.name: Set In Stone Demo
demos.short_description: Explore a unique level and fight a boss! Get a taste of Set In Stone's platforming and fighting mechanics without getting the main game spoiled. This small sample contains secrets to find and bits of lore, can you find them all?

demos.name: Hastilude Clash Demo
demos.short_description: Master the art of the duel in Hastilude Clash, a high-speed, 4-player party fighter. This demo includes 2-4 player local multiplayer battles and single player against bots.

demos.name: Damnation84 No Man's Land Demo
demos.short_description: Damnation84 is a fast-paced FPS game that uses impulse and propulsion weapons as a means of movement and combat. In this devastated world, eliminate enemies in sequence and complete the levels before your oxygen runs out. You are the last hope, survive and cause damnation.

demos.name: Storm Clan Demo
demos.short_description: Race across the alien ocean in a high-speed boat in this deck-building bullet hell. Weave through waves of bizarre enemies while dodging glowing projectiles and build your deck to overcharge weapons, add bounces and spreads, and survive escalating chaos.

demos.name: 呪霊が見せる夢 / Dreamscapes Demo
developers: アイエダゲームズ（Aieda Games）
publishers: アイエダゲームズ（Aieda Games）
demos.short_description:
Visit the room you toured by day, once more in your dreams at night. Waiting there are ghosts pleading, "Let me out."
Dreamscapes is a horror adventure set in six haunted properties. Gather clues to perform rituals and release trapped spirits.
This demo features the story's prologue.

demos.name: 记忆画廊 Demo
demos.short_description:
A light fantasy visual novel.
After losing your memory in a car accident, you take over an art gallery to recover your blank past — every painting holds the same blurry figure.

demos.name: Pool Glow Demo
demos.short_description: Pool Glow is an immersive exploration game inspired by Poolcore. Experience the demo version for a small but complete 'Poolcore' experience.

demos.name: Chop Sous-Y-Chef Demo
demos.short_description: No holds barred boomer shooter with beat 'em up + hack n' slash elements. They thought it was a quick in and out job. They thought they were gonna make Chop suey outta the Sous-chef. But they got it all wrong. Now he's preparing a very special three course meal for them that they'll never forget...

demos.name: Next Station Demo
demos.short_description: Next Station (Demo): A surreal Survival Horror/Walking Simulator. Trapped in mysterious, lonely rooms, you must solve puzzles, survive monsters, and avoid traps to find the exit. Experience a dark, immersive atmosphere with unique NPCs and creatures reflecting the void. Can you find your way out?

highlights.trailer_name: NEXT STATION | Official Demo Trailer - eng

demos.name: The Unclosed Case Demo
demos.short_description: A psychological detective thriller. Everyone has already decided who did it. You don't have to. Investigate a double death, question everyone who loved them, and discover how much you can trust your own mind.

demos.name: TocoToco
demos.short_description: TocoToco is an addictive platform game where every jump counts. Explore colorful levels, dodge challenging obstacles, and uncover hidden secrets while testing your reflexes. Easy to learn, hard to master.

demos.name: Desolation Arcanist Demo
demos.short_description: Craft your own magic in this Action Roguelite. "Program" your wands with varied Spell Cores (Fireballs, Flying Swords... or Watermelons?) and Runes. Raise your companion Dragon, command a Puppet army, and abuse physics to knock enemies off cliffs. Your build is your destiny.

demos.name: Milliseconds Matter: Precision Platformer Demo
demos.short_description: Milliseconds Matter is a precision platformer where you run, jump and dash to finish every level as fast as possible. Find clever shortcuts, explore handcrafted levels, and climb leaderboards. How fast can you go?

demos.name: ORE x TRACTOR Demo
demos.short_description: ORE x TRACTOR is a short, incremental game about demolishing space rocks with a variety of weaponry.

highlights.trailer_name: ORE x TRACTOR DEMO ANNOUNCEMENT TRAILER

demos.name: Toybox Havoc: Arcade Combat Racing Demo
Robologs Demo
demos.short_description: Fight against out-of-control zombie robots! This demo is an early preview of Robologs in development. Gear up, try to survive, and help shape the game with your feedback.

demos.name: Gene Crawl: Dungeon Descent Demo
demos.short_description:
> Die. Inherit. Evolve.  
Fight through dungeons, craft gear, brew potions, and collect relics. then die, pass your DNA to the next generation, and push deeper. An idle incremental RPG with a dark secret.

demos.name: The Fifth Bell: Frequency of Secrets Demo
demos.short_description: The Fifth Bell is a premium 2D point-and-click mystery adventure set in 1994 Europe. Investigate hidden mechanisms, decode historical clues, and stop a forbidden instrument before it is awakened.

highlights.trailer_name: The Fifth Bell: Frequency of Secrets Demo

demos.name: Appalachia Demo
demos.short_description: The Mothman is said to haunt these hills, but nothing will stop you from finding your missing Uncle.

demos.name: 糺糺縁糸（きゅうきゅうえんし） Demo
demos.store_url: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4630250/糺糺縁糸きゅうきゅうえんし_Demo

demos.name: Hang Out Demo
demos.short_description:
Hang Out》是一款融合多种玩法的视觉小说游戏。故事从一场记忆残缺的苏醒开始：你在一个诡异的城镇深处醒来，这里的天空被名为“天空之海”的怪物霸占。眼前只有支离破碎的废墟，以及一个似乎与你关系匪浅、却又始终难以看透的熟悉身影。在他的引导下，你被迫一步步接近那些被刻意掩埋的过去。
逐渐异变的居民、各怀鬼胎的不同阵营，还有你逐渐找回的记忆片段，都在暗示着一个你注定必须重新面对的真相，你准备好了吗？

demos.name: Crow's Curated Closet - Shop Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Step into the role of a boutique owner with a flair for the unusual. Decorate your shop, unlock new collections, and create a space your customers won’t want to leave. Grow your business, optimise your layout, and watch the numbers climb. Turn your tiny shop into a thriving gothic fashion powerhouse

demos.name: Project: Haste Demo
demos.short_description: Project: Haste is a first-person multiplayer parkour arena shooter on skates, where skill, style, and speed reign supreme. After hours, skaters hijack civil spaces using 2000s-inspired tech to wall run, double jump, and power slide through newly created chaos playgrounds.

demos.name: Four Directions Demo
demos.short_description: "Four Directions" is a turn-based strategy game that features a rotatable Rubik's Cube chessboard. It cleverly incorporates mechanical tasks and card skills, allowing players to activate mechanisms on the chessboard map to confront enemies head-on.

demos.name: Aurule Dynasty Demo
demos.short_description: Discover hidden secrets. Delve into dungeons. Solve puzzles. Find ancient relics to vanquish bosses. Unravel the mysteries of the Kingdom of Aurule and its talkative denizens in this Zelda-like adventure.

demos.name: PACOSTEP Demo
demos.short_description: PacoStep is a hardcore platformer set in a tree world consumed by darkness. Join Paco, the last surviving spirit, and explore the ruined forest to uncover the source of corruption and reveal the truth hidden in this dying world.

demos.name: Dark Stream Demo
demos.short_description: Step into the opening chapter of Dark Stream. You’re a disgraced content creator chasing one last chance at relevance by livestreaming a night inside a notorious haunted house. Face real paranormal anomalies as your twitch chat influences what happens… for better or worse.

demos.name: Love Matrix Demo
demos.short_description: Prep your viewing holes for: the Love Matrix, an erotic incremental alchemy sim where intimacy fuels civilization. Level up your harem, harness pleasure as power, purchase powerful upgrades, and alchemize Coom into civilization.

demos.name: Waking Nightmares Demo
demos.short_description:
Waking Nightmares is a top-down survival horror game
where you're a detective, the last inhabitant of a ghost town,
or at least, that's as far as you remember...
Everyone is gone, and yet you can't seem to remember anyone...
The case is open.
Your objective: Find out what happened to everyone.

demos.name: Exofinity Clicker Demo
demos.short_description: Discover new worlds and earn credits by mining the legendary Infinity Crystal in Exofinity Clicker! Tap to extract rare cosmic minerals, upgrade your buildings and expand your reach as you evolve from a small outpost into a multi-planetary powerhouse.

demos.name: B.O.B.Y's Journey Demo
demos.short_description: Follow a robot’s journey to find the Spiritual Island, seeking the key to offering genuine emotional support while healing and transforming within, a story of resilience, self-discovery, and inner growth.

demos.name: Joe Adventure Demo
demos.short_description: Save Joe Mama and don’t explode any of your Joes by keeping them on the move. You can only control one at a time but they are all exploding at the same time. Throw them around to traverse deadly terrain in this rage-inducing speedrun-friendly platformer!

demos.name: Liminal Shroud Demo
demos.short_description: Explore surreal liminal spaces in this first-person psychological horror game. No-clip through shifting realities and uncover a quiet mystery as the Shroud closes in. DEMO includes first 5 chapters!

demos.name: Mark The Headless Chicken Demo
demos.short_description: Play as a headless chicken on the run from deranged farmers in a stealthy, physics-driven platformer. Dodge traps, sneak through barns, and cause chaotic mayhem as you fight to get your head back.

demos.name: UFOntastic Demo
demos.short_description: Jano has debts to pay, and the easiest place to get money is on Earth! Use your flying saucer: abduct objects, people, enemies and much more from the environment to progress through dungeons and mini-games.  Amass a fortune!

demos.name: Alfred's Alien Abduction Adventure Demo
demos.short_description: Join Alfred in this 3D adventure game (demo version) set onboard a scary alien mothership. In space no one can hear you s#!t yourself, thankfully.

highlights.trailer_name: Alfred's Alien Abduction Adventure - Demo - Trailer 1

demos.name: Undead Night Crew Demo
demos.short_description: You are a manager at the Undead Cleaning Services. Your only job is to build up a crew of auto attacking followers to clean up thousands of the undead. Jump in online with friends and maximize wild synergies! Sign contracts, complete missions, get money, get stronger, do it again!

demos.name: The Friendliest Skunk Demo
demos.short_description: Skunk is the friendliest critter in the forest — but his natural scent makes making friends a bit… tricky. Help Skunk traverse a musical forest, in this charming rhythm-based platformer! Meet adorable forest friends, outwit hungry predators, and prove that kindness (+ good timing) conquers all!

demos.name: Hüddam: The Cursed Mansion Demo
demos.short_description: Hüddam: The Cursed Mansion is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore a 19th-century cursed mansion in Istanbul. Armed with only a flashlight, find the hidden talismans, survive the relentless Djinn, and uncover the dark secrets of Molla Celil.

highlights.trailer_name: Hüddam: The Cursed Mansion Demo Fragman

demos.name: Forgotten Blood Demo
demos.short_description:
Ventured into the Forgotten Valley, banished from a world consumed by the eternal blight.
Descend through corrupted lands, seeking the cure to shatter the cycle of final death.
Forgotten Blood is an action RPG open map with branching paths, ancestral relics, and buried lore.

demos.name: REQUIRED SYNERGY WORKSHOP: Deja Damnation Demo
demos.short_description: Play the opening three chapters of Required Synergy Workshop: Deja Damnation. A mandatory orientation module begins to repeat after someone disappears. Everyone around you needs something, and the System watches how you respond.

demos.name: Aluminium City Demo
demos.short_description: Crush empty cans and sell the aluminium, buy upgrades, automatic can presses, and robots to automatize and speed up your process, and pay off your debt.

demos.name: PAC-SIDE Demo
demos.short_description: PAC-SIDE is a fast-paced pacman-based horror game, where you can meet your old yellow friend! Wait.. It looks like something bad happened with him..

demos.name: Hatarake! - Working Hard! Even though I getting isekai'd! Demo
demos.short_description:
Working Hard! Even though I getting isekai'd! is a simulation game similar to the old Harvest Moon/Rune Factory series.
Set in Grion, a small village somewhere in Xelia.
A fantasy world where magic and monsters are exist.

demos.name: Cosdarica's Journey at the End of the World Demo
demos.short_description:
Human civilization had finally burned out its last spark.
The survivors chose to gather together, shutting themselves within safe zones to await death.
But Cosdarica did not.
Neither did I.

highlights.trailer_name: Cosdarica's Journey at the End of the World

demos.name: Disorientation Syndrome Demo
demos.short_description: Welcome to the company! A friendly boss, harmonious colleagues—everything seems almost too good to be true. But you always feel there's something strange about it. This is a psychological suspense and chilling visual novel that unveils the truth hidden beneath the surface of everyday illusions.

demos.name: Gunmetal Rails Demo
demos.short_description: A roguelite bullet hell where you build trains — that's right, TRAINS. Add carts, bolt on guns, stack upgrades, and see if you can survive. Playstyle? Up to you.

demos.name: Rackpunk: A Wasteland Hustle Demo
demos.short_description: RACKPUNK: A Wasteland Hustle is a physics-based, roguelike rack-builder where you battle post-apocalyptic gangs in a deadly game of pool. Build a rack of complimentary balls, line up your shot, and wreck the enemy’s turf.

demos.name: PARADICE Demo
demos.short_description: Roll the dice, hunt your rivals, and survive the chaos. ParaDice is a fast-paced multiplayer dice racing game where strategy, luck, and betrayal collide.

demos.name: Locked in love : The Office Demo
demos.short_description:
An interactive escape room game where your choices determine your fate. 
Right before a "long holiday," you find yourself trapped in the office with beautiful women for unknown reasons. Collect clues, cooperate with them, and escape this place!

highlights.trailer_name: Locked in love : The Office Demo

demos.name: ComboCraft Legendary Demo
demos.short_description: An Idle incremental clicker focused on crafting symbols, merging combinations, and building automated production. Reset your run to unlock permanent upgrades and grow stronger each cycle.

demos.name: Team Rocket Project Demo
demos.short_description: Team Rocket Project Demo played with 1-4 players is set in a retro futuristic world where you guide a rocket! Wield one or more of the 4 thrusters of the rocket and propel it to your destination! Adventure in unique levels, avoid traps and get the highest score! Two levels available in the demo!

demos.name: Lacustris - The War over Water Demo
demos.short_description:
An innovative, realistic point-and-click game where you step into the shoes of a mysterious character in search of his identity and a shocking truth.
Puzzles to solve, complex dialogue, and realistic graphics are the focus of this engaging game.

demos.name: Tied to the Beat Demo
demos.short_description: Play the free demo of a music-driven arena survivor where lyrics unleash effects across the battlefield. Pick the drums or the violin and survive four songs in Evergreen Forest. Your music. Your weapon.

demos.name: Evades X Demo
demos.short_description: Evade your way through danger with friends in the World's Hardest Precision Game!

demos.name: 孟婆靓汤 Demo
demos.short_description: 一款带有模拟经营元素的纯狱系调饮类视觉小说。玩家扮演新孟婆“小孟娘”，在熟悉又陌生的现代地府中经营汤屋，招待来自三界形形色色的客户。通过熬制各种特调汤品，解决各式千奇八怪脑洞大开的遗忘需求，并逐渐了解到自己失忆和老孟婆失踪的真相……欢迎来到孟婆靓汤！这里的宗旨是——“忘陈莫急”！

demos.name: Mini Pond Farm: Frogs & Lilypads Demo
demos.short_description: Collect all the cute frogs! Shape your pond paradise, fill it with colorful hoppers, make them happy with reeds and lilies, and enjoy pure cozy serenity.

demos.name: Smash Dash: Demolition Run Demo
demos.short_description: Top-down PvE looter shooter. Fight, loot, and survive—extract to keep your items and clear the stage.

demos.name: BassBlock Demo
demos.short_description: BassBlock is a relaxing, casual 2D platformer rhythm jumper. Inspired by Rhythm Heaven and Geometry Dash, it aims to bring simple joy through effortless interaction!

demos.name: Shanwen Demo
demos.short_description: 1990s: Windswept mining town Linshan, dependent on fading coal mines, worshipped a mountain god’s stele. After it cracked and oozed brown liquid, a strange illness spread. Lin Tianqing returned for his sick father, uneasy as the eerie town neared, having overheard whispers.

demos.name: 甲午：北洋风云 Demo
demos.short_description: 《甲午：北洋风云》是一款以甲午战争为背景的复古像素风战棋游戏。你将置身于那个荣光与屈辱交织的时代，指挥北洋水师在惊涛骇浪中与日本联合舰队展开一场场殊死对决。这一次，你已不再是历史的旁观者，每一次移动、每一次炮击都不仅仅是战术的博弈，更是能决定民族命运的走向！

demos.name: Last Night Last Call Demo
demos.short_description: Can you solve a murder with only your wits, cocktail shaker, and silver tongue? Last Night Last Call is a narrative detective game where you mix cocktails, interrogate suspects, gather clues, and shape relationships to solve five murders. Every customer has something to hide.

demos.name: Gnomed Demo
demos.short_description: Gnomed is a roguelite clicker base defence game where your humble home is the last line of defense. Hold out against 20 chaotic waves of enemies, unlock new abilities, and grow stronger each run!

demos.name: Wild Ice Demo
demos.short_description: Grab your stick, build traps, defend the furnaces, and dangle your way to victory against waves of frost zombies in this hockey-themed tower defense game. Play the first 2 battles, complete a few quests, and unlock 5 traps in the demo.

demos.name: Folk Emerging Demo
demos.short_description: Lead nomadic families through the Stone Age in this turn-based 4X strategy game with in-depth characters, cultures, and ecosystems. Explore the wilderness, hunt megafauna, outsmart competitors in trade & autobattler combat. Discover fire, agriculture, politics... and survive to tell the tale.

demos.name: My Adorable Ghost Story Demo
demos.short_description: Play the opening chapter of this cozy, story-driven adventure. Meet the cowardly ghost, complete his first wish, and get a glimpse of the mystery surrounding his death in this short demo.

demos.name: Purranoia Demo
demos.short_description: Purranoia is an action roguelike with a twist: you don’t control movement. Instead, you wield powerful scientific inventions to protect the frightened cat Mousti from waves of questionably designed robots and hostile lab creations.

demos.name: A Little Age Demo
demos.short_description: A cozy minimalist city builder about expanding a network of settlements, each with its own little economy. Manage the flow of resources between them at your own pace, and pause at any time. Watch a civilization emerge as your settlements work together to raise a great temple and claim the land.

demos.name: Tamerlane Chess Demo
demos.short_description:
This isn’t just chess. It’s a war strategy.
Tamerlane Chess is the digital version of the board used by Tamerlane to forge battlefield tactics. With a larger board, unique pieces, and deep strategic play, every move requires the mind of a true commander.

demos.name: Urban Struggle Demo
demos.short_description:
In this world of beliefs and super powers, the mankind is moved by the deities that grant people their powers based in his own convictions but need to have faith, in yourself before the gods.

 A Fighting Game for old and new players, easy to play and deep to joy, can you masterize the game system?

demos.name: Beat & Beasties Demo
demos.short_description: Run and defeat countless enemies and obstacles! Beat & Beasties is an action game that harmoniously blends the thrill of running and roguelike.

demos.name: WuLin Showdown Demo
demos.short_description: A turn-based combat game with deck-building elements. Enter the world of martial arts, a realm of flashing blades and fierce contests, and duel against all manner of warriors. Every step in battle, from your own moves to the enemy's actions, is dictated by your grand strategy.

demos.name: The Gutter Demo
demos.short_description: Descend into 1801 China as an opium-addicted father who sold his daughter, now prowling a burned-out floating brothel for treasures. As you touch relics of the dead, violent memories reveal a sickening truth: the greatest monster in this tale has always been you.

demos.name: Nuktedan: The Forgotten Emotions
demos.short_description: Rediscover the 7 emotions lost by a bird with Alzheimer's. Every memory is a color, every color is a power.

demos.name: Corpus et Spiritus Demo
demos.short_description: Corpus et Spiritus is an alchemy deckbuilder without combat. You signed a pact with a demon, and it was a bad idea… Gather rare metals, then use your workshop to transform them into powerful cards and magical talismans. Find the best combos and break out of the pact before your partner kills you!

demos.name: A Deck Full of Hex Demo
Wish Demo
demos.short_description: Wish Demo – Trial Version. Experience a playable preview of Wish. Tap to gain Spirit Energy, honor guardians, upgrade Resonators, and relax in a Zen atmosphere.

demos.name: Brave Saga: Artifact Reborn Demo
demos.short_description: 《Brave Saga: Artifact Reborn》is a customizable RPG game where you take on the role of a hero, search for suitable teammates to embark on an adventure together, find the seven legendary artifacts, crush the enemy's conspiracy, and ultimately defeat powerful enemies to save the world!

demos.name: ETERNAL ROMANCE Complete Edition Plus Demo
demos.short_description:
This is a 2D side-scrolling action game in which a futanari girl get ejaculated and/or ejaculate.
The protagonist Sophie, is cursed by the succubus Fara, causing her to become constantly aroused.
In order to lift the curse, Sophie sets out on a journey to find Fara…

demos.name: Silan: Monster Girl Master! Demo
demos.short_description: Silan: Monster Girl Master is a soulslike-inspired monster girl collection RPG developed solo over 2 years. Recruit and strengthen 60+ monster girls with unique skills and attributes, explore forests, deserts, volcanoes, and more, and experience Rance X-inspired combat. DEMO available now!

demos.name: MergePiece: Merge pixels into masterpieces Demo
demos.short_description: MergePiece is a pixel-merging puzzle game themed around world-famous paintings. On the board, every color fragment originates from a real masterpiece — your mission is to merge them back into the complete artwork.

demos.name: Survivors Under Siege Demo
demos.short_description: Survivors Under Siege blends action RTS and tower defense into a minimalist tactical experience. Position your units wisely and strike at the perfect moment to stand against waves of zombies and mutants.

demos.name: Hardcore Soldier Demo
demos.short_description: Test yourself and see if you can beat one stage from Hardcore Soldier in this Demo.

demos.name: 100 Cats Lost in Netherlands Find & Color Demo
100 Cats Lost in Norway Find & Color Demo
100 Cats Lost in South Korea Find & Color Demo
100 Cats Lost In England 2 Find & Color Demo
100 Cats Lost in Russia Find & Color Demo
NULL Demo
demos.short_description: You moved in on a quiet street. Your neighbour said goodnight like he already knew something. Your mother never knocked on your door. And the night you arrived has not ended yet.

demos.name: DeadWave Demo
demos.short_description: Squad up or go solo in a stylized arcade zombie shooter where every round gets deadlier. Killstreaks, nukes, dynamic weather in day or night.... how long can you survive?

demos.name: PR0B-1E: Expedition Origin Demo
demos.short_description: A sci-fi action-adventure game focused on physics-driven asteroid mining as a probe bot. Smash rocks together with a grapple hook, haul them home using a magnetic stasis field and cash in to upgrade your abilities. Solve puzzles and acquire new robotic friends as you explore a mysterious galaxy.

demos.name: Loophole: The Prison Break Demo
demos.short_description: Break out of prison with your past selves. In this top-down 3D puzzle-platformer demo, record your actions, reset the loop, and coordinate with your clones to solve impossible escape puzzles.

demos.name: Rombykon Demo
demos.short_description: Are you feeling curious and eager to try Rombykon? Download the free demo now and enjoy a small taste of the game. Your demo save files are fully compatible with the full version!

demos.name: Machine Gun Knight Demo
demos.short_description: Machine Gun Knight is a fast-paced vertical roguelike shooter where reflexes, positioning, and a bit of luck decide your run.

demos.name: Shadow Rush Demo
demos.short_description: Slay hordes of Shadow Demons in this Action RPG with roguelike elements. Fast-paced combat, quick runs, build experimentation, and re-rolling characters. Spells are collectable, equip-able 'Shards' that trigger when you attack. CAN YOU BEAT THE SPEED OF DARKNESS?

demos.name: Slotlander Demo
demos.short_description:
A short incremental game about a gambling addict whose trip to rehab goes wrong.
After a plane crash, you wake up alone on a tropical island with a broken slot machine on the beach.
One wish brings it to life.
Spins are free. No penalties. No one telling you to stop.

demos.name: Kill Cast Demo
demos.short_description: Born from classic arcade top down shooters like Smash TV and 80’s action thriller The Running Man! Welcome to Kill Cast Show! An FPS endless shooter where you must survive endless wave of mutants. It's the gameshow of the future where contestants fight for survival.

demos.name: Delegatory Demo
demos.short_description: A short incremental game about climbing the ranks within a dystopian retro-future corporation. Delegate tasks to your increasingly underpaid team of interns. Leverage a large branching skill tree to upgrade your team's efficiencies, and unlock unique powers.

demos.name: Flip & Shop Simulator Demo
demos.short_description:
All simulators in one game!  
A cooperative city simulator where you and your friends manage businesses in a single large world.  
Open stores, earn money, and develop the shared city - together or separately.

demos.name: Memories Loaming, November
