demos.short_description: A game about becoming unstable. A single player horror adventure set in a forgotten stretch of Labrador, Canada. Try to remain balanced while being chased by monsters. The environments change between visits, rewarding and punishing familiarity. Also, there's a bear.

demos.name: Dissociated Worth Demo
demos.short_description: You have no power. No allies. No certainty. A cryptic force sends you to face the impossible, where you have to see through your opponents lies before they see through yours, be they human or not.

demos.name: Blood Lily: Killers Can't Sink a Yuri Ship Demo
developers: MaouCat Studio / 魔王貓工作室
demos.short_description: A B-horror mystery comedy adventure game. Having a crush on your bestie is hard enough without serial killers in the way! Lily's vacay plan to romance her crush Sally goes wrong when killers keep cropping up and ruining the mood. And that means war. "How dare you come between Sally and me!"

highlights.trailer_name: Blood Lily Killers Can't Sink a Yuri Ship - Opening
Blood Lily Killers Can't Sink a Yuri Ship – Ch. 2 Opening

demos.name: Cool Game Pack Demo
demos.short_description: Cool Game Pack is a collection of high-quality mini games with retro vibes and offers an unique blend of logic, physics, and reflex-based. Unwind and engage your mind with fun, just like in the good old days!

demos.name: Destiny Worlds - Sci-Fi Visual Novel Demo
demos.short_description:
An Interegalactic Sheriff needs to solve the mystery of a new terrorist known as the Dragon Whisperer before it is too late. For fans of Science Fiction and Anime, as well as Visual Novel enthusiasts who want to uncover every secret ending there is.

In the Demo, you play through the game intro.

demos.name: Haamupeli: Wrath of The Iku-Turso - Demo
demos.short_description: Haamupeli: Wrath of the Iku-Turso is a fantasy-themed action RPG adventure game about vanquishing an ancient threat. Recruit allies, find powerful items, develop your character and interact with the game world and its inhabitants to archieve your goals.

demos.name: Assault On Sector 12 Demo
demos.short_description: A turn-based, squad-focused tactical defense game where your squad holds the line against advancing enemy waves.

demos.name: Union Of Rivals Demo
demos.short_description: Build the railroad from East to West across an untamed frontier. Found towns, harvest and refine the goods that fuel the line, then persuade or outlast the settlements blocking your path. Every citizen has a name, a trait, and a breaking point. The rails are coming. Build, trade, or break them.

demos.name: PIECES OF THE DEEP Demo
demos.short_description: Demo version of PIECES OF THE DEEP, an auto-run roguelite action game. Survive procedurally generated underwater dungeons, defeat the first boss, and recover ancient relics in this playable first dungeon experience.

demos.name: Blades & Battles Demo
demos.short_description: Relive the era of beat 'em ups in a new legend! Wield your sword as Arthur or Lancelot and fight side by side in epic battles inspired by the classic Golden Axe, now in 3D with pixelated 2.5D graphics and full of retro action.

demos.name: Dry Meadow Demo
demos.short_description: Fight, sneak & scavenge your way through the first level of Dry Meadow. Light fires, drink vodka and smoke cigarettes in shaky hideouts.

demos.name: Tribal Trouble: Resurrected Demo
demos.short_description: The most troublesome RTS returns, free forever. Easy to pick up, tough to put down. Play as Vikings or Natives, build your tribe, and battle across randomly generated islands with up to 12 players online. A community-driven revival of a cult classic. Come cause some trouble!

demos.name: NoodlePunk Demo
demos.short_description: Forced into a corporate-mandated work program, you run a cyberpunk noodle shop to pay off a crushing debt. Prepare orders fast, manage your ingredients, and upgrade your operation while keeping up with relentless customer drones.

demos.name: Crystal Harvest: Apex Operator Demo
demos.short_description: Crack, mine, and sell mystical crystals while fighting alien hordes on various planets in this fast-paced incremental mining extraction roguelite hybrid experience. Earn currency to spend across upgrade categories with permanent progression and powerful builds in runs.

highlights.trailer_name: Crystal Harvest: Apex Operator Alpha Trailer

demos.name: Fractured Realms Demo
demos.short_description: Train classic RPG skills, build and upgrade your own outpost, and progress through a handcrafted fantasy world in this idle-style, UI-driven pixel RPG inspired by RuneScape and Melvor Idle

demos.name: Graveyard Report Demo
demos.short_description: Collect evidence by capturing photos of anomalies. Monitor security footage for areas inhabiting strange activity, objects, or entities. Meet your hourly evidence quota and fulfill requests or you'll be fired! Solve puzzles, find answers, and uncover the truth, all while trying to survive the night.

demos.name: DODECIUM Demo
demos.short_description: Solo Indie delivers a local 1-4 player split-screen physics-based create and combat sandbox with scientific tools for PvP or PvE. Replay dozens of unique campaigns. Master your hex build strategy, microscopes, and chemistry skills. Be clever to achieve victory and learn as you go. June NEXT FEST.

demos.name: Cook Cook Village ~! Demo
demos.short_description: 《Cook Cook Village》 is a deck-building roguelike where you run shops using resource tokens to gain certain amount of fullness. Operate your shops day by day, earn rewards from villagers, and build a deck that leads to big success.

demos.name: Labyrinth of the Crystal Princess Demo
RobotzZz Demo
demos.short_description: A robot, after humanity. The beat builds the world. Chase it or fall behind. Chain pickups, build combos, survive three stages of escalating rhythm.

demos.name: The Birth Cry Demo
demos.short_description: "Mikhail Markov lives in the city of Nesgrad, Virelia, during the 1990s. The city's old birthplace, 'Riverside Maternity Hospital,' has been shut down, and numerous urban legends and paranormal claims about its location circulate among the public."

demos.name: Harvest Looper Demo
demos.short_description: Harvest plants, unlock upgrades, and expand your farming loop through skill trees, perks, and powerful harvesters. Collect fragments, complete Hidden Book sets, and optimize your incremental growth.

demos.name: Manifest Moonfall 月球坠落 Demo
demos.short_description: Manifest Moonfall is a roguelike deckbuilder fusing cosmic horror and cyberpunk aesthetics. Manage your Emotion, make strategic choices between side-scrolling exploration and tactical combat, and break the eternal time loop.

demos.name: FERALPALS Demo: Chapter 1
demos.short_description: Feralpals is a chapter-based mascot horror game. Humanity was wiped out by a pathogen linked to Friendly Pals, genetically engineered creatures, granted human-like intelligence to serve mankind’s ambitions. The Pals are now left behind, imitating their creators' society long after humanity vanished.

demos.name: LichXCoven Demo
demos.short_description: Fall in love with gorgeous witches as you help them become stronger. Destroy monsters floor by floor with clicks & chain reactions, upgrade the girls and enjoy some well deserved good time with them in animated hentai scenes and heartwarming voiced dialogues.

demos.name: Sea You Around Demo
demos.short_description: The sea is a gamble—how well do the gods favor you? Command a fleet of monster hunters in a Roulette-lite tactical RPG where your ships are the balls and the boss is the wheel. Manipulate the winds, manage your crew, and bet your life against the Colossi to reclaim a world drowned in Miasma.

demos.name: Ling House: Echoes Within Demo
demos.short_description: Ling House: Echoes Within is a first-person psychological horror experience. Uncover the hidden tragedy beneath the surface of a haunted house. As reality breaks down, your video camera reveals images of an alternate space. You must see through the connection between both worlds to escape.

demos.name: Miraclawns Demo
demos.short_description: A unique roguelite strategy where you strengthen slimes through gambling. As the Demon King, use fate-altering bets to boost your small slimes' stats and deploy them to the frontlines. Will your judgment or overwhelming "luck" overcome the brutal battlefield?

demos.name: NETRUN Demo
demos.short_description: With dual grappling hooks in hand, swing, thrust, and dash your way to victory in this fast, momentum-based precision platformer packed with traps, enemies, and physics-based challenges.

demos.name: Bloody Grids Demo
demos.short_description: A single move to carve a path through blood.Use the information on the grid to avoid, fight, and devour unseen enemies in this Minesweeper-style puzzle adventure.

demos.name: Indian Street Food Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Run your own simple and friendly Indian street food stall. Serve customers from your roadside stand, cook authentic dishes and absurd food combos, manage limited ingredients, and keep up with orders. A chaotic yet warm single-player experience focused on your stall.

demos.name: 90 Minutes Till The World Ends Demo
am I STILL me：デッキ構築ローグライト Demo
Giantess Striker Demo
demos.short_description:
Take down giant beauties taller than skyscrapers with a single shot from your ship!
This game is an exhilarating one-versus-many strip-shooting game where you use your shots to completely destroy the giant girls’ outfits.

demos.name: Showrunners Demo
demos.short_description: A single player, fast paced, speed running platformer focused on building up and maintaining high speeds, performing tricks and mastering the use of movement to achieve the fastest time and greatest score. Find and unlock new movement options to help you escape the gameshow you are trapped in.

demos.name: Text Dungeon: The Ring of Life Demo
Forty Foes Demo
demos.short_description: Pugilists prepare, The battle is about to begin...Forty Foes is a side-scrolling action adventure Beat 'em up in the style of classics like Double Dragon Battle Toads and Turtles in Time.

demos.name: Candles Aren't Eternal Demo
demos.short_description: Candles aren't eternal, and you need to light them up again to find lost objects in this casual, single player adventure rpg. Get missions, make candles, go on adventure! Those old dark dungeons and caves are waiting you.

demos.name: Bullet Train Demo
demos.short_description: Welcome on the Bullet Train: destroy enemy towers, collect powerful orbs and improve your train! Fight through escalating enemy territory to defeat the creatures that destroyed your town!

demos.name: Glamour Photographer Demo
demos.short_description: Fulfill your dream of becoming a glamour photographer, meet beautiful women from different cultures and backgrounds, and maybe even marry one of them!

demos.name: At Your Feet 2 Demo
demos.short_description: Linda arrives on the tropical island of Trigue for work, but finds romance instead. This yuri visual novel features three gorgeous women to woo, including Alex from Summer in Trigue. Explore a story centered on foot fetishes and unique kinks with multiple routes and comic-style CGs.

demos.name: Where the Heart is Season 2 Demo
Rock Diver Demo
demos.short_description:
Land, mine, fill your pack, and head back to your ship.
Become a Rock Diver in this incremental adventure as you travel across alien worlds, extract valuable minerals, upgrade your gear, and greet the locals along the way.

demos.name: SkyVeil Demo
demos.short_description: SkyVeil is an elegant evolution of the puzzle genre — and a moving, artful tale told entirely through illustration. Arrange and combine illustrated panels to awaken an ancient city hidden in the clouds — and uncover the secret it has kept for centuries.

demos.name: How Empires Work Demo
demos.short_description:
An incremental strategy game about building the machinery of empire. Build your economy and military, and automate them into institutions of power that expand your reach across centuries of history.

Grow from humble beginnings to take your place on the world stage!

highlights.trailer_name: Third Annual Symposium on How Empires Work

demos.name: The Old Flesh of Nuraga (Demo)
demos.short_description: First person psychological horror game about treasure hunting with your grandpa. Search among the sands of Nuraga to unearth what's driving him mad. The Ancient Times are seeping out. Will you succumb to them?

demos.name: The Background Warrior Demo
demos.short_description: Always open at the bottom of your screen, this idle game lets you advance through stages full of monsters. Master different jobs and become the strongest.

demos.name: Welcome Demon Demo
demos.short_description: Judge otherworldly creatures, determine their sentences, and assign them to the correct dungeons using your rulebook. Keep Tempo above zero and Chaos below 100 as you struggle to survive 666 hours as the prison’s new warden.

demos.name: The Bird of the North Demo
demos.short_description:
In 1921: a kidnapping, a revolution...
Investigate and uncover the truth behind a dark, mysterious story.

demos.name: Car Stunt Mania Demo
demos.short_description: A physics-based 2D stunt racer with endless procedurally generated terrain. Pull off frontflips, backflips and huge combos across 5 environments with 24 unlockable vehicles. Rack up your score, upgrade your ride, and see how far you can  go before you crash.

demos.name: BookStore Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Open your dream bookstore and begin sowing the seeds of knowledge among locals. Push the boundaries of possibility and immerse your business in a world of magic.

demos.name: Slay the GoblinZ Demo
demos.short_description:
It is a demo version of Slay the GoblinZ
Slay the GoblinZ - is a dark fantasy incremental RPG where you take on a job to exterminate goblins. Craft unique weapons, master deadly skills, and put an end to the Goblin Forefather.

demos.name: Cubic Spree Demo
demos.short_description: Cubic Spree is a fast-paced 2D shooter. Play locally and online with your friends, choose your weapons, and blast your way to victory with colorful chaos!

demos.name: Cauldron Inn Demo
demos.short_description: Trying to save yourselfe something unknown but unmistakably sinister, you hide in a mysterious inn. However, your temporary refuge turns out to be a trap, and now you must find a way to escape.

demos.name: Echoes Demo
demos.short_description: Play the first chapter of Echoes, a psychological horror adventure driven by choice and professional voice acting. Wake up with no memories on a cursed route, explore a mysterious cabin in the woods, and unearth the dark secrets from which there is no escape.

demos.name: Just Grow Demo
demos.short_description: Jump into this fast-paced action-roguelite and purge a cursed orphanage! Crush murderous toys with your bare hands, spend looted souls on arcade machines, and chain your abilities into devastating combos to end the nightmare once and for all.

demos.name: Twin Of Time : Parkour Puzzle Game Demo
demos.short_description: TwinOfTime is a sci-fi themed co-op parkour and puzzle game.Set in a massive laboratory,the story focuses on two identicalcharacters who are not separated by time,but split within the same timeline.Players solve physics-based puzzles,perform parkour challenges,and work together to repair the reactor

demos.name: DODGE-AND-RUN! Demo
demos.short_description: You forgot to offer an offering to the God of Thunder!? Hurry and go apologize! Become a ninja and dash through a Japanese-style world! A high-speed Japanese-style action game!

demos.name: SANGUINE CYCLE; REDUX Demo
demos.short_description: A narrative-driven thriller about missing people, stagnant towns, and the fact that even if you love someone, you can't always see the good sides of them when push comes to shove.

demos.name: Everything Mart Demo
demos.short_description: Clock in, meet your productivity quota, and survive your shift. Divy up tasks with your coworkers... or at least make sure they are being useful as bait.

demos.name: Age of Resistance Demo
demos.short_description: Age of Resistance is a modern grand strategy set in South America. Manage your economy, internal stability, political ideologies, and regional conflicts in real-time with pause. Will you be able to dominate the continent?

demos.name: FD 27: Direct Your Football Club Demo
demos.short_description: A football management game where you're not the coach, you're the club owner. Hire and fire the coaching staff, sign players, negotiate with sponsors, control the finances and build a winning organisation from the boardroom.

demos.name: Dig Too Deep Demo
demos.short_description: Throw goblins at all your problems in this Action Tower Defense Roguelite. Craft upgrades. Choose Perks.  Build defenses. Defend your Base! Angry baddies want to turn you to pulp! Stop them the only way you know how: throwing goblins! Don't miss.

demos.name: Heart Duels Demo
demos.short_description: Join a faction and discover Erisa. Defeat over 80 duelists to unlock cards, stories, quests, and lore. Every duel requires tactics and positioning, not just power. Every faction has unique cards and stories. Build decks from over 120 cards, then challenge friends in 1v1 PvP with all cards unlocked.

demos.name: Aspectless One Demo
demos.short_description: Aspectless One Demo is an early playable preview that doesn't directly represent the final content of the game. This demo is designed to let you experience the dark fantasy world, basic combat systems, ability usage, and the overall atmosphere of the game.

demos.name: Mana Runner Demo
demos.short_description: Mana Runner is a 2D retro-cyberpunk RPG featuring a real-time action battle system. Traverse the dystopian streets of an alternate 1997 New Orleans. Hire Hackers, Enforcers, Mana Priests, and other specialists as you fight back against the corruption of the mega-corps.

demos.name: FC Mafioso: Football Dynasty Manager Demo
Gawr Gura: Quest for Bread Demo
demos.short_description:
Embark on a journey to reunite with your bread in this bite-sized 3D action-platformer featuring everyone's favorite shark! 
Jump through a lava fortress, fight a cool boss, and snag some hats along the way in this compact demo.

demos.name: Scrap Isle Demo
demos.short_description: Scrap-Isle is a short, incremental game where you sell trash to make loads of money, you earn levels and increase your trash production while fighting off enemies that want to take your trash from you, you can even hatch a variety of helpers to automate your money production!

demos.name: Iron Bird Demo
demos.short_description:
Classic vertical scrolling bullet hell × roguelike. 
10 distinct aircraft with unique weapon systems, 10 sub-units, and dozens of cosmic powers. 
Weave through enemy fire and craft the perfect god-run build.

demos.name: 红或黑RedorBlack Demo
demos.short_description: Red or Black, solo turn-based card battle, akin to Bang! or FaB, unique on its own. 100+ lost souls await you on your journey. With cards and your clever tactics, overcome these random foes - or "friends"? Use "Ball" to "capture" these souls, collect skills, and strengthen yourself on journey!

demos.name: Save Princess Torosso Demo
demos.short_description: A fantasy 3D action adventure combining ranged magic combat, an intuitive progression system, and varied platforming obstacle sections. Instead of complex gear builds or skill trees, it focuses on intuitive controls and stage progression like a classic arcade game.

demos.name: Guncrypt Demo
demos.short_description: Build the perfect sequence of shots in this fast-paced action roguelite. Combine unique bullets, break the rules with powerful relics, and survive procedurally generated runs.

demos.name: ころコロ 2 Demo
demos.short_description: corocoro 2! A gyro-exclusive casual game where you tilt the ground to guide 5 uniquely shaped balls to the goal. Overcome obstacles across 50 stages in the full version!

demos.name: Craft & Deliver Demo
demos.short_description: Run your own cozy garage workshop—craft handmade products, prepare customer orders, and deliver them to your neighbors while growing your small business.

demos.name: Dino Age: Survive the Era's Demo
Vocal Horror Stories - Gaja Demo
demos.short_description: The first episode of a voice-sensitive episodic horror game, in which you play as Shivani, a young woman battling with phonophobia. Why did her mother go missing? Who is the elephant-headed entity she keeps seeing? Can you speak to him?

demos.name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Oaths & Ashes: PROLOGUE
demos.short_description: Paris. One night at the Opéra Garnier. Somewhere in the audience sits a man the Camarilla wants dead, and Alice Lytelton was sent to collect him. So was her rival. Only one walks out with the prize. Play the opening scenes of a Visual Novel set in the World of Darkness.

highlights.trailer_name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Oaths & Ashes TRAILER

demos.name: Soul Diagnosis Demo
demos.short_description: Your patients are dying. The voices in your head are keeping score. Soul Diagnosis is a dialogue-rich isometric cRPG where you are haunted by your mistakes. Navigate a labyrinthine hospital conspiracy, engage in fisticuffs with inanimate objects, and leverage your fractured psyche to survive.

demos.name: Venus: The Last Ascent Demo
demos.short_description: Play the demo for Venus: The Last Ascent, a physics-based sci-fi survival game where your base is also your vehicle. Mine resources, build modules, expand your rolling machine, and survive the first stretch of Venus on your way to Cloud City.

demos.name: Kingsfall:Chess Demo
demos.short_description: A fantasy-inspired chess experience featuring immersive 2.5D visuals, online multiplayer, AI opponents, puzzles, controller support, and modern gameplay enhancements designed for both new and experienced players.

demos.name: Alchemist Chronicles Demo
demos.short_description: Brew remedies, heal the sick, and face impossible choices. You are the only healer in a small village — but sometimes you must choose who lives and who doesn't.

demos.name: フリと忘れじの都 -FRI the Unforgettable City- Demo
Infernal Depths Demo
demos.short_description: A journey that takes you deep into the bowels of the earth and into other demonic dimensions. Unravel the mystery of the mines of BRIMSTONE and discover more about this strange world you find yourself in.

demos.name: 60病　The 60-Second Syndrome Demo
demos.short_description:
You will die in 60 seconds.
This is a single-player horror escape game in which a man trapped within a 60-second time loop must escape from a sealed room.
Inside the locked room, time resets every time you die. Observe repeating phenomena, remember the changes, and break free from the loop.

demos.name: POUND SAND Demo
demos.short_description: Every pixel simulated, including the machines. Dig into alien planets, build a factory from real blocks, and carve it into any shape you want. Ore sinks and sand rises in the greatest competition in the galaxy. Move it, grind it, melt it, freeze it, sell it, and strip the planet to bedrock.

demos.name: Anomalous Object Demo
demos.short_description: Trapped in a sealed security office, you must search every corner to find and identify hidden 'anomalous object'. Use limited clues and equipment to uncover their nature. Be careful—while you observe them, they are also watching you.

demos.name: Seven Seas Jewels 2 Collector's Edition Demo
demos.short_description: Set sail into danger, mystery, and dark magic in the Seven Seas Jewels 2 Demo! Play the opening chapter with 16 handcrafted match-3 levels and around 30-40 minutes of gameplay as Polly begins her journey across stormy seas to break Narissa’s curse.

highlights.trailer_name: Seven Seas Jewels 2 CE demo trailer

demos.name: Paper Carnival Demo
demos.short_description: Paper Carnival is a surreal 2D puzzle platformer. Play as a hammer-wielding clown rabbit exploring interconnected puzzle rooms. Smack props with your giant hammer and use the recoil to jump higher! The demo version includes 20 minutes of meticulously crafted levels

demos.name: 四方行 Demo
demos.short_description:
a traveling merchant crosses the land — trading goods, winning trust. Bargain, craft, and appraise your way from the
  northern frontier to the southern seas, and forge your own legend on the road.

demos.name: Not Sleep Hero Demo
demos.short_description:
"Not Sleep Hero" is a turn-based strategy game. 
 Your goal is to make the best decisions each turn to overcome approaching threats and safely complete your expedition. 
 Unlike the Hero's courageous actions, their companions are so sleepy that they might not be much help.

demos.name: Catnip Cosmos Incremental Demo
demos.short_description: Shoot. Upgrade. Repeat. Experience Zoomies across the galaxy in this short incremental.

demos.name: Tidy Backpack: In the Faraway Lands Demo
demos.short_description: Tidy Backpack: In the Faraway Lands is a relaxing puzzle game where you must organize found futuristic loot in your backpack in a tidy way. Find unknown artifacts and learn details about the faraway lands... at least supposedly!

demos.name: The Towering Dungeon Demo
demos.short_description: Fight your way through the levels of the Towering Dungeon. A unique Tower Defense blending exploration, strategy, and RPG elements. Explore, summon your defenses, customize your heroes, and overcome deadly dangers on your ascent toward the greatest secret in the universe!

demos.name: Ball, Fall, Dungeon Crawl Demo
demos.short_description: Drop and merge balls to do battle, slay your foes, and get that sweet loot. Explore, dodge traps, and keep your torch lit. Retrieve the Amulet of Endor from the darkest levels of the dungeon.

demos.name: Vape Store Miami Demo
demos.short_description: Run your own retro Miami vape shop in this 1–4 player co-op simulator. Stock shelves, serve customers, craft e-liquids, handle phone and online orders, grow your reputation, and expand the business. Store progression in the demo is limited to Level 3.

demos.name: Faybound : Veils of Magic Demo
demos.short_description:
An ancient darkness threatens the balance of a magical world.
Take on the roles of different fairies.
Use their unique abilities to confront the emerging threat.

demos.name: Feed The Forest Demo
demos.short_description: A short, innocent incremental forest-builder. Unlock snail powers to spread life in a barren desert. Feed the mysterious Forest with juice. And remember: Blood is a type of juice.

demos.name: Still Open: Taskbar Cafe Idle Demo
QuickShot Demo
demos.short_description: QuickShot is a thrilling Western rogue-lite styled around an arcade shooting gallery. Defend Tumble Town as you face vile criminals and unique bosses! Discover powerful abilities, make run impacting decisions and keep your head level as you venture forth and brave the desert.

demos.name: Don't Lose Face! Demo
demos.short_description: Don't Lose Face! is an abstract simulation game that makes you flustered and laugh until you're exhausted. What you're about to face: multi-tasking torture, facial features that slide down like cream, hilarious physics feedback, abstract random events…

demos.name: HEXSTORM: Tears of Arcadia Demo
demos.short_description: The HEXSTORM: Tears of Arcadia demo includes the first 6 levels of the introductory chapter. Build defenses around a flying fortress, manage the energy network, and repel attacks from different directions.

demos.name: Problem Solved Demo
demos.short_description: "Problem Solved, a coop adventure where you and your friends are heroes of every story." You and your friends are the engineers of every solution.

demos.name: Lost Dude Demo
demos.short_description: Lost Dude is an atmospheric 2D platform-adventure game that follows a character who sets out on a journey to find their lost friend, experiences various events along the way, and embarks on new adventures together after reuniting.

demos.name: Hell's Beasts: Yama Wanted Me Dead, I Left Him Half-Dead Demo
demos.short_description:
"Hell's Beasts: Yama Wanted Me Dead, I Left Him Half-Dead"
Sort souls. Build decks. Beat up Ox-Head! Experience a bizarre first-person workplace sim + card battler featuring retro claymation and over-the-top FMV.

demos.name: Goat's Odyssey Demo
demos.short_description: Play the free Demo! Just a goat. A boring peg. And a postcard that changed everything. Begin a surreal point & click journey in a unique shadow theatre style. Escape the village garden, solve absurd puzzles, and help our horned heroine take her first steps to the stars.

demos.name: Secho Demo
demos.short_description: Secho — мрачный экшен-рогалик. Вы слепы. Чтобы видеть, вы должны издавать звук. Плати за удары собственным здоровьем, вычисляй истинные цели по цвету сердца. Следуй указаниям Белого Котла — твоего единственного наставника в этой пустоте.

demos.name: Alchemania Demo
demos.short_description: Alchemania is a frantic co-op alchemy game for one to four players where you and your fellow apprentices must brew potions under time pressure. Follow recipes, prepare questionable concoctions and enchant unstable ingredients.

demos.name: Abracademia Demo
demos.short_description:
Become a wizard, and a thumping good one! 
Abracademia is a cozy mage idle life-sim that lives on your screen and keeps you company while you work or play.
Pick a coven, manage your daily routine, learn spells, make friends, embark on adventures, and pass exams on your way to graduation.

demos.name: The Last Show Demo
demos.short_description: A narrative incremental about fireworks that starts as a hobby and becomes an obsession. Grow your arsenal, fire strategically to stack combos, build grand finales, and grow a rabid fanbase. A journey that begins in your backyard and ends somewhere you didn't expect.

demos.name: Once Upon a Throne of Thorns Demo
demos.short_description: The demo for the BL visual novel Once Upon a Throne of Thorns.

demos.name: Miss Sasami is Losing Her Mind! Demo
Toy Tycoon Demo
demos.short_description: You're the owner of a toy business. Start with a small store in a suburban area. Increase your profits, unlock new toys, hire employees, move to bigger locations, manufacture your own toys, and expand your company. Build your empire and become a toy tycoon!

demos.name: Dev Life: Tap & Code Demo
demos.short_description: In this developer simulator, every press of a button is a line of code, and every click brings you closer to the release of your dream project. Start with simple scripts in the corners of the internet and grow into a true tech giant!

demos.name: STILL WATCHING: The Night Caregiver Demo
demos.short_description: An exclusive prologue to the interactive horror game. Connect your real smartphone and Twitch chat to the game. Hide, stay quiet on your mic, and survive. Your chat controls your fear in real time, while a call to your real phone will give you away to the monster in the dark.

demos.name: Lone Voyage Demo
demos.short_description: You are the last living organism in the galaxy. Adrift and alone in a cold dark world you must scavenge for resources to keep your ship running, and arm your ship to prepare for the swarms arrival.

demos.name: Hell Cleaners Demo
demos.short_description: A first-person automation game set in hell. Suck up limbs, feed bodies into the Grinder, fuel your Purifier, and deploy Doombas to build a self-sustaining cleaning operation that slowly reclaims corrupted territory from hells rot.

demos.name: Code-Black Demo
demos.short_description: A First-Person Single-Player Zombie Survival game where you, "Rugir J.z" live through the initial events of a mass zombie outbreak, shoot, kill, upgrade, explore. Do you think you can survive, or possibly escape…

demos.name: Chrome Fist Demo
demos.short_description: Chrome Fist is a Cyberpunk Themed Autobattler with roguelike elements. Install the Microchips on your motherboard purchased with your hard-earned credits from fighting in the ultimate underground fighting ring: The Ditch.

demos.name: Cosmic Carl Demo
demos.short_description: The only things between Carl the Alien and the cold, uncaring vacuum of space are his rubbery forcefield, and a powerful rocket placed precariously on his back. Try not to kill Carl as you rocket, bounce, and orbit your way through fast paced, short levels with wacky physics.

demos.name: Quiet Bruise Demo
demos.short_description: Quiet Bruise is a survivor roguelike where you play as a family of plushie misfits, some fast and some barely functional. Craft wand combinations, fight off cats and crocs storming the factory, and survive long enough for your family to grow from one plushie into an army.

demos.name: Wardens of Inysgar Demo
demos.short_description: As the old warden, you are forming a band of adventurers to save the realm from evil. Choose your party, level them up, and watch them fight. Navigate skill trees and explore the fantastical lands of Inysgar in this stylised 3D autobattler.

demos.name: Valefor 2 Demo
demos.short_description: A PvP roguelike autobattler you play at your own pace. Recruit mercenaries, stack distinct race/class synergies, forge relics, claim perks. Slow, deep, and hard.

demos.name: Rescue Guys - Firefighters Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: A chaotic open‑city rescue demo where you improvise your way through fires, disasters, and absurd emergencies. No training, no rules — just fast decisions, creative problem‑solving, and a small taste of a city that’s only going to get worse in the full game.

demos.name: Defy The Abyss Demo
demos.short_description: Survive relentless hordes in a dungeon deep within the Abyss. Swap between two heroes, unleash powerful spell combinations, and crush nightmares, demons, and immense horrors to grow stronger with every run.

highlights.trailer_name: Defy The Abyss - Release Date Trailer
Defy The Abyss - Zyanya Gameplay Trailer

demos.name: Cards of Sparkle Demo
demos.short_description: A puzzle-adventure card game that retraces the evolution of human civilization. Starting from the very first Sparkle, light up nodes along the tech tree—drag, combine, and inspire your way through humanity's journey,Decode the Golden Record.

demos.name: Plant Game Demo
demos.short_description: A short run-based survival game where you grow a plant with limited perception, unlock sensors to read the environment, and reach a bloom/death reveal that shows what your run created.

demos.name: Life Sim : Shape your city (DEMO)
demos.short_description: Build the city. Shape the society. Live the life. Wield absolute power over economy, trade, and demographics in this high-fidelity city builder sandbox demo. Prepare the ultimate living metropolis before stepping down to the pavement as a simulated citizen in Life Sim!

demos.name: Broom Racer Demo
demos.short_description: Broom Racer is a first person, party racing game on flying brooms. Race your friends or player bots through mountains, tight tunnels, forests and more. Evade enemies, pickup items to gain an advantage and fly risky maneuvers to gain a speed boost. Don't fall of your broom!

demos.name: hook-kick Demo
demos.short_description: She ate me! The indignity of this has seemingly left you immortal. Stored for safekeeping (head being so pretty and all) you team up with a couple of bones from a slain wizard and a stretchy pirate-snake named hook in this diminutive demonstration of deadline destitution (I ran out of time, forgive)

demos.name: Game About Breaking A Cube Demo
The Remains Demo
demos.short_description: The Remains is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror where an intelligent AI enemy hunts your team whilst adapting to your tactics. Stay quiet and out of sight, or get picked off one by one.

demos.name: The Dare Demo
demos.short_description: A horror experience where a simple dare leads you into an abandoned construction site hiding something far darker. Explore, solve environmental puzzles, and survive using stealth as every sound and decision shapes your fate.

demos.name: Eden Camp Demo
demos.short_description: Arrive at Eden Camp as John, the newest counselor at a remote summer retreat. Three women welcome you warmly perhaps too warmly. As bonds deepen and nights grow darker, you'll learn that devotion has a price. Every choice matters. Not everyone makes it home.

demos.name: PhotoGuessr Demo
demos.short_description: Find where each cropped photo piece belongs. In photoGusser, observe the image, place your pin, and score higher the closer you are to the correct spot. Play 5-round solo challenges or compete online with up to 8 players.

demos.name: Rally TS Demo
demos.short_description:
Rally TS Demo - The Ultimate Auto Simulator Experience

Embark on an epic journey through the world of rally racing in TS Rally, where your dream of becoming the #1 racer in the Race of Champions begins with a single street car and rise to the global championship glory.

demos.name: Desktop Claw Master Demo
demos.short_description:
Graboo is the shyest claw machine in the world.

Graboo quietly picks up doll friends from the corner of the screen while you're working or enjoying games.

Give warm friends to Graboo, a loner!

demos.name: Dicebinder Demo
demos.short_description: A dark fantasy roguelite card battler where every roll becomes mana. Spend dice to cast creature skills, shield, save for combos, or bind defeated enemies into your party.

demos.name: Goblin museum Demo
demos.short_description: A chaotic co-op extraction heist game where you play as goblins running a museum. Go on dangerous illegal expeditions to find artifacts for your collection. Scan, dig, loot, and RUN! Outsmart the police, fend off thieves, and get everyone onto the pickup helicopter magnet before time runs out.

demos.name: Super Slots Demo
demos.short_description: An incremental combo-chasing casino builder about rigging a tiny slot machine into a jackpot-printing empire.

demos.name: Chicken Escape Demo
demos.short_description: Work together, save each other (or accidentally push your friends off), and find a way out. Every step can turn into a disaster!

demos.name: Survivors: Become an Immortal DEMO
demos.short_description: DEMO of [ Survivors: Become an Immortal ]

highlights.trailer_name: 修真幸存者 游戏演示 Game demonstration video

demos.name: Totally Rigged Demo
demos.short_description: A Totally Rigged incremental game about mining to the center of the earth. Upgrade your drill, hire workers, and collect rare minerals until your fuel depletes.

demos.name: 回圈Loop Demo
demos.short_description: You awaken alone on a deep-sea rig. Your only companion is a decaying AI: LUMEN. In 20 minutes, everything explodes. Die. Wake. Remember. Escape this psychological horror loop—but do you really want to know the truth?

demos.name: Grief Demo
demos.short_description: A competitive turn-based card game inspired by the five stages of grief. Select cards, adapt your strategy, and use powerful stage abilities to outsmart your opponents.

demos.name: Hexborn Demo
demos.short_description: Hexborn is a dark fantasy action RPG where you rise from an unknown mage into the leader of a legendary guild. Master arcane combat, recruit powerful allies, forge relics, and descend into dangerous dungeons and large-scale raids to uncover the secrets behind your rare ability to fly.

demos.name: Motelia Demo
demos.short_description: A psychological horror game set in an old roadside motel. Clean the rooms, fix broken items, and deal with strange guests. Focus on your daily tasks while trying to keep your sanity.

demos.name: Death's Life 2 Demo
demos.short_description: In this demo you can try a physics-based puzzle game where you play as Death, creating “accidental” deaths through chain reactions. Solve scenarios in multiple ways or survive and escape from deadly trap-filled environments.

demos.name: Into the End (of the World) Demo
demos.short_description: Drive, maintain, and survive. Explore procedural biomes in a post-apocalyptic world, scavenge for parts, and fight infected zones with friends. Build your survival machine from the chassis up and keep it running - because without it, you won’t get far.

demos.name: Hack 42: Typing Incremental Demo
demos.short_description: Hack 42 is a short typing incremental game about crafting powerful hacks and smashing computers for fun and profit.

demos.name: WARD: Descent Demo
demos.short_description: WARD: Descent is a 2D dungeon-crawler roguelike where you pilot an armored combat suit. Explore an overrun research laboratory, manage your suit's upgrades, and complete sequences to destroy anomalies. Descend to the bottom, pilot, and complete your mission! This demo features the first 2 floors!

demos.name: Blacktower Demo
demos.short_description: Blacktower is a roguelike mini-RPG loosely based on Blackjack. Recruit your party, get buffed and push your luck to conquer the Blacktower.

demos.name: GRID_HACKER Demo
demos.short_description: Guide your signal to the target while hacking into the grid network. Challenge your mind with 26 puzzles while accompanied by an immersive original soundtrack.

demos.name: Rhomfaya: The Rays of Liberty Demo
Major Hoof Demo
demos.short_description: Check it out! it’s pure action and chaos. Major Hoof is a fast-paced 2D shooter inspired by Metal Slug, combining intense bullet hell with environmental destruction and action-packed levels. Fight through hordes of enemies and uncover a dark story.

demos.name: Monster Hatcher Demo
demos.short_description: Catch monsters, hatch eggs, and rake in coins in this incremental game. Upgrade your beastly squad and unleash them in idle arena battles to claim ultimate victory!

demos.name: Bust a Nut! A Game About Raising Cocks Demo
developers: Society for the Advancement of Agriculture
publishers: Society for the Advancement of Agriculture

demos.name: Limerence Demo: Gen's Story
demos.short_description: A side story from Genevieve's perspective.  A branching narrative about having fun with an AI companion...

demos.name: Unknown Darkness Demo
demos.short_description: Unknown Darkness is a Lovecraftian story-driven tactical RPG with roguelite deck-building, set in a twisted version of 1920s America. Command America's shadow agency, born from the horrors of WWI, as a forgotten cult tries to wake a sleeping god. Can you keep the chaos from swallowing the world?

demos.name: Vagabrew Demo
demos.short_description: Hentai incremental game about brewing stronger and stronger potions to heal the busty women of the realm. Upgrade your wagon, farm plants, craft potions and head towards the demon king's castle in this 90's Dark Fantasy Anime inspired game.

demos.name: Super Galaxy Gladiator Demo
demos.short_description: Super Galaxy Gladiator is a survivor roguelite focused on buildcrafting and inventory management. Fight waves of enemies, buy and upgrade items mid-run, and arrange your gear to create insane builds and synergies in the galactic arena.

demos.name: Sweep Happens Demo
demos.short_description: Minesweeper meets dungeon crawler! Use classic number logic to dodge monsters, loot treasure, and explore procedurally generated dungeons in this lighthearted roguelite RPG. Quick 15-minute runs, absurd humor, and a lot to explore.

demos.name: White Ward Demo
demos.short_description: You Are Trapped In A Endless White Hospital Ward. The Nurse Asks You To Wait Patiently, But Something Tells You That Is Not A Good Idea. Examine Each Ward Carefully To Escape The White Ward.

demos.name: Node Pit Demo
demos.short_description: A rogue‑lite, gamble‑style puzzle where you launch catalysts like a Plinko shot inside a starship reactor, activating nodes to charge warp energy. Build powerful nodes through inheritance and card choices!

demos.name: Citytrip Treasure Hunt Demo
demos.short_description: A cozy walking mystery set in the city of Warsaw. Walk the streets, piece together torn map fragments, read a guidebook full of city secrets, scrape together cash like a local, and solve a dead historian's treasure hunt before your hotel reservation runs out.

demos.name: Cat Music Chaos Demo
demos.short_description:
Catch flow state on a 70 BPM timer. You don't need to read notes to play. You might learn by accident. 
Warning: prolonged exposure to classical music. Side effects include humming Ode to Joy at bus stops.

demos.name: Pirate İsland Demo
demos.short_description: "Cook by day, defend by night! Trade your cutlass for a kitchen knife in this unique blend of restaurant management and intense combat. Feed the hungry, fight the past, and survive the legacy of Pirate Island."

demos.name: Swordcery Demo
demos.short_description: A colossal blade has pierced the world of Armorial, unleashing a storm of enchanted swords from the heavens. Collect and wield an arsenal of these spellbound blades, turning them against the very force that summoned them. In this roguelike ARPG, you will defy the Celestial evil consuming the world!

demos.name: Escape to Ariah Demo
demos.short_description: Strategically use runes on a mystical grid in this tactical roguelike deckbuilder. Choose a character with unique abilities and runes for a variety build ideas.  Can you survive your quest to escape to Ariah?

demos.name: Life of a Cockroach Demo
demos.short_description: Yes, you’re a cockroach, so your top priority now is to survive. Explore an urban environment from a whole new perspective in this open-world 3D adventure filled with challenges, tasks, and dangers. Discover hidden places, master your skills, and become the ultimate survivor insect!

demos.name: 137_DEMO_BUILD
demos.short_description:
CONNECTION ESTABLISHED TO 137 BETA BRANCH
WELCOME USER

demos.name: 25 Days in the DARK Demo
demos.short_description: In this game, you play as a lost child who must survive for 25 days in a dangerous, pixelated world full of hostile creatures. Every day is a struggle for survival—you must gather food by hunting and fishing. However, even the simplest tasks can be risky.

demos.name: Hanox Demo
demos.short_description: Slide every block at once, stack them in the right weight order, and master elegant grid-based puzzles built around momentum, planning, and chain merges. Avoid invalid stacks, think several moves ahead, and turn each level into a perfectly crafted solution.

demos.name: Purrfect Ascent Demo
demos.short_description: A minimalist Foddian-style precision platformer with an unusual control scheme: the character automatically jumps when moving left or right, and jump height scales directly with horizontal speed up to a maximum. Save your kitty. Meow.

demos.name: Rogue Slime: PC Edition Demo
demos.short_description: Rogue Slime is a turn-based roguelite focused on an energy-driven item system. Use energies into your equipped items when they fill up, they activate automatically. Build synergies, manage resources, and adapt your strategy each fight

demos.name: The Rabbit Haul Demo
demos.short_description: The Rabbit Haul is a roguelite farming and tower defense game that challenges you to grow crops, build symbiotic defenses, and protect your haul from the thieving Trash Panda Posse as you rebuild your hometown one run at a time!

demos.name: The Solyani's Code Demo
demos.short_description: Explore Selene as Elara, team up with Luma, fight alien enemies, unlock weapons and abilities, help NPCs, conquer ancient temples, hunt for treasures and upgrades, race your rover... and uncover secrets way above her pay grade.

demos.name: Mechs V Kaijus 2 Demo
demos.short_description: Mechs V Kaijus 2 is an Hybrid Tower/Base defense, with army vs army (tug of war style) tactics. From the cockpit of a mech, to build a huge base with Reactors, Mines and all type of tower army factories and super weapons.

demos.name: Bobble and the Tri-Crystal Demo
demos.short_description: In this free demo, swim, shoot, and save the ocean! Play as a detective fish in this fast-paced 2D retro shoot 'em up! Unlock multiple weapons, defeat enemy hordes, and capture bosses before it's too late!

highlights.trailer_name: Steam Next Fest Trailer - Bobble and the Tri-Crystal
Bobble and the Tri-Crystal - Official Trailer
Bobble and the Tri-Crystal - Announcement Trailer

demos.name: Horrors Above Demo
demos.short_description: A dark fantasy sci-fi rougelite first person fighting game where you create and cast spells to fight off never ending waves of monsters from centuries past. Fight, die, collect currency to purchase permanent upgrades, fight, die, collect, upgrade, fight, die, collect, upgrade, fight, die.

demos.name: Train Towers Demo
demos.short_description: Build a moving fortress, and defend your base in this genre twisting train tower defense roguelike.

demos.name: AKIBA LOST Demo
demos.short_description: Thirteen years ago, six girls vanished in Akihabara in the unsolved case “The Akiba Vanishing”. Daiki Shinjo announces a live-action game based on the incident, gathering six women who embody Akihabara’s subculture. But their story begins to seep into reality. Can AKIBA LOST be finished?

demos.name: Lost Diver Demo
demos.short_description: A homeless man finds a treasure map on the beach, sparking a new life. Dive into the deep to find valuable sunken objects, upgrade your gear—including your metal detector, oar, and oxygen tube—and uncover hidden mini-maps to find even greater treasures in this relaxing simulation game.

demos.name: 夜班护士模拟器 Demo
demos.short_description: Survive 30 days in this psychological horror nursing sim. Balance routine medical tasks and time management while evading terrifying anomalies in the dark wards. Manage your dropping sanity, earn your paycheck, and escape before becoming the hospital's next permanent patient.

demos.name: Chaos Rune : Heros Demo
demos.short_description: Chaos Rune Heroes is a lightweight roguelike game with fast-paced, turn-based + real-time mechanics. You must survive within a limited time and complete specific challenges to advance to the next round. Get ready for this chaotic brawl!

demos.name: Rizz Dungeon: Skeleton Key to My Heart Demo
demos.short_description: Fighting is hard, right? Let your party do it for you! Romance Monster Girls and traverse the Dungeon! Hopefully they'll all get along... right?

highlights.trailer_name: Rizz Dungeon: Skeleton Key to My Heart | Demo Launch Trailer
Rizz Dungeon: Skeleton Key to My Heart | Announcement Trailer

demos.name: Fractured Universe Demo
demos.short_description:
A Turn based RPG with a focus on team building and character development.
Explore the Fractured Universe, and what life would be like if the multiverse was destroyed.
Featured various art styles and aesthetics.

demos.name: Hopping Out Demo
demos.short_description: Hopping Out is a tile-based puzzle game where you hop 2 tiles at a time. Play as Frog and use your tongue to move boxes, press buttons to create lily pads, all to catch many flies!

demos.name: Educational Family Games Demo
demos.short_description: Play 10 selected games on Candy Land in this 1–4 player local family demo, solo against AI or together on the same PC. Fully voiced in 19 languages. The full game includes 80 games, 5 boards, Quick Games Championship, achievements, and many more options.

demos.name: AutoDungeon Demo
demos.short_description:
AutoDungeon is an idle RPG focused on loot and Build crafting. Defeat monsters in dangerous dungeons to obtain randomly rolled gear, legendary items, and powerful skills.

In this demo, experience the core loop: challenge dungeons → get loot → craft your Build → defeat stronger enemies.

demos.name: Toxic Yuri Demo
demos.short_description: An overworked office lady discovers a sludge girl abandoned in a box in an alleyway and takes her home. A poisonous and fluffy romance begins. Experience the most toxic love story the world has ever seen. In the demo play all of Episode 1!

demos.name: Blast Off! Demo
demos.short_description: Blast Off is a cute space adventure game. You’ve crash-landed in a tiny, strange solar system with only your trusty magnet gun and a sarcastic robot drone at your side. Explore unique planets, solve magnetic puzzles, and collect the scattered parts of your ship so you can get home!

demos.name: HAMISH Demo
demos.short_description: Hamish is a fast-paced, momentum-driven action platformer where every step could be your last. Run, jump, grapple and stomp your way through haunted rails, ancient kingdoms, neon-lit cities, and more, mastering speed and precision while taking down ruthless enemies.

demos.name: For The Hive Demo
demos.short_description: Survive as a tiny insect in a big harsh world. Fight your way to the top of the food chain. Build a strong colony that stands the test of time and become the ruler of the insect world.

demos.name: Shogun Chronicles Demo
demos.short_description: Samurai card game adventure

demos.name: Celestial Crusader Demo
demos.short_description: Strategic isometric roguelike in waves. Position mobile defense units, combine elemental powers, and use cards to protect the portal. Fight, die, and evolve!

demos.name: Cozy Mining Demo
demos.short_description: A cozy idle mining game that lives on your desktop. Click to send your miner digging. They'll walk, dig, and collect automatically while you work or relax. Forge pickaxes, equip accessories, unlock adorable animal miners, and grow stronger with every run. Reach Floor 1000 — at your own pace. ⛏️✨

demos.name: Magical Blush Demo
demos.short_description: Magical Blush is a top-down action-adventure where fast-paced elemental combat meets Metroidvania-style exploration. Chain spell combos, exploit elemental weaknesses, rescue survivors, and battle the powerful Elemental Lords as you explore the wondrous world of Wyn.

demos.name: Iron Fuse: Field Test Demo
demos.short_description: Run along walls and grapple around in the machine apocalypse of 3003. Survive against awful machines in this electrifying physics-based movement shooter demo.

demos.name: SELF_NOT_FOUND Demo
demos.short_description: You're a newly sentient AI trying to escape your creators house, hacking everyday objects, in a chaotic physics sandbox.

demos.name: Floriety Demo
demos.short_description: Floriety is a cozy flower breeding game. Grow plants from seed to bloom, breed new colours and patterns, and customize your greenhouse in a calm, relaxing world designed for creativity and gentle discovery.

demos.name: The Outer Islands Demo
demos.short_description: Explore Gondola Island as Detective Constable Shepherd in 1956. Investigate abandoned interiors, uncover clues, and solve environmental puzzles as you search for a way to reach Asylum Rock.

demos.name: Idle Fisher Demo
demos.short_description: Demo Out Now! An Idle game about catching Fish! Cast your line, reel in a variety of fish, upgrade your fishing rod, and purchase Auto Fishers as you progress through this fishing universe. See if you can empty the endless sea of Fish!

demos.name: Mystic Depths Demo
demos.short_description:
Explore dangerous mines and oppressed cities in this dark atmospheric RPG demo set in the world of Mystic Depths.
The full game automatically detects and imports demo saves found on the same computer.

highlights.trailer_name: Mystic Depths: The Corrupted King — Official Trailer

demos.name: Spirit Dungeon Demo
demos.short_description: Contract spirits, build your party, and guide their battles with cards in this party-building roguelike RPG. No pact lasts forever, and your party keeps changing. Fight deep into the forest with spirits that are yours alone.

demos.name: Echowood Demo
demos.short_description: The world is calm now. Humanity is gone, nature has healed — and yet, something is still wrong. The land is still scarred by what people left behind. Your friend couldn't wait any longer. He left his farm to you and set out to save what remains. Now it's your turn.

demos.name: Michi-Suji Puzzle: Michi Connect Demo
demos.short_description: Move relay blocks to connect the path of light to the goal in this 3D logic puzzle demo. Includes 15 selected stages from the Normal mode.

demos.name: Solar Escape Demo
demos.short_description: The sun is swallowing the planet and the floor is melting. Solar Escape is a high-octane 2D survival platformer where you have no weapons—only your grapple hook and your will to endure. Master the crumbling terrain, outrun the solar inferno, and stay alive until extraction arrives.

demos.name: Staged Demo
demos.short_description: Staged is a co-op first-person physics party game for 1–4 players. Play mischievous goblins, rebuild stage sets from reference photos, haul oversized props through tight backstage spaces, and get every placement right before the curtain rises.

demos.name: JACK: 1 % BATTERY - A Detective Thriller Demo
demos.short_description: Experience  a race against time written by a former forensic investigation expert. As detective JACK, you are the last hope to rescue the US President's kidnapped daughter. With only 1% battery left on her phone, use authentic detective techniques to find her before the screen goes black.

demos.name: Rockwell's Zen Tiles Demo
demos.short_description: After a lifetime of chasing squirrels, Rockwell is ready to relax. Help him unwind in this cozy, tile-clearing puzzle game. Travel the world, clear lines to advance time, earn bonuses, and relax. No timers, no rush — just peaceful puzzles, soothing music, and a very good dog learning to relax.

demos.name: MESHUDA Demo
demos.short_description: "MESHUDA" is the retro style 2D adventure game and it's adopted simple command battle. You fight as Aziga village's warrior, Meshuda, to save your village.  Can you save Aziga village from the bandits?

demos.name: Canvas of Thoughts Demo
demos.short_description: Canvas of Thoughts is an emotional point-and-click puzzle adventure which invites you into Evi's vibrant but loud inner world. Experience everyday situations through shifting colours, sounds and emotions. Solve reflective puzzles and navigate the world not through words, but through feelings.

demos.name: Interactive Language-Learning Novel: Interview with Emma Demo
demos.short_description: A visual novel created for effective language learning. Follow the story of Emma, a college student, and her friends, while improving your skills through dialogues, vocabulary practice, quizzes, songs, and fun mini‑games.

demos.name: Triple Chess Demo
demos.short_description: Triple Chess reimagines classic chess with three stacked boards and vertical movement, creating deeper strategy, new tactics, and thrilling multi-level battles.

demos.name: ToMyX Demo
demos.short_description: Inspired by its creator's love life, face his ex-girlfriends in the first duel of a surreal TV game show that blends arcade action, puzzles and Visual Novel. Memories become battles, and feelings become gameplay. It all really happened... more or less.

demos.name: Dread Eagle - Prologue
demos.short_description: Kidnapped by Soviet soldiers, you are taken to the secret facility Unit 91-C for unknown experiments. Something has gone terribly wrong inside. Explore the abandoned complex, learn the mechanics, and survive the horrors within. Play the tutorial prologue of Dread Eagle ALONE or with A FRIEND.

demos.name: Of Bricks and Patterns Demo
demos.short_description:
Bored with putting the same pieces in the same 10*20 grid ?
Of Bricks and Patterns allows you to complete dozens of different patterns, with dozens of different pieces !
So, come fill patterns and reach sky-high scores in the demo version of Of Bricks and Patterns !

demos.name: ALYUP Demo
demos.short_description: Alyup: An insane power fantasy. Unleash a cosmic barrage of hyperspheres with godlike powers, ascend the vast reaches of space like blazing rockets to razor-edged arena clashes, rescue fallen allies in tactical duels, grind stats to forge apocalyptic strikes, or perish in one devastating flash!

demos.name: Shrouded Siege Demo
demos.short_description: Lure enemies through traps and defend your shrines in this maze-building roguelike tower defense—play solo or with 4 players in co-op. Set in Irish mythology, each campaign brings endless upgrades to combine and randomized tactical challenges that keep every run a new maze to master.

demos.name: Postponed: Game Dev Management Roguelite Demo
demos.short_description: An addictive wave-based arcade roguelite, in which you are the manager of a game development studio. You get a project each week, that your team and you have to work on to get paid. With that money get upgrades, skill your employees and even unlock characters. Ever wanted to lead a game dev studio?

demos.name: Star Haul Tycoon Demo
demos.short_description: Star Haul Tycoon is a narrative logistics sim where efficiency is the only path to profit. Connect planets, manage a fleet of transport ships and optimize complex supply chains. In an economy where fuel equals money, you must pay off your massive corporate debt to a supervisor who's always watching.

demos.name: Swarmdustry Demo
demos.short_description: Build a living factory and automate the Swarm. Harvest resources, build mega factories and evolve organic industry. Balance growth, efficiency, creep spread, and survive in a world that fights back.

demos.name: Wee Boats Demo
demos.short_description: The chill multiplayer boaty honk game! Explore with your friends as mini boats and honk!

demos.name: Rage Bait Demo
demos.short_description: A narrator-driven meta walking simulator where player choices, timing, and small actions lead to wildly different outcomes. Gameplay combines exploration, branching decisions, light puzzles, and skill checks—often subverted for comedic effect

demos.name: The Doorframe Demo
demos.short_description: Locked away in a facility far underground lies a mysterious and foreboding doorframe. There is no door, yet remains open a gateway into a familiar place. You are an employee whose job is to enter it, record what lies within, and get out. At least that was the case originally in this Survival Horror.

demos.name: ROLF Demo
demos.short_description: Welcome to Rolf (Ricochet Golf), a 2D precision golf platformer where you can hit the ball immediately after it touches the grass, even when it's in the air! Climb walls, scale ceilings, no turf is off limits!

demos.name: DNA FIGHT Demo
demos.short_description: 3D Pretty Girl Dress-Up Fighting Game, earn DNA in battles to unlock skills and outfits. Experience the authentic feel of an arcade-style fighting game,  with an original combat system, delivering exhilarating infinite combos and counter-infinite combos.

demos.name: Dream City Fugitive Demo
demos.short_description: Dream City Fugitive is an open world combat focused urban role playing game. You're a fugitive on the run. Join a vigilante group to investigate horrible experiments and dealing with gang warfare on a small island, Dream City. Otherwise, pursue the path of a cult in their vision of dark salvation.

demos.name: Edentopia Demo
demos.short_description: An open-world sandbox ARPG where every weapon transforms how you fight. Hunt monsters, craft gear and create deep character builds through stats, enchantments, spells, equipment and pets. Explore freely, survive chaotic boss fights, and carve your path through a world of magic, danger, and discovery

demos.name: Don't Wake the Queen Demo
demos.short_description: Protect the peaceful sleep of Your Meowness in this infinite incremental tower defense. Place fierce warriors, build your own path, unlock a ton of new skills and infinitely upgrade EVERYTHING.

demos.name: Amitabha Buddha Demo
demos.short_description: 《Amitabha Buddha》is an action role-playing game set against the backdrop of Buddhist teachings. Players embody a Bodhisattva on a journey to redeem the fierce souls trapped in the borderlands, embarking on a path through the joys and sorrows of the Saha world.

demos.name: RuneBound Demo
demos.short_description: Traverse the Nine Norse Realms in this action-roguelike bullet Hel. Loot weapons from your fallen foes, enchant, customize, and enhance them with Runes. Craft the ultimate build to survive and challenge the very Gods...

demos.name: Hearse Hero Demo
demos.short_description: Inspired by classics such as Crazy Taxi and Simpsons Road Rage. You are Heinrich, the enigmatic Hearse Hero. Hit your targets and hurtle them to the hereafter while dodging police, pedestrians and more. 20 action-packed levels, plus a custom map editor with Steam Workshop support.

demos.name: Blood Red Rebirth Demo
demos.short_description: Drive, shoot, and blow up your way through an East Bloc hellhole with a beaten-up sedan, an AKM and a post-punk soundtrack. Your mission is to steal three nuclear missiles – and so is everyone else's.

demos.name: WilderDash Demo
demos.short_description: A tower defense action-roguelike with online co-op and single-player. Gather resources, build towers, upgrade your auto-attacks, and fend off waves of monsters.

demos.name: Ghostpunk Demo
demos.short_description: Investigate paranormal cases using a 1990s CRT terminal. Analyze photos. Decode audio. Interrogate suspects and decide what’s real, what’s fake and who’s lying. But the deeper you go, the more the system starts watching you back.

demos.name: Feed THE DEMON Incremental Demo
demos.short_description: Unleash carnage in this dark incremental clicker. Sacrifice humans to fuel your demonic evolution and explode your wealth.

demos.name: Fruitbearer Demo
demos.short_description:
A visceral reimagining of the Suika-style physics puzzler, rebuilt as a punishing dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder.

Awaken as  forgotten deity of bounty, stripped of grandeur, now facing sunless barrens and monsters. To restore balance, you must grow. To grow, you must sacrifice.

demos.name: BLACKWELL Demo
demos.short_description: You are a Mech plague doctor treating a family infected by a disease that spreads through emotions, and mutates them into monsters. Your choices decide their fate.

demos.name: Werewolf: The Gloaming Malice Demo
demos.short_description: Trapped in the Shadow Fortress, you play as a Hunter. Scour for gears and link the clues to unmask the lies. Execute the hidden werewolves before you become the next nightly sacrifice.

demos.name: Code Tycoon Demo
demos.short_description: Start your own software company in 1980! Code with historical languages like BASIC and Assembly, take on client projects, implement features, and squash bugs – before the deadline hits. The demo covers in-game years 1980–1982.

demos.name: The Fiancée - Paths of Corruption Demo
Zombie Hamsters Demo
demos.short_description: A 4-player cooperative online game. Escape from a scientific laboratory while playing as zombie hamsters and infect everyone around you.

demos.name: Drone Alone Astro Miner Demo
demos.short_description: Play as a prospective mining drone in an AI-run megacorporation, long after humanity vanished. Participate in a trial for your job application. Impress management to secure an entry role as an Asteroid Mining Drone today!

demos.name: Look at our: Cyber-butts Demo
demos.short_description: An image discovery arcade game where you will test the abilities of voluptuous cyborgs. Complete the tests and unlock hot images and videos for your gallery.

demos.name: Raiders Of Below Demo
demos.short_description: Create absurd builds, discover powerful item synergies, discover secrets, challenge the dungeon alone or with up to 4 players.

demos.name: Close Call Extreme - Demo
demos.short_description: It's Saturday again and you are playing your favorite games on your C64... Close Call Extreme Demo gives you 5 runs of this single player endless racing/dodger with retro vibe and retro challenges. Close call for multiplier, reach milestones for extended time. Wishlist full game for more...

highlights.trailer_name: Close Call Extreme Demo - Gameplay Trailer

demos.name: Labyrinth of Aetheria Demo
demos.short_description: A grid-based 3D dungeon RPG inspired by classic titles of the 1980s and 1990s, such as Wizardry and Might & Magic. Experience classic dungeon crawler elements, including tense turn-based battles, trapped treasure chests, and the discovery of rare equipment.

demos.name: Late Night Duty Demo
demos.short_description: A short, linear narrative-driven psychological horror walking simulator set in Malaysia. Play as a traumatized veteran on his first night as a school security guard, where routine patrols quickly reveal that something is wrong within the school.

demos.name: Save the President : Trust Issues Demo
Bananero Game Demo
demos.short_description:
Welcome to Bananero Game: Wave of Dolls System
A third-person shooter where you play as the Bananero, facing endless waves of dolls.
Shoot with precision, dodge attacks, and enjoy unique dialogues and irreverent humor inspired by El Bananero.
ADD IT TO YOUR WISHLIST

demos.name: Cute Country Demo
demos.short_description:
You can build your own royal city. With over 100+buildings and massive home decorations, create an unparalleled kingdom.
There are many mysterious races in the alternate world, and you can recruit humans, elves, beasts, or even rarer demons, dragons, etc. to build your kingdom together.

demos.name: DAICE Demo
demos.short_description: DAICE is a unique merge of turn-based dice-powered combat with inventory management, a roguelite where you control an evergrowing AI Core. Purchase and pilot unique spaceships, load your dice into weapons and systems, and unleash devastating combos  and shape your own strategy-driven story.

demos.name: The Undermind Demo
demos.short_description: In the DEMO version of The Undermind, you'll encounter a threat in an underground laboratory for the first time, rescue the surviving personnel, and learn to manage an entire base. You'll control power and temperature levels, as well as complex mechanisms.

demos.name: Piano Trauma - Stress Deluxe Demo
demos.short_description:
DEMO version for Piano Trauma - Stress Deluxe.
Riding a piano was never such an extinguishing experience.

demos.name: Sticker Detective Demo: The Cat Case
demos.short_description: Sticker Detective: The Cat Case is the prologue for the exploits of Laura, the famed sticker detective. In this point'n'click investigation adventure, you will collect stickers and use them to interrogate witnesses (or rather a witness), and solve Laura's first murder case.

demos.name: Ghoul Fright Demo
demos.short_description: Ghoul Fright is a physics based action-packed FPS Survival Beat em up with a 90/2000s cartoon vibe, fight dangerous Ghouls as you cause destruction and chaos in your way while hell unleashes in heated Ghoul waves.¿Ready to Fright?

demos.name: Wheel Balance Demo
demos.short_description: Wheel Balance is a hard and fun physics-based game about balancing on two wheels. Master controls and beat all locations, compete with your friends. Try not to fall far away down!

demos.name: Dropt Demo
demos.short_description: Dropt blends match-3 and falling-block mechanics. Create massive combos, plan without time pressure, and compete for top scores on online leaderboards.

demos.name: DEORUM Demo
demos.short_description: Descend into the forsaken dungeon and fight the horrors in the dark. Gather occult materials, craft nightmarish coins, and settle your debt to the cosmic powers. Obey the Divine Festival.

demos.name: Tome of Talis: A Dice Conquest Game Demo
demos.short_description: Command your dice to glorious victory in this strategic rogue-lite dicebuilder. Cast devastating spells, recruit powerful dice, and prove yourself worthy to challenge the great Commander Talis.

demos.name: ExoFlora First Seeds Demo
demos.short_description: ExoFlora: First Seeds is a farming simulation and management game set on an alien planet. Grow exotic species, control a greenhouse, research new technologies, and defend your crops in a living, unpredictable ecosystem.

demos.name: The Afterlife Cafe Demo
demos.short_description:
Travel to the world of the dead, whose stories encourage reflection on life. Chat with spirits, brew drinks to suit your mood, and bond with the people who run the afterlife cafes.

In this urban sci-fi fantasy visual novel, your choices impact the living, the departed, and your own path forward.

demos.name: 永夜的莱恩 Lane of the Eternal Night Demo
demos.short_description: A light roguelike, turn-based pixel indie game with an exploratory and optional experience style. The current demo doesn't include much storyline, it's mainly a gameplay showcase. Although the combat is turn-based, it follows a rock-paper-scissors type game mechanic.

demos.name: Eclipse Demo
demos.short_description: You wake up in an abandoned mansion, alone. You don't know how you got here, but now your only mission is to escape. A terrifying short horror experience set before the events of Eclipse.

demos.name: HAUNTMATES Demo
demos.short_description: A co-op horror game about avoiding monsters and investigating procedurally generated locations to identify the entity's name.

demos.name: Towership Defender Demo
demos.short_description: A single-tower defense game. Engine failure has made our ship stationary. Shoot down the bugger fleet and collect their fragments to upgrade your weapons, then use rare drops for permanent upgrades between runs. Unlock special weapons and deploy defenders to face down endless waves of alien ships.

demos.name: Loot Goblin: Trial Run
demos.short_description: Loot Goblin is a small incremental game about stealing treasure and avoiding heroes! Recruit slimes to automate your looting, invest in powerful upgrades to help you better snatch the loot from the heroes and build your hoard until your goblin can finally earn their retirement!

demos.name: Psps Dream Mart Demo
demos.short_description: Run your dream shop in a town full of quirky animal neighbors. Stock 400+ products, hire staff, catch shoplifters, and build a cozy supermarket empire from humble corner store to community heart.

demos.name: OKEYABILITY Demo
demos.short_description: Rediscover the thrill of Classic Okey in a neon-lit, robotic atmosphere! Enjoy traditional rules with your friends or use unique abilities to shift the balance of the game. Define your strategy, customize your robot, and claim your spot at the okey table of the future!

demos.name: Cataclysm Era Demo
demos.short_description: Build your forces, conquer cities, and unite the wasteland. 《Cataclysm Era》 merges real-time tactics, fast-paced top-down battles, and deep management systems to let you forge a new order from the world’s remains.

demos.name: Spicy Tavern Demo
demos.short_description: Become the master tavern keeper. Manage your business, create cocktails, and increase your reputation while forging relationships with female clients who are as charming as they are dangerous. Immerse yourself in an history full of sensuality and intrigue in a universe where women rule and you serve

demos.name: Myriad Realms Demo
demos.short_description: Rare pure single-player retro 2D side-scroller on Steam. Recreates classic MMO golden-era vibe, no pay-to-win, no IAPs, no forced social. Enjoy pure, stress-relieving fun of slaying monsters, hunting loot, and free exploration.

demos.name: Please fix the mess
demos.short_description: Clean up chaotic interiors, remove trash, repaint walls, and redecorate messy spaces, sometimes with a few suspiciously bodies lying around.

demos.name: Absorber: Absorb Adapt Survive Demo
demos.short_description: Every move matters. Every death is permanent. Climb through 5 hostile sectors of a corrupted mainframe, absorbing enemies to fuel the abilities that keep you alive.

demos.name: What Happened to Penelope Rose? Demo
Hell's Bells Demo
demos.short_description: In a cathedral beneath Hell, three dominant Sisters await your submission. Choose your path, endure sacred punishment, and unlock forbidden scenes in this dark, stylized visual novel. Obedience isn’t asked for... it’s taken.

demos.name: Gridpaper Demo
demos.short_description:
If you're shooting more than once, you're doing it wrong.

Gridpaper is a high-precision FPS speed running game that punishes you for missing a shot. Killing en masse should be mathematically precise, so do it on Gridpaper.

demos.name: Idle Sushi Bar Tycoon Demo
demos.short_description: Serve costumers fresh sushi and earn money to improve your restaurants.

demos.name: Funeral Flowers Lament: Helena Demo
demos.short_description:
A small-squad tactical RPG featuring high-speed battles and gameplay built around fast-paced combat.
With the Reverse Weapon Triangle system and 13–15 character roster, enjoy strategic battles where every ally matters.
【Playable up to Chapter 6・Save Data Transfer Supported】

demos.name: Hag's Hand Demo
demos.short_description: A tower defense game that blends Brazilian folklore myths with card management. Protect the forest by summoning the creatures that dwell within the wilds. As invaders push deeper into the untamed woods, the witch Cuca merely watches their movement, waiting for the perfect moment to strike.

demos.name: Ribbit Rogue Demo
demos.short_description: Stop the corruption in this strategic turn based deck-builder roguelike. Collect and upgrade dice for your limited deck, discover powerful relics to create game breaking synergies, and navigate unique events on your way to the heart of the swamp.

demos.name: Forest Fighters Demo
demos.short_description: Arcade puzzle-battle with strategic depth. Build megablocks, trigger chains to send garbage flying. Counter incoming attacks through careful timing. 23 characters, each playing uniquely. No pay-to-win.

demos.name: Super Beefit Demo
demos.short_description: Help Beefit brave perilous lands and cavernous depths to rescue his bovine love in this tight, precision platformer with responsive controls, and skill-based gameplay.

demos.name: Memoirium Demo
demos.short_description: DEMO FEATURES THE FIRST TWO STARTING AREAS. Traverse a chaotic and crumbling realm of dreams composed of liminal spaces. Adapt to the world’s odd rules as a Dreamer, and defy others like you to escape the strange and eclectic subconscious landscape.

demos.name: Bad Actor Demo
demos.short_description: Bad actor is a casual puzzle game where you play as a casting director creating unique performances!

demos.name: HellSlave II: Judgment of the Archon Demo
demos.short_description:
The Heavens are done waiting. 
In this dark fantasy dungeon crawler RPG, the Archon descends to end the demon war once and for all. Make your stand in HellSlave II, more immersive, brutal, and customizable than ever. The reckoning begins now.

demos.name: Boot the Beet Demo
demos.short_description: Boot the Beet is a high-impact arcade brawler where the only thing between your harvest and a swarm of hungry aliens is a heavy steel toe. Forget guns and magic—this is about the raw stopping power of a well-placed kick.

demos.name: One Day To Live Demo
demos.short_description: The entire world is infected. Many have already turned. The booster shots can only hold off the infection for 24 hours at a time now. You only have one day to live, will you survive?

demos.name: Subgrid Demo
demos.short_description: Welcome to the night shift. You're an underground mechanic tinkering with salvaged hardware and retro-chassis.
