Wire up your rigs, deploy them into automated combat arenas, and sit back while the telemetry rolls in. Grind scrap, synthesize experimental parts, and perfect your machines.

demos.name: Crop Dead Demo
demos.short_description: Defend your coffin in this action roguelite tower defense hybrid! Grow magical weapons and guard crops to blast through slime waves. Climb a dark gothic tower, unlock unique characters, and master meta-upgrades in the Soul Forge. High-octane pixel art combat awaits!

demos.name: The Fifteenth: A Pluvial Prelude Demo
demos.short_description: 2000年，暴雨封锁的奇瑶坞教堂，是只邀请“有罪之人”的命运舞台。主角冼夏涛为追查弟弟死亡的真相只身入局，却跌入敌对组织编织的罗网。这场以性命为筹码的游戏中，精英人士，帮派组织，边缘人群悉数登场，每个人都背负着不可言说的秘密。你必须在成为下一个受害者前，推演出案件的真相和唯一的生路。

demos.name: Zero Out Demo
demos.short_description: Complete puzzles by zeroing out the board! This is achieved by placing the pieces onto the board. Once the piece is placed, the numbers of the affiliated squares on the board will decrease based on the number of the piece. Pieces may need to be rotated or flipped.

demos.name: The Last Gap DEMO
demos.short_description: Meistere die engsten Parklücken und schalte stylische Upgrades in diesem physikbasierten Einpark-Simulator frei!

highlights.trailer_name: THE LAST GAP - Official Release Date Trailer

demos.name: Nevergrind Demo
demos.short_description: Embark on a legendary treasure-hunt in Vandamor! Master real-time combat and build lethal chain combos for epic rewards. Define your playstyle with a unique talent tree and discover powerful items! Experience a streamlined dungeon crawl focused on pure combat and treasure hunting!

demos.name: Rayborne Demo
demos.short_description: Rayborne is a puzzle game built around lasers, physics, and real-time light simulation. Solve handcrafted challenges by shaping light itself while uncovering the mystery behind a questionable AI research facility.

demos.name: Jeff & Cubie Demo
demos.short_description: A sci-fi tower defense where misunderstandings spiral into a full-blown galactic meltdown.

demos.name: Thinky Wants To Guess Demo
demos.short_description: Draw a simple sketch and see if the AI can guess it. Thinky Wants To Guess is a relaxing drawing game that challenges your creativity with an AI trying to understand your doodles.

demos.name: Demon Draw Demo
developers: Beijing XinJing Culture Communication Co., Ltd
publishers: Beijing XinJing Culture Communication Co., Ltd

demos.name: Fantasy Bird Woods Demo
demos.short_description: Fantasy Bird Woods is a desktop idle game. Observe and guide mystical birds on the right side of your screen. They evolve alongside your work or study without window-switching. Enjoy light interaction and a sense of companionship during breaks with these evolving digital pets.

demos.name: Slums: DriveBy Demo
demos.short_description: A gritty third-person action game set in the crime-ridden SlumCity where you take on contracts to gain money and use your fists, melee weapons and firearms to get ahead in the game. As you progress, use your cash to gain leverage- but remember, you got a Debt to pay, or else...

demos.name: Violeta Artificial Demo
demos.short_description: A visual novel about identity and social validation. Step into Violeta’s life and make choices that shape who she really becomes.

demos.name: Big Tiddy Moms to the Rescue Demo
Integrity Demo
demos.short_description: If grid-based, board-game-like turn-based combat has ever felt restrictive to you, experience Integrity. Move freely, destroy or create terrain with your skills, and manage line of sight and stamina in a turn-based tactical RPG where every decision can decide the outcome.

demos.name: Gold Coast Gambits: Boca Raton & Palm Beach Demo
Pixel City Demo
demos.short_description: A fully pixelated city? You just graduated from Pixel University, and you still need to pay your student loans. Can you find your way to survive in this Pixel City? You will have to find a job to keep life going!

demos.name: Deckslinger Demo
demos.short_description: Decked Out is a card-slinging deck-building roguelike. Use cards in real time to wipe out waves of enemies in order to defend and upgrade your town.

demos.name: Brute Battles Demo
demos.short_description: Fight against other players in this medieval auto-battler! Customize your brute with stats, 45+ traits, pets, and randomly generated weapons. Will you be at the top of the leaderboards?

demos.name: Beyond Hatred Demo
demos.short_description: Beyond Hatred (Demo) is a 2D ARPG where you follow Daran on his quest to rescue Alexia. Fight enemies, overcome obstacles, and gear up to survive in a hostile world filled with danger and challenges at every step.

demos.name: Sting & Swing Demo
demos.short_description: Explore a strange overgrown world as a bee with a golf ball. Master the skills of bee-golf to uncover the mysteries hidden in its furthest reaches and hiding in front of you. Discover uses for abilities you didn't know you had. There are always more secrets for those who seek them beneath the green.

demos.name: Dwarven Forge Demo
demos.short_description: Master the early depths in the Dwarven Forge Demo. Use your fireball-flinging lantern to mine Iron and clear paths. Experience the core incremental loop: upgrade digging power, optimize ore yields, and craft Iron weapons for profit. Start your journey into the mountain’s secrets today!

demos.name: My Coworkers Are Made Of Static Demo
demos.short_description: A horror game, where you found yourself trapped at your job. Leave the office. And remember - The Spider is watching.

demos.name: Happy My Friends Demo
demos.short_description:
Happy My Friends is an 8-player competitive multiplayer game where cute characters destroy each other blindly. In the demo version, the main game mode is available.
Increase your rank and unlock new skins for characters and weapons.

demos.name: Soul Reaper: Endless Harvest Demo
demos.short_description: Reap souls. Open the portal. Extract or risk it all. A skill-based bullet heaven where every battle is a short harvest. Souls reaped before the portal are safe, souls after are at risk. Spend them in a permanent skill tree, beat the level, push to the next.

demos.name: Jump Broke Demo
demos.short_description: Play as a legless Mimic whose only way to move is by blasting gold coins at the ground, using physical recoil to jump. The rule is simple: 1 jump costs 1 gold coin. Precisely control the force and angle of every leap. Finish in heavy debt, or reach the summit decently with your treasure intact.

demos.name: SHOTRUN Demo
demos.short_description: One shot. One kill. SHOTRUN throws you into a brutal office nightmare where only the fastest survive. Blast your way through and reach The Manager at any cost.

demos.name: Turbo Horizon Demo
demos.short_description: Drive through a vibrant world of color and chaos, smashing obstacles and chasing distance in a relaxing, physics-driven experience. Customize your environment and master the art of controlled destruction.

demos.name: Proto Zero Demo
demos.short_description:
There Is No Point In Looking Back. The Only Way Left Is Forward. - O. 

Escape the mega complex and find out what happened to the world our Protagonist Yuuto once knew after his long slumber, in this new generation 3d action sci-fi brawler.

demos.name: Strawberry Flavor Sci-Fi Demo
demos.short_description: Like strawberries? If they went extinct, how would we find their taste again? This fundamentalist suspense & sci-fi visual novel lets you step into the shoes of an Ocular to unravel a series of conspiracies woven from tech ethics and human nature in a near-future world that could arrive anytime.

demos.name: Edd Skeleton VR Demo
demos.short_description: Try the Edd Skeleton VR demo! In addition to seeing how it runs on your hardware, in this demo you'll meet Edd, shoot terrifying monsters, and get scared out of your wits by Skull Face.

demos.name: The First Million Demo
demos.short_description: An incremental deckbuilder where you constantly unlock new cards and upgrades and discover one game-breaking strategy after another to make THE FIRST MILLION — and then many more!

demos.name: IRON-PLUNDER Demo
demos.short_description:
THE PLUNDER AWAITS!
Ambient Noise needs comic books, and the Mecha-Skull shrines of the Machine-Faith can be traded for comics!
Assault their constantly shifting stronghold by way of action-packed arcade twin-stick shooting, 
Crush your foes and get the IRON-PLUNDER (That being comics).

demos.name: Aether Keepers Demo
demos.short_description: Protect the core! Don't let the demons eat it! Welcome to this addictive incremental tower defense challenge. Build and upgrade your army in real-time to get stronger and stronger. Create your invincible legion—All units move out!

demos.name: Gummy Invaders Demo
demos.short_description: To denounce the evils of truth and love, the lovely charming germ agents, Gummy Invaders, blasting through the veins at the speed of light! In this incremental game, you’ll lead your germ agents through constant evolution. Upgrade skill tree, multiply  forces, and teach those troublemakers a lesson!

demos.name: Ember Express Demo
demos.short_description: Ember Express is a sci-fi light yuri narrative adventure. Step into the role of a junior researcher at megacorporation COSMIC, uncover the truth behind the "Ember" incident, and rekindle a buried memory with your mysterious superior.

demos.name: Backgaminion Demo
demos.short_description: Open boosters, build your deck, and fight your way through an adventure map filled with events, battles, and treasures. Lose, adapt, and try again. Backgaminion is a fantasy roguelike deckbuilder.

demos.name: Gunshot Survivors VR Demo
demos.short_description:
Gunshot Survivors VR is a VR roguelike shooter where you upgrade your gun and defeat enemies to survive.
Build the ultimate gun and defeat the robot swarm!

demos.name: The Door at the End of the Hall Demo
demos.short_description: Trapped in a looping hallway, you must study subtle changes to choose the right doors. Each passage resets the hall, but slightly wrong. Observe carefully, make smart choices, and uncover the path that unlocks the mysterious door at the end of the hall.

demos.name: Flame Up Demo
demos.short_description: Flame Up is a simplistic fighting game with no jumping, no blocking, no health, and no fuss, only you and your neutral. Featuring easy to learn systems and intuitive controls.

demos.name: Dice Gun Commando Demo
demos.short_description: Guns roll dice. Dice trigger mods. Mods cause MAYHEM! Destroy waves of alien horrors in this bullet heaven roguelite by building an arsenal of dice-driven, synergistic weaponry.

demos.name: Fear the ring place 0 Demo
demos.short_description: Fear The Ring Place 0 is a first-person horror game blending RPG-style illustrated storytelling with 3D environment exploration. Set in a brutal world overrun by ghosts and cults, you step onto this ensemble drama stage, guiding characters through peril.

demos.name: Hex Shop Demo
demos.short_description: Run your late grandmother’s occult shop by day, survive demonic hauntings by night, and uncover your family’s centuries-old covenant with Hell.

demos.name: Morse Depths: WWII Demo
demos.short_description: Take command of a WWII submarine. Master Morse Code to fire torpedoes, defuse mines, and survive the final siege. From 1942 to 1945, every dot and dash is the difference between glory and the ocean floor.

demos.name: Sexy walk through the woods Demo
Track Star Demo
demos.short_description: Track Star is a track and field career sim where you manage one athlete through their high school career. In the demo, you are limited to two seasons, which gives you a feel for the gameplay.

demos.name: Mass Edge - Gravity Ball Demo
demos.short_description: Mass Edge Demo is a vibrant 3D puzzle-platformer inspired by the cult 90s classic Game, bringing back that unforgettable feeling of rolling, balancing, and thinking your way through impossible spaces.

demos.name: Field of Heroes Demo
demos.short_description: Swords, sorcery – and soccer. Assemble your orc players in Field of Heroes, the wildest, most radical online fantasy sports brawler ever. Conquer fields, sharpen your weapons, focus your spells, and SCORE!

demos.name: Perfect Castle Demo
demos.short_description: Cursed paths, dead ruins, and whispers in the dark. Every click leads you deeper, opens new paths, and leaves a mark on you. A  horror RPG clicker  in a cruel medieval world. Grow through your actions, and face ritual battles shaped by cursed bones and desperate choices.

demos.name: Phantacall Realm
demos.short_description:
A unique game that fuses the “Memory card” card-matching mechanic with RPG.
By flipping cards to looting treasures, and synthesizing cards. Your gift of memory may grant you fortune, but true progress comes from mastering skills, wielding relics, and relying on strategy.

demos.name: Floors of Fate Demo
demos.short_description: Step into the relentless 11-floor demo of Floors of Fate! Venture through Orc Caves in a dark fantasy world, discover 2 different weapons, and survive challenging action RPG combat. Begin your ascent now to uncover the mysteries of the tower!

demos.name: Rotten Chamber Demo
demos.short_description: A single-player logic puzzle disguised as social deduction. Read the claims of a corrupt city council, catch the liars and arrest them, but every wrong call brings you closer to losing it all.

demos.name: Battle : Frenzy Zone
demos.short_description: A unique mixture of Turn-based gameplay, RNG mechanics and Roguelike elements in a Fighting game format. Four different symbols to choose from in every turn. Symbol matches will trigger actions. Strategize around the RNG factor to achieve victory. Test your skills on PVE or Multiplayer modes.

demos.name: Rashin Detective Chronicles CASE01： The Final Page Demo
Void Signal Demo
demos.short_description: An immersive sci-fi space shooter where you pilot a ship through an anomalously expanding region of space. Analyze real-time scientific data, survive encounters with mysterious alien entities, make ethical decisions, and uncover hidden truths as the universe around you transforms.

demos.name: Fibula Demo
demos.short_description: Embark on a dark fantasy action RPG adventure alone or with friends. Master combat and magic, explore dangerous dungeons, build a home, and create your own path through the world of Fibula.

demos.name: Janet DeMornay Is A Slumlord (and a witch) Demo
Archipeo Demo
demos.short_description: Build a thriving island empire in this retro city-builder. Automate complex supply chains and shape your archipelago across singleplayer and 16-player multiplayer.

demos.name: Flock Off! Demo
demos.short_description: Flock Off! is a first-person action adventure game for 1–4 players. Team up with friends to survive a strange and woolly uprising in the remote Scottish Highlands. Improvise with oddball weapons to fend off zombified sheep and uncover unexpected twists. Will you survive the Sheepocalypse?

demos.name: Grandpa Needs Fish Demo
demos.short_description: Grandpa Needs Fish is a cozy idle clicker game where fortune rides the waves. You are Abraham and you have one mission: catch as many fish as possible. Every cast brings new rewards and every upgrade makes you stronger. Hover, catch, upgrade, and repeat in this satisfying idle incremental adventure.

demos.name: No Final Run Demo
demos.short_description: A quick, skill‑based action game focused on dodging, timing, and survival. Explore a procedurally generated world with infinitely scaling difficulty and compete for the top spot on the global leaderboard.

demos.name: 界墨山河 (INK Mountains And Rivers) Demo
demos.short_description: 《INK Mountains And Rivers》is a casual ink style idle collection and cultivation game, with themes taken from worldviews similar to Shanhai and Honghuang. It is a mountain and river world full of exotic beasts. Here, you can collect various exotic beasts, cultivate them to become stronger.

demos.name: Haunted Bar Simulator 🍻 Demo
demos.short_description:
Run a cozy bar with friends by day.
Serve strange customers and survive the horror by night.

demos.name: Down Below: Chapter One
demos.short_description: In this top-down pixel art adventure, you wake up in a dark hallway, unaware of your surroundings. The only person you see is a zany, smiling man tied to a boulder. Where have you ended up?

demos.name: $$$://somnialys i am tired, so i bought a couple of dreams: First Dream
demos.short_description:
An adventure game about exploring dreams purchased by an office worker who can no longer dream.
Using the “Somnialys” dream console, explore surreal/weirdcore worlds that loop endlessly and solve the puzzles to wake up.

demos.name: Clay Crusade: Night of the Necromancer Demo
demos.short_description: Claymation hack n' slash zombie survival horror game set in fantasy world. Team up with your friends, upgrade your arsenal and slash through hordes of zombies to defeat the evil necromancer.

highlights.trailer_name: Clay Crusade: Night of the Necromancer Announcement Trailer

demos.name: Dungeon Dilemma Demo
demos.short_description: A Dungeon Builder and Crawler Roguelike where you can construct your own dungeon or raid one designed by your friends. Vie for victory, defeat minions, and evade traps as a party of up to 4 Challengers, or create the most diabolical dungeon imaginable as the Dungeon Boss!

demos.name: EVEN OR ODD 1 Demo
demos.short_description:
"Even? Odd? Forget the math!" Enter the Collatz Conjecture—mathematics' greatest unsolved mystery—reimagined as a high-speed roguelike action game. 
Play as "Ichi," the muscle-brained magical girl, teleporting between lanes to smash back incoming numbers with charge shots!

demos.name: Stack Up Demo
demos.short_description: A multiplayer tactical shooter focused on realistic weapon handling and special forces tactics. Work with your team, master authentic firearm mechanics, and fight through intense close-quarters combat across multiple game modes.

demos.name: Unbelievers Demo
demos.short_description: A psychological horror FPS where time fractures between 1986 and an alternate 1919. Fight nightmarish creatures, uncover a dark conspiracy, and struggle to reclaim your place in time.

demos.name: The Birds of Egg Isle Demo
demos.short_description: Run a small sanctuary on Egg Island: grow birdseed, care for birds, hatch eggs, and collect different species of birds through breeding and genetic combinations. This demo showcases the game's core cycle of planting, raising, hatching, and collecting.

demos.name: Bee Space Demo
demos.short_description: Plant flowers and deploy tech from orbit in this roguelike deckbuilder! Terraform tiny hex grid islands as advanced space Bees. Contend with fickle weather, strange creatures, mysterious artifacts and meddling bosses as you reclaim Earth for all Bee-Kind!

demos.name: ReEvolution Project Demo
demos.short_description: A singleplayer story-driven horror game set in a desolate post-apocalyptic world. Explore a decaying abandoned house, scavenging for supplies and uncovering fragments of its story. Solve environmental puzzles that challenge your perception, and decide how deep you're willing to dig.

demos.name: Oh!Ware Demo
demos.short_description:
Sow marbles, chain their movement, and control the board.

Oh!Ware is a roguelike where you build your deck, trigger captures and effects, and turn every carefully planned move into a devastating chain reaction.

demos.name: Craft. Sell. Goblin. Repeat. Demo
demos.short_description: Build and manage your own goblin shop. Craft unique weapons with minigames and negotiate their price! Hire workers to help you run the business! Become the richest merchant in the kingdom!

demos.name: Earthlings Demo
demos.short_description: Earthlings is a side-scrolling settlement builder. Manage your colonies and survive disasters while you make weird monuments for a space delivery guy pretending to be your God.

demos.name: Caterpillar King Demo
demos.short_description: Protect a cute baby Caterpillar so he can safely reach his food! Plan your moves carefully in this turn-based puzzle game about finding a chosen family.

demos.name: Shippin Demo
demos.short_description: Embark on a narrative adventure in a mist-covered world where memories fade and harbors hide secrets. Rebuild your ship, help its people, and unravel the mystery threatening to erase the oceanic world of Shippin forever.

demos.name: Exark Demo
demos.short_description: Exark is a run-based engine builder where you command a gigantic ark-ship. Construct buildings, hire crew with unique skills, and exploit powerful synergies to survive your voyage to the rim of the world.

demos.name: Happy Village: The Broken Timeline Demo
demos.short_description: A narrative RPG of three intertwined stories, hidden secrets, and a broken timeline only the player can repair. Every ending reveals new paths... if you know where to look.

demos.name: Cloudbreaker Demo
demos.short_description: Bullet Heaven meets Inventory Management. Dive through a sky-world, shred hordes of enemies, and slot engine parts into your airship's grid to build absurd synergies. A roguelite where placement, not luck, decides the run. Every ship has a different grid to solve.

demos.name: Loser Got Isekai’d – Sex, Side Jobs, and Odd Tasks Demo
demos.short_description: You arrive in a city altered by a mysterious energy. To find your way home, you must assist seven women and earn their trust. This is a story-driven adult adventure game featuring character interaction. In this dangerous and enigmatic city, your choices determine your path back.

demos.name: Get in the Hole Demo
demos.short_description: A roguelike about pushing things into a hole. Satisfy the hole by unlocking new things, helpers, and upgrades, creating powerful combos to keep up with the hole's bottomless hunger.

demos.name: Unshine Arcade Demo
demos.short_description: An arcade full of secrets, a sentient virtual pet in the prize cabinet, a stealth shooter roguelite arcade machine and one way to escape: win tickets.

demos.name: Axe Me Why Demo
demos.short_description: Survive 15-minute runs with 3D movement & uneven terrain in the Spirit Realm. Fight, forage & adapt while defending your village’s fading spirit. The Demo takes you through the tutorial, one run and early interactions in NPC dialogue. The feedback & sampling area for all public features is here!

demos.name: IKARUS Demo
demos.short_description: IKARUS blends the bullet-hell chaos of arcade shmups with the strategic edge of a roguelike deck-builder. Dodge, parry, and shoot through waves of hostile machines while crafting game-breaking card synergies. How close to the sun will you fly?

demos.name: Space Snatcher Demo
demos.short_description: 1-6 player co-op horror chaos where you're trapped aboard increasingly dangerous space stations. Scan every monster the Company demands, scavenge for powerful items to help you survive, and keep the ship's systems repaired. But the biggest threat might just be your friends.

demos.name: Nimbit Frontier Demo
demos.short_description: Raise adorable Nimbits, build warm little habitats, and explore the shifting Underwild for fragments and treasures. Experience a two-hour sample of the game in this demo, including one early Underwild biome, habitat building, and the first release cycle.

demos.name: Light Dude Demo
demos.short_description: The level hides when you move in this skill-based action game. Scan the level, then step into the dark. Dodge deadly threats, outmaneuver enemies, and defeat brutal bosses to reclaim the stolen sun. No map. No safety. Just your skill. Demo Out Now!

demos.name: Trickshotterz Demo
demos.short_description: BEER PONG GETS GUNS... Only shots in the top count, pick abilities, grab wild powerups, and pull off absurd trickshots that hit harder the crazier they are. Play with up to 4 players locally, online, or hop into public matchmaking.

demos.name: Magical Thief Silky Demo
demos.short_description: Free Demo Version of Magical Thief Silky.

demos.name: Please, Spin Demo
demos.short_description: The wheel of fate roguelike where you spin for your life. Customize your wheel, discover game-breaking relics, survive twisted side events, and outsmart rigged bosses to beat the lunatic host and escape the broadcast!

demos.name: Mining and Dwarves Demo
demos.short_description: Mining and Dwarves is an incremental game where you mine rocks, gather ore, and recruit dwarves. Use powerful abilities for maximum gains, or relax and let your dwarves do the work.

demos.name: The Missing Threads Demo
demos.short_description:
Who am I, without my memories?
Armed with nothing but the knowledge that I was once a detective,
I face the cases before me, piecing together fragments of truth—
deciding which leads to follow, which voices to trust,
and how quickly I can reach the answer.

demos.name: 삼국연의 : 한조재흥의 꿈 Demo
demos.short_description: 몰락하는 한 왕조를 세우기 위한 유비의 위대한 여정! 유려한 BGM과 귀여운 도트 그래픽으로 재탄생한 삼국지 SRPG입니다. 15종의 다양한 병종별 상성과 상성과 책략을 활용한 전략적 전투, 50여 개의 전장에서의 활약을 통해, 몰락해가는 한나라의 부흥을 이끌어보세요.

demos.name: FISH Demo
demos.short_description: FISH is a Platformer Run & Gun Shooter where you play as an armed FISH violently exploring through multiple levels. The game features a funny, unique stylized artstyle that could get a chuckle out of you!

demos.name: The Minesweeper Demo
demos.short_description: The classic game of minesweeper from a fresh new perspective. Toss grenades, plant flags, and math a path to victory. Enjoy the calm of nature, chill tunes and chaotic reveals.

demos.name: VANRAN Demo
demos.short_description: Descend into hell and carve your way through monstrous enemies in this brutal action demo of VANRAN. Experience aggressive melee combat, violent executions, and your first encounter with a living colossus.

demos.name: Bullet Meltdown Demo
demos.short_description: An adrenaline-pumping bullet heaven where death is permanent. Hire and evolve unique companions, discover 950+ weapon variations, and fight through swarms of enemies and bosses. Grow stronger every run, but if your team falls, they're gone for good.

demos.name: Claws Of Power Demo
demos.short_description: Claws of Power is a cute, real-time card battle game. With a variety of unique and adorable cat cards, each one could be your key to victory. Strategize by building different decks and using items to overcome challenges and claim the throne as the ultimate cat leader.

demos.name: Epic Idlenture Demo
demos.short_description: A pixel art idle dungeon crawler where you fight automatically, gather loot, upgrade gear, and unlock new attributes and skills to progress deeper into the dungeon.

demos.name: Love  in Summer Demo
demos.short_description:
毕业自驾游？不，是「心动修罗场」！
《盛夏离与合》是现象级互动影像系列《完蛋！我被美女包围了！》IP的全新篇章。本次我们将填补“完蛋宇宙”时间线上的关键一块，带你回到那个承前启后、充满无限可能的毕业季，体验一段关于成长、抉择与命运交织的动人故事。
这段承前启后的夏日篇章，都会因你每一次的抉择，导向独一无二的盛夏结局。

demos.name: Kill Code Demo
demos.short_description: Hunt the last remnants of humanity in a world shattered by war. Master brutal melee weapons, unleash powerful relics, and transform ORB your deadly robotic companion into the ultimate weapon of destruction.

demos.name: Cozy~Fishing Kitten Demo
demos.short_description: Dive into a cozy, idle fishing experience! Cast your line from a little corner on your desktop. Customize your cute avatar and background, then feed and collect adorable cats of all breeds. Unlock beautiful scenes and jump into multiplayer and sneak in some "chill-time" with friends!

demos.name: Poker Warrior Demo
demos.short_description: This is a roguelike deck-builder game around poker suits. Hearts fuel survival, Spades drive strength, Diamonds power wealth, and Clubs embrace chaos. Through deck construction and card fusion, you can twist the suits, break expectations, and uncover wildly different builds.

demos.name: 星天へ発つ日 Demo
demos.short_description: ───暴いて。瞳に映ったその全て。伝奇サスペンスビジュアルノベル。

demos.name: Herd Demo
demos.short_description: Build your set, outplay your rival, and win the Mélodus in a cute musical card battler where every match becomes a live performance.

demos.name: 100FRIENDS Demo
demos.short_description: 100FRIENDS is a brick-breaking roguelite where your ammo is 100 friends. Launch chefs, grandmas, vampires, and other friends at waves of enemies, build-crafting ridiculous chain reactions. Every bullet is your bestie, and they always have your back :)

demos.name: Gold and Wars Demo
demos.short_description: A medieval strategy board game where economics, territory, and tactical card battles decide the fate of a kingdom. Each game is a struggle for influence, resources, and map control, just like in a real board game. Immerse yourself in the harsh and opulent world of the Middle Ages, where every dec...

demos.name: Fowl Brawl: When Chickens Fly Demo
demos.short_description: A physics-based catapult defense game with cute art and strategic depth. On a forgotten planet, magic-tech collision sparks a species war. Players control magical duck heroes, using ancient totems as boosters across six extreme terrains to battle mechanized chicken legions.

highlights.trailer_name: Fowl Brawl: When Chickens Fly GamePlay ENG

demos.name: NIPH Demo
demos.short_description: NIPH is a stylish roguelite platformer with risky and intense combat. Slash, shoot, and learn and cast spells with more varied items as you explore a vast and diverse fantasy world!

demos.name: Serenade of the Soul Demo
demos.short_description: 7 days granted at life's end. "The night air is pleasant, isn't it?" A story as calm as the evening breeze, shared with a fairy found in despair. A classic romance brought to life through full Korean voice acting and lyrical New Age music.

demos.name: Rupture Demo
demos.short_description: When the Anomaly tore our sky apart, the Scourge armada poured through. Now, to save humanity, you must cross the Rupture and assault their most sacred stronghold: The Reliquary.

demos.name: Knock It Over, Again? Demo
demos.short_description: Master your skills as a cat to knock things over! Pushing things to fall off the edge is easy, but what if you have some targets that are harder to hit just right? Test your physics intuition and see how long your perseverance lasts before you rage-quit.

demos.name: Kat Kat: The Food Truck Demo
Soul Strip: Waifu Card Battler Demo
A Good Day Fishing Demo
demos.short_description: A Good Day Fishing is a gamified focus tool where you catch fish while completing real-life tasks. Reel in and record new species, decorate your favorite cozy fishing spot, and customize your soundscape to create a custom vibe to help you relax and boost concentration.

demos.name: Bubble Shooter but In Space and Incremental Demo
demos.short_description:
A short, satisfying incremental game about flying through space, popping bubbles, and harvesting Bubble Matter. 
Build combos, land skillshots for massive multipliers, and spend your loot in a sprawling upgrade shop.

demos.name: Temptation Loop Demo
demos.short_description: Fight, fail, grow, and talk your way through a branching story in this hybrid incremental roguelike and visual novel.

demos.name: CADDIE Demo
demos.short_description: Try the first 9 holes of CADDIE, the golf game that puts you in the passanger seat.

demos.name: Digital Footprint: Cyber Investigation Demo
demos.short_description: Experience the first case of Digital Footprint in this Work in Progress demo. Step into a fully interactive OS interface, analyze private data, and connect the dots. The game is still in active development—try the demo, share your feedback, and add to your Wishlist to support the journey!

demos.name: Sandfall: Rock Smash Demo
demos.short_description: Smash rocks with hammer. Sand falls in cart. Make money. Repeat.

demos.name: YGGDRA: SURVIVOR Demo
demos.short_description:
"You want ME to save the world? I'm just a convenience store part-timer!"
A black tower threatens Earth. Summon 30 legendary heroes to climb 100 floors! Roguelite defense meets bullet-hell survival. Command your champions from zero to hero!

demos.name: Love All My Girls
demos.short_description: What would you do with infinite resurrection and time travel? Predict the future, save the world, get rich overnight… or date six girls at once? You’ve lived every man’s dream but stepped into a fatal trap. You’re just trying to make them all happy—what’s wrong with that?

demos.name: ACT LIKE TOYS! (A.L.T.) Demo
demos.short_description: Rescue abandoned toys and find your way back to your owner in this thrilling co-op action adventure! Evade those who seek to break or discard you by using the ultimate survival tactic: stop moving and 'Act Like Toys!' to blend in.

demos.name: Cubie Demo
demos.short_description: CUBIE is a minimalist puzzle platformer where you control gravity. Each side of the cube offers unique physics based on how you enter it. The world remains the same – only your perspective changes. Can you solve spatial puzzles in a labyrinth where "up" is just a relative term?

demos.name: FLESHBREAK Demo
demos.short_description: A story-driven survival visual novel inspired by SCP-610. Face a flesh-spreading outbreak, make brutal moral choices, protect the people you can’t let go of, and uncover the terrifying truth behind the disease.

demos.name: Moanarchy Demo
demos.short_description: Rule a whimsical kingdom, hear absurd petitions, and grow a chaotic royal harem. Balance Gold, Population, and Happiness while juggling politics, comedy, and courtly drama in this parody mix of strategy and romance.

demos.name: A.V.E.N.A Demo
demos.short_description: Pilot disposable combat drones through the Primal Portal in a sci-fi action roguelike. Customize your drone, fight through various missions, recover research data and alien technology to enhance your drone setup for the next session.

demos.name: Stop and Smell the Flowers Demo
demos.short_description: Relax in your shady garden and watch the flowers grow. Seeds have a chance of mutating into a new species of flower -- follow the chart to complete the collection of over 100 flower types!

demos.name: Overvoid Demo
demos.short_description: Overvoid - is a dark sci-fi third-person action roguelike. You are a starship pilot trapped in an endless cycle across hostile space sectors. Fight relentless enemy waves, experiment with builds, gather resources, and unlock weapons, ships, and modules to break the cycle.

demos.name: Marked Souls Demo
demos.short_description: How far would you go to undo death? Marked Souls is a psychological horror visual novel about five orphans trapped in an isolated manor. Uncover the shelter's dark history, perform a forbidden ritual, and try to survive the consequences.

demos.name: The Ayna Demo
demos.short_description: The Ayna is a psychological exploration game set in Türkiye, inspired by the music video aesthetics and lyrical themes of a female vocalist. The player is tasked with noticing anomalies in the concert venue and uncovering the truth.

demos.name: Lethal Ghosts Demo
demos.short_description: Become a rookie ghost investigator uncovering the truth behind supernatural entities. Gather evidence, identify each unique threat and get a taste of what the full game is like.

demos.name: HOP-CO-OP Demo
demos.short_description: HOP-CO-OP Demo: try the free demo of this first-person bunny hop parkour game. Master precision movement across 5 handcrafted maps, play with friends in online co-op, and battle with powerups. Wishlist the full game for more content!

demos.name: how to kill a fly [ H2KAF ] Demo
Deepcore Demo
demos.short_description: A run-based mining incremental where you steer a drill rig, bank ore, unlock deeper tiers, and turn fast dives into permanent upgrades.

demos.name: Split Fate Demo
demos.short_description: Split Fate is a 2D co-op game for two players where you control fire and ice characters. Work together to solve puzzles, fight enemies, and progress through levels. Success depends on teamwork, timing, and coordination between both players.

demos.name: Zorbo Demo
demos.short_description: Step into the ruthless world of Zorbo. Every corner is full of danger, and every enemy brings a different challenge. Improve your skills, set your strategy, and survive against smart enemies. Discover secrets, choose your weapon, and write your own legend. Are you ready?

demos.name: Everglen Demo
demos.short_description: Build your dream farm in a cozy pixel RPG. Grow crops, fish, mine, and explore a charming island full of secrets. Meet unique NPCs, craft and trade items, and uncover magical surprises at your own pace. Relax, explore, and create your story in this farming adventure.

demos.name: Selfie Worm Demo
demos.short_description: Selfie Worm is a cozy adventure blending squishy 2D physics with photography. Control an elastic worm through a colorless world, capturing selfies to restore vibrancy and uncover a heartwarming narrative. Featuring a built-in "Anti-Boss Mode" and Focus Timer, it turns work breaks into healing times.

demos.name: K2-18b: Legacy Demo
demos.short_description: Immerse yourself in the mysterious atmosphere of exoplanet K2-18b. Traverse its unusual labyrinths, uncover a captivating story, and reveal the world's secrets - all set to an atmospheric original soundtrack. Every decision brings you closer to the truth... or to one of several endings.

demos.name: SAKIMORI Demo
demos.short_description:
"Sakimori, find and purify the Cursed Objects disrupting the boundary."

Explore shunned ruins and observe invisible threats. With Tsukino Saku, a spirit sentinel, survive where Utsushiyo (living) and Kakuriyo (spirit) intersect. Purify Cursed Objects in this Japanese survival horror action.

demos.name: Lust and Agony in Netori:The Ritual of Despair Demo
demos.short_description: After moving back to her husband's childhood village, Chinastu discovers that beneath its peace lies a forbidden custom "Men and women may cross the boundaries of marriage and love freely."

demos.name: Gladiator's Revenge Demo
demos.short_description:
Gladiator’s Revenge is a fast-paced 2D action and strategy game focused on arena survival. master the real-time combat and pick your character's skills to overcome escalating enemies in the Arena!
Controlls: Enter, arrows, and q w e r (optional- mouse).

demos.name: The Lucky Hive Demo
demos.short_description: Play poker with your friends in The Hive! Relax, enjoy yourself, maybe you'll get a royal flush? Who knows what else you might get? Lots to uncover in this simple game of poker...

demos.name: INTERRED Demo
demos.short_description: He never blinks. You wake up across from a presence in a room with no exit. Play a distorted, stat-based strategy gamble on a 5x5 grid. Draw from the chest, upgrade your stones, and outsmart an opponent who learns from your fear. Every move is a sacrifice. Don't keep Him waiting. Free demo.

demos.name: Blueprint: EV Demo
demos.short_description: Blueprint: EV is a single-player strategy game about founding an electric vehicle company and running it through six fiscal years. Make three founding decisions, then guide pricing, production, R&D, and finance across 24 quarters of real P&L against three rival companies.

demos.name: The Matter of Being Demo
demos.short_description: Set in the world of Cultist Simulator, haunt mortals and escape divine punishment in this unique relationship and resource management game. Strike Faustian pacts, manipulate mortals, and forsake your immortal life. Developed by Common Logic via Weather Factory's Sixth History License.

demos.name: EULA Demo ~HeartDokidoki Art Club~
demos.short_description: Release is imminent. EULA Demo is a short visual novel that asks, at the release button, what 【 the game I made 】 is, and what it means to make a game.

demos.name: GalactiBus Demo
demos.short_description: GalactiBus DEMO is an online co-op bus-driving simulator set in a wacky alien world. Team up as up to 4 players with friends or strangers. Keep the bus running, deliver your passengers “safely” and eliminate all threats along the way on this cosmic journey doomed to be disastrous.

demos.name: Prophecy of Vul Demo
demos.short_description: A playable demo of Prophecy of Vul featuring the game's first act. Meet the denizens of the forest and explore a beautiful pixel art world!

demos.name: Cellular Soup Demo
demos.short_description: Start as a tiny cell. End as the terror of the pond. Absorb plankton, viruses, and cells. Gather DNA, unlock upgrades! Swim, chase, and dodge your way to the top in this short active incremental game.

demos.name: All Vans on Deck Demo
demos.short_description: Build a parcel network from scratch in this hand-drawn logistics simulation. Connect cities with trucks, trains, ships and planes, choose your weekly upgrades, and rethink your routes as new cities appear and warehouses fill

demos.name: Character Limit Demo
demos.short_description: 12 Letters, No Mercy. The demo of the fast-paced typing word game. How long can you last before you hit your Character Limit?

demos.name: Kint Demo
demos.short_description: A text-based fantasy multiplayer RPG where all players must decide what lore is true. Explore the world of Seram, learn everything you can. Resolve conflicts between lore by voting each week. Can you solve the mystery behind the Kilns?

demos.name: Battle Boss Demo
demos.short_description: Manage your very own battlemon gym! In this demo, experience a few days in the life of a Battle Boss, where it's your job to battle challengers and manage your gym!

demos.name: Glowbot Tower Defense Demo
demos.short_description: Competitive endless sci-fi tower defense demo with global leaderboards where you place and upgrade Glowbots to defend against waves of enemies on the Cosmic Orbit map.

demos.name: Epic Action Packs Demo
demos.short_description: Become a master of Deckscovery when you combine cards, build your Master Deck and defeat the Deck Master while avoiding elemental weaknesses!

demos.name: Nightmare Hospital Demo
demos.short_description: Nightmare Hospital is a fast-paced horror game focused on chase sequences. You will play as a patient, encountering various entities in the hospital, and understanding and deciphering their rules is the only way to safely leave the hospital.

demos.name: rAIse: Embrace the Future Demo
demos.short_description: rAIse: Embrace the Future is a classic style first-person shooter inspired by cyberpunk and the golden age of 90s action games. Battle gangs and megacorporations in intense firefights driven by a brutal soundtrack.

demos.name: Bouncy Ball Demo
demos.short_description: Your goal: hit the red button with the ball! Each click teleports the ball across the screen, jumping between all four corners. Time your clicks, control the movement, and land every shot.

demos.name: Don't Knife Me! Demo
demos.short_description: Don't Knife Me! is a funny knife-throwing game. Throw knives at the target and hope that you hit it. You'll be laughing by the end of the game!

demos.name: The Undercut: Racing Manager Demo
demos.short_description: Experience one full race weekend in The Undercut: Racing Manager. Make pre-season decisions, then hit the track — practice, qualifying, and race day with a physics-driven 2D engine. Every circuit is procedurally generated. This is a taste of the full management sim.

demos.name: Prison Queen Demo
demos.short_description: In a world ruled by sharp tongues, one slip of the lip lands young Odette behind bars. Steal words from your fellow inmates, chain them into razor-sharp sentences, and talk your way up the prison food chain. Here, every sentence is a weapon.

demos.name: Industronaut Demo
demos.short_description: Survive the early hours of Industronaut. Build a basic habitat, produce oxygen, water, and food, mine the first resources, and start automating production before your space suit gives out.

demos.name: Chronicles Puzzle: Cesta historií Demo
demos.short_description: Experience a journey through history! This demo features 6 levels and 24 sliding puzzle challenges. Piece together the world from the Big Bang to the far future in 4 difficulties. Collect trophies and prepare for the full game with 80 levels. 14 languages & relaxing music included.

demos.name: 方寸甜序lovely bakery Demo
demos.short_description: 《lovely bakery》 is a cozy decorating game inspired by miniature houses. Step into bakery venues of various themes, arrange all kinds of items freely, turn an empty little house into your own private world, and enjoy relaxing and pleasant leisure time.

demos.name: Huglings Demo
demos.short_description: Huglings is a cozy adventure for 1-4 players where you can help the huglings restore their village, which was damaged by the goblins. Create peace as you farm, craft, and decorate your dream home. No pressure, just a peaceful world to explore and a heartwarming journey of friendship and helpfulness!

demos.name: Goal Idle Demo
demos.short_description: Goal Idle is a relaxing incremental game focused on scoring goals and earning money. Click to shoot balls into the goal, upgrade to better balls, unlock powerful skills, and hire Helpers that auto-score goals. Start with rubber balls and work your way up to golden balls. Satisfying and addictive.

demos.name: Immortal Cards
demos.short_description: A Xianxia Roguelike deckbuilder. 3 cultivators, 214 cards, 42 relics, 12 formations. Master Five Elements combat across 3 acts. 9 endings, 21 difficulty levels. Every run is unique.

demos.name: Wherever You Get Your Podcasts Demo
demos.short_description: A podcast simulator horror game with cozy vibes. Become a podcast editor, repair audio files, and find the hosts of the podcast Spooky Sacramento before the hard drive dies!

demos.name: Between Worlds: challenging puzzles Demo
demos.short_description:
"Between Worlds" is a 2D puzzle game where you reshape the boundary between two intertwined worlds to reach the goal.
Turn characters into terrain to create paths, but every change affects both sides of the world.
Use logic, shifting gravity, and creative thinking to solve complex puzzles.

demos.name: A Fighter's Nova: Mindara Demo
demos.short_description: A Fighter’s Nova: Mindara is a narrative-driven JRPG that fuses character-focused storytelling with the intensity and precision of a true tag-team fighting game.

demos.name: Dohyo Dreams: Rise to Yokozuna Demo
Medium Chronicles: Room 644 Demo
demos.short_description: You must speak to survive. But speaking might kill you. Whisper rituals into your microphone — while a demon hunts every sound you make.

demos.name: Promethean Thirst Demo
demos.short_description:
The brutal action-roguelike where Greek gods have tied your fate to smiting vampires. Return stolen Ichor to earn their fickle favor, unlock devastating weapons, and hunt down immortal horrors.
Play 2 of 5 zones in the this early demo.

demos.name: TooneQuest Demo
demos.short_description:
An exploring and capture game.
Find and capture all the unique creatures hiding on the 5 islands.
Discover Abilities such as Jump, Crawl, Glide and Double-jump to help you explore.

demos.name: MoeArmy vs SuArmy Demo
demos.short_description: Build structures that auto-spawn units. Pick your commander, outsmart the enemy! This Demo features the Moe Army faction with core gameplay.

demos.name: 这是Emoji Demo
demos.short_description: A small but “orthodox 3A” project: AI Coding, AI Drawing, and AI Assembling. Inspired by the format of 《这是谐音梗》, this game focuses on guessing words through Emoji. It currently includes over 200 puzzles, and also lets players create their own Emoji artwork. Feel free to try it!

demos.name: The Ministry for Anomaly Observation Demo
The Guild Manager Demo
demos.short_description: “Recruit your team, forge a legendary guild!”In this unique management simulation, you won't play as a lone hero—you'll become a Guild Master, leading a group of flesh-and-blood, distinct personalities from rookies to conquerors of epic raids.

demos.name: Dissolution of the Silent Union Demo
Stickman Obstacle Course Demo
demos.short_description:
Stickman Obstacle Course is a fully physics-based platformer.
You play as a stickman, making your way through game show-inspired obstacle courses.

demos.name: Art Studio Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Bring your wildest imagination to life in your art studio. Paint, sell, build your own gallery, and invite friends to admire your art.

demos.name: Crazy Neighbour Demo
demos.short_description: A psychological horror game set in a small post-Soviet town. You play as a troubled man, drowning himself in cheap beer while being pulled deeper into the shadows of his dark past.

demos.name: Agrocracy Demo
demos.short_description: A farming management game focused on planning and numbers. This is not a farming sim - no driving, animals, or role-playing. Manage weather, labor, capital, and time on a large isometric map.

demos.name: Turbo Loop Demo
demos.short_description: Turbo Loop is a casual slot car racing game focused on simple, fun gameplay - easy to learn, but hard to master. Challenge AI opponents or race a friend in head-to-head matches, unlock and customize cars, compete across dozens of tournament tracks, or create your own with the track editor!

demos.name: Artesnaut Demo
demos.short_description: A hardcore medieval fantasy idle RPG, almost entirely in text. Build characters with races, jobs, and epithets. Over 1,000 items to loot. A story 93% of players rated "great." Combat and exploration are fully auto—just check your results. Now in Chapter 5, unfolding across five major updates.

demos.name: Moon Fishies Demo
demos.short_description: Moonfishies is relaxing desktop fish simulator. Customize your dream aquarium, catch new fish and breed unique hybrids!

demos.name: 100 for Justice Demo
demos.short_description: Experience up to 10 lives of resistance in this text-driven political roguelite. Play Tier 1 professions, manage each month, build permanent legacies, help people in need, and risk opposing oppressive laws. Higher tiers and the complete campaign are in the full game.

demos.name: Hotel Paraíso Demo
demos.short_description: Explore a surreal hotel overrun by otherworldly spirits in this mellow yet haunting 2.5D RPG. Master a sharp, innovative combat system that plays like a tactical puzzle, and unravel the mysteries of a dreamlike world.

demos.name: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Tyrant God Demo
demos.short_description: Slay waves of monsters with your mouse, collect coins, buy permanent upgrades, and grow stronger round after round in a compact incremental action game.

demos.name: Tiles & Vials Demo
demos.short_description: A strategic roguelike deckbuilder with tiles instead of cards. Fight enemies by collecting unique tiles and merging them to deal damage or defend yourself. Unleash devastating combos by combining powerful artifacts that radically change your run.

demos.name: 5hit Rocket Demo
demos.short_description: A physics-based lander about precision flying and chaos. Explore Titan’s mines, land on the Moon, deliver kebabs across space and test your relationship in 2-player “Divorce Mode” with chain-linked spacecraft.

demos.name: Horrorvania Demo
demos.short_description: The protagonist's wife disappears under mysterious circumstances in an enigmatic place shrouded in terrifying rumors. As the protagonist, embark on a search for her. The demo version features three locations and one boss.

demos.name: InCowMental Demo
demos.short_description: InCowMental is a cute and colorful tiny incremental game where you collect milk from your cows to sell it and make cheese. Upgrade your farm, and between upgrades, play mini-games to boost your production and sales!

demos.name: Pin Money Demo
demos.short_description: Turn a rundown neon bowling alley into a billion-dollar strike empire. Stack absurd multipliers, unlock powerful upgrades, expand to 7 simultaneous lanes, and break the economy in this incremental idle bowling game.

demos.name: ZHITEN Demo
demos.short_description: Some villages aren't just abandoned, they are cursed. Zhiten, a victim of clashing cults, awakens from its slumber with Nikolay's return. While Nikolay searches for traces of the past, he will be forced to meet the village's new owners.

demos.name: 整活玩家 / Gimmick Survivors Demo
demos.short_description: Gimmick Survivors is a fast-paced Roguelite action game developed by a solo dev. You play as a survivor struggling to live in a dream world, using dashes, bombs, and all kinds of quirky Gimmicks to build your playstyle, all while surviving under the threat of the Execution Line.

demos.name: ShareNote Engine Demo
demos.short_description: A game-aware note app: entries are bound specifically to the current game. It auto-hides at screen edges and summons instantly in-game. Quick tools like calculators and to-dos are one click away. Features an integrated Workshop for sharing notes and real-time chat with fellow players.

demos.name: Witch Pachi Demo
demos.short_description: Aim, shoot, and gather mana! Witch Pachi is a unique hybrid of physics-based pinball action and turn-based roguelike strategy. Build your deck of powerful spells, form mystical pacts, and master the board to defeat your enemies in this magical adventure.

demos.name: A Puzzle game where you fold Dice Demo
demos.short_description: Fold a net of a dice into a cube. This is the only video game in existence that relies on your 3D Spatial Reasoning skill.

demos.name: PhotoBricks Demo
demos.short_description:
Break Bricks. Reveal Photographs. Relax: The Demo!
An interactive digital gallery letting you create and export compelling video reveals of your own photographs. Unwind with the relaxed zen-like gameplay: 5 photos, 5 campaign levels and an Infinite mode give you a taste of the full PhotoBricks game.

demos.name: The Merchant's Eden Demo
demos.short_description: Build a medieval town around a thriving market. Defend your citizens and traveling merchants against raiding bandits. A minimalist game blending cozy city-building and intense tower-defense as you grow and protect your town.

demos.name: DELETERS Demo
demos.short_description: beep-bop-bib -- Objective defended the Core from endless waves of enemy's, level-up, collect resources and data, to improve, research and upgrade your chance of survivability...

demos.name: Dreamer's Wake Demo
demos.short_description: A stylized third person collectathon set in collapsing dreamscapes. Play as a Haniwa clay figure — conjure projectiles, rewind time, and explore surreal worlds to restore them from static.

demos.name: Elven Friends Demo
demos.short_description: A heartwarming interactive game about gentle daily life. The legendary Elven Witch is beloved by her kin. She shares a close bond with the gentle Human Saint, and once saved a serene Sword Immortal from another world. Four companions—no grand adventures, just peaceful and sweet days… or is it?

demos.name: GeckoShop 2 Demo
demos.short_description: Open boxes and collect geckos. Fuse them to create new mutations, then sell or keep 'em. Build huge factories and automate every single step.

demos.name: AstroDig Demo
demos.short_description: Mine, defend, and profit across planets. Expand your operation, survive enemy waves, and discover dangerous hidden worlds in this minimalist sci-fi strategy shooter.

demos.name: Desktop Reptiles Demo
demos.short_description: Desktop Reptiles is a cozy desktop idle reptile sim. Care for a leopard gecko, decorate and upgrade its enclosure, unlock gear and terrarium layouts, and let a quiet reptile habitat bring relaxing moments to your busy workday.

demos.name: Keystones: Foundations Demo
demos.short_description: Keystones is a cerebral 3D puzzle game focused on spatial reasoning. Manipulate voxel blocks through sliding, rotating, and tumbling to solve intricate grid-based challenges. Master the logic of movement and orientation to unlock the path forward in a minimalist, atmospheric world.

demos.name: Torment Hexus Demo
demos.short_description: Technofascist cyberpunk CEOs must die! Charge spells with the match-3 grid, then cast them on your enemies in turn-based tactical roguelike combat. Climb the tower, kill the boss, and maybe make the world a better place. This demo includes the first third of the full game.

demos.name: Agestan Demo
demos.short_description: Build your base in Agestan, form your army with cards, and crush your rivals. Conquer all lands solo or clash with a friend in PvP... Choose a blind spot, fire the catapult, and destroy their base. Remember: you can only see each other on the battlefield!

demos.name: Limerencia Demo
demos.short_description: Sho is in his last year of high school. Upon meeting Kazumi and meeting Nara (a friend from the past), his routine changes. Enjoy this visual novel while you discover memories, emotions and hidden secrets, your decisions will mark the end of a stage. (Limerence Demo).

demos.name: Anomaly Road [DEMO]
demos.short_description:
"Anomaly Road" is an escape game set on a mountain road in Japan, combining horror, driving, and strange occurrences.
While driving, you suddenly realize you've gotten lost on a road deep in the mountains. As you turn a corner with a bad feeling, what awaits you...?

demos.name: Stella Nova Demo
demos.short_description: Build modular space stations, manage citizen crews, and master a deep crafting chain in a procedurally generated solar system with real orbital physics. Mine asteroids, smelt alloys, manufacture components, and expand across the planets!

demos.name: Minimon: Tiny Idle Tactics Demo
demos.short_description: A tiny monster-taming auto-battler that lives in the corner of your screen. Catch Minimon, build your squad, and let them grind loot while you work, browse, or play other games.

highlights.trailer_name: Minimon Tiny Idle Tactics Game Features

demos.name: Lostbound Demo
demos.short_description: Find all the Artifacts before you’re caught in this Roguelite Action RPG. Embrace your destiny and escape a collapsing world. Darkness is alive. The Hand erases your path and drags you into the Abyss. Every step shapes your run.

demos.name: Drilling Demo
demos.short_description: "DRILLING" is a relaxing game focusing on the pure joy of digging and moving forward. You play as "Mr. Drill," who has awakened deep underground, and begin an expedition toward the surface. Mine 9 kind of ores found across various layers, and use the resources you gather to upgrade your modules.

demos.name: Ambroise Niflette & the Gleaned Bell Demo
demos.short_description: In this stop-motion inspired adventure, play as detective Ambroise Niflette in the thrilling investigation of the search for the stolen bell in a mysterious village.

demos.name: Corner Arcade Demo
demos.short_description:
Live the dream and run your own arcade in this idle management sim.
Purchase arcade machines and build your space, your way.
Run your arcade, level up and upgrade your machines to attract elite gamers and watch as they empty their pockets to fill yours! Then sit back & enjoy the buzz of the arcade.

demos.name: SubPrime Delivery Demo
demos.short_description: Drag & Drop Various Action Blocks to Guide The Robot to The End of The Level!

demos.name: Neighborhood Video Demo
demos.short_description: Crack the case of the missing video store employee in this 3D point and click mystery game by solving escape room puzzles, combing the computer database, and stocking shelves as an undercover detective posing as a cashier during your first weekend at the suspiciously understaffed Neighborhood Video.

demos.name: Potion Pony Demo
demos.short_description: Unravel a new mystery while delivering to your customers in Potion Pony! Craft potions, ride your pony, and manage shops as you gather the ingredients you need to succeed. Take good care of your pony, you'll need to work together to bring alchemy back to the lands of Everwind.

demos.name: Bottle Cracks Demo
demos.short_description: Bottle Cracks is a party game where everyone is a bottle. Jump through chaotic levels without breaking! Play solo, online with up to 12 players, or with unlimited local players.

demos.name: The Velan Reach - Book One: An Unbroken Line Demo
demos.short_description: An adult steampunk Visual Novel where you take on the role of a scientist joining a mission of discovery and wonder. Travel to strange new worlds and get to know your traveling companions (quite intimately so in some cases).

demos.name: Carbon Compliance Demo
demos.short_description: A simulation game about experiencing the very mundane job of a government official, rummaging through paperwork. Make sure all the paperwork is free of any errors. Deny applications that are not up to the specified requirements. Bored of working, play mini-games to relieve stress.

demos.name: Idle Monkey Theorem Demo
demos.short_description: Hire adorable typing monkeys and watch them randomly recreate the complete works of Shakespeare, one word at a time. Upgrade your monkey army, unlock powerful skills, and prove the Infinite Monkey Theorem right in this charming idle clicker.

demos.name: A Game About Bouncing DVD Demo
LetMeSee Demo
demos.short_description: This is the demo version.

demos.name: The Serpent & The Seed Demo
demos.short_description: Explore the Garden of Eden in Act I of a sweeping poetic adventure retelling the greatest story in history through stunning art, immersive music, and atmospheric puzzles.

demos.name: Leap Of Faith Demo
demos.short_description: Unlimited local multiplayer chaos! Connect infinite controllers & phones, control wobbly giraffes, dodge physics-based obstacles, and fight to reach the rocket ship first. The more players, the more chaos!

highlights.trailer_name: Leap Of Faith Demo Gameplay Trailer

demos.name: Bake Neko Love Demo
demos.short_description:
You are a depressed Bake-Neko that everyone mistakes for an adorable cat. Your one and only goal: to end it all.
A visual novel with multiple choices, featuring diverse, deep, magical and deeply endearing characters.
Play the first chapter of the game in this demo !

demos.name: Surviving Magic Academy as a Demon Lord Demo
Deliver Together Demo
demos.short_description: In Deliver Together, You control either (or both) of the two trucks attached to the same loooong trailer. And who's driving? Oh, just you. Or you and a friend. Or maybe four of you, all screaming different directions at once. Your goal is to reach the finish line in chaotic tracks.

demos.name: Runes & Rivets Demo
demos.short_description: Runes & Rivets is a steampunk magitech deckbuilder where you run a workshop for 20 turns. (The demo version is limited to 10 turns.) Generate gears, metal, mana, and gold to build a crafting engine, forge products, boost them with rune engravings, then sell for big profit.

demos.name: Rollin' Ravioli Demo
demos.short_description:
A physics-based rage game. Control a ravioli can. Fight the physics. Accept the fall.

Inspired by an iconic early 2000s ravioli commercial.

demos.name: Effective Immediately Demo
demos.short_description:
All intergalactic travel passes through the orbital relay checkpoint.
Verify ID discrepancies, repair vehicle systems and struggle against ethical dilemmas as you negotiate a shifting political landscape.
Report for duty, Effective Immediately.

demos.name: Codex Arcana: Grimoire of Monsters Demo
demos.short_description: Summon an army of Monster Girls to face your enemies in strategic battles! Defeat the Dark Lord's minions and expand your collection with cool, fierce and cute Monster Girls of all variety in this "Capsule Monsters" inspired game!

demos.name: Hexiv Demo
demos.short_description: Hexiv is a strategy deckbuilder about surviving on a lush but hostile planet. Use cards to build, explore and feed your crew while battling a determined adversary to unlock the mysteries of this genre-blending roguelike!

demos.name: GameZone Demo
demos.short_description: Run your own game store, by yourself or with your friends! Stock shelves, sell games, and serve customers in this 1-4 player co-op simulator.

demos.name: Voxel Shooter Demo
demos.short_description: Couch co-op roguelite shmup for 1–4 players. Demo: four elements, 90+ upgrades, 4 Ascension tiers out of 10. Full game launches July 2026.

demos.name: Animagi Demo
demos.short_description: Animagi is a magical cooperative game where you build, purify, and defend spiritual biomes while facing chaotic creatures in fast-paced matches full of action and strategy.

demos.name: Snuggle nightmare Demo
demos.short_description: Survive this first-person mascot horror adventure set in an abandoned theme park. Solve puzzles, craft tools, avoid a deadly animatronic, and uncover the secrets hidden within Brain World Rots.

demos.name: Neon Pulsefire Demo
demos.short_description: Create an endless variety of unique builds and decimate huge waves of enemies. Unlock unique classes, weapons, passives and stats to unlock even more overpowered builds as you weave your way through enemies, arena hazards and projectile assaults.

demos.name: Heavy Mental: A Co-op Action Roguelite Demo
demos.short_description: Experience 3D Run 'n Gun chaos! Fight on foot as a Cyborg or lead an Iron Snake tank with modular trailers. Blast through dual-wielding grandmas and teleporting ninjas to conquer 5 massive fortresses. Upgrade with power cards in this high-octane Co-op Action Roguelite. Join the siege!

demos.name: Charades Universe Demo
demos.short_description: Welcome to Charades Universe, a fun party game where players act out, sing, draw, or mime prompts shown on the screen while friends or teammates try to guess them. Inspired by classic charades.

demos.name: Memory Farm Demo
demos.short_description:
Memory Farm is a nostalgic farming mobile game. Return to childhood: farm, raise poultry, gather wood and harvest.
Unlock shops as the main house upgrades to cook. Complete tasks for upgrade resources.
With various gameplay, renovate the barren courtyard into a thriving one.

demos.name: Veritas Tales: Witch of the Dark Castle Demo
demos.short_description: A dice-driven dark fantasy RPG inspired by solo tabletop adventures. Charge in sword in hand, talk your way out of danger, or ignore it all and keep walking. Every roll, every choice has a price. Handcrafted over six years by a 30-year Vanillaware veteran.

highlights.trailer_name: Witch of the Dark Castle PV01

demos.name: Shothop Demo
demos.short_description: SHOTHOP is a violent retro boomer-shooter blending fast-paced movement mechanics with brutal combat. Utilize movement mechanics, cleanse the robot invasion, and restore the portal defense network. Reboot the grid. Survive the shift.

demos.name: In The Name Of Fortune Demo
Wiseman: No More Breakups Demo
demos.short_description: Fight through a moving train in a stylish rhythm-combat boss rush where timed four-button inputs become your attacks. Defeat absurd bosses, survive relationship chaos, and help August Wiseman get his phone back.

demos.name: Tap Dungeon Demo
demos.short_description: Pixel-art isekai roguelike dungeon crawler! 5 classes, mix skills & items freely in turn-based combat across deadly random dungeons. Fight goblins, orcs, undead; collect artifacts, beat hidden bosses. Death = rebirth, endless builds await. Become the hero saving the kingdom!

demos.name: ZAIBALY Demo
demos.short_description: Horror-comedy boomer shooter, fantastic reimagining of a real-life experience of living under the constant threat of aerial assault.

demos.name: The Depth Contract Demo
demos.short_description: A minimalist horror game about a prisoner who signs a deal with a mining corporation to extract valuable materials and search for something hidden deep within underground caves, all while facing dangerous entities and threats in exchange for a reduced sentence.

demos.name: Unmixable Syrup Demo
demos.short_description:
I wolf down a cold, lonely meal.
Work's wearing me down, and money's shaky.
The syrup I pour into my cold coffee never mixes, no matter how much I stir.

demos.name: Typecraft Demo
demos.short_description: You are the guardian of the Sanctuary. When evil comes, type to cast spells, defeat enemies, and protect the Sanctuary!

demos.name: DICEPATH Demo
demos.short_description: DicePath is a puzzle game where every move costs Action Points. Plan your route, collect dice to stay alive, and reach the exit before you run out. 50 handcrafted levels. One resource. No margin for error.

demos.name: Going my way? Demo
demos.short_description: In a world consumed by an insomnia pandemic, where there are no laws and people are going crazy, you're a train conductor racing through an endless night blizzard. Study the strange passengers, solve mysteries, and survive the time loop before the snowy abyss swallows you up.

highlights.trailer_name: Demo Trailer - Going my way? - EN

demos.name: BounceForever Demo
demos.short_description: Bounce from the backyard to the clouds in this punishing vertical climber. The only thing faster than the climb is the fall. Bounce forever and you might just reach the top

demos.name: Appalachian Onslaught Demo
demos.short_description: Build, upgrade and defend against an endless onslaught of cryptids being sent to destroy your tribe by the great Appalachian nightmare himself... the Rketari.

demos.name: DASH n CRY: Bursting Demo
demos.short_description:
Help Lala Sparks reignite her passion by bursting through hundreds of hand-crafted challenges! 
DASH n CRY: Bursting is a fast-paced 2D precision platformer. Every DASH matters, every CRY will make you stronger!

demos.name: BOT.vinnik Chess: USSR vs the World Demo
DEEP DIVER Demo
demos.short_description: Can you become the most skilled diver capable of reaching the deepest depths in the world? Every breath you take and every meter you descend will become more dangerous. Upgrade your diver with 30 different abilities and skill trees, and try to survive.

demos.name: Indomitus: Path of Ordeals Demo
demos.short_description: Face relentless trials as an indomitable hero. 'Indomitus' is a 2D pixel-art roguelike deckbuilder. Use cards in real-time auto-battles, level up to choose powerful traits, and build synergies with unique relics. Overcome every ordeal with your tactics. High-stakes strategy and deep growth await.

demos.name: Lost in the Fogbound Deadwood Demo
demos.short_description:
Most will fail. Will you escape the Fogbound Deadwood?

A hardcore first-person survival escape FPS. You have 60 minutes to survive. Find keys, open gates, gather resources, and navigate deadly terrain. You are being hunted—and every mistake brings you closer to death.

demos.name: Cave Clicker Demo
demos.short_description: Mine rocks to collect rare ores to become the richest Mole alive, and looking good while doing it too!

demos.name: KOOO TO JUMP! Demo
demos.short_description: A free taste of the ultimate voice-controlled precision platformer! Survive the first 19 camera zones of a brutal, foddian-style map. Test your vocal cords (or controller skills) in this hardcore rage game demo. Practice Mode included!

highlights.trailer_name: This is how KOOO to JUMP! is meant to be played

demos.name: No Blink Allowed Demo
demos.short_description:
Train your timing skills to stop the clock close to zero, collect shards, and spend them on a massive skill tree in this short arcade-ish incremental game. 
Struggle with glitching displays, hidden timers, chaotic multi-stops, and other hazards as you improve your accuracy.

demos.name: Apple Picker Demo
demos.short_description: Start with an apple tree and experience the beginning of this creepy idle incremental game. Pick apples. Produce more apples. Cause the apple-fication of reality. An all-consuming apple obsession is brewing... but whatever you do, (don't) shoot the unicorn.

demos.name: Heroes of the Triangle: Mask Rush Demo
Black Plague: Survival Demo
demos.short_description: Experience the brutal start of Black Plague: Survival in this single-player demo. Explore the infected Oakshade Village, scavenge for resources, and master the power of "Devil's Mushrooms" to fight the undead.

demos.name: DarkStone Restoration Demo
demos.short_description: Darkstone Restoration brings the classic action RPG back to modern PCs with improved stability, compatibility, controls, readability, and quality-of-life improvements — while preserving the spirit of the original game.

demos.name: Bait Ball Party Demo
demos.short_description: A real-time billiard brawler for up to 6 players. Play as mini characters to dominate the scoreboard, sabotage your friends with power-ups, and punch them to win.

demos.name: LURRUNA - The Island of Towering Automatons Demo
RuneKingdom Demo
demos.short_description: Explore a hand-crafted 2D world of adventure in RuneKingdom. Master 16 unique skills, battle 150+ fierce foes, craft legendary gear, and shape your legacy. Your epic journey awaits!

demos.name: DEATH CASINO Demo
demos.short_description: Spend a lifetime at the Death Casino! Russian Roulette meets tabletop strategy in a high stakes duel between you and a glassen maniac. Stay on top of ever escalating complexity as each round introduces more and more mechanics. Juggle guns, knives, drinks, cards and more to survive the Death Casino!

demos.name: Don’t Trust Demo
demos.short_description: DEMO BUILD ! This is an early access version and does not represent the final product. Content, gameplay, balance, and performance are subject to change based on player feedback.

demos.name: Soulwoven Princess Demo
demos.short_description: Survive a toxic royal family in this story-rich life sim and tactical deckbuilder. As the Princess, manage your schedule, shape your personality, and build powerful shard decks. Your choices permanently alter the story. Play the 6-turn demo and uncover 5 unique endings.

demos.name: Cargo Lines Demo
demos.short_description: Build a bustling railway network and juggle cargo transport in real time. New stations appear, the flow of goods shifts constantly, deadlines loom, and trains collide if you don't keep your eyes on them. Keep your cool and master the chaos as orders pile up, and every second counts.

demos.name: Tribe Quest Demo
demos.short_description: Fight, craft, and survive. Swap between characters in your party as you navigate procedurally generated levels and complete quests. Rebuild your home from the rubble and hunt the warlord who destroyed it.

demos.name: Isolation Edge Demo
demos.short_description: Isolation Edge is a hardcore single-player survival game set in a desolate world reclaimed by zombies. Traverse dangerous zones to scavenge, craft gear, and build your fortress to endure the relentless hordes. The past is lost, but on this isolated edge, every breath is a victory worth fighting for.

demos.name: Physician Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: A Papers, Please-style medical bureaucracy sim. You're a fresh graduate assigned to a small-town clinic. Diagnose patients, spot fake referrals, refuse pushy pensioners. Every decision shapes your reputation. Five days, twenty-five lessons in saying "no".

demos.name: Corporate 0 Demo
demos.short_description: You're trapped in your office after a typical working day. Carefully explore every corner to reach the freedom and break the loop.

demos.name: Pubes Demo
demos.short_description: A 3D action game where you control a strand of body hair and move around a 3D room! Use the unique fluffy floating and sticking abilities of body hair to safely reach your destination!

demos.name: Null Carrier Demo
demos.short_description: Operate a deep-space listening array in this minimalist signal-reconstruction puzzle game. Tune frequencies, isolate transmissions from noise, and classify patterns for Command. But as the shifts go by, you begin to realize: the signals aren't from where you thought, and Command is lying to you.

demos.name: Twinkle Seek Demo
demos.short_description: Go search for sparkles to the ends of the world!

demos.name: Maze 95 Ultimate Demo
demos.short_description: The maze that hypnotized a generation is back. It was a screensaver. But now? You can finally walk those halls yourself. Or just relax and watch, like the old times.

demos.name: SkyFab Demo
demos.short_description: Stranded on a floating island in the shadow of a mysterious cube planet, you must survive using only your wits and advanced engineering. Build intricate automation lines, manage power grids, and transform a single tree into a sprawling industrial space station. Will you find your way home?

demos.name: END US Demo
demos.short_description: In this ruined world, nothing good happens at midnight. We fight, we hunt, we build. We tear from the earth whatever is left, just to buy a few more moments of life. You arrived here believing you were the only one. Maybe you were wrong. Would this be the last night?

demos.name: The Punchbag Machine Demo
demos.short_description: A fast-paced pixel-neon rhythm roguelite where every missed punch can end your run. Hit falling notes, chain combos, upgrade your boxer, defeat 9 bosses, and climb the leaderboard.

demos.name: NEVER SAFE IN DELAWARE Demo
demos.short_description: A throwdown between 3 of the most wanted men on the East Coast and the powers that be who want them dead.

demos.name: MyBiz: Pomodoro Desk Tycoon Demo
demos.short_description: A cozy pixel-art office sim powered by your real Pomodoros. Focus sessions earn cash + XP — decorate, hire staff, level up. Music, ambience, break-time minigames. Productivity tool by day, tycoon by every minute.

demos.name: ClumpHunter Demo
demos.short_description: ClumpHunter is a fast-paced 2D roguelite platformer where you fight through waves of enemies in action-packed levels. Collect loot influenced by your luck, level up your stats, and combine upgrades to create powerful builds.

demos.name: Till Hell Is Empty Demo
demos.short_description: Final Judgment Day. You are trapped inside a stone statue. Face sinners. Judge across eternity and an instant. Force their confession. Choose their punishment. Let the fire burn fiercer…until Hell is empty.

demos.name: TORR Demo
demos.short_description: A retro turn-based exploration game reminiscent of 80s RPGS! Explore the land of TORR by fighting daemons, solving puzzles, and uncovering the origins of the cloud sea that separates the world from the land below...

demos.name: うつらうつらとつつうらうらと Demo
demos.store_url: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4728640/うつらうつらとつつうらうらと_Demo
demos.short_description: Roam a quiet late-night city in this chill point-and-click adventure. Click anything that catches your eye, check your phone, and reply to viewer comments only if you feel like it. Take your time and enjoy a slow, unhurried night—free from anyone’s expectations.

demos.name: Orca Insurgency Demo
demos.short_description: Play as an orca in a fast-paced ocean rebellion against yachts, whalers, and human greed. Smash boats, rescue your pod, command other orcas, hunt with echolocation, and test absurd weapons from a mysterious octopus arms dealer. The Orca Insurgency begins.

demos.name: Escape the Grind Demo
demos.short_description: Free demo. Can you retire before 65? A financial life sim across 10 real economies with real salaries, real housing, real decisions. Easy mode unlocked here. Medium, Hard, and Play Your Life mode in the full game.

highlights.trailer_name: Escape The Grind - Demo Gameplay Official

demos.name: 迷渡桥 Demo
