demos.short_description: 《迷渡桥》试玩 Demo 现已上线！这是一款水墨风格的国风悬疑推理游戏。你将扮演牵涉谋逆的罪臣后人宁不移，背负家族十年冤屈，在弥留之际踏上迷渡桥，开启一场追寻真相的宿命之旅。试玩篇章将带你入局一桩桩离奇命案，初窥朝堂深处的暗流涌动。层层迷雾已然拉开，静待你来探寻故事的开端......

demos.name: 魔律物语-韦德霍尔克学院 Demo
developers: 杭州达图雷网络科技有限公司
publishers: 杭州达图雷网络科技有限公司

demos.name: Inscrutable FourDC -Imprisonment- Demo
demos.short_description: In this demo version, only Q1 is selectable.

demos.name: Pump Crew Demo
demos.short_description: Pump Crew is an online co-op survival horror game where teamwork, communication, and poor decisions collide. Explore procedurally generated levels using positional voice to survive the darkness. Collect SLOP to travel and explore entire planets and varied cave systems in your quest for glory.

demos.name: Deepest Darkest Demo
demos.short_description: Deepest Darkest is a 90s as hell and metal as hell boomer shooter. Shoot your way through an action packed single player campaign with an arsenal of weapons, power up and magic spells as you tear though an army of cultists and monsters.

demos.name: MeowFactory Demo
demos.short_description:
Welcome to the MEOWFACTORY!
Automate production lines and manage limited space to achieve perfection. Connect machines with conveyor lines and minimize hand (well, paw) labour!
In the near and depressing future, when the world is on the verge of destruction, ONLY MEOWORKERS can revive production!

demos.name: DeadWeight: A Lullaby Demo
demos.short_description: A baby fell. You jumped after it. God didn't like that. DeadWeight: A Lullaby is a psychological narrative experience about guilt, judgment, and the weight of human intent.

demos.name: Exium: Theia Demo
demos.short_description: Explore the hostile planet of Theia in this open-world action RPG. Scavenge, fight, craft, and uncover the secrets hidden beneath a world controlled by Vexx Industries.

demos.name: Blighthold Demo
demos.short_description: Blighthold is a 2D city builder set in a Lovecraftian-Dieselpunk world. Reclaim the lost city and its Eldritch Tree. Suffer through moral dilemmas that will shape your society. Defend against abominations and uncover the terrible secret that lies below.

demos.name: Paw Pew Pew Demo
developers: PT Sangnila Interaktif Media dan Teknologi
publishers: PT Sangnila Interaktif Media dan Teknologi
demos.short_description: A fast-paced 3D roguelike shooter set in a world where nature and hostile technology violently collide. Customize your heroes with unique professions, collect devastating weapons, and adapt your build each run to rescue your friends from the Robo-Beast army!

demos.name: Scraps Of The Machine Demo
demos.short_description:
FPS Mech Action! Pilot a mass of steel through a single player campaign set in a desolate landscape. Target enemy armor or weapons to wear them down piece by piece, find upgrades to improve your mech or change its loadout, and survive in a world of rust and decay.
Discover, Destroy, Scavenge.

demos.name: Fluff Up Demo
demos.short_description: 《Fluff Up》 is a charming yet challenging game where you control a chubby little bird flapping through a fantastical sea of clouds. Master your speed, manage your stamina, and ride the clouds to reach the highest skies.

demos.name: Nova Impact Demo
demos.short_description: Pilot your ship and survive! Test the combat loop of this one-of-a-kind survival game. Prove your worth by surviving as long as possible and face off against the Champion in an intense 3D racing phase.

demos.name: Alice's Gaze Demo
demos.short_description: This is an eerie clicker idle game with light puzzles and idle combat. Alice wakes in darkness, trapped in a strange mansion, seeking escape. The Cat God's altar drops gold, Rabbitfolk gather carrots, and dungeon monsters block the way... Can you accompany Alice to the final truth?

demos.name: Last Bullet Demo
demos.short_description: Build the Ultimate Gun by loading a chain of super powerful bullets! Discover game-breaking combos with over 100+ bullets and trinkets in this highly replayable turn-based strategic shooter!

demos.name: Tormentum II Demo
demos.short_description: Tormentum II is a dark, surreal Point & Click adventure where nightmare worlds, grotesque creatures, and uneasy choices await. Inspired by H.R. Giger and Zdzisław Beksiński, it’s the long-awaited return to Tormentum.

demos.name: Gunshot Arcade Demo
demos.short_description: Gunshot Arcade combines the action of a classic arcade shoot 'em up with the meta-progression of a roguelike. Buy some weapons, upgrade your gear and survive as long as you can. Unlock much stronger guns from wave to wave and increase your reward, good luck.

demos.name: Only Humans On Board Demo
demos.short_description: Buy supplies and manage your resources. Serve customers quickly from your trolley, but stay sharp: be aware of the unknown. Some passengers are only pretending to be human...

demos.name: The Call Button Demo
demos.short_description: A short horror observation thriller. Could you tell what's real and what isn't? You stole intel from your company. Now you wake up in a hospital every day with two choices: take your medication if something looks wrong, or hit the call button if you're sure the room is safe.

demos.name: Nerds Revenge Demo
demos.short_description:
Nerds vs Bullies. IQ vs Fame.

A chaotic PvP and Coop game combining quiz mechanics, absurd weapons, and a war for influence across Donkey Town. Answer questions, upgrade your weapons, capture districts, and prove whether IQ or Fame is the true source of power.

demos.name: Booty Beats Demo
demos.short_description: Try the free demo of Booty Beats — a synthwave rhythm game with anime characters, VHS aesthetics, and outfit progression. 3 characters, 3 tracks, 3 difficulties. Hit the beat, fill the fever bar, and watch the show evolve.

demos.name: Pillars of Pantheon Demo
demos.short_description: Pillars of Pantheon is a bullet-heaven “tower offense” roguelite. Build the ultimate Roman siege tower block by block and drive it through waves of mythological creatures while gaining divine abilities from the gods.

demos.name: The Only Droid Demo
demos.short_description: Tear enemy robots apart piece by piece in a physics-based action roguelike. Destroy weak points, stack upgrades, and create your unique build as you turn relentless robotic enemy waves into mechanical graveyards.

demos.name: Moon Garden Demo
demos.short_description: A cozy incremental game about growing your way home. Strategically plant flowers, optimize machinery, and grow your tree tall enough to escape!

demos.name: Arcana, Gas & Waterworks Inc. Demo
demos.short_description: The full set of game features through the first six levels of your fantasy utility career.

demos.name: DVD Dealer Simulator Prologue
demos.short_description: Build and manage your own DVD game store in DVD Dealer Simulator. Buy, sell, and trade game discs, expand your inventory, upgrade your shop, and move to bigger locations as your business grows. Turn a small store into a thriving gaming retail empire.

demos.name: The Black Shift Demo
demos.short_description: In this AI-powered thriller, your phone is the gateway to a dark past. As a mine chief, you receive messages from a mysterious stranger demanding you put your workers in danger in exchange for uncovering forgotten historical secrets. Who will pay the price for the truth?

demos.name: Silency: Cube 666 Demo
demos.short_description: Try the CUBE 666 demo: read the counter on each door, deduce the safe route, open the next door inside a rotating mechanical cube, and survive spikes, electric shocks, fire, and falling.

demos.name: Neon Null Demo
demos.short_description: Neon Null drops you into a shattered cosmos where survival depends on speed and precision. This 2D shooter is built around short, intense runs that reward quick reflexes and persistence. Every defeat reveals a new lesson, and every attempt carries you a little farther into the unknown.

demos.name: Vatan Demo
demos.short_description: Vatan is a narrative-focused historical drama set in Sivas in 1892. In young Ahmet's life, caught between family, love, and homeland, every decision you make changes relationships, atmosphere, and the path to the finale; every scene carries an emotional cost

demos.name: Rift Rumble Demo
demos.short_description: Rift Rumble is a lightning fast, platform party fighter where fighters from across the universe have come to battle for control of The Rift. Play with unlimited players locally across numerous unique maps.

demos.name: KAON : Fragmented Core Demo
demos.short_description:
KAON: Fragmented Core is a 2D action-platformer with a metroidvania feel.

You play as Kaon, an android awakened in a world where no one lives anymore, neither humans nor animals. Mostly what’s left is plants, ruins, and robots, a good chunk of them turned hostile

demos.name: Medieval Tavern Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Transform a run down tavern into the region's most popular gathering spot. Serve beer, manage your customers, and expand your business. Increase your profits while protecting your reputation, because every night brings new opportunities, surprises, and a touch of chaos to your doorstep.

demos.name: SHADE WALKERS Demo
demos.short_description: A 2v2v2 horror escape royale set in a haunted school. Team up with your partner, gather ritual dolls, use items, avoid deadly entities, and outplay rival duos. Only one team can escape.

demos.name: Streets of Miami VR Demo
demos.short_description: Streets of Miami VR is a gritty 1980s crime-action VR game where you fight, drive, spray paint, shoot, hustle for money, and survive the streets of Miami in a open world sand box experience built for physical VR gameplay.

demos.name: The Letter Demo
demos.short_description: The Letter is a narrative-driven psychological adventure set in a forgotten town. Explore abandoned streets, follow scattered notes and hidden messages, and uncover fragments of a story inspired by real events as you piece together a mystery buried in the past.

demos.name: Erimos: Blood and Dust Demo
demos.short_description: A dark fantasy soulslike set in a cursed underworld where no soul rests. Recover your shattered soul, master brutal combat, and face the truth of who you were.

demos.name: TV Boy Demo
demos.short_description: A Demo for TV Boy! An action packed top-down shooter. Blast waves of weird and whacky enemies with even weirder weapons to rescue the captured citizens of TV Topia and restore peace to the galaxy!

demos.name: RETRIEVAL Demo
demos.short_description: RETRIEVAL is a first-person psychological horror game where you explore a looping house, collect scattered memory fragments, and search extracted keywords in an old computer terminal to uncover a tragic truth.

demos.name: Crownbreak Demo
demos.short_description: Build your army, conquer castles, and dominate tactical battles. Earn gold, upgrade your gear, and defeat powerful elemental bosses.

demos.name: 鸥鹭罔继 Demo
demos.short_description: "Oulu Wangji" is a fantasy visual novel set in an alternate world. Players can choose different options to decide the story's direction, experiencing a tale intertwined with chuunibyou fantasy and melodramatic emotions.

demos.name: Spreadsheets & Dungeons Demo
demos.short_description: A grid-based turn-based roguelike where you manage a party across a dungeon which is a spreadsheet. Explore each dungeon, level up your heroes, build synergies, scale absurd stats, and survive escalating dungeon pressure through tactical positioning and resource management.

demos.name: Sender Unknown Demo
demos.short_description: Work the night shift in an underground sorting facility. Weigh packages, compare their contents, and meet your quota by 6 AM. But beware, some packages hide dark secrets. Identify bad batches, earn cash, and survive the night in this tense PSX-style horror job simulator.

demos.name: A Hard Game About Reaching Valhalla Demo
demos.short_description: Swing your axe, master momentum and overcome impossible obstacles on your journey to Valhalla, alone or with your friends

demos.name: No One's Hero Demo
demos.short_description: A 2D side-scrolling runner set in ancient times where you play as an unknown messenger racing through danger behind the scenes of a famous legend. Jump, slide, and survive 13 handcrafted levels inspired by ancient Greece.

demos.name: Colossus - Eternal Blight Demo
demos.short_description: Your brother is corrupted. The Blight is spreading. Only you can stop it. Colossus is an atmospheric pixel action-adventure where you master precise combat, explore a vast dark fantasy world, and make choices that permanently scar the kingdom of Eireos.

demos.name: Mega Squad Survivors Demo
demos.short_description: You are the Physician. Draft 50 reimagined warriors from rival kingdoms & turn historical bonds into synergies. Start small, grow into a legion that sweeps thousands. 200+ skills, 35 bond combos, and epic boss battles. A Three Kingdoms pixel-art survival action roguelite. Can your legion survive?

demos.name: 十个好人Ten Innocent People Demo
demos.short_description: The Righteous Army has nevertheless issued the "Order of Ten," granting this fallen nation one final chance. In this portion, the Emissary will establish his base and intelligence network.The demo includes one important hidden side quest,Can you find that young man with the blue eyes?

demos.name: DISASTER PLAN Z Demo
demos.short_description:
Try a short combat-focused Steam Next Fest demo of DisasterPlanZ. Experience shooting, enemy pressure, 2 weapons, 4
  enemy types, and 1 boss before the full scavenging, base building, and defense systems arrive in the full version.

demos.name: Hellsino Pokerlike Demo
demos.short_description: Hellsino is a poker roguelike-deckbuilder, where you gamble on your 54-card deck as your Life. Play poker-hands on a grid against gambling demons, break Hell's rules with forbidden Cheat Cards, and decide which parts of yourself you can afford to lose in order to execute your Grand plan.

demos.name: Rogue Kingdom Demo
demos.short_description: Rogue Kingdom is an Online Roguelike with every dungeon persistently simulated! Claim dungeons, settle colonists, and defend!

demos.name: Who Haunts The Haunters? Demo
demos.short_description: Who Haunts The Haunters? is an East Asian-inspired social deduction game. Purify the mansion as a Ghost, or corrupt it as an Intruder and unleash the Ahgwi Night Hunt. Follow strange sounds, flickering candles, distorted shadows, and suspicious traces to uncover the truth.

demos.name: CoreBreaker: Desktop Swarm Demo
demos.short_description: A corner screen incremental brick-breaker where bouncing cores destroy endless swarms. Let it run in the corner of your screen while you work or jump into fullscreen and take control yourself. Unlock new Cores, expand your skill tree, survive endless waves.

demos.name: Elecade Demo
demos.short_description:
Strike down rampaging machines with chain lightning.
Elecade is a 1-bit action game with incremental upgrades, where you power up and climb to the top of a space facility.

demos.name: NTR Tales - The Elf Next Stream Demo
Viking Vending Demo
demos.short_description: Start with a Viking harbor at your command—buy low, sell high, and turn a tidy profit! Identify unknown treasures and strike it rich overnight! Rebuild the blacksmith's forge, enchant mighty artifacts, hire fierce raiders, and make every Viking your loyal customer!

demos.name: Potter About Demo
demos.short_description: Demo of Potter About. Try out wandering around the beautiful drawn graphics of the Potter About universe. Explore one of the five levels of the complete game.

demos.name: Neko Miko Kaibyo Shioki no Emaki Demo
demos.short_description:
"Neko Miko Kaibyo Shioki no Emaki" is an arcade-style action game where both allies and enemies are cats.
Control the cat shrine maiden and her cat companions with the joystick, and run through the stages while defending against the fierce attacks of the monstrous cats with your feline companions.

demos.name: Interstellar Inn Demo
demos.short_description: Interstellar Inn is a 2D hotel building and management sim in space. - DEMO -

demos.name: Saintless Demo
demos.short_description: Explore the halls of the underground cult of The Open Hand. Experience the test rooms setup for your initiation in this psychological horror exploration game. Never forget....they are always watching.

demos.name: Fishbait Demo
demos.short_description: Dive into Fishbait, a 4-player survival card game where every draw is a gamble. Avoid the Traps, play your cards right, and sabotage your rivals in a race to be the last fish swimming. Fast-paced, strategic, and dangerously addictive.

demos.name: LOOK UP AND GO Demo
demos.short_description: A fast paced, fps, score attack where every run is a risk. Use your points to bet on your own survival or make other players' runs harder. Get combos by stabbing, shooting, and doing tricks. Ascend the tower. Climb the leader board. Play the demo and Wishlist now.

demos.name: Lizard Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Try the free demo. You're a lizard, the town's having a normal day, and you are about to fix that. Tongue-grab people, climb buildings, go ragdoll off a roof. No goal. No rules. Just chaos. This is a slice — the full game has more to ruin.

demos.name: Averi the Accursed Demo
demos.short_description: Shunned outsider Averi becomes her small planet's last hope against the tyrannical Lord Kroff and Lady Psonos in this action-packed 2D pixel art platformer.

demos.name: Pun Chan Pop Demo
demos.short_description: Think fast, match faster! Chain 5 pieces in any direction to win, or use the Square-Merge to turn 2x2 clusters into massive, high-scoring blocks before clearing them. Battle cute animals to a pulsing Bitpop soundtrack in this frantic puzzle showdown!

demos.name: The Last Disease Z Demo
demos.short_description: The Last Disease Z is a co-op survival experience where everything is against you. Abandoned cities, zombies and bandits, a struggle for resources and a place to live. Build, unite, and survive.

demos.name: Cloudpaws Demo
demos.short_description: CloudPaws is a cozy sky trading adventure where you sail an airship, trade goods, farm, fish, and explore floating islands while helping locals and uncovering their mystery✨

demos.name: The Last Roll Demo
demos.short_description: An extraction-style board game that demands constant thinking, dice rolling, and decision-making. The true challenge lies not in combat skills, but in tactical choices, resource management, and strategy.

demos.name: Hollow Ground Demo
demos.short_description: Top-down shooter inspired by 90s arcade games. You and up to three friends play as four mercenaries as they descend into the Epsilon 9 bunker. Navigate 70+ handcrafted labyrinthine levels, purchase upgrades, and destroy chaos manifest: The Machine.

demos.name: Boil Cabbage Make Soup Demo
demos.short_description: A cosy idler starring an Onion who makes soup anywhere on your desktop! Watch him grow and harvest cabbages to make delicious soup for a cast of colourful customers. Decorate your island and customise your Onion with your hard-earned gold to level him up, and build your very own soup making empire!

demos.name: Save Humanity.exe Demo
demos.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder based around designing a microchip from a pile of junk circuits to out compute incoming viruses trying to crash your system. Combo hardware with software programs to chain multipliers that overflow your FLOP meter before the glitches overwhelm you.

demos.name: Iris and the Moonlight Bakery Demo
demos.short_description: Play the Chapter 1 demo of Iris and the Moonlight Bakery. As Iris, a burnt-out goddess hiding in a sleepless city, take midnight DM orders, read emotions as colors, and decorate cakes for six customers over three nights, while someone searches for you.

highlights.trailer_name: Iris and the Moonlight Bakery Demo

demos.name: Eyes On Them Demo
demos.short_description: Your car breaks down on a deserted road at midnight. As you walk through the fog-shrouded forest, you come upon the entrance to an abandoned factory. But this place isn’t as empty as it seems. Deep within the factory, dark traces of the past and something inexplicable await you.

demos.name: Crownborne
demos.short_description: A FULLY ENGLISH-VOICED action-romance visual novel. Pulled from the modern world into a kingdom at war, wield an ancient power, romance four heroines, and steer branching battles where every choice you make reshapes alliances, fights, and which ending you reach.

demos.name: Cards Of Calling Demo
demos.short_description: This demo includes the first act of Cards of Calling, featuring 1 playable summoner, 3 summonable creatures, elite and boss encounters, and a preview of the card, relic, and event systems. The full game is planned to include additional acts, summons, events, and content.

demos.name: Tokioriki Demo
demos.short_description: Meet one person, and you may miss another. Spend limited after-school time building relationships, exploring the town, shaping Kanata’s diary, and facing the first timed Shadow Choice. Includes the Prologue through the first half of Chapter 1.

demos.name: Harmony Of Tea Demo
demos.short_description: Small relaxing puzzle game where you need to find the right place for tea on a shelf. Travel from Yunnan Province to Shanghai as a tea courier, exploring charming provinces and discovering unique tea flavors.

demos.name: Hypatia Demo
demos.short_description: Play the opening of Hypatia, a romance visual novel set in a café that is closing next week.

demos.name: Petaltone Demo
demos.short_description: Plant, tend to, and grow a musical garden masterpiece! By mixing and mastering different Plants, Mods, and Gardening Tools, you can create a synthesized symphony entirely unique to you!

demos.name: War of Flip Demo
demos.short_description: It's a two-player card chess game. Play against your friend with chesses that have the ability to flip. At the right moment, flip the chess to release powerful skills, or hide and wait for the right opportunity to strike. In addition, build a deck and explore various possibilities!

demos.name: S.E.X. Project: Simulated Emotional Xenotech Demo
The Time‑Stealing Cat Demo
demos.short_description:
Side with the Demon Lord and sabotage the hero’s adventure.
In The Time-Stealing Cat, you play as the Demon Lord’s pet cat and secretly interfere with the hero’s journey. Block paths, set traps, and create obstacles to slow the hero down and steal time before the final battle.

demos.name: StreamNet Alliance Demo
demos.short_description:
A cyberpunk visual novel about chasing fame and losing yourself. 
30 days. 100,000 followers. Daily choices that shape who Hoshino 
becomes — and what she's willing to sacrifice to get there.
✦ Demo Version Information: You can try it for free for the first 5 days.

demos.name: Nanjing Massacre: John Rabe's Diary Demo
demos.short_description: This text game is based on John Rabe's diaries. Play as Rabe in the desperate Nanking Safety Zone. Your choices shape blood-stained diary entries. Decide refugees' survival under extreme resource scarcity. Help the younger generation re-examine this heavy history through immersive narrative.

demos.name: Aaattack Demo
demos.short_description: Aaattack is a deckbuilder, where you build and customize a deck of magical runes, to fight your foes and send the monsters back to the Underabyss! But beware! The monstrosities of the land have their own runes to fight with. Only a true hero can save this land. Are you ready? Aaattack!!!!

demos.name: Take The Wheel Demo
demos.short_description: Some days you just keep moving. Play as a teddy bear collecting scattered clarinet pieces while a shadow car follows close behind. A quiet narrative platformer about control, forgiveness, and finding your way back.

demos.name: Desktop Planet Demo
demos.short_description: A desktop idle-style game. Free from constant monster attacks, you can focus purely on construction. Start by mining resources to build bases and factories, then assemble fleets to explore more planets.

demos.name: Runic Curse Remastered Demo
demos.short_description: Runic Curse Remastered is a thrilling action RPG Metroidvania that transports you to a cursed island. Explore dark and diverse locations, battle hordes of enemies and mighty bosses. Forge your own playstyle by combining various weapons with magical runes to overcome all challenges.

demos.name: Beast Bastion Demo
demos.short_description: A Roguelike Auto-Chess game Demo. Recruit troops and pair them with defense turrets. Try it now!

demos.name: Featherless Demo
demos.short_description:
You’re a duck. You’re armed. Everything wants you dead.
Fair enough.
Blast through hordes of enemies, discover ridiculous weapon combos, and grow stronger every run in this chaotic roguelike shooter.

demos.name: Apocalypse: The Last RV Demo
demos.short_description: Reborn 7 days before the apocalypse, empty the supermarket and modify your RV! Experience the last frenzy before doomsday + 15 days of wasteland survival. Full version is buy-to-play with no ads. Save data can be carried over to the full game.

demos.name: Depth:Origin Demo
demos.short_description:
Battle against "music" in a rhythm x shooting x adventure game.

To quell the cursed object "Depth Origin," which has been reported to devour people, play a game within a game and uncover the "truth" hidden within the cursed object.

demos.name: What The Dog Remembers Demo
demos.short_description: What The Dog Remembers is a retro style psychological horror game. In this demo, survive a week of curated nights in a claustrophobic trailer. Spot reality breaking anomalies and report your findings.

demos.name: Gnome Glade Demo
demos.short_description: Gnome Glade - a cozy city builder puzzle with deckbuilding. Help gnomes build a village in a magic forest! Grow and merge mushrooms, build your deck of cards, and raise a golden statue. Create a gnome paradise!

demos.name: In Time Demo
demos.short_description:
In Time is a 4 player online co-op adventure. 
Chronosyn’s strange machine has brought back the dinosaurs, and only you and your team can set things back to normal. 
Explore an ever-changing environment and make it back to the machine all while hungry predators stalk your path.

demos.name: Keyboard Smash Demo
demos.short_description: Run a shop. Help weird customers. And definitely make everything worse!

demos.name: How to Fly a Cannon Demo
demos.short_description: Your cannon isn't just a weapon - it's also how you launch into the air!  Shoot towards the ground and fly skyward in this physics-based destruction game.

demos.name: ScreenSaver Idle Demo
demos.short_description: A screensaver-inspired idle incremental game. Unlock skills, explode your income, and feel the thrill of the perfect corner hit.

demos.name: Arcane Towerline Demo
demos.short_description: Arcane Towerline is a roguelite tower defense blending auto-battler synergies. On a dynamic battlefield, draft powerful 1-to-5 cost units to build a formidable lineup. Defend your crystal from swarms of enemies using tactical positioning and random game-changing magic!

demos.name: Mobius Demo
demos.short_description: If space has no end, where is the exit? Mobius is a gravity-flipping puzzle-platformer set in a looping realm. Cross screen edges to invert gravity and find hidden paths in symmetrical spaces. Solve physical puzzles to reach the mysterious door—what secrets await on the other side?

demos.name: Seal The Breach Demo
demos.short_description: The Demo for Seal The Breach. A 3D survival experience set within a cramped one-man submarine exploring a hostile ocean trench.

demos.name: Hannibal Demo
demos.short_description: Hannibal is a grand strategy game with real-time tactical battles. Choose regions on the campaign map, command your army, and take direct control when war begins. Build formations, break enemy lines, and lead your empire to victory through smart strategy and battlefield decisions.

demos.name: In The Mist of War Demo
demos.short_description: In the Mist of War is a turn-based online PvP strategy game. Select your units, position them strategically, and outsmart your opponent in a tactical top-down fog-of-war battle.

demos.name: Monocre Demo
franchises: モノクロルートクリエイター
demos.short_description:
White or Black—
A world painted in just two colors.
Toggle the colors of your character and the blocks to "forge" your path to the goal in this brand-new puzzle experience.

demos.name: Epic Card Battle Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: a PvP card auto-battler simulator, play solo or with up-to 6 Friends! Play cards to summon little dudes who auto-battle each other to the death!

demos.name: Chronicle of Wuxia & Xianxia Survivors Demo
Euphorbia Milii Demo
demos.short_description: A ruined research station reclaimed by nature. Days pass, resources disappear, and decisions leave lasting marks. Euphorbia Milii is a narrative, text-based roguelike RPG where existence costs more than survival. This is vegetation…

demos.name: Space Fleet Logistics Demo
demos.short_description: Wars are won by logistics. Command the Federation's fleets across a star system, manage supply chains, secure planets, and outmaneuver a relentless AI enemy. Every battle is decided before it begins.

demos.name: Ibiza Madness: Zombie vs Demons Demo
demos.short_description: Fight through a chaotic island overrun by zombies and demons in this fast-paced action survival game. Explore Ibiza, battle hordes of enemies, upgrade your weapons, and survive the madness alone or with friends.

demos.name: Good Hands Demo
demos.short_description: In Good Hands, join Nia as she helps her neighbor Aunty Zubeida tidy up a tangled garden. Tend, sort, and restore calm in this cozy puzzle about care and connection. Unwind with uniquely crafted puzzles, made for anyone who finds joy in gardens.

demos.name: Life on Neptune Demo
demos.short_description: Build a new life and a new home on a distant planet. Explore islands to find furniture for your house. Meet aliens and make the best of a strange situation. A Life on NEPTUNE awaits.

demos.name: The Options Menu Demo
demos.short_description: The Options Menu is a game where you play as a 'Player' and experience a life filled with Options. Explore countless endings to uncover a game that may surprise you as the real friend all along was your Options Menu in this Comedic Story.

demos.name: Drunken Hog: Dystopian Pub & Brewing Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Dystopian Pub Management & Brewing Simulator. Brew beer, serve customers, upgrade your bar, and explore Napolis City and its dark secrets.

demos.name: 私たちはどう死のうか Demo
demos.short_description: A story-driven action game in which a hopeless high school girl confronts her life within her dreams as she turns 18, progressing through magnetic movement, exploration, dialogue, and combat.

demos.name: Claire Detective 1 : The Monster of Lake Flavoria Demo
demos.short_description: A monster has been spotted at Flavoria lake ! Hoax or truth ? Start your detective career with panache by solving this mystery... not so complicated... but hey ! First time for everything, right ?

demos.name: Farmageddon Demo
demos.short_description: Defend your farm from waves of invading moles in this fun action roguelike, solo or in co-op with up to 4 friends. Dodge attacks, pick up vegetables from the ground or steal them mid-air, and use them as projectiles to stop the moles and survive the underground invasion.

demos.name: 無人島哪有這麼爽 Demo
狂華乙女～Crazy Bloom～ Demo
demos.short_description: Girls Fight in This Anime Battle Game!

demos.name: Ferrano: Beyond Redline Demo
demos.short_description: Feel the rush at the limit. Weave through tight traffic in legendary retro supercars within a decaying synthwave simulation. Enter the flow state, synchronize with mates, or drive solo to break the limits and reach beyond the redline.

demos.name: Neo Capitalist - Stock Market Survival Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Trade by day. Eat, sleep, and survive by night. Lose everything with a single bad decision. Neo Capitalist is a financial survival roguelite where the richer you get, the harder the system fights back. Play in a realistic stock market simulation or in a dystopian cyber-punk world.

demos.name: Pengzle:Arctic Arcane Demo
demos.short_description: Pengzle is a real-time puzzle action adventure where you weave mana into spell formulas in the middle of battle. Read the flow of combat, build the right combination, and cast at the perfect moment as a small penguin mage in a distinctive polar fantasy world.

demos.name: Creepy Shift: Deer Farm Demo
demos.short_description: Run your farm, take care of your animals, and survive the storm. Try a demo that mixes farming sim with horror and throws you right into weird events from the very first minute.

demos.name: 春はあけぼの、我はバケモノ - Spring at Dawn, I Am a Monster Demo
demos.store_url: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4796320/春はあけぼの我はバケモノ_Spring_at_Dawn_I_Am_a_Monster_Demo
demos.short_description: A psychological horror visual novel where a teacher visits three truant students at home. Each girl hides a secret, and each visit leads deeper into a nightmare of love, guilt, obsession, and the dangerous bond between broken adults and lonely children.

demos.name: Scratch your Luck Demo
demos.short_description: Scratch tickets, upgrade your odds, and pay deadlines before you go broke.

demos.name: Pogo Froggo Demo
demos.short_description: Two frogs, one bar, zero coordination. Bounce up the mountain before your tank breaks... and before you blame each other.

demos.name: Alien Apocalypse Demo
demos.short_description: In this demo you will be able to try out Alien Apocalypse an open-world sandbox survival game set after a devastating alien invasion. Scavenge for resources, craft, build defenses, and harness alien technology to fight back. Play solo or in co-op and reclaim what’s left of the planet.

demos.name: Project Pixel Demo
demos.short_description: Welcome to Project Pixel! Build and share stages online, jump through hand-crafted levels within the game's story mode, or find hidden gems within the player-driven Community Hub! You can play single player or join a lobby with friends in online co-op.

demos.name: LampMan! Demo
demos.short_description: LampMan! is a 2d action-platformer featuring three playable characters you can switch between at any time. Master their abilities, conquer vibrant levels, and restore light to LampWorld!

demos.name: Touhou Tenshiin  ~ Celestial Examination Hall
demos.short_description: A fan-made 3D fighting game set in the Touhou Project universe! Unease once again shrouds Gensokyo, as terrifying rumors intertwine with the rising craze of 'Celestial Cultivation'!? End this chaos with dazzling combos and tactical mastery！

demos.name: INTO THE AETHER Demo
demos.short_description: The first half of INTO THE AETHER: Chapter 1! Explore the magical oceanside town of Starry Hill, and meet the magic users that live within it...

demos.name: Oil Island Hustle Demo
demos.short_description: An Empty Island, Full of Oil, and you're ON IT! Build your Oil Empire and Dominate the World Market! Create oil factories, produce oil barrels and sell them to different countries and earn Lots of Money! Hire workers to automate and remember to pay your 1 million loan to your co-worker

demos.name: Obrum: The Demo
demos.short_description: OBRUM is a roguelite puzzle game about controlled chaos. Build unstable chain reactions across a 4×4 grid, draft (and leverage) powerful Rules, survive the rising Overcharge, and push this collapsing system to its limit in a high-pressure battle for mastery.

demos.name: Four Lights Demo
demos.short_description: This is a grand tale of revenge - waged by God and Us against Lucifer.

demos.name: Link Empire Demo
demos.short_description: Link Empire is a real-time strategy game based on a hexagonal grid. In this game, you just need to link nodes to command your forces, not control every unit. Focus on your development, unit combination. Choose your attack timing and path carefully. Defeat your enemies on a truly strategic level!

demos.name: Island Wolves Demo
demos.short_description: You are a wolf. Hunt prey and gather materials to build your camp, decorate your den and grow your pack. Fight off rival wolves or avoid combat altogether by using the environment to your advantage. Explore the islands and discover the truth behind the lost packs.

demos.name: Crime: 1997 Demo
demos.short_description: Newport, 1997. Waterside gang member Henry Gallagher is thrust into a lethal spiral after a failed deal. Trapped between a police crackdown and the Sorvino Mafia, Henry must navigate a city ignited by "Pulse"—a volatile new drug turning every street into a warzone.

demos.name: Football Pitch And Arcade Simulator Demo
Train Set Code Demo
demos.short_description: Build a train set layout where everything runs on its own. Automate points and signals to direct the trains and keep them moving. Get creative and design a huge network that carries a fleet of trains.

demos.name: Withering State Demo
demos.short_description: Play through a brief section of the Withering State story in this narrative-driven RPG demo. Meet the most significant power-brokers in the All-Sudlivia Communist Party, decide on an economic direction to combat the stagnation, and find your place in a shifting web of international alliances.

demos.name: The Machinist Demo
demos.short_description: A psychological horror and train management game where every passenger could be a threat. Keep the train running, manage your stress, investigate suspicious individuals, and survive the journey.

demos.name: Koatl The Defender ULTIMATE Demo
demos.short_description: Descend into the hidden tunnels beneath San Luis Potosi, Mexico, in Koatl The Defender ULTIMATE, a cinematic action-adventure that blends 2.5D platforming with dynamic 3D combat. Uncover ancient secrets, wield powerful weapons, and face epic bosses in a world inspired by the Koatl comics.

demos.name: A Rhapsody In Steam Demo
demos.short_description:
The expedition against the Dark Lord is long delayed, but the railway keeps pushing north.
You ride as the Hero's advisor. The carriage is your transport — and your home. People along the way come to recognize you. Marks pile up on the walls.
The Dark Lord is still in the north. The road is long.

demos.name: The Aether Project TD Demo
demos.short_description: The Aether Project TD is a classic 3D tower defense game built around tower placement, upgrades, varied enemy threats, active abilities, and different ways of surviving each level. Defend against structured waves or continuous attacks, adapt your defenses, and hold the line.

demos.name: The Ardmore: Last Shift Demo
demos.short_description: Forty-five minutes. One night. Run the elevator at the Ardmore Hotel, New York, 1937. The hotel is not what it seems, and neither are its rules. A demo from the upcoming psychological horror game.

demos.name: Throne of Decisions Demo
demos.short_description: Throne of Decisions is a medieval card-based strategy game where every choice shapes the future. As King, you must maintain the balance of power by approving or rejecting the petitions of your subjects. Determine the fate of your people and lead your kingdom to glory or ruin.

demos.name: Nytherra Demo
demos.short_description: A cozy 2D adventure where you explore, gather resources, turn them into profit, craft, and battle enemies to save a fading world before time runs out.

demos.name: Real Life Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Rise to the top of trade with your friends! Buy and sell second-hand goods, establish a car dealership, manage the real estate market, and own the biggest businesses in the city. Real Life Simulator combines all trading simulations in a 2D Co-op world.

demos.name: Florp Farming Demo
demos.short_description:
Shake tree, get apple, feed florp, profit. Florp Farming is a mostly-idle farming game about building a capitalist empire one honk at a time. Automate your farm with magnets, moles, machines and make the money never stop.

Can you get $10,000 and buy the dog?

demos.name: Limited Space Demo
demos.short_description: Frantic 1–4 player co-op space survival. Build defenses, repair your ship, and hold out as endless asteroid waves tear everything apart.

demos.name: Three Kingdoms:BOND BENCHMARK DEMO
demos.short_description:
The "THREE KINGDOMS: BOND BENCHMARK DEMO" is a demo designed to help you check three specific points in advance, ensuring a smooth and comfortable experience when playing the full game.
Clear these 3 checks, and step into the battlefield of THREE KINGDOMS: BOND!

demos.name: Aboxcalipse Demo
demos.short_description: Grab cure materials, build boxes and load them onto the truck while smashing zombies with them along the way. In Aboxcalipse, you and your friend are warehouse workers in a zombie apocalypse who use the stock itself as a weapon to survive

demos.name: Dumb Dunks - Demo
demos.short_description: Dumb Dunks! is a wildly creative, satirical twist on basketball where every level throws a ridiculous new object and target at you. Master tricky physics, perfect your timing, and embrace the chaos in this humorous physics-based dunking frenzy.

demos.name: Alyanom Demo
demos.short_description: Work your first shift at Alyanom, featuring one level set in a museum where you must work with up to 4 players to memorize the layout of the room and detect if any anomalies occur during each loop.

demos.name: SCP: Antimemetics Division Demo
demos.short_description: No, it's not your first day. The Amnestics have kicked in, and Site-48 has locked down. Scavenge restricted gear, gain clearance to forgotten levels, and bend reality to escape lethal SCP anomalies. Tactile survival horror where remembering too much will get you annihilated.

demos.name: Unreal Race Demo
demos.short_description: Unreal Race is a real-time racing simulation game. Simulate competitions ranging from 2 to over 999 competitors. Place bets, spice up the race with powers, create custom tracks, and analyze results across multiple game modes !

demos.name: Don't Block My Ads! Demo
demos.short_description:
At the head of your own advertising agency, generate maximum conversions!
Customize your campaigns, leverage social media, and master the latest trends to attract more and more clients and build a true commercial empire. Will you be able to seize every opportunity?

demos.name: Satan's Fall Demo
demos.short_description:
Satan has fallen. Now fight your way back up.
A brutal top-down bullet hell roguelite where you play as the Devil himself. Upgrade your arsenal, unlock demonic powers, and face relentless hordes of Heaven's finest.
Apparently, running Hell isn't as easy as it looks.

demos.name: Miniature LAND -Four Seasons- Demo
demos.short_description:
An escape room adventure set in a handcrafted miniature world.
Can you find your way back home?

demos.name: Miss Rosen's Wowtastic! Marching Band Demo
Where Are The Alices? - Demo
demos.short_description: Detect lies and break the denizens of Wonderland in this noir thriller. As Detective Juno, confront contradictions within the corrupt WoodHale under a ticking clock. Manage your trauma and extract confessions. Are you a good person?

demos.name: Changeable Guardian ESTIQUE Demo
demos.short_description:
A spectacular, satisfying, and super-watchable defense battle! 
The ultimate 8-bit shoot 'em ups born in the 21st century, ""Changeable Guardian ESTIQUE"", is now on Steam!

demos.name: ZENONIA Demo
demos.short_description:
Remember the RPG that defined a generation?
ZENONIA is back—faithfully restored and now on Steam.
Relive the adventure that kept you playing for hours, or experience it for the first time.

demos.name: Abyss Ring Demo
demos.short_description:
Survive, cook, and conquer!
Cook monsters to stave off hunger in this roguelike as you reach the deepest floor. With 200+ equipment items and random dungeons, every run offers endless possibilities.

demos.name: Rotted - A Brain Rot Simulator Demo
Sepulchron Demo
demos.short_description: Trapped within Astor Manor, you have 72 hours to escape with your life. Solve challenging puzzles by day, endure deadly supernatural assaults by night, and uncover the truth behind the curse threatening your survival.

demos.name: Samurai: Ronin's Path Demo
demos.short_description: Samurai: Ronin's Path is a dynamic action game set in feudal Japan. Fight in true samurai style, unlock new abilities, avoid death, and cut down your enemies using an extensive arsenal available to Asian warriors.

demos.name: Glory Hole Barista Demo
demos.short_description: A short, sweet, 3D simulation game about a café with a "unique" marketing strategy! And in case you were wondering, no, you won't be serving coffee...

demos.name: Aksun Demo
demos.short_description: A hack & slash roguelite rooted in Korean shamanism. Descend to the dark shadows of Aksun, chain hundreds of elemental artifacts and abilities into devastating reactions, and break the cursed cycle.

demos.name: Uh Oh Airlines Demo
demos.short_description: Serve drinks, wrangle passengers, and survive turbulence in this silly solo or co-op flight attendant simulator. Handle routine cabin duties while everything goes hilariously wrong, from loose pets to spiraling passenger panic. It’s pure cabin chaos at 30,000 feet!

demos.name: The Rain Spirit : Code Breaker Demo
demos.short_description: An atmospheric, folk-horror adventure game about uncovering hidden codes in a cursed rain-soaked world. A blend of adventure, fantasy and horror. Uncover a huge interactive world filled with codes , clues and puzzles to unlock in different areas.

demos.name: Good Children Say Grace Demo
demos.short_description: My parents sacrificed an orphan to the red egg. She came back home that night. How will the two of us survive the hunger? Good Children Say Grace.

demos.name: For The Cat! Sorcerer's Revenge Demo
demos.short_description: They killed your cat. Fatal mistake. In this magic-infused bullet-heaven roguelike, develop your wizard, upgrade and evolve spells, collect items, and create unstoppable builds while battling hordes of enemies.

demos.name: Shadows of Kepler Demo
demos.short_description: Shadows of Kepler is a Sci-Fi Horror Survival game with RPG elements which brings an unique style in first person. Walking on the shoes of Seargent Cooper and help him make the right choices in this terrifying journey. Don't let the planet Kepler tame you, keep the human hope alive.

demos.name: The Core Demo
demos.short_description: Discover a world of mystery and self-discovery with The Core, an immersive action-adventure game. As an autonomous AI core, you awaken alone in a long-forgotten facility, your memory lost. Embark on a thrilling journey to uncover your true identity and unravel the purpose behind your creation.

demos.name: Panic Protocol Demo
demos.short_description: A 1-4 player co-op horror game, where you guide your friends through a dangerous research facility. Use the CCTV system to observe enemies, set traps and interact with the environment. Extract with the research materials before time runs out. This is the demo version.

demos.name: Ducks in Disguise Demo
demos.short_description: Ducks in Disguise is a cozy hand-drawn hidden object game where you find hundreds of hidden rubber ducks in intricate 2D illustrations and collect them in your personal scrapbook.

demos.name: Hex Town Demo
demos.short_description: Hidden objects, logic puzzles, city-building, and (optional) multiplayer shenanigans all wrapped up into a beautiful, no-stress cozy game you can zone out to.

demos.name: Weather Roll Demo
demos.short_description: Weather Roll is a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder. Wield rare Mana to awaken unique, charming plant girls, fend off monster hordes across four seasons. Use Weather Dice to rewind time, change weather, turn the tide in despair, and defend your last home!

demos.name: Kusan: City of Wolves Demo
demos.short_description: Kusan: City of Wolves is a high-octane hardcore top-down shooter set in a brutal urban jungle ruled by gunfire and corruption. Play the demo and wishlist today.

demos.name: Fantasy Network Demo
demos.short_description: Fantasy Network is a metroidvania game with a social media twist - a socialvania! Explore the colorful world of Holua and chat to hand-drawn, larger-than-life characters to discover a story that runs deeper than it may seem.

demos.name: For Stella: Prologue
demos.short_description:
“Why would someone who has spent their entire life suppressing their emotions suddenly pull you aside to talk about love?”
「For Stella」is an interactive narrative game centered around mental health conditions.

demos.name: Legend of Idle Demo
demos.short_description: Legend of Idle is an Incremental Idle Game, where you rebuild your kingdom, recruit an army and capture dungeons! Gather ressources and defeat Evil to bring peace again! Inspired by the classic SNES aesthetics!

demos.name: Oar We There Yet? Demo
demos.short_description: Raft down a river while you try to wrangle your stupid friends.

demos.name: Kalanoro Demo
demos.short_description: Kalanoro is an action-adventure platformer where you build a band of lemur artists. Explore Lemuria, recruit lemur musicians, grow your band and use platforming and combat to fight the witch Raneny, one song at a time.

demos.name: Winemaker Simulator Demo
demos.short_description: Step into the Medieval Mediterranean and live the life of a winemaker. From growing your vineyard to harvesting, from crafting wine to trading, every decision shapes your future. Will you be the one who creates the most exquisite and valuable wine? 🍷

demos.name: Amelia's Escape Demo
demos.short_description: Amelia’s Escape is a VR escape room with an interwoven narrative! Take on the character of Amelia to solve puzzles to escape the room of a time travel obsessed scientist! Will you be able to escape?

demos.name: Outpath VR Demo
demos.short_description: An experimental VR base building game. Craft, gather & manage resources, build your base and buy more islands to exploit and expand!

demos.name: Kings Archer VR Demo
demos.short_description: In this atmospheric world dominated by darkness and snowstorms, you stand on the walls of a massive fortress, the kingdom's last line of defense.

demos.name: Heave Ho 2 Demo
demos.short_description: Get a grip, it’s Heave Ho 2! The insane 2-4 player party game sequel takes the couch co-op mayhem online for the first time. Grab what you can and swing to win!

demos.name: Blind Touch VR Demo
demos.short_description: Experience blindness in VR. Navigate a world of darkness using your guide cane, immerse yourself in a sensory journey through sound and touch.

demos.name: Fish Lab Demo
demos.short_description: A short incremental game where you collect fish for your lab. Upgrade by making discoveries. Synced to music.

demos.name: Fixer Undercover Demo
demos.short_description: Unscrew ventilation panels, reroute circuits, and dismantle security systems using nothing but hand tools and logic. Fixer Undercover is a spy-themed puzzle game that puts a screwdriver in your hand instead of a gun. Think like a repairman. Infiltrate like a spy. Demo – Chapter 1 of 7.

demos.name: Hack 'n' Stack Demo
demos.short_description: Physics meets tower defense in this chaotic party game for 1 to 4 players. Craft barricades and turrets with whatever you can find. But beware: relentless waves of enemies are coming to tear down everything you build.

demos.name: エロスの記憶 ～エッチで世界を救う物語～ 体験版
demos.store_url: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4781280/エロスの記憶_エッチで世界を救う物語_体験版

demos.name: Wade: Fly Fishing Demo
demos.short_description: Wade is a realistic fly fishing simulation with carefully crafted rod and line physics, river currents, and fish fights that demand all your focus to catch and not lose a fish.

demos.name: BRAMBLEFORT Demo
demos.short_description: BRAMBLEFORT is a VR survival horror game built for exploration, immersion, and weighty combat. Journey through a desolate North Atlantic island, where rotting huts gradually give way to towering Victorian mansions as you make your way toward its center.

demos.name: Hyperstacks Demo
demos.short_description:
A VR world of combat, parkour, logic-driven puzzles, memorable characters, and community-made levels.
Meet its residents through quests and discover a growing library of player creations built with Hyperstacks’ powerful level editor.

demos.name: Spies & Soldiers Demo
demos.short_description: A game of strategy and subterfuge that plays out across watercolor maps of a procedurally generated kingdom. Go head-to-head in turn-based conflicts as your empire expands across each new world, but while your soldiers’ swords may conquer the land, your hidden spies could win you the game.

demos.name: Wind Runners Demo
demos.short_description: Wind Runners is a high-speed bullet-hell dogfighting roguelite where you start as a lone pilot, turning each flight into a fight for freedom. Face the ruthless technotheist Realm, take on relentless fleets and colossal bosses, and let your victories ignite a growing resistance across the star system

demos.name: Axe Gang Demo
demos.short_description:
Sci-Fi Balloon demo 
is representing graphics that will be in the Axe Gang. 
And a special Axe Gang's vehicle that you can try!
keyboard included

demos.name: Mike & Tyler Demo
demos.short_description: Investigate a mysterious murder with Mike and Tyler in a Miami Vice–inspired point-and-click adventure. Solve puzzles, analyze clues, and deduce suspects — all without a single line of dialogue.

demos.name: HyperCore Demo
demos.short_description: HyperCore is a “Rhythm bullet hell”, mixing the frenetic action of classic bullet hell shoot'em up with semi-procedurally generated encounters based on the music.

demos.name: Iron Frontier Demo
demos.short_description: Iron Frontier is a single-player strategy rogue-lite with the spirit of classic RTS. Draft a fresh army from random units and boost them with powerful synergies. Defend your base, crush the enemy, and make hard moral choices that shape the campaign and dictate the war's outcome.

demos.name: Wilgold's Playground Demo
demos.short_description: Challenges await in the Demo of Wilgold's Playground, a third-person ragdoll physics adventure in a time attack format. Witness the beginning of the journey of Ray, as he is trapped in a world full of mysteries, and test out your skills in a more advanced challenge as well.

demos.name: Occulto Demo
demos.short_description: Occulto is an indie adventure with artistic hand-drawn visuals and non-verbal gameplay. Guide Eliot through an eerie world of silent riddles and unsettling creatures to find his master. Experience a haunting journey where every hand-crafted detail hides a chilling mystery.

demos.name: Rogue Blight Demo
demos.short_description: Rogue Blight is a rogue-lite with focus on souls-like combat, featuring a Slay The Spire-inspired map system. Fight your way through ever-changing maps. Customize your playstyle based on what you find. Death is punishing. Only skill and persistence will carry you forward.

demos.name: Mirth Island Demo
demos.short_description: Mirth Island is a cozy rhythm adventure game where you play as Dodo, a young duck, who returns home and teams up with his friends to rebuild the island’s legendary theater. Explore a vibrant island, interact with charming locals, and enjoy fun rhythm games.

demos.name: K-pop Idol Stories - Road to Debut Demo
demos.short_description:
Start your dream idol group in this demo of K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut! 

Manage your first six weeks as a K-pop manager by discovering trainees, scheduling their weekly training and activities, and guiding them toward debut success.

highlights.trailer_name: K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut | Release Date Announcement

demos.name: Wonder Air: Lunara's Adventure Demo
demos.short_description: “Wonder Air: Lunara’s Adventure” is a fantasy flying action game where players can freely soar through a beautifully rendered 3D world.

demos.name: Demra: Rifts of War Demo
demos.short_description: Classic 90s RTS gameplay mixed with direct hero control and grid-based real-time movement. Command your army and wield powerful light magic to fend off the demon invasion.

demos.name: Wanderer Wheels Demo
demos.short_description: Wanderer Wheels is a cozy, story-driven experience where you travel quiet countryside roads in a mobile van shop, meet strangers, trade goods, and take small jobs, each step bringing you closer to helping your wife receive the care she needs.

demos.name: Shards of the Heart Demo
demos.short_description: A dark RPG blending mystery, fantasy, and romance. When a strange girl appears in Sawyer's town, demons follow. Uncover hidden truths, build relationships, and fight to protect what remains.

highlights.trailer_name: Shards of the Heart Demo Trailer

demos.name: Liquidation Demo
demos.short_description: Enter the war-torn world of Veá, where sci-fi and fantasy collide in Liquidation, an immersive RTS. Lead your armies and harness powerful abilities in a high-stakes battle for Quenrium, the mysterious substance that holds Veá’s fate.

demos.name: Kill the Man in the House Demo
demos.short_description: A game about killing a man in a house. This single-player, first-person tactical shooter provides a sandbox for hectic, visceral combat on a variety of semi-open world maps.

demos.name: Heroes Suck Demo
demos.short_description: A physics-driven tower defense where you play the dungeon. Lay out traps and launch waves of invading "heroes" who are, charitably, bad at their job. They walk into every snare, complain about their knees, ask where the restroom is, and leave with the cheese wheels.

demos.name: Chicken Scratch Demo
demos.short_description: Chicken Scratch is a quirky multiplayer drawing game with broken telephone mechanics. Play with up to 7 of your friends as bird co-workers trying to keep your job at Chicken Scratch. Work together on confusing cases where you'll be drawing, captioning and then trying to guess the original meaning.

demos.name: Sweet Dreams Dahlia Demo
demos.short_description: Hand-drawn metroidvania where you play as two characters: Dahlia and her companion Axo. Reveal the mysteries of the Tower, explore forgotten biomes, master ancient combat techniques, and face the consequences of your absence. Every discovery brings you closer to the truth behind Dahlia's awakening.

demos.name: Denari Demo
demos.short_description:
Denari is a narrative action game about a boy with telekinetic powers who must fight to save his people from the invasion of an empire.

Master fast-paced hack and slash combat, take down epic bosses and follow a young warrior's coming-of-age journey as he becomes the protector of his people.

demos.name: PsyX Demo
demos.short_description: Sometimes, regrets come too late. When you're over 40, you start to rethink your life. You remember people and events that completely changed you. I will tell you 7 stories that happened to me in childhood, after which I became a different person.

demos.name: The Crimson Maid Demo
demos.short_description: As a secret celestial curse takes hold of his father, a young cleric finds himself enraptured by the charms of a strikingly beautiful maid. A period drama that combines romance and murder mystery, with a dash of supernatural.

demos.name: Bohnice: Within The Mind Demo
demos.short_description: Uncover the dark secrets of Prague's Bohnice Asylum. As an investigative journalist, you must document forbidden experiments and chilling paranormal encounters. Collect photographic evidence and survive the horrifying truth hidden for 40 years.
